text.title: 影行者
text.objectives: 跟灰谷朵丹尼尔兽穴入口外的盖凡·影行者谈一谈。
text.description: 恶魔之门既然被关闭，森林的力量也该复苏。一定要找到森林之心！$B$B盖凡·影行者是一名强大的利爪德鲁伊，他朝西南出发，越过冥火岭，前往朵丹尼尔兽穴去了。森林之心就在那里。它被埋藏在深深的地下，由灰谷的德鲁伊们保护着。$B$B找到盖凡，$N，告诉他所发生的一切。
text.completion: You are brave to come here, $c, but you may be too late. All of the druids are either dead or have been driven insane. Still, your tale is intriguing, and if what you say is true, then Gnarl must have the Forest Heart and soon, or Ashenvale will begin to wither!

english.title: The Shadewalker
english.objectives: Speak with Gaivan Shadewalker pacing outside the entrance to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den in Ashenvale.
english.description: Now that the demon gates have been destroyed, the power of the forest must be replenished. The Forest Heart must be retrieved!$B$BGaivan Shadewalker, a powerful druid of the claw, has gone southwest, past Felfire Hill, to the Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Therein rests the Forest Heart. It is protected by the druids of Ashenvale deep below the ground.$B$BSeek out Gaivan and tell him of what has transpired, $N.
english.completion: You are brave to come here, $c, but you may be too late. All of the druids are either dead or have been driven insane. Still, your tale is intriguing, and if what you say is true, then Gnarl must have the Forest Heart and soon, or Ashenvale will begin to wither!

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: 将四枚冠军的印记交给银色比武场的伊尔蕾·夜幕。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 作为冠军，你已经掌握了骑乘战斗的技巧，击败了各种层次的对手。但你还是要继续练习，确保在锦标赛正式开始之后可以击败所有对手。$B$B你应该继续磨练自己的战斗技巧，了解对手的弱点。代表各个城市参战的冠军都在手兽栏旁的冠军赛场中练习。到兽栏中去骑上属于你的坐骑，然后面对各位冠军的挑战吧。
text.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
text.completion: You handle your mount well, $n. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
text.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$B$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, and pick any mount you're permitted to ride, then face the champions.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: You handle your mount well, $n. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
english.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 纯洁者耶德瑞克
text.objectives: Speak with Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: I have asked my brothers of the Argent Crusade to work closely with those who rise to the rank of champion. Eadric the Pure, our brotherhood's grand champion, helps oversee training exercises for champions from all cities and helps them make their final preparations for tournament competition.$B$BPlease go and introduce yourself to him. I know he'll be eager to meet you and work with you on your way to competing against Azeroth's greatest champions.
text.completion: It's good to finally meet you, champion. The highlord has asked me to help coordinate the efforts of all champions to train together and bolster the defenses of the tournament grounds.

english.title: Eadric the Pure
english.objectives: Speak with Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I have asked my brothers of the Argent Crusade to work closely with those who rise to the rank of champion. Eadric the Pure, our brotherhood's grand champion, helps oversee training exercises for champions from all cities and helps them make their final preparations for tournament competition.$B$BPlease go and introduce yourself to him. I know he'll be eager to meet you and work with you on your way to competing against Azeroth's greatest champions.
english.completion: It's good to finally meet you, champion. The highlord has asked me to help coordinate the efforts of all champions to train together and bolster the defenses of the tournament grounds.

text.title: The Scourgebane
text.objectives: Speak with Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: The leader of the Knights of the Ebon Blade delegation has asked to speak you, $c. Crok Scourgebane is as fearsome a combatant as they come and I have no doubt he'll have much to ask of you.$B$BThe Knights of the Ebon Blade have made camp on the north side of the tournament grounds, west of the tent housing the Alliance delegations.
text.completion: So you have become a champion, $n. I had no doubt that it would happen. We knights have been trained in the heat of battle, not in front of wooden dummies. Let's show the paladins and their guests what battle has made us.

english.title: The Scourgebane
english.objectives: Speak with Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The leader of the Knights of the Ebon Blade delegation has asked to speak you, $c. Crok Scourgebane is as fearsome a combatant as they come and I have no doubt he'll have much to ask of you.$B$BThe Knights of the Ebon Blade have made camp on the north side of the tournament grounds, west of the tent housing the Alliance delegations.
english.completion: So you have become a champion, $n. I had no doubt that it would happen. We knights have been trained in the heat of battle, not in front of wooden dummies. Let's show the paladins and their guests what battle has made us.

text.title: 森林之心
text.objectives: 获得森林之心。
text.description: 你必须不惜一切代价，把森林之心带给纳亚尔！$B$B它就位于朵丹尼尔兽穴最深处，被部落所腐化。只有纳亚尔才能将其净化。$B$B但是，想要移动它，你需要自然之力。假如你从痛苦德鲁伊和守护者身上收集一定未被污染的灵魂，它们就能组成一道自然之力。$B$B祝你好运，$N！
text.progress: $n, you have returned.
text.completion: The Forest Heart! It's corrupted! Stand back, $n, I will try to cleanse the heart before all is lost!
text.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: The Forest Heart
english.objectives: Obtain the Forest Heart.
english.description: You must get the Forest Heart to Gnarl at all costs!$B$BDown at the bottom of the Dor'Danil Barrow Den it sits, corrupted by the Horde. Only Gnarl can cleanse it.$B$BIn order to move it, though, you'll need a Power of Nature. If you collect enough untainted spirits from the Severed druids and keepers, the spirits can be combined into a Power of Nature.$B$BGood luck, $N!
english.progress: $n, you have returned.
english.completion: The Forest Heart! It's corrupted! Stand back, $n, I will try to cleanse the heart before all is lost!
english.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 肮脏的种子
text.objectives: 搜索新近挖掘的石块堆并找到10大块矿石。
text.description: 德娜卡需要的是某种磁石——可以将她的恶魔飞弹吸引过去。$B$B<杜莱克诡诈地笑了笑。>$B$B我碰巧知道一个办法可以满足咱们的要求。$B$B你到矿井里找些拳头大小的矿石来，我来准备一个特别的……附魔术。
text.progress: Have you collected the ore we need?
text.completion: Well done! These should hold a curse long enough for our purposes....
text.completed: Return to Durak at the Splintertree Mines in Ashenvale.

english.title: Dirty Deeds
english.objectives: Search the piles of Fresh Rubble to find 10 Chunks of Ore.
english.description: What Draaka requires is a magnet of sorts - something that her demonic missiles will be drawn to.$b$b<Durak grins slyly.>$b$bI happen to know of a method that should suit our purposes.$b$bYou scour the mines for fist-sized chunks of ore, while I prepare a special... enchantment.
english.progress: Have you collected the ore we need?
english.completion: Well done! These should hold a curse long enough for our purposes....
english.completed: Return to Durak at the Splintertree Mines in Ashenvale.

text.title: 毁灭之雨
text.objectives: 使用被诅咒的矿石为德娜卡制导，目标是杀死30名暗夜精灵部队以及5棵暴怒的古树。$B$B跟杜莱克交谈以重新获得小鬼伪装。
text.description: Just in time, $c. The elves have launched another attack!$b$bFrom the guard towers, use the Accursed Ore to mark targets for Draaka.$b$bHer projectiles will strike your target and erupt in fel magic flame, destroying any nearby enemies.$b$bThere is strong prejudice against the use of demonic magics. Unjustified, but real nonetheless. For this reason, I will transform you into an imp for the duration of the mission to prevent you from being identified.
text.completion: Did you feel it, $n!? The raw fel power seething through your being? There is nothing else like it!
text.completed: While in imp form, Speak to Durak in Splintertree Mines.

english.title: Rain of Destruction
english.objectives: Using Accursed Ore to mark targets for Draaka, you are to kill 30 Night Elf troops and 5 Raging Ancients.$b$bSpeak with Durak to reapply Imp Disguise.
english.description: Just in time, $c. The elves have launched another attack!$b$bFrom the guard towers, use the Accursed Ore to mark targets for Draaka.$b$bHer projectiles will strike your target and erupt in fel magic flame, destroying any nearby enemies.$b$bThere is strong prejudice against the use of demonic magics. Unjustified, but real nonetheless. For this reason, I will transform you into an imp for the duration of the mission to prevent you from being identified.
english.completion: Did you feel it, $n!? The raw fel power seething through your being? There is nothing else like it!
english.completed: While in imp form, Speak to Durak in Splintertree Mines.

text.title: Where Are My Keys?
text.objectives: Dr. Fingers wants you to kill his evil clone, Evil Fingers, and retrieve his keys.
text.description: I can't find my keys -- I suspect my evil twin is at fault. "Take care" of him for me, $N.

english.title: Where Are My Keys?
english.objectives: Dr. Fingers wants you to kill his evil clone, Evil Fingers, and retrieve his keys.
english.description: I can't find my keys -- I suspect my evil twin is at fault. "Take care" of him for me, $N.

text.title: Get My Keys!
text.objectives: Find Dr. Fingers' Keys.
text.description: 抓住他们！

english.title: Get My Keys!
english.objectives: Find Dr. Fingers' Keys.
english.description: Get 'em!

text.title: 死精灵上路
text.objectives: 消灭朵丹尼尔兽穴的任意15只暗夜精灵鬼魂。
text.description: 你——你听见没有？是鬼！我恨鬼！$B$B它们可怕的嚎叫一直从南边的兽穴传来。啊啊！让它们别叫唤了！！$B$B求求你，$G先生:小姐;，只要你能把这声音从我脑子里赶出去，我愿意付大价钱！
text.completion: Woohooo!! You've silenced the voices! Thank you, thank you!
text.completed: Speak to Pixel in Splintertree Post.

english.title: Dead Elves Walking
english.objectives: Destroy any 15 of the night elf ghosts at Dor'danil Barrow Den.
english.description: D-did you hear that? Ghosts! I hate ghosts!$b$bTheir eerie howls are coming from the barrows to the south. Ahhh! Make them stop!!$b$bPlease, $gmister:missy; I'll pay good money to get those voices out of my head!
english.completion: Woohooo!! You've silenced the voices! Thank you, thank you!
english.completed: Speak to Pixel in Splintertree Post.

text.title: The Goblin with Two Brains
text.objectives: Bring a Slobberfang Murloc Brain Stem to Professor Flozz along the coast.
text.description: Do you see them, along the shore? Such magnificent specimens! Look at their primitive society in action, working like a well-oiled machine from the lowliest grunt to their leader, who I've named "King Burgrurble."$B$BI must study their brains.$B$BCan you procure an intact Slobberfang Murloc brain stem for me? Kill them - for science!

english.title: The Goblin with Two Brains
english.objectives: Bring a Slobberfang Murloc Brain Stem to Professor Flozz along the coast.
english.description: Do you see them, along the shore? Such magnificent specimens! Look at their primitive society in action, working like a well-oiled machine from the lowliest grunt to their leader, who I've named "King Burgrurble."$B$BI must study their brains.$B$BCan you procure an intact Slobberfang Murloc brain stem for me? Kill them - for science!

text.title: 弱者的血
text.objectives: Kadrak wants you to bring the Blood-Soaked Axe to Durak in Splintertree Post.
text.description: 我们知道精灵不会束手待毙，但是没想到他们居然会围攻碎木岗哨……$B$B该让他们为自己的行动付出代价！$B$B附近的朵丹尼尔兽穴有件敌人垂涎不已的宝贝——森林之心。$B$B我要找个人去那里把它腐化掉。$B$B那个人就是你，$N。$B$B不过首先，把我的斧子给矿井里的杜莱克带去，他要我们敌人的血有用。
text.completion: Tainting the Forest's Heart? How ruthless - an utterly vicious blow.... I adore the idea!
text.completed: Bring the Blood-Soaked Axe to Durak in Splintertree Post.

english.title: Blood of the Weak
english.objectives: Kadrak wants you to bring the Blood-Soaked Axe to Durak in Splintertree Post.
english.description: We knew the elves wouldn't go down without a fight, but no one expected them to be able to lay siege to Splintertree...$b$bTime for them to pay for their actions!$b$bNearby, in the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, lies something very dear to the enemy - the Forest Heart.$b$bI need someone to make their way to the heart and corrupt it.$b$bThat someone is you, $n.$b$bFirst though, bring my axe to Durak here in the mines. He'll make use of the blood of our enemies.
english.completion: Tainting the Forest's Heart? How ruthless - an utterly vicious blow.... I adore the idea!
english.completed: Bring the Blood-Soaked Axe to Durak in Splintertree Post.

text.title: To Catch a Fish-Thing
text.objectives: Place a trap and use the remote to capture a live Slobberfang Murloc. Return the filled trap to Professor Flozz.
text.description: 看看这些结果！这样一种独特的电化妆 - 啊，但我不怀疑低$C会理解我在这里发现的巨大。我需要一个活体标本，$B$BI将会自己购买一个，但显然他们会咬人。$B$B我已经配置好这个陷阱来磨练他们独特的大脑模式。只要设置陷阱，然后按下这个按钮来吸取一个Slobberfang。但首先，我需要你签署这个赔偿豁免。这项技术是流血的！

english.title: To Catch a Fish-Thing
english.objectives: Place a trap and use the remote to capture a live Slobberfang Murloc. Return the filled trap to Professor Flozz.
english.description: Look at these results! Such a unique electrochemical makeup -- ah, but I wouldn't suspect a lowly $c would understand the magnormity of what I've discovered here. I'll need a live specimen.$B$BI would acquire one myself, but apparently they bite.$B$BHere, I've configured this trap to hone in on their unique brain patterns. Just set the trap, then hit this button to slurp up a Slobberfang. But first, I'll need you to sign this indemnification waiver. This technology is bleeding edge!

text.title: 刺穿他们的心！
text.objectives: Durak wants you to use the Tainted Blood of the Kaldorei on the Forest's Heart.
text.description: 给……$B$B卡多雷阵亡者的血已经转化好了。现在，你可以对朵丹尼尔兽穴的森林之心使用这种鲜血，将其完全腐化。$B$B用傲慢的精灵们自己的圣器来对付他们，多么富有诗意！$B$B<杜莱克残忍地放声大笑。>$B$B兽穴就坐落在山丘的东南边。我的小鬼在入口处留下了一道血迹，可以指引你找到那颗心。$B$B动作快点！卡德拉克可没什么耐心。$B$B去吧，$C。
text.completion: It is done? Good work, $n. That will gradually weaken their forces, as well as their spirit.
text.completed: Report to Kadrak in Splintertree Post.

english.title: Pierce Their Heart!
english.objectives: Durak wants you to use the Tainted Blood of the Kaldorei on the Forest's Heart.
english.description: There...$b$bThe blood of the fallen Kaldorei is turned. It can now be used on the Forest Heart in Dor'Danil Barrow Den. Doing so will utterly corrupt it.$b$bThe sacred relic of the arrogant elves will be turned against them. How poetic!$b$b<Durak laughs cruelly.>$b$bThe barrow den lies nestled against the hills to the southeast. One of my imps has laid a blood trail from the entrance to the heart.$b$bMake haste! Kadrak is not likely to be in a patient mood.$b$bOff you go, $c.
english.completion: It is done? Good work, $n. That will gradually weaken their forces, as well as their spirit.
english.completed: Report to Kadrak in Splintertree Post.

text.title: 恶魔使命
text.objectives: 碎木的洛克·奥卡尔要你关闭萨提纳尔和萨维亚的12座萨特传送门。
text.description: 听好，$C，我知道碎木被围困，大家都身心俱疲，但假如我们把萨特传送门的事情抛诸脑后，就会不得不在此后面对一个更大的危机。$B$B<洛克看着面无表情的你。>$B$B你不知道传送门的事情？$B$B就在东北边的萨提纳尔和萨维亚区域，萨特试图召唤恶魔为自己助阵。$B$B不管我们在这里面对什么麻烦，都要把关闭传送门放在议程上！
text.completion: Good work, $r. One less thing we have to worry about!

english.title: Demon Duty
english.objectives: Locke Okarr in Splintertree wants you to close 12 Satyr Portals in Satyrnaar and Xavian.
english.description: Listen, $c, I know this assault on Splintertree has everyone worked up, but if we forget about the satyr portals we'll come out of this crisis to face an even larger one.$b$b<Locke stares at your expressionless face.>$b$bYou don't know about the portals?$b$bTo the northeast, in the regions of Satyrnaar and Xavian, the satyrs are attempting to summon in demons to bolster their numbers.$b$bWe must be vigilant in closing those portals, no matter what issues we face here!
english.completion: Good work, $r. One less thing we have to worry about!

text.title: 不可能是真的任务
text.objectives: Kadrak wants you to use the Secret Signal Powder on the Smoldering Brazier across from Satyrnaar.
text.description: 我有项特别的任务，需要一名全副武装、能力出众的$C来完成。既然没有别的人选，我想只好屈就于你了……$B$B敌人攻打了战歌伐木营地，把它从我们的部队手里割离了出来。一名重要的血精灵外交官被困在了那里，她本是要前往奥格瑞玛的。$B$B必须把她救出来。$B$B沿着这条路朝东北走，将这些粉末撒在闷烧火盆里，召唤我们的特工。一切都听从他的指挥。$B$B解散！
text.completion: You have your work cut out for you here, friend. Let's hope that you're up to the task,,,,
text.completed: Speak with Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier across from Satyrnaar.

english.title: Mission Improbable
english.objectives: Kadrak wants you to use the Secret Signal Powder on the Smoldering Brazier across from Satyrnaar.
english.description: I have a special mission that requires a well equipped, competent $c. As I have no one else to spare, I suppose I'll have to settle for you...$b$bThe enemy has assaulted Warsong Lumber Camp and cut it off from the rest of our forces. An important blood elf diplomat en route to Orgrimmar is trapped there.$b$bShe must be liberated.$b$bTake the road northeast and pour this powder into the smoldering brazier to summon our operative there. Do whatever he might require of you.$b$bDismissed!
english.completion: You have your work cut out for you here, friend. Let's hope that you're up to the task,,,,
english.completed: Speak with Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier across from Satyrnaar.

text.title: 临近的威胁
text.objectives: Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
text.description: Highlord Tirion Fordring has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. He doesn't believe that they will stop just because their Black Knight has been defeated.$B$BOur skytalon scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party. If we don't intercept them, the tournament will come under attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
text.completion: $n, you and your allies have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. Though our skytalon riders are brave, they  have their hands full keeping the peace on the tournament grounds and would be hard-pressed to defend the skies against the cult's attack. You have the thanks of the Argent Crusade and all who have gathered here to compete.
text.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: Highlord Tirion Fordring has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. He doesn't believe that they will stop just because their Black Knight has been defeated.$B$BOur skytalon scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party. If we don't intercept them, the tournament will come under attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
english.completion: $n, you and your allies have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. Though our skytalon riders are brave, they  have their hands full keeping the peace on the tournament grounds and would be hard-pressed to defend the skies against the cult's attack. You have the thanks of the Argent Crusade and all who have gathered here to compete.
english.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的塞利安·碎日要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭这些诅咒教派的成员。
text.description: 这座竞技场坐落在世界上最危险的地方，$N。为了把这块土地从天灾军团手中夺过来，我们历经苦难，付出了极其沉重的代价。然而敌人仍然在持续不断地向我们发动攻击，仿佛他们有着无穷无尽的后备队。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，干掉你遇到的所有天灾士兵。
text.completion: You are a true champion, $n, both inside the ring and on the field. We must all be vigilant against the Scourge and you are a great example to our brethren and your own people.
text.completed: Return to Cellian Daybreak at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
text.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

english.title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
english.objectives: Cellian Daybreak at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill cultists in any part of Icecrown.
english.description: The coliseum is perched in the most dangerous part of the world, $N. The territory we've taken from the Scourge has been paid for in blood and misery, yet the enemy continues to strike back with a seemingly limitless army. To make matters worse, this undead army is supported and assisted by mortal sympathizers, the Cult of the Damned.$B$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any cultists you encounter.
english.completion: You are a true champion, $n, both inside the ring and on the field. We must all be vigilant against the Scourge and you are a great example to our brethren and your own people.
english.completed: Return to Cellian Daybreak at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: 将四枚冠军的印记交给银色比武场的鲁莉。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 作为冠军，你已经掌握了骑乘战斗的技巧，击败了各种层次的对手。现在，那些被你击败的对手正在加倍努力训练，当锦标赛开始的时候，他们会卷土重来，报那败北之仇。$B$B你最好不要松懈，继续与冠军赛场中的斗士们切磋，磨练自己的战斗技巧。代表各个城市参战的冠军都在手兽栏旁的冠军赛场中练习。拿起你的长枪，到兽栏中去骑上属于你的坐骑，面对各位冠军的挑战吧。
text.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
text.completion: Well done. Training against the other champions is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make the Horde proud, $n.
text.completed: Return to Luuri at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Luuri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, besting challengers of all levels. When the tournament begins, those you have defeated will have redoubled their efforts and will seek to avenge their losses.$B$BIt would be wise to continue honing your own skills and learning from your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions. Equip your lance, mount up on any mount you're entitled to use at the stables, and face the champions.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other champions is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make the Horde proud, $n.
english.completed: Return to Luuri at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 临近的威胁
text.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
text.description: The Argent Crusade has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. They know the cultists won't stop until they've destroyed this area and thwarted the tournament.$B$BThe Argent Crusade's scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party.$B$BYou must intercept and destroy them before they attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
text.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
text.completion: $n, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge. It's no matter. We always protect our own.
text.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: The Argent Crusade has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. They know the cultists won't stop until they've destroyed this area and thwarted the tournament.$B$BThe Argent Crusade's scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party.$B$BYou must intercept and destroy them before they attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
english.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
english.completion: $n, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge. It's no matter. We always protect our own.
english.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.

text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的放血者佐尔比要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭那些异教徒。
text.description: 我们在模拟战中打闹的同时，不能忘了真正的敌人正环伺在我们周围。银色北伐军想通过比赛来选出最好的战士，但是真正的强者只能是那些从战场上生还的人。我们要让那帮圣骑士看看，在为锦标赛做准备的同时，我们也随时准备跟诅咒教派开战。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，杀死你遇到的所有异教徒。他们的力量在奥尔杜萨和亡语者岗哨周围尤其强大。
text.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
text.completion: You have done well in demonstrating our commitment to fighting the Scourge, no matter where we are or what we are doing.
text.completed: Return to Zor'be the Bloodletter at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
text.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

english.title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
english.objectives: Zor'be the Bloodletter at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill cultists in any part of Icecrown.
english.description: While we all play at mock combat, it will do us good to remember that the real enemy surrounds us. The Argent Crusade wants to use competition to find the best fighters, but we can tell that by who returns from battle. Let's show the paladins that we are willing to take battle to the Cult of the Damned, even while making preparations for the tournament.$B$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any of the cultists you encounter. They have a strong presence around Aldur'thar and Deathspeaker's Watch.
english.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
english.completion: You have done well in demonstrating our commitment to fighting the Scourge, no matter where we are or what we are doing.
english.completed: Return to Zor'be the Bloodletter at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
text.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$B$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, pick any mount you can ride, then face the champions in practice bouts.
text.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
text.completion: You handle your mount well, $n. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
text.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$B$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, pick any mount you can ride, then face the champions in practice bouts.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: You handle your mount well, $n. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
english.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 伐木
text.objectives: 科罗克要你使用碎木伐木斧砍倒战歌伐木营地的灰谷橡树。然后去闷烧火盆找他。$B$B要是你丢失了秘密信号粉末，就跟碎木的科罗克谈一谈。
text.description: 现在你也知道了，我们要把一名外交官安全护送出伐木营地。$B$B事实上的情况是，这根本不可能。精灵们有一千支箭瞄着营地的所有出口。$B$B我们首先得转移一下他们的注意——只要能让他们对营地的警惕稍稍松懈一下就好。$B$B我的主意很简单。带上这把斧子，把该地区他们一直在照料的树木砍倒。$B$B完事以后，用这些信号粉末跟我汇报。
text.completion: Nice work, $n. You've demoralized the enemy and harvested resources for the Horde. Let's hope the rest of the mission goes as well.
text.completed: Report to Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier.

english.title: Making Stumps
english.objectives: Krokk wants you to use the Splintertree Axe to cut down the Ashenvale Oaks in Warsong Lumber Camp.$b$bIf you lose your Secret Signal Powder, speak to Kadrak at Splintertree.
english.description: As you've been told by now, we are to escort a diplomat from within the besieged lumber camp to safety.$b$bAs it stands, that's simply impossible. The elves have a thousand arrows trained on the camp's exits.$b$bFirst we must create a diversion - something that will take their eyes off of the camp for a time.$b$bMy idea is simple. Take this axe and cut down the trees they've been nurturing in the region.$b$bWhen you're through, use the signal powder here to speak with me again.
english.completion: Nice work, $n. You've demoralized the enemy and harvested resources for the Horde. Let's hope the rest of the mission goes as well.
english.completed: Report to Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier.

text.title: 英雄：天文台
text.objectives: 奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员罗尔伦要你找到天文台的入口。
text.description: 听着，$G小伙子:小姑娘;，艾泽拉斯的命运危在旦夕。$B$B我们唯一的机会是到天文台去，找到奥尔加隆，阻止他向他的泰坦主人发送信息。$B$B赶快找到天文台。如果你发现了任何有价值的信息，就立即回来向我报告。奥尔加隆抵达之前，我们还有一些时间可以准备。
text.completion: It's locked?  Figures! I'll let Brann know... maybe he can uncover something in the Archivum.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

english.title: Heroic: The Celestial Planetarium
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to locate the entrance to the Celestial Planetarium.
english.description: Listen, $glad:lass;!  Azeroth's fate is at stake here.$B$BOur only chance is to get to the Celestial Planetarium in time to find this Algalon and stop him from beaming back any messages to his Titan masters.$B$BLocate the Celestial Planetarium and come back with any information you get.  We might still have some time to prepare for Algalon's arrival.
english.completion: It's locked?  Figures! I'll let Brann know... maybe he can uncover something in the Archivum.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：档案馆数据圆盘
text.objectives: 将档案馆数据圆盘带到奥杜尔的档案馆控制台前。
text.description: 这张白金圆盘的表面惊人地光滑匀称，没有一丝的划痕和瑕疵。在这张圆盘的边缘，有一行符文刻成的字：“档案馆”。$B$B奥杜尔内部一定有什么装置可以读取这张圆盘中包含的信息。
text.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
text.completion: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console.  It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Heroic: Archivum Data Disc
english.objectives: Bring the Archivum Data Disc to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: This platinum disc is surprisingly symmetrical and devoid of any scratches or imperfections.  Engraved along its edge, bold runes spell out the word "ARCHIVUM."$B$BThere must be a device inside Ulduar capable of reading the disc.
english.progress: The console whirrs with energy as the round receptacle opens.
english.completion: The platinum disc fits perfectly inside the console.  It begins to spin as its contents are scanned by white beams of light.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: Heroic: Algalon
text.objectives: Bring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
text.description: You really did it, $N.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$B$BYou best hurry, $g lad:lass;.  Time is of the essence.
text.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
text.completion: Stand by for verification. Access to the Celestial Planetarium granted.  Please retrieve your key.
text.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

english.title: Heroic: Algalon
english.objectives: Bring the Sigils of the Watchers to the Archivum Console in Ulduar.
english.description: You really did it, $N.  Take the sigils to the Archivum Console and see if you can gain access to the Celestial Planetarium.$B$BYou best hurry, $g lad:lass;.  Time is of the essence.
english.progress: The console's bright lights scan the glass surface repeatedly, as if awaiting some form of input.
english.completion: Stand by for verification. Access to the Celestial Planetarium granted.  Please retrieve your key.
english.completed: Return to Archivum Console.

text.title: 英雄：结果好，一切都好
text.objectives: 将回复代码阿尔法交给达拉然的罗宁。
text.description: 我们必须抓紧时间，$N。必须回到达拉然，在那里把回复代码发射出去。$B$B带着它去找罗宁吧，我会在那里等你。
text.progress: You're ready, $n?
text.completion: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.
text.completed: Return to Rhonin in Crystalsong Forest.

english.title: Heroic: All Is Well That Ends Well
english.objectives: Take the Reply-Code Alpha to Rhonin in Dalaran.
english.description: We'd best hurry now, $N.  We're going to have to transmit the reply-code from Dalaran.$B$BTake it to Rhonin, I will meet you there.
english.progress: You're ready, $n?
english.completion: You're here.  Let us hope this works.  For all our sakes.
english.completed: Return to Rhonin in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 布拉斯波兄弟
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的贝兹尔·布拉斯波谈一谈。
text.description: 大领主命令我尽快完成这座体育馆。我们派出了所有的石匠加班加点工作，但很快就发现没有足够的建筑材料。我雇了两个地精来帮忙，也就是贝兹尔·布拉斯波和他的兄弟波兹尔·布拉斯波。$B$B他们负责监督比武场东南区域的工程进度。去和贝兹尔谈谈，看看他们兄弟能不能帮我们找些材料来。

english.title: The Blastbolt Brothers
english.objectives: Speak with Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The highlord has tasked me with getting that coliseum completed as soon as possible. We've put our own masons to work on the project, but we found out very quickly that we were going to need help procuring materials. I've hired a couple of goblins, Bezzle Blastbolt and his brother, Bozzle.$B$BThey're supervising construction at the southeastern end of the tournament grounds. Speak with Bezzle and see if he and his brother could use any more help getting the building materials we need.

text.title: 英雄：弗蕾亚的徽记
text.objectives: 将弗蕾亚的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得弗蕾亚的徽记。
text.description: 我想弗蕾亚的徽记可能是最难得到的一块。$B$B根据档案馆的数据，徽记与弗蕾亚身边的三位古树仆从密切关联，它们是明叶长老、铁枝长老和石树长老。一旦它们之中有任何一位受到伤害，徽记的完整性就无法保障了。$B$B然而，如果你们对这三位长老手下留情，弗蕾亚的力量就会变得更加强大。$B$B我又能说什么呢，$N，我们现在真是进退维谷。
text.progress: Freya's sigil, $n?  Do ye have it?
text.completion: Excellent job, $n.  We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!
text.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

english.title: Heroic: Freya's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Freya's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Freya's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Freya's Sigil is going to be one of the tougher ones, I reckon.$B$BAccording to the Archivum, the essence of the Sigil is tied to her three elder servants, Brightleaf, Ironbranch and Stonebark.  Should any of the elders be harmed, the Sigil's integrity will be compromised.$B$BSparing the elders, however, means that Freya will be more powerful when you face her.$B$BWhat can I say, $N.  We're stuck between a rock and hard place.
english.progress: Freya's sigil, $n?  Do ye have it?
english.completion: Excellent job, $n.  We're one step closer to saving Azeroth!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：霍迪尔的徽记
text.objectives: 将霍迪尔的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得霍迪尔的徽记。
text.description: 要拿到霍迪尔的徽记可不容易。你不但要击败霍迪尔，而且必须抢在他打碎装着徽记的箱子之前击败他！$B$B如果你想了解更多信息的话，可以去查查档案馆的控制台。那里面的知识比世界上所有的图书馆加在一起还要多！
text.progress: Did ye obtain the sigil, $n?
text.completion: Ye did it!  I don't know how, but ye did!
text.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

english.title: Heroic: Hodir's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Hodir's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Hodir's Sigil, consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Hodir's Sigil won't be easy to obtain.  Not only are ye going to have to defeat Hodir himself, but yer going to have to do it before he destroys the chest that contains it!$B$BCheck the Archivum console if you need more information.  That thing contains more knowledge than all of the world's libraries put together!
english.progress: Did ye obtain the sigil, $n?
english.completion: Ye did it!  I don't know how, but ye did!
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：托里姆的徽记
text.objectives: 将托里姆的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得托里姆的徽记。
text.description: 托里姆已经失去了自我，$N。一股黑暗的力量正在影响着他。$B$B某个邪恶的家伙假扮成他死去的妻子西芙，蒙蔽了他的心智。$B$B你要阻止那个冒牌货控制托里姆。如果托里姆被这股力量征服，我们就永远都无法找到他的徽记了！$B$B你要让他清醒过来，越快越好！$B$B和以往一样，档案馆的控制台会给你提供所有必要的讯息……包括那些你不喜欢听到的讯息。
text.progress: Well, $n?  Do ye have it?
text.completion: Ye never cease to impress, $n. Ye and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?
text.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

english.title: Heroic: Thorim's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Archivum in Ulduar wants you to obtain Thorim's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Thorim's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Thorim's not himself, $N.  He's come under a dark influence.$B$BAn evil presence under the guise of an illusion pretends to be his lost wife, Sif.$B$BYe can't let him be overcome by this impostor's spell.  If he does, the location of his sigil might forever be lost!$B$BYer going to have to beat some sense into him and yer going to have to do it quick.$B$BAs always, the Archivum Console will give ye all the gory details... even the ones ye don't like.
english.progress: Well, $n?  Do ye have it?
english.completion: Ye never cease to impress, $n. Ye and me are having a pint together after all this is done, ye hear me?
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 英雄：米米尔隆的徽记
text.objectives: 将米米尔隆的徽记交给奥杜尔档案馆中的勘探员罗尔伦。$B$B你可以向档案馆控制台查询如何获得米米尔隆的徽记。
text.description: 米米尔隆是个聪明的家伙，他给自己的地盘装上了一套自毁装置。$B$B很不幸，如果你想要拿到徽记，就必须争分夺秒。如果你需要了解什么详细的资料，可以去档案馆控制台那里查询。
text.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $n?
text.completion: I've got to hand it to you, $n.  Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

english.title: Heroic: Mimiron's Sigil
english.objectives: Prospector Loren at the Ulduar Archivum wants you to obtain Mimiron's Sigil.$B$BFor more information on obtaining Mimiron's Sigil consult the Archivum Console.
english.description: Mimiron's a clever one.  His entire abode is rigged with some sort of self-destruction mechanism.$B$BUnfortunately yer gonna have to race against it if ye want to get his sigil.  Check the Archivum Console for more details if ye need them.
english.progress: Were you able to obtain the sigil, $n?
english.completion: I've got to hand it to you, $n.  Our odds might not be the best, but I feel a lot better with you lending a hand.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Loren in Ulduar.

text.title: 钓鱼专家纳特·帕格
text.completion: Well hello there, young $r.  Either my memory is failing me, or I forgot to give you this the last time we spoke....

english.title: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
english.completion: Well hello there, young $r.  Either my memory is failing me, or I forgot to give you this the last time we spoke....

text.title: Treasure!
text.completed: Return to Pirate Treasure Chest.

english.title: Treasure!
english.completed: Return to Pirate Treasure Chest.

text.title: 近战训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈，然后对一个近战目标使用5次刺击。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向奥术师泰利斯复命。
text.description: 锦标赛的核心项目就是骑乘战斗。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马之后，去跟耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。耶兰会教你学会使用防御技能，在近身战斗中保证自己的安全。
text.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
text.completed: Return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Mastery Of Melee
english.objectives: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
english.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
english.completed: Return to Arcanist Taelis at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 近战训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的夺日者陆行鸟。和耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈，然后对一个近战目标使用5次刺击。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向魔导师埃迪恩·炎谷复命。
text.description: 锦标赛的核心项目就是骑乘战斗。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上夺日者陆行鸟吧。$B$B骑上陆行鸟之后，去跟耶兰·洛克伍德谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。耶兰会教你学会使用防御技能，在近身战斗中保证自己的安全。
text.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
text.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Mastery Of Melee
english.objectives: Equip your lance, then mount the Stabled Sunreaver Hawkstrider outside the pavilion. Speak to Jeran Lockwood and use Thrust 5 times on a Melee Target, then return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The heart of tournament competition is mounted melee combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Sunreaver hawkstrider just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Jeran Lockwood. He's on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Jeran will instruct you on how to use your defenses to keep you safe while attacking a melee target at close range.
english.completion: Keep the words of the master in mind as you practice with the training dummies.
english.completed: Return to Magister Edien Sunhollow at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 幽灵鱼
text.objectives: 达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯希望你去揭开幽灵鱼的秘密。
text.description: 在诺森德垂钓的人如果没有听说过小型亚口鱼，那可真是白活了。这种鱼无法食用，但在炼金领域里有特殊的用途。$B$B不过，有另一种隐秘的鱼类混迹在索拉查盆地河流之心的亚口鱼中，那就是幽灵鱼。只要一离开水，这种鱼就会逐渐变得透明，最后完全消失。有些人猜测它回到了索拉查盆地，而其他人的猜测就更加不着边际了……$B$B总之，我希望你去想办法找到这种鱼，揭开它的秘密！
text.completion: So eating it makes you invisible... what a strange defense this clever fish has developed.$b$bI'd like to digest this for a bit.  Pun not intended, $N.  Really.  Why don't you come see me tomorrow?
text.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

english.title: The Ghostfish
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to discover the mystery of the Phantom Ghostfish.
english.description: Any Northrend angler worth $ghis:her; salt knows about the pygmy suckerfish.  It's not edible, but sometimes useful to alchemists.$b$bThere is, however, a stealthy fish that hides among the suckerfish in the River's Heart of Sholazar Basin.  The phantom ghostfish.  When out of water, they become increasingly translucent until they fade away completely.  Some hypothesize they return to Sholazar, and others are more... superstitious.$b$bI want you to catch this fish and discover its secret by any means!
english.completion: So eating it makes you invisible... what a strange defense this clever fish has developed.$b$bI'd like to digest this for a bit.  Pun not intended, $N.  Really.  Why don't you come see me tomorrow?
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

text.title: 令人不安的处方
text.objectives: 将药剂师的记事笺交给洛达内尔的萨纳瑞恩·绿树。
text.description: 你面前是一个粗糙搭就的药剂师工作台，上面堆满了潦草的字条和有毒的方剂。看起来被遗忘者也在研究腐蹄的杰作。你抓起便笺中看起来最重要的一些，打算在告知绿树你的发现之前把这里砸个稀巴烂。
text.progress: What's this? You found something else in the cave?
text.completion: So the Forsaken have been studying Foulhoof's work? My gut crawls at the thought of what they might have done were they able to weaponize his corruption. You've done well to destroy their work, but this raises deeper concerns. What brought the Forsaken to our doorstep? Are they working with the Shatterspear trolls to our north? Sorrows are heaping upon sorrows, $c. I'm glad you're here.
text.completed: Deliver the Apothecary's notes to Tharnariun Treetender at Lor'danel in Darkshore.

english.title: A Troubling Prescription
english.objectives: Deliver the Apothecary's notes to Tharnariun Treetender in Lor'danel.
english.description: A crude, hastily-assembled apothecary's workbench stands here, heaped with scrawled notes and noxious brews. It looks as though the Forsaken have also been studying Foulhoof's handiwork. You grab the most important-looking notes and prepare to smash the laboratory before notifying Treetender of your discovery.
english.progress: What's this? You found something else in the cave?
english.completion: So the Forsaken have been studying Foulhoof's work? My gut crawls at the thought of what they might have done were they able to weaponize his corruption. You've done well to destroy their work, but this raises deeper concerns. What brought the Forsaken to our doorstep? Are they working with the Shatterspear trolls to our north? Sorrows are heaping upon sorrows, $c. I'm glad you're here.

text.title: 下水道中的珍宝
text.objectives: 将一块被腐蚀的珠宝交给达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯。
text.description: 我真不敢相信，有那么多人去达拉然下水道钓鱼，只为几只大老鼠或是变异鱼。难道他们不知道，有许多伤心欲绝的傻子、走投无路的窃贼和心不在焉的醉汉，把数不清的无价之宝扔到了下水道里吗？$B$B在那里钓鱼的秘诀是把鱼钩沉到水底去，如果钓到了什么东西，就缓缓地把线收上来。去试试吧，$N，我会用我收藏的宝贝和你钓上来的东西交换的。
text.progress: 找到了吗?
text.completion: Well now, that looks like it could be valuable.  Difficult to know until it's cleaned up and appraised, but I'm still willing to make the trade if you are.
text.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

english.title: Jewel Of The Sewers
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her a piece of Corroded Jewelry.
english.description: Hard to believe that most people fish in the Dalaran Sewers for giant rats and mutated fish.  Especially when those waters are filled with priceless jewelry - discarded by broken hearted fools, thieves, and careless drunks.$b$bThe trick is to let your hook drag the bottom and don't pull up too hard when you get something.  Try it out, $N.  I'd be willing to trade whatever you find for a few trinkets of my own.
english.progress: Any luck?
english.completion: Well now, that looks like it could be valuable.  Difficult to know until it's cleaned up and appraised, but I'm still willing to make the trade if you are.
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

text.title: 血溶于水
text.objectives: 达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯希望你为她带去5条血齿狂鱼。
text.description: 血齿狂鱼可以用来烹制一道佳肴，对治愈感染伤口有奇效。如果你有兴趣的话，我们能让它们能派上一些用场。$B$B就如同它们的名字所暗示的，血齿狂鱼会被鲜血的味道所吸引。据我所知，想要钓起这些小恶鱼就只有一种办法：弄出一片带血的池塘来。$B$B先把你自己弄得满身是血——只需要在北风苔原杀掉几头动物——然后跳进水里就行。如此一来，溶入了鲜血的池塘就成了绝佳的渔点。
text.progress: Any luck with the bloodtooth?  Don't forget what I told you about making blood pools.
text.completion: You are a brave one, $n.  I hope you didn't lose any extremities making your fishing spot.  If you've still got the fishing bug, come back tomorrow and we'll talk some more.
text.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

english.title: Blood Is Thicker
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 5 Bloodtooth Frenzies.
english.description: The bloodtooth is a feisty little fish used in a recipe to cure infected wounds.  We could use some of them, if you're up to it.$b$bAs the name suggests, they've a hunger for blood.  The only way I know how to catch the little devils is by creating a blood pool and fishing in it.$b$bGet yourself covered in blood - just slaughter a beast in the Borean Tundra - and then jump in the water.  It'll wash right off and create the perfect fishing spot.
english.progress: Any luck with the bloodtooth?  Don't forget what I told you about making blood pools.
english.completion: You are a brave one, $n.  I hope you didn't lose any extremities making your fishing spot.  If you've still got the fishing bug, come back tomorrow and we'll talk some more.
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

text.title: 危险的美食
text.objectives: 将10条恐怖鱼交给达拉然城中的玛西娅·切斯。
text.description: 最好的钓鱼地点总是最危险的。冬拥湖里有无数的战利品等待着大胆的垂钓者。$B$B事实上，只有在冬拥湖才能钓到传说中最危险也最美味的恐怖鱼。给我带些这种鱼来，然后我们再好好聊聊。
text.progress: Be on your guard when you're after the Terrorfish.
text.completion: My, my, my!  You've caught yourself some Terrorfish.  Why, that reminds me of the time...
text.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

english.title: Dangerously Delicious
english.objectives: Marcia Chase in Dalaran City wants you to bring her 10 Terrorfish.
english.description: The best fishing is often the most dangerous.  Wintergrasp boasts a bountiful catch for the brazen.$b$bIn fact, it's the only place to catch the fabled Terrorfish - a fish both lethal and delicious.  Bring me some, and we'll have something to discuss.
english.progress: Be on your guard when you're after the Terrorfish.
english.completion: My, my, my!  You've caught yourself some Terrorfish.  Why, that reminds me of the time...
english.completed: Return to Marcia Chase in Dalaran.

text.title: 碎盾训练
text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈，然后对两个脆弱的远程目标使用碎盾技能。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向斥候沙琳蒂亚复命。
text.description: 想要在骑乘战斗中获得胜利，你就必须先学会如何突破对手的防御。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马以后，去找瓦利斯·逐风者谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。瓦利斯会向你传授使用远程武器击破对手盾牌的基础技巧，这样就可以更容易地击败你的目标。
text.completion: Commit Valis's lesson to memory, $n. It will mean the difference between winning and losing your mounted combat matches.
text.completed: Return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
text.objective2: Use Shield-Breaker on vulnerable Ranged Target

english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Valis Windchaser and use Shield-Breaker on 2 vulnerable Ranged Targets, then return to Scout Shalyndria at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: You'll need to learn how to break through an opponent's defenses to succeed in mounted combat. Take this lance and mount the stabled Quel'dorei steed just outside the pavilion.$B$BOnce you're mounted, seek out Valis Windchaser. He'll be on the northern edge of the tournament grounds at the training area east of the Aspirants' Ring. Valis will teach you the basics of using a ranged shield breaker attack to make a ranged target vulnerable.

text.title: 胳膊丢了！
text.objectives: 将断臂交给达拉然城中的善良的欧莉萨拉。
text.description: 我得到消息，在达拉然监狱发生了一桩非常不幸的意外。一名卫兵的胳膊被一个邪恶的囚犯砍断，又被扔进了水里。$B$B我们的急救医生说，如果能找回那条胳膊，他们就能为那名卫兵接好断肢。$B$B你在那座监狱外面的水域去垂钓一下。我用我最好的鱼竿打赌，只要你用的时间足够长，就一定能找到那条胳膊。然后你把它带回达拉然来，交给善良的欧莉萨拉。她知道该怎么做。
text.progress: Hi there.  Do you have something for me?
text.completion: Oh, hello there $n.  Marcia said you'd be coming by with that poor man's missing arm. She also gave me this bag to give you as a reward.  It smells horrible, and I'm anxious to make the trade if you don't mind.
text.completed: Return to Olisarra the Kind at First to Your Aid in Dalaran City.

english.title: Disarmed!
english.objectives: Olisarra the Kind in Dalaran City wants you to return the Severed Arm to her.
english.description: I've received word of an unfortunate accident at the Dalaran prison; a guard had his arm severed and thrown into the water by a particularly vicious inmate.$b$bOur first aid clinic promises they can reattach the arm if we bring it back.$b$bYou fish long enough in the water outside the prison, and I'd bet my favorite fishing pole that arm will surface.  Find that arm, and bring it to Olisarra the Kind here in Dalaran.  She'll know what to do.
english.progress: Hi there.  Do you have something for me?
english.completion: Oh, hello there $n.  Marcia said you'd be coming by with that poor man's missing arm. She also gave me this bag to give you as a reward.  It smells horrible, and I'm anxious to make the trade if you don't mind.
english.completed: Return to Olisarra the Kind at First to Your Aid in Dalaran City.

text.objectives: 装备上你的长枪，到大帐外面骑上兽栏中的奎尔多雷战马。和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈，然后向两个脆弱的冲锋目标发动冲锋。完成训练后回到银色比武场，向阿瓦雷斯·迅击复命。
text.description: 在骑乘战斗中，冲锋是最强大的攻击方式。拿上这杆长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上奎尔多雷战马吧。$B$B骑上战马之后，去和卢格安·钢胃谈一谈。他就在比武场的北部，候选者赛场东面的训练场地里。卢格安会告诉你如何使用这项强大的技能，还会教你一些其它的基本战术。
text.completion: With a teacher like Rugan, you'll be an expert at mounted combat in no time.
text.completed: Return to Avareth Swiftstrike in Icecrown.

english.objectives: Equip your lance and mount the Stabled Quel'dorei Steed outside the pavilion. Speak to Rugan Steelbelly and Charge 2 vulnerable Charge Targets, then return to Avareth Swiftstrike at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Your strongest attack in mounted combat is undoubtedly the charge. text.title: REUSE
text.objectives: 找一些特殊的鸡饲料，把它交给友好的小鸡。当你找到小鸡的时候，在喂食它之前对它做出高兴的表情。（使用/cheer命令）
text.description: “咕咕嘎……咕咕嘎……咕咕！$B$B咕咕嘎……咕咕嘎……咕咕。”$B$B小鸡抬头看着你，然后伸出爪子探到地面上。你认为它是在拼写某个单词，但是又不确定是什么单词。S-A-L-D-E-A-N…C-o-o-C-e-l-y…是指萨丁农场吗？在你发出询问之前，小鸡转过身子，做它自己的事儿去了。
text.completed: Return to Chicken.

english.title: REUSE
english.objectives: Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.
english.description: "Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!$B$BCluck... cluck... cluck."$B$BThe chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word, but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask, the chicken turns away and goes about its business.
english.completed: Return to Chicken.

text.title: 难辞其咎
text.objectives: Draaka wants you to bring her Letter of Explanation to Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.
text.description: This could be the end of me... Perhaps my actions were not thought out as well as they should have been...$b$bThe good news is that we pushed back an attack that would have otherwise meant the end of Splintertree. Let us pray that Commander Hellscream sees it that way.$b$bI am certain to be summoned to Orgrimmar to explain my actions.$b$bPlease, $n, go ahead of me and present this letter to Garrosh.$b$bDo what you can to soften his heart towards me.
text.completion: Fools!! This Draaka woman has allowed herself to be manipulated by a demon! And I smell its taint on you as well, $c....
text.giverWindow: Here's hoping he shows some mercy...

text.title: 将功赎罪
text.objectives: 跟碎木矿井的杜莱克谈一谈。
text.description: The demons want nothing more than for us to renew our dependence on their foul magics. That reliance can only lead to the entire orc race becoming enslaved.$b$bYou wish to see Draaka go unpunished? Then you must find the demons' pawn who has manipulated her, and destroy him!$b$bIf you do not soon return to me with the head of this being, then I shall see both yours and Draaka's hoisted upon a spike!
text.progress: Have you brought me the head of the enemy, $r?
text.completion: Grah... very well. I'll remove the bounty I had placed upon your head. Though I am sorely tempted to end your life anyway, just on principle. Be sure that you never raise my ire again, $n. Now, get out of my sight...
text.completed: Speak to Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Dread Head Redemption
english.objectives: Speak to Durak in Splintertree Mines.
english.description: The demons want nothing more than for us to renew our dependence on their foul magics. That reliance can only lead to the entire orc race becoming enslaved.$b$bYou wish to see Draaka go unpunished? Then you must find the demons' pawn who has manipulated her, and destroy him!$b$bIf you do not soon return to me with the head of this being, then I shall see both yours and Draaka's hoisted upon a spike!
english.progress: Have you brought me the head of the enemy, $r?
english.completion: Grah... very well. I'll remove the bounty I had placed upon your head. Though I am sorely tempted to end your life anyway, just on principle. Be sure that you never raise my ire again, $n. Now, get out of my sight...
english.completed: Speak to Garrosh Hellscream in Orgrimmar.

text.title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
text.objectives: 使用创世者的图书馆中的原型机控制台。
text.description: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.
text.completion: You take note of the information displayed in the schematic and the materials required to construct the scrapbot kit.

english.title: The Scrapbot Construction Kit
english.objectives: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.
english.description: Searching the databanks of the prototype console reveals schematics for a scrapbot construction kit. With your engineering expertise, you could learn this schematic and produce scrapbot construction kits of your own.
english.completion: You take note of the information displayed in the schematic and the materials required to construct the scrapbot kit.

text.title: 奥萨拉克斯的藏宝
text.objectives: 在奥萨拉克斯之塔废墟里找到纳拉辛的学识之书，并杀掉被遗忘者指挥官提甘·霍拉维。
text.description: 在你重新投入战斗之前，$C，有件紧急的事情引起了我的注意。斥候报告说被遗忘者正在搜查南边的奥萨拉克斯之塔废墟。$B$B在开战之前，那座黄塔里驻扎着一支由堕落的上层精灵埃瑟里克斯·纳拉辛指挥的，狂热的暗影议会军队。纳拉辛早已远离人世了，但若是他研究结果尚在，我们就不能置之不理。把他的研究成果带回来，杀掉搜刮废墟的被遗忘者指挥官。
text.progress: Narassin is no longer our concern, but if his life's work should fall to our enemies, centuries of dark wisdom could be called down onto our heads. How goes the hunt?
text.completion: Let's see what we've got here.... By Elune, his notes are scrawled in a half dozen languages. What is this, blood? This archive makes my flesh seethe, but at least it's secure. It will take us some time to decipher these notes. Oh - your reward? Yes, here. Nice work with those undead scavengers. Now get back to the fight.
text.completed: Return the Tome to Mathas Wildwood at the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.
text.giverWindow: The Forsaken prowl the tower's grounds. Show no mercy.

english.title: The Looting of Althalaxx
english.objectives: Locate Narassin's Tome among the ruins of Althalaxx and kill the Forsaken commander Teegan Holloway.
english.description: Before you rejoin the battle, $c, something urgent has come to my attention. My scouts report that the Forsaken are scouring the ruined tower of Althalaxx to our south.$b$bPrior to the assault, that bleak tower housed a fanatical arm of the Shadow Council commanded by the fallen highborne Athrikus Narassin. Narassin is long since dead, but if any of his work survives, we can't allow it out of our sight. Retrieve his research and kill the Forsaken commander who's plundering the ruins.
english.progress: Narassin is no longer our concern, but if his life's work should fall to our enemies, centuries of dark wisdom could be called down onto our heads. How goes the hunt?
english.completion: Let's see what we've got here.... By Elune, his notes are scrawled in a half dozen languages. What is this, blood? This archive makes my flesh seethe, but at least it's secure. It will take us some time to decipher these notes. Oh - your reward? Yes, here. Nice work with those undead scavengers. Now get back to the fight.
english.completed: Return the Tome to Mathas Wildwood at the Ruins of Mathystra in Darkshore.
english.giverWindow: The Forsaken prowl the tower's grounds. Show no mercy.

text.title: 密封的毒药瓶
text.objectives: Bring the Sealed Vial of Poison to Alchemist Cinesra in the Dalaran Sewers.
text.description: 这只装着毒药的小瓶子看上去很危险。也许达拉然城中的某人会对它感兴趣。
text.progress: Is that what I think it is, $c?
text.completion: You are brave to have carried this.  If even one drop were to touch your skin, you'd have died an agonizing death. Allow me to pay you for it... I can always use venom of exceptional potency.
text.completed: Return to Alchemist Cinesra at the Black Market in Dalaran.

english.title: Sealed Vial of Poison
english.objectives: Bring the Sealed Vial of Poison to Alchemist Cinesra in the Dalaran Sewers.
english.description: This vial of poison looks particularly dangerous.  Perhaps someone in Dalaran might be interested in it.
english.progress: Is that what I think it is, $c?
english.completion: You are brave to have carried this.  If even one drop were to touch your skin, you'd have died an agonizing death. Allow me to pay you for it... I can always use venom of exceptional potency.
english.completed: Return to Alchemist Cinesra at the Black Market in Dalaran.

text.title: 微薄的贡献
text.objectives: 与侍从亚迪再次交谈，为银色北伐军的事业捐献10枚金币。
text.description: 最优秀的冠军们每天都来礼拜堂，聆听银色神官的演讲。$B$B你应该看看她给予了这些人多大的鼓舞，$N。他们不仅坚定了为银色北伐军作战的信心，还向我的捐赠篮中放入了大把的金币。$B$B你要不要也捐赠一点？
text.progress: Do you want to contribute?
text.completion: Thank you. I just know the crusade will put it to good use!

english.title: Contributin' To The Cause
english.objectives: Speak with Squire Artie to contribute 10 gold to the Argent Crusade's cause.
english.description: The bestest of the champions come to the chapel to hear the argent confessor speak every day.$B$BYou should see how much she inspires them, $N. Not only do they fight for the Argent Crusade, but they put a lot of money into the collection basket when I take it around.$B$BMaybe you'd like to contribute too?
english.progress: Do you want to contribute?
english.completion: Thank you. I just know the crusade will put it to good use!

text.title: 兵临城下
text.objectives: 银色比武场的约瑟夫·霍雷上尉要求你消灭15名白骨卫士步兵、10名白骨卫士斥候和3名白骨卫士军官。
text.description: 在我们准备锦标赛的同时，银色北伐军也在准备对敌人的冰冠堡垒发动攻击。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的北伐军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南建立了先头营地。拿上你的长枪到营地去，骑上军马，击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.completion: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders what they already knew -- that our warriors are more than just parade ground decorations.
text.completed: Return to Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: At The Enemy's Gates
english.objectives: Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, and 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
english.description: Even as we ready for the tournament, Argent Crusade forces prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's minions.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.completion: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders what they already knew -- that our warriors are more than just parade ground decorations.
english.completed: Return to Captain Joseph Holley at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 凶讯使者
text.objectives: Kadrak wants you to speak to Commander Grimfang in Zoram Strand.
text.description: 碎木岗哨被围以来，我们的情报就一直传不出去。眼下，指挥官恐牙一定焦急万分。$B$B我要派你把我们的消息带到佐拉姆海岸去，不是什么捷报，但至少他能了解实情。$B$B你做好出发的准备，就去告诉乌尔格拉。
text.completion: This is grim news, indeed. May the spirits preserve them until we can fight our way to Splintertree....

english.title: Bad News Bear-er
english.objectives: Kadrak wants you to speak to Commander Grimfang in Zoram Strand.
english.description: No reports have made it out of here since the beginning of the siege on Splintertree. By now, Commander Grimfang must be getting anxious.$b$bI am sending you to Zoram Strand to deliver our report. It's not pretty, but at least he'll have the facts.$b$bSpeak to Vhulgra when you're ready to make the trip.
english.completion: This is grim news, indeed. May the spirits preserve them until we can fight our way to Splintertree....

text.title: 阿斯特兰纳在燃烧！
text.objectives: 扑灭15处大火。
text.description: $C，阿斯特兰纳在燃烧！$B$B快，拿上这桶水，趁一切还没被烧光，赶紧救火！
text.completion: Thank you! Now it's time to deal with the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Thenysil at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: Astranaar's Burning!
english.objectives: Extinguish 15 fires.
english.description: $C, Astranaar's burning!$B$BQuickly, take this bucket of water and put out the fires before there's nothing left!
english.completion: Thank you! Now it's time to deal with the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Thenysil at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 毒药的免疫力
text.objectives: 安戈洛环形山的莫维克说，如果你能被毒皮暴掠龙的血染上20次毒，就可以安全地骑它了。攻击毒皮魔暴龙，有一定几率会中毒。
text.description: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$B$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$B$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of the Marshlands, northwest of here.
text.completion: You did it? You actually did it?! Ho ho! Stubborn as my wife, you are.
text.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Toxic Tolerance
english.objectives: Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
english.description: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$B$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$B$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of the Marshlands, northwest of here.
english.completion: You did it? You actually did it?! Ho ho! Stubborn as my wife, you are.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 还击
text.objectives: 用阿斯特兰纳投刃车击落15名地狱咆哮的恶徒和他们的哨站驭风者。
text.description: 火势基本上被控制住了，但我们还有双足飞龙要对付！$B$B快一点，$N，到我们的弩车上去，马上还击！
text.completion: We're saved! You've shot down enough of them that we should be able to handle the rest. I cannot thank you enough, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Thenysil at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: Return Fire
english.objectives: Use an Astranaar Thrower to shoot down 15 Hellscream's Hellions & their Watch Wind Riders.
english.description: The fires are mostly contained, but we have to do something about those wind riders!$B$BQuick, $N, you have to jump into one of our glaive throwers and return fire!
english.completion: We're saved! You've shot down enough of them that we should be able to handle the rest. I cannot thank you enough, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Thenysil at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.objectives: Anka Clawhoof at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
text.description: 在我们准备锦标赛的同时，银色北伐军也在准备对敌人的冰冠堡垒发动攻击。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的北伐军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南建立了先头营地。拿上你的长枪到营地去，骑上军马，击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.completion: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders that we are steadfast allies in the battle against the Lich King.
text.completed: Return to Anka Clawhoof at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: At The Enemy's Gates
english.objectives: Anka Clawhoof at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 Boneguard Footmen, 10 Boneguard Scouts, 3 Boneguard Lieutenants.
english.description: Even as we ready for the tournament, Argent Crusade forces prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's minions.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.completion: Your bravery on the field has shown the crusaders that we are steadfast allies in the battle against the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Anka Clawhoof at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 堡垒外的战斗
text.objectives: 银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克要求你消灭3名白骨卫士指挥官。
text.description: 在我们为锦标赛做准备工作的时候，我们的兄弟已经准备向敌人的冰冠堡垒发动进攻了。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的十字军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南建立了先头营地。拿上你的长枪，骑上军马，到那座营地去击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.completion: The Argent Crusade is heartened to have paladins like you fighting alongside us in the battle against the Lich King.
text.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Battle Before The Citadel
english.objectives: Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
english.description: Even as some of us labor on the tournament, our brothers prepare the way for an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
english.completion: The Argent Crusade is heartened to have paladins like you fighting alongside us in the battle against the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 堡垒外的战斗
text.objectives: 银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者要求你消灭3名白骨卫士指挥官。
text.description: 十字军的一部分成员正为锦标赛做准备工作，而另外一些十字军已经准备向敌人的冰冠堡垒发动进攻了。$B$B在冰冠冰川西南部的白骨之庭，几位勇敢的十字军战士已经在恐惧之门科雷萨以南建立了先头营地。拿起长枪，骑上战马，到营地去击败巫妖王的仆从吧。$B$B你会遇到许多的白骨卫士步兵，$N不过你完全不用害怕。你的战马可以轻易地将它们踏平。
text.completion: Everywhere we have met the Scourge, we have made them fear us, and this campaign is no different.
text.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Battle Before The Citadel
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 3 Boneguard Commanders.
english.description: As some crusaders prepare for the tournament, they have sent others to make an assault on the enemy's stronghold of Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the Court of Bones in southwestern Icecrown, a few brave crusaders have set up a forward camp on the southern side of Corp'rethar. Equip your lance and mount the stabled campaign charger at the camp, then destroy the Lich King's commanders.$B$BDo not fear the masses of boneguard footmen, $N, for they can easily be trampled under your horse's hooves.
