text.title: 脏活
text.objectives: 科罗克要你杀掉多里纳、阿尔米隆、恩多兰和12名灰谷斥候。$B$B要是你丢失了秘密信号粉末，就跟碎木的科罗克谈一谈。
text.description: 仔细听好，$C。有三名领袖指挥着这一地区的精灵，让他们全力攻打伐木营地。把他们都杀掉，就能让敌人群龙无首，多半也能让我们成功完成任务。$B$B你去的时候，把他们的斥候也干掉一些，就最好了。
text.completion: Well done, $c. They're in complete disarray. Just look at them!
text.completed: Report to Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier.

english.title: Wet Work
english.objectives: Krokk wants you to kill Dorinar, Arminon, Endolar, and 12 Ashenvale Scouts.$b$bSpeak to Kadrak in Splintertree if you lose your Secret Signal Powder.
english.description: Listen carefully, $c.$b$bThere are three leaders in this region who are commanding the elves, keeping their focus directed on the lumber camp. Slaying them will certainly cause panic and disarray, hopefully enough for us to successfully complete our mission.$b$bWhile you're at it, bringing down their scouts can only aid our cause.
english.completion: Well done, $c. They're in complete disarray. Just look at them!
english.completed: Report to Krokk at the Smoldering Brazier.

text.title: To The Ramparts!
text.objectives: Speak with Kulg Gorespatter at the Ashenvale/Azshara border to be transported to the Mor'shan Ramparts. Report to Kadrak when you arrive.
text.description: 这些树林可能是沉默的，但我们的敌人潜伏在每一根树干后面。我发现了许多背上有一个箭矢的兽人，他的武器还是被套住了。$B$B这里是背后的道路，但是我们可以在莫山山城使用强壮的手臂和锐利的头脑。卡德拉克准备从那里进攻 - 他喜欢采取行动说话。你和他会相处的，当你准备好的时候，我会和你一起说话，我会在那里飞你。
text.completion: You are just in time, $c. Old Kulg has been slinking around those woods too long. He grows too cautious, jumping at shadows. We will fear this forest no longer - the time has come to subdue Ashenvale once and for all!

english.title: To The Ramparts!
english.objectives: Speak with Kulg Gorespatter at the Ashenvale/Azshara border to be transported to the Mor'shan Ramparts. Report to Kadrak when you arrive.
english.description: These woods may be silent but our enemies lurk behind every trunk. I've discovered many an orc with arrows in his back, his weapon still sheathed.$b$bIt is treacherous here, behind the lines, but we could use strong arms and sharp minds down at the Mor'shan Ramparts. Kadrak is preparing an offensive from there - he prefers action to talk. You and he will get along.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready and I will fly you there.
english.completion: You are just in time, $c. Old Kulg has been slinking around those woods too long. He grows too cautious, jumping at shadows. We will fear this forest no longer - the time has come to subdue Ashenvale once and for all!

text.title: 剿灭熊怪
text.objectives: 在灰谷蓟皮村杀死15只熊怪。
text.description: 阿斯特兰纳径直往北，有一帮蓟皮熊怪。我的斥候报告说，他们的数量在过去几个月里增长迅速。假如他们人多势众，多半就会壮起胆来直攻阿斯特兰纳！$B$B到蓟皮村去，尽你所能把他们杀掉。$B$B我将在留阿斯特兰纳等你的消息。愿月神与你同在，$C。
text.completion: 好样的，$N。$B$B长期以来，我们一直在受到熊怪的威胁。希望这次的打击可以让它们收敛一些。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: Culling the Furbolg Threat
english.objectives: Slay any 15 furbolg at Thistlefur Village in Ashenvale.
english.description: Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly!$B$BGo to Thistlefur Village and kill as many of their kind as you can.$B$BI shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you, $c.
english.completion: Well done, $n. We are under constant threat from the furbolg. Hopefully this will keep them at bay for a bit longer.
english.completed: Return to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 腐化的影响？
text.objectives: 将巨魔符咒带给灰谷阿斯特兰纳的莱恩·狼行者。
text.description: 死掉的熊怪躺在你面前。在你搜索他们的物品时，一枚明显是由巨魔制作的小符咒掉了出来，摔在地上。$B$B刚碰到它，你就感觉这片木头不对劲。一种叫人不舒服的、腐化的感觉弥漫在上面。$B$B你用多余的布料把它包好，放在背包里，打算一回阿斯特兰纳，就把它交给莱恩·狼行者看。
text.progress: What's troubling you, $c?
text.completion: A troll charm? What are the furbolg doing with such a thing? You're right, it does have a feeling of corruption about it... even I can sense that. There's someone here who might be able to help.

english.title: Corrupting Influence?
english.objectives: Deliver the Troll Charm to Raene Wolfrunner at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: As you search through the belongings of the dead furbolg lying before you, a small charm, very obviously created by trolls,  spills out onto the ground.$B$BTouching the charm, you immediately get a sense that something is not right about the wood. A feeling of unease, of corruption, permeates the object.$B$BWrapping it in some spare cloth, you put it in your pack and resolve to show it to Raene Wolfrunner when next you find yourself in Astranaar.
english.progress: What's troubling you, $c?
english.completion: A troll charm? What are the furbolg doing with such a thing? You're right, it does have a feeling of corruption about it... even I can sense that. There's someone here who might be able to help.

text.title: 抢回遗骸
text.objectives: 收集10块战歌木材。
text.description: While what the satyrs have done to the trees is horrible, nothing compares to the mass slaughter that the orcs have been engaging in!$B$B<The ancient shakes with visible rage, his leaves falling all around you.>$B$B$R, I would have you head across the road here at the lumber camp and recover the remains of those trees, treants, and ancients that the Horde have hewn down in their prime.
text.progress: Have you the remains, little one?
text.completion: I have lived a very long time in peace with the forest, but what these orc-things are doing makes me want to feed them back to the ground! I will put this wood to rest now. Thank you for this kindness, $n. I will never forget.
text.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Recover the Remains
english.objectives: Collect 10 Warsong Lumber.
english.description: While what the satyrs have done to the trees is horrible, nothing compares to the mass slaughter that the orcs have been engaging in!$B$B<The ancient shakes with visible rage, his leaves falling all around you.>$B$B$R, I would have you head across the road here at the lumber camp and recover the remains of those trees, treants, and ancients that the Horde have hewn down in their prime.
english.progress: Have you the remains, little one?
english.completion: I have lived a very long time in peace with the forest, but what these orc-things are doing makes me want to feed them back to the ground! I will put this wood to rest now. Thank you for this kindness, $n. I will never forget.
english.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 尽善尽美
text.objectives: 科罗克要你进入战歌伐木营地，跟监工古尔萨克谈一谈。
text.description: 嗯，$C，情况再好不过了。$B$B托你的福，精灵正在忙于恢复元气。现在正是进入伐木营地的大好机会！$B$B到里面去跟监工古尔萨克谈一谈。他会告诉你如何将外交官安全送出来才好。$B$B祝你好运！
text.completion: If only you'd arrived an hour ago.... The diplomat suffered mortal wounds at the hands of an elf assassin. How the enemy was able to infiltrate the camp undetected remains a mystery.

english.title: As Good as it Gets
english.objectives: Krokk wants you to enter the Warsong Lumber Camp and speak with Overseer Gorthak.
english.description: Well, $c, this is as good as it gets.$b$bThe elves are scrambling to recover from your recent deeds. There's no better time to break into the lumber camp!$b$bMake your way in and speak with Overseer Gorthak. He'll instruct you as to how best escort the diplomat to safety.$b$bGood luck!
english.completion: If only you'd arrived an hour ago.... The diplomat suffered mortal wounds at the hands of an elf assassin. How the enemy was able to infiltrate the camp undetected remains a mystery.

text.title: 保安！
text.objectives: 监工古尔萨克要你把卡多雷刺客徽记带给他。
text.description: 好像我操的心还不够似的！$B$B就算没有精灵和德莱尼的骚扰，让这地方运转起来就已经够难的了。$B$B现在更甚的是，营地周围有个刺客埋伏着，还杀了一名重要的外交官……就在我的眼皮底下！$B$B不管是谁干的，都不可能走远，$C。把营地搜个遍，也要找到这个刺客，为外交官报仇！$B$B至少我面对地狱咆哮的时候，还能有刺客的徽记在手里。
text.progress: I want to know one thing, $r. Is that assassin dead?
text.completion: Well done, $c. One last request - it would probably be best if none of my laborers knew this assassin ever existed.

english.title: Security!
english.objectives: Overseer Gorthak wants you to bring him the Kaldorei Assassin's Head.
english.description: It's not as like I haven't got enough to think about here!$b$bKeeping this place operational is hard enough without constant elf and draenei harassment.$b$bNow, on top of everything, there's an assassin lurking around the camp who's killed an important diplomat... on my watch!$b$bWhoever it is couldn't have gotten far, $c. Scour the camp until you find her and then avenge the diplomat!$b$bAt least I can bring the assassin's head with me when I have to answer to Hellscream.
english.progress: I want to know one thing, $r. Is that assassin dead?
english.completion: Well done, $c. One last request - it would probably be best if none of my laborers knew this assassin ever existed.

text.title: 狼人的智慧
text.objectives: 把巨魔符咒带给灰谷阿斯特兰纳的火神的朝圣者。
text.description: 站在我对面的那个人叫做火神的朝圣者。他是狼人的一员。$B$B他和他的姐姐不久之前来到阿斯特兰纳，打算找地方住下来。就我掌握的那点情报来看，他对帮助大地之环应付大灾变十分感兴趣。他的姐姐比他还要厉害，她到东边帮萨满对付火山去了。$B$B这人也许能帮上忙。把符咒给他瞧瞧，看他怎么说。
text.progress: <The worgen gives you a blank look as you walk up to him.>

english.title: Worgen Wisdom
english.objectives: Take the Troll Charm to Hephaestus Pilgrim at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: The man standing right across from me is known as Hephaestus Pilgrim. He's one of the worgen.$B$BHe and his sister came to Astranaar not long ago looking for a place to live. From what little I've been able to glean, he's interested in trying to help the Earthen Ring with the Cataclysm. His sister is even more powerful. She's gone east to try and help the shaman deal with the volcano.$B$BPerhaps he can help. Take the charm over to him and see what he thinks.
english.progress: <The worgen gives you a blank look as you walk up to him.>

text.title: 茜拉尔的遗愿
text.objectives: Guardian Menerin wants you to deliver the Sealed Missive to Guardian Gurtar.
text.description: 我……我真不敢相信她已经去了。发生得太突然了……$B$B我明白，多亏了你，女士的大仇才能得报。为此，我感谢你，银月城感谢你。$B$B生前，女士的聪明才智就预见到了这个结局。她准备了一封信函，以防自己遭遇不测。$B$B我们要在北边同奥格瑞玛的一批随员会面。拜托你，$R，代替我们去见他们，并且一定要把信件送到。
text.completion: I'll deliver this to Hellscream personally, $r. In the meantime, there's something I need you to do for me....

english.title: Sheelah's Last Wish
english.objectives: Guardian Menerin wants you to deliver the Sealed Missive to Guardian Gurtar.
english.description: I... I cannot believe she's gone. It all happened so fast....$b$bI understand that I have you to thank for avenging my mistress. For that, you have my gratitude, and that of Silvermoon.$b$bIn her wisdom, my lady foresaw this end. She prepared a missive to be delivered in the event that something happened to her.$b$bWe were to join an Orgrimmar retinue at the crossroads just north of here. Please, $r, meet them in our stead and see that the message is delivered.
english.completion: I'll deliver this to Hellscream personally, $r. In the meantime, there's something I need you to do for me....

text.title: 熊怪的木雕
text.objectives: 收集8枚巨魔符咒。
text.description: 熊怪染指了不属于他们的东西。$B$B<朝圣者把符咒放在手里翻看一下，然后将它扔掉了。>$B$B这块木雕有一种能力，可以慢慢地腐蚀巨魔以外的生物。据我说知，熊怪以前干过类似的事情。有些家伙永远也不知道吸取教训。$B$B毫无疑问，他们把大多数符咒都藏在北边村子上方的蓟皮要塞里。
text.progress: Do you think that you retrieved all of the troll charms from Thistlefur Hold? If any are left behind, the Thistlefur tribe will continue to be influenced by them, and eventually they will attack this place.
text.completion: You've likely saved the Thistlefur from themselves, at least in the short run.  If they can keep from stealing objects of power that don't belong to them, that is. I understand that the night elves are having problems with the other furbolg tribe to the south. That's something that Raene is going to want to speak to you about. However, there are more immediate concerns that I would ask for your help with.
text.completed: Return to Hephaestus Pilgrim at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

english.title: A Not-So-Charmed Life
english.objectives: Collect 8 Troll Charms.
english.description: The furbolg covet that which does not belong to them.$B$B<Hephaestus turns the charm over in his hand and then discards it.>$B$BThere's a property to the carving that slowly corrupts those that aren't trolls. As I understand it, the furbolg have done this sort of thing before. Some never learn.$B$BNo doubt they hoard most of the charms in Thistlefur Hold above their village to the north.
english.progress: Do you think that you retrieved all of the troll charms from Thistlefur Hold? If any are left behind, the Thistlefur tribe will continue to be influenced by them, and eventually they will attack this place.
english.completion: You've likely saved the Thistlefur from themselves, at least in the short run.  If they can keep from stealing objects of power that don't belong to them, that is. I understand that the night elves are having problems with the other furbolg tribe to the south. That's something that Raene is going to want to speak to you about. However, there are more immediate concerns that I would ask for your help with.
english.completed: Return to Hephaestus Pilgrim at Astranaar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 古塔尔的请求
text.objectives: 守护者古塔尔要你将血盅花饰带献给碎木的德娜卡。
text.description: 我有一个比较私人的请求，$C。$B$B我已经好多天没有见到我的爱人德娜卡了。还要更久，我们才能相见。我生怕随着时间的推移，她对我的爱也将淡化。$B$B这条饰带对我俩来说意义非同寻常，这一区域带刺的血盅花更是如此。$B$B请你摘下花朵，编在饰带上，替我将这礼物献给德娜卡。
text.progress: 你好，$N。
text.completion: Oh, $n. Thank you for this gift! It means more than you could know. He hasn't forgotten...

english.title: Gurtar's Request
english.objectives: Guardian Gurtar wants you to give the Bloodcup Braid to Draaka in Splintertree.
english.description: I have a bit of a personal request for you, $c.$b$bIt has been many moons since I have seen my love, Draaka. It will be many more before we are able to be together again. I fear that as time passes, her love for me will wane.$b$bThis braid has special meaning to the two of us, as do Thorned Bloodcups, the flower of this region.$b$b I ask that you pluck the flowers and weave them into this twine, then present the gift to Draaka on my behalf.
english.progress: Hello, $n.
english.completion: Oh, $n. Thank you for this gift! It means more than you could know. He hasn't forgotten...

text.title: 无可救药
text.objectives: 获得血爪的藏品。
text.description: 是的，我会说你们的话，$R。$B$B我们熊怪以前经历过这种腐化。就在我们的首领将雷姆洛斯雕像偷来后不久，那被恶魔污染的东西就蛊惑了整个部族。一名叫做布罗尔·熊皮的德鲁伊好不容易才把我们解救了出来。$B$B但这次，我们没偷。符咒是佐拉姆加的巨魔送的，作为友好的象征。还真是要命的友好啊。$B$B我们的酋长，达尔·血爪，已经无可救药了。到要塞去把他的符咒都拿来。
text.progress: Well? The future of the Thistlefur rests upon your shoulders, $r.
text.completion: What was done had to be done. As our leader, Dal's sickness from the troll charms was destroying us. It was better for the health and dignity of the tribe that it was you, outsider. This way there will be no civil war amongst us and we will easily find new leadership... hopefully one that does not have a tendency to so easily trust outsiders. Perhaps I am guilty of this as well? Here, allow me to repay the debt we owe you before we part ways forever.
text.completed: Return to Vear Darksnout at the entrance to Thistlefur Hold in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: Obtain Bloodclaw's Collection.

english.title: Too Far Gone
english.objectives: Obtain Bloodclaw's Collection.
english.description: Yes, I speak your tongue, $r.$B$BWe furbolg have been through this kind of corruption before. Not long ago our leader stole the Idol of Remulos. The demon-tainted thing ensorcelled the entire tribe and our redemption was barely delivered by a druid known as Broll Bearmantle.$B$BBut this time, we did not steal. The trolls of Zoram'gar gave us the charms as a sign of friendship. A deadly friendship it would seem.$B$BOur chief, Dal Bloodclaw, is too far gone. Enter the hold and return with his charms.
english.progress: Well? The future of the Thistlefur rests upon your shoulders, $r.
english.completion: What was done had to be done. As our leader, Dal's sickness from the troll charms was destroying us. It was better for the health and dignity of the tribe that it was you, outsider. This way there will be no civil war amongst us and we will easily find new leadership... hopefully one that does not have a tendency to so easily trust outsiders. Perhaps I am guilty of this as well? Here, allow me to repay the debt we owe you before we part ways forever.
english.completed: Return to Vear Darksnout at the entrance to Thistlefur Hold in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Obtain Bloodclaw's Collection.

text.title: 漂
text.objectives: 跟灰谷雷鸣峰南边岩浆流的朝圣者莎比娜谈一谈。
text.description: <狼人热切地看着你，然后提出了他的要求。>$B$B如果我们不赶快行动，火山就会吞噬整个灰谷。我向你保证，这不是什么正常的火山爆发。$B$B我的妹妹莎比娜力量强大。她沿着大路朝北去了，到东边的雷鸣峰岩浆流边上去援助其他元素，对抗导致这场灾难的火焰领主。$B$B$N，去找她，尽你所能帮助她。
text.completion: My brother must have sent you. He wouldn't have done so unless you are capable of doing what must be done. For all of our sakes I hope that he's right. The elementals here are now my allies. You must do as they ask if we are to prevent the destruction of the rest of Ashenvale.

english.title: Go With The Flow
english.objectives: Speak with Sabina Pilgrim at the southern edge of Thunder Peak's lava flow in Ashenvale.
english.description: <The worgen stares at you intently before launching into his request.>$B$BThe volcano threatens to engulf all of Ashenvale if we do not act quickly. Let me assure you, this was no natural eruption.$B$BMy sister, Sabina, is powerful. She has gone east to the edge of Thunder Peak's lava flow, just north of the road to enlist the aid of the other elements against the fire lord that has caused this destruction.$B$B$N, go to her and give her what assistance you can.
english.completion: My brother must have sent you. He wouldn't have done so unless you are capable of doing what must be done. For all of our sakes I hope that he's right. The elementals here are now my allies. You must do as they ask if we are to prevent the destruction of the rest of Ashenvale.

text.title: 穿越烈焰与火光
text.objectives: 砸烂锁链，把狼从燃烧的兽栏里救出来。
text.description: 救救我，$C！猪人来烧兽栏了——火！火！$B$B<多拉克语无伦次地嚎叫着，直到你让他镇静下来。>$B$B狼还锁在里面。来人救救小狼啊！
text.completion: You save the wolves! So brave! Someday, maybe you get a wolf just like that to ride. What should I do now?
text.completed: Check in with Dorak south of Far Watch Outpost in North Barrens.

english.title: Through Fire and Flames
english.objectives: Break the chains to free the wolves from the burning stables.
english.description: Help me, $c! Piggy men come burn stables - fire! Fire!$B$B<Dorak wails incoherently before you can settle him down.>$B$BWolves still chained inside. Someone's got to save the wee wolves!
english.completion: You save the wolves! So brave! Someday, maybe you get a wolf just like that to ride. What should I do now?
english.completed: Check in with Dorak south of Far Watch Outpost in North Barrens.

text.title: 雷鸣峰
text.objectives: 布萝克要你去找雷鸣峰的斯提克瓦。
text.description: 你好，$C。$B$B恭喜你在阿斯特兰纳大获全胜。精灵们将不会淡忘你对他们造成的羞辱。$B$B不过要知道，部落在征服灰谷的道路上，遇到的障碍并不只有精灵而已……$B$B东边大地之环的一名萨满祭司又遇到了另一个危机，需要援助。你可以在一座被称为雷鸣峰的火山底部找到他。
text.completion: The spirits whispered that help would soon arrive. Pardon my surprise, but I was hoping the spirits would guide someone a little more... heroic. These elementals are trusted allies. Listen to them and do their bidding. If we fail, there will remain nothing in Ashenvale worth fighting for.

english.title: Thunder Peak
english.objectives: Broyk wants you to find Stikwad at Thunder Peak.
english.description: Greetings, $c.$b$bCongratulations on your victorious assault on Astranaar. The elves shall not soon forget the humiliation they have suffered at your hand.$b$bBut you must know, the elves are not the only obstacle to the Horde's conquering of Ashenvale....$b$bTo the east, a shaman of the Earthen Ring requires assistance with yet another crisis. You can find him near the base of the volcano, Thunder Peak.
english.completion: The spirits whispered that help would soon arrive. Pardon my surprise, but I was hoping the spirits would guide someone a little more... heroic. These elementals are trusted allies. Listen to them and do their bidding. If we fail, there will remain nothing in Ashenvale worth fighting for.

text.title: 热岩浆
text.objectives: 使用大地的赠礼填满8处熔岩裂缝。
text.description: <巨大的土元素低头凝视着你。>$B$B要想胜利，就必须阻止岩浆流。我会赐予你一部分我的力量，用它将熔岩裂缝填满！
text.progress: Done?
text.completion: Well done, $r. Lord Magmathar's fire is now trapped, restrained within the earth once more.
text.completed: Return to Core at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.

english.title: Hot Lava
english.objectives: Use the Gift of the Earth to fill 8 Lava Fissures.
english.description: <The massive earth elemental gazes down upon you.>$B$BThe flow of the lava must be stopped if we are to prevail. I will grant to you a portion of my power. Use it to fill the lava fissures!
english.progress: Done?
english.completion: Well done, $r. Lord Magmathar's fire is now trapped, restrained within the earth once more.
english.completed: Return to Core at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.

text.title: 病逝
text.objectives: 杀死6头被吞噬的蓟熊，调查它们喝水的湖。
text.description: 我目前最关心的是那些还残留在林子里蓟熊家族。就在我们的南方，熊族祭坛那里，一代蓟熊都得了一种病。很要命的疾病。$B$B$N，我不知道它们患上的是什么，但这种疾病从体内吞噬了这些熊怪。整整一代熊怪都没救了，这使我痛苦万分，但我们必须把它们杀掉，让它们重归大地。$B$B更重要的是，我们必须找到病源。调查一下它们喝水的浅水湖！
text.completion: $n, this is terrible. What is that thing, and how did it get there? Something is devouring these animals, physically and spiritually. I had suspected the satyrs or some sort of disease was the culprit, but this is shaping up to be something ... unnatural.
text.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

english.title: Consumed
english.objectives: Kill 6 Consumed Thistle Bears and investigate the lake they're drinking from.
english.description: My first concern right now is for the thistle bear families who call what's left of these woods home. Just to our south, beyond the bear shrine, an entire generation has fallen ill. Gruesomely ill.$B$B$N, I don't know what they're suffering from, but it's consumed them from within. It pains me that a whole generation is beyond saving, but we've got to kill them off so that the earth can reclaim their bodies.$B$BMore importantly, we need to find the source. Investigate the shallow lake they drink from!
english.completion: $n, this is terrible. What is that thing, and how did it get there? Something is devouring these animals, physically and spiritually. I had suspected the satyrs or some sort of disease was the culprit, but this is shaping up to be something ... unnatural.
english.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 生命之种
text.objectives: 收集一颗大地之种、一颗海洋之种和一颗天空之种。
text.description: 有什么东西正试图从内部吞噬黑海岸的生命！我会打听打听你在湖里发现的这个——东西——的情报。与此同时，你要保护这里的野生动物免遭其害。$B$B你能不能给我收集一些素材？我需要生命的所有化身形式。跟林地的安努交谈可以获得一颗大地之种。俘虏一只漂浮在树木中的黑海岸小精灵，我们就有了天空之种。然后在西边海滩上的贝壳里找一颗海洋之种来。
text.progress: Life is powerful, $n. Concentrated in its purest form, it can overcome anything. Someday, even Darkshore will heal from its wounds. Did you find everything I need?
text.completion: Perfect, this is everything. Did you have fun collecting the wisp? I used to chase the wisps around Ashenvale when I was just a girl. I'm afraid I've found out what we're dealing with.
text.completed: Bring the seeds to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

english.title: The Seeds of Life
english.objectives: Gather a Seed of the Earth, a Seed of the Sea, and a Seed of the Sky.
english.description: Something is trying to devour the life of Darkshore from within! I'll ask around to learn more about the - thing - you discovered in the lake. Meanwhile, we need to protect the local wildlife from further harm.$B$BCan you gather some materials for me? I'll need life in all its incarnations. Talk to Onu here in the grove to acquire a Seed of the Earth. Capture a Darkshore Wisp floating amongst the trees and we'll have a Seed of the Sky. Find a Seed of the Sea within seashells along the coast, west of here.
english.progress: Life is powerful, $n. Concentrated in its purest form, it can overcome anything. Someday, even Darkshore will heal from its wounds. Did you find everything I need?
english.completion: Perfect, this is everything. Did you have fun collecting the wisp? I used to chase the wisps around Ashenvale when I was just a girl. I'm afraid I've found out what we're dealing with.
english.completed: Bring the seeds to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 破船一艘
text.objectives: 收集10块沉没的金属碎片。
text.description: 做工真垃圾！没别的可说了……$B$B这些船肯定是赶工赶出来的。根本用不着打中，整块整块的装甲板就会往下掉！$B$B我得让他们瞧瞧真正的手艺。但首先，你得帮我把材料从海床收集上来。$B$B把装甲片带来，剩下的就交给我吧。
text.progress: Were you able to recover that armor plating, $r?
text.completion: Good work, $r. I'll show them how an armored ship should be built!
text.completed: Speak to Dagrun at Zoram'gar.

english.title: Lousy Pieces of Ship
english.objectives: Recover 10 pieces of Sunken Scrap Metal.
english.description: Shoddy workmanship! There's no other explanation...$b$bThese ships must've been constructed in a hurry. Entire pieces of armor plating are falling off without even sustaining a direct hit!$b$bI'll show them how it is to be done. But first, I need you to recover the pieces from the sea floor.$b$bReturn to me with the pieces and I'll do the rest.
english.progress: Were you able to recover that armor plating, $r?
english.completion: Good work, $r. I'll show them how an armored ship should be built!
english.completed: Speak to Dagrun at Zoram'gar.

text.title: 把火灭了
text.objectives: 杀死10名熔岩狂暴者。要是你需要另一只冰涌水元素，就告诉阿克塔努斯。
text.description: 只有先将元素勋爵玛格玛萨的爪牙铲除，我们才能阻止这场毁灭森林的大火。$B$B北方日益壮大的熔岩狂暴者被属于它们自己的元素属性所强化，恐怕你单枪匹马对付它们的胜算不大。$B$B你准备好了就告诉我，我把我的元素召唤出来帮你。
text.completion: You acquitted yourself well in battle on the field. However, I'm afraid that Lord Magmathar has taken notice of you and the destruction that you've wreaked upon his minions. You will have to deal with him or he is sure to burn you alive, $n.
text.completed: Return to Arctanus at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.

english.title: Put Out The Fire
english.objectives: Slay 10 Lava Ragers. If you need another Freezing Surger, speak with Arctanus.
english.description: Lord Magmathar's minions must first be dealt with if we're to retake this area and put a stop to the fiery destruction of the forest.$B$BThe lava ragers on the flow to the north are strengthened by being on their own element. I fear that on your own, you won't have much chance against them.$B$BWhen you are ready, speak to me again, and I will summon one of my own to assist you.
english.completion: You acquitted yourself well in battle on the field. However, I'm afraid that Lord Magmathar has taken notice of you and the destruction that you've wreaked upon his minions. You will have to deal with him or he is sure to burn you alive, $n.
english.completed: Return to Arctanus at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.

text.title: 保卫黑海岸
text.objectives: 跟古树之林外的奥修斯谈一谈，骑上角鹰兽，从空中对8头白尾鹿、8只灰斑蓟熊，和8头月夜雌/雄虎进行防疫。
text.description: 现在我们知道预防手段有效，应该尽可能地进行大面积防疫。$B$B我已安排征用一头角鹰兽来，但我不能光靠一己之力。去和我的朋友奥修斯谈一谈，他就在林地外的飞行管理员旁边。你准备好了就告诉他，然后我们在那里见。我们要从空中对黑海岸进行清理，尽可能多地保护动物们！
text.completion: So the animals are safe, then. Thank you, thank you! But now it's time to turn our attention to the source.
text.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

english.title: In Defense of Darkshore
english.objectives: Talk to Orseus outside the Grove of the Ancients and mount a hippogryph. From the air, protect 8 Whitetail Deer, 8 Grizzled Thistle Bears, and 8 Moonstalker Matriarchs/Sires from the consumption.
english.description: Now that we know our preventative measures work, we should cover as much ground as possible.$B$BI've arranged to commandeer one of our hippogryphs, but I can't do this alone. Talk to my friend Orseus, next to the flight master right outside the grove here. Let him know when you're ready and I'll meet you there. We'll canvas Darkshore from the air and protect as many animals as we can!
english.completion: So the animals are safe, then. Thank you, thank you! But now it's time to turn our attention to the source.
english.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 魔法涡流
text.objectives: 使用呼啸的气旋的力量消灭元素勋爵玛格玛萨。
text.description: 时候到了，$N。你准备万全后就告诉我，我将召唤一团呼啸的气旋将你送上雷鸣峰。$B$B通过那元素来召唤大地之环的力量，在它的帮助下消灭元素勋爵玛格玛萨，让我们将他再一次带入平衡之中。
text.completion: It is done. The power of fire is subdued and the four elements are returned to harmony. You have saved the rest of Ashenvale through your brave and selfless actions, $n. You have our eternal thanks.
text.completed: Return to Sabina Pilgrim at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: The very essence of Thunder Peak. Snuff him out!

english.title: Vortex
english.objectives: Use the powers of the Whirling Vortex to slay Lord Magmathar.
english.description: The time has come, $N. When you have steeled yourself we will speak again and I will summon forth a whirling vortex to speed your way up to the skies over Thunder Peak.$B$BChannel the power of the Earthen Ring through the elemental to slay Lord Magmathar so that we may bring him into balance once more.
english.completion: It is done. The power of fire is subdued and the four elements are returned to harmony. You have saved the rest of Ashenvale through your brave and selfless actions, $n. You have our eternal thanks.
english.completed: Return to Sabina Pilgrim at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: The very essence of Thunder Peak. Snuff him out!

text.title: Venomhide Eggs
text.objectives: Bring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
text.description: Now that you've built up an immunity to venomhide toxin, you can safely handle the animals and their eggs. Venomhides are vicious and must be trained from the moment they hatch.$B$BIf you want to ride one, you'll need an unhatched egg. Scattered throughout the Marshlands are a number of ravasaur nests. Look for the eggs with lighter colored shells -- those are the ones that will hatch venomhides.$B$BIf you bring me several of the eggs, I'll allow you to keep one and raise its hatchling, with my guidance.
text.progress: Did you find those eggs?
text.completion: Good work. Honestly, I'm amazed you were able to find this many. With each clutch, they seem fewer in number. I'll let you raise one of the freshly-hatched venomhides. It shouldn't be shy about letting you know what it needs.
text.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: Venomhide Eggs
english.objectives: Bring 4 Venomhide Ravasaur Eggs to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands.
english.description: Now that you've built up an immunity to venomhide toxin, you can safely handle the animals and their eggs. Venomhides are vicious and must be trained from the moment they hatch.$B$BIf you want to ride one, you'll need an unhatched egg. Scattered throughout the Marshlands are a number of ravasaur nests. Look for the eggs with lighter colored shells -- those are the ones that will hatch venomhides.$B$BIf you bring me several of the eggs, I'll allow you to keep one and raise its hatchling, with my guidance.
english.progress: Did you find those eggs?
english.completion: Good work. Honestly, I'm amazed you were able to find this many. With each clutch, they seem fewer in number. I'll let you raise one of the freshly-hatched venomhides. It shouldn't be shy about letting you know what it needs.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 魔法涡流
text.objectives: 使用呼啸的气旋的力量消灭元素勋爵玛格玛萨。
text.description: 时候到了，$N。你准备万全后就告诉我，我将召唤一团呼啸的气旋将你送上雷鸣峰。$B$B通过那元素来召唤大地之环的力量，在它的帮助下消灭元素勋爵玛格玛萨，让我们将他再一次带入平衡之中。
text.completion: You've done it! The spirits were right after all! The power of fire is subdued and the four elements are returned to harmony. The rest of Ashenvale is spared this fiery fate. You have the eternal thanks of the Earthen Ring.
text.completed: Return to Stikwad at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: The very essence of Thunder Peak. Snuff him out!

english.title: Vortex
english.objectives: Use the powers of the Whirling Vortex to slay Lord Magmathar.
english.description: The time has come, $N. When you have steeled yourself we will speak again and I will summon forth a whirling vortex to speed your way up to the skies over Thunder Peak.$B$BChannel the power of the Earthen Ring through the elemental to slay Lord Magmathar so that we may bring him into balance once more.
english.completion: You've done it! The spirits were right after all! The power of fire is subdued and the four elements are returned to harmony. The rest of Ashenvale is spared this fiery fate. You have the eternal thanks of the Earthen Ring.
english.completed: Return to Stikwad at Thunder Peak in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: The very essence of Thunder Peak. Snuff him out!

text.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
text.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
text.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.
text.completion: The venomhide hatchling seems satisfied with the giant meal you've provided, but there's no way of telling when it will be hungry again.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Fresh Dinosaur Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.

As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.

english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.

text.title: 别让火灭了
text.objectives: 佐拉姆加的指挥官怒牙要你将魔尾多头蛇之油浇在灯塔的火焰上。
text.description: 这任务非同小可，$R！$B$B越来越多的船只到来，但是没有灯塔，它们就都要迷航——甚至更糟！因此我授命于你，保障灯塔的照明。$B$B从这片水域的多头蛇身上收集油脂，把它带到这里的熔炉来炼成燃油。$B$B把油浇在灯塔的火苗上，可以给我们争取一点必要的时间。
text.completion: Nice work, $r! No more ships will run aground, thanks to you.

english.title: Keep the Fires Burning
english.objectives: Commander Grimfang at Zoram'gar wants you to pour Mystlash Hydra Oil on the lighthouse fire.
english.description: This is no small task, $r!$b$bWe have more ships arriving, and without the lighthouse they'll be lost - or worse! You are hereby charged with keeping its fire lit.$b$bCollect the blubber from the hydras in these waters, then bring it to the forge here to melt it into oil.$b$bThrowing that oil on the lighthouse fire will buy us the time we need.
english.completion: Nice work, $r! No more ships will run aground, thanks to you.

text.title: 黑海岸的吞噬者
text.objectives: 在古树之林南边的圣湖岸上使用予生者幼苗，摧毁吞噬神器和它的守护者。
text.description: 现在黑海岸的生物都安全了，让我们把注意转到你在湖里发现的神器上来。我相信它是上古众神的某个手下所为。我们要用黑海岸自身的生命力同这些恶魔较量！把予生者幼苗带到南边的圣湖去。在湖面挥动，就能解除上古神器的效用。$B$B要当心，$N。神器可能被某种不明生物守护着。
text.progress: I'm afraid to ask, $n. Is the artifact destroyed? What about its guardian?
text.completion: Love of Elune, look at you. That must've been some fight! You're covered in what looks like... chowder. If a mere minion could cause so much agony here in Darkshore, I can't even imagine the suffering that a true Old One could bring about. Well, at least the animals are safe for now. I will plant the sapling you created to help rebuild this shattered land. Thank you, $n! I'd give you a hug but, you know. Chowder.
text.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
text.giverWindow: Who knows what you might find...

english.title: The Devourer of Darkshore
english.objectives: Use the Lifebringer Sapling on the shore of the shallow lake south of the Grove of the Ancients to destroy the Devouring Artifact and its guardian.
english.description: Now that the creatures of Darkshore are safe, let's turn our attention to the artifact you found in the lake. I believe it's the work of a minion of the Old Gods. We'll fight these fiends using the very lifegiving energies of Darkshore itself! Take the Lifebringer Sapling to the shore of the shallow lake to the south of here. Wave it over the waters of the lake and it should disable that ancient artifact.$B$BBe careful, $N. The artifact is likely to be guarded by who-knows-what.
english.progress: I'm afraid to ask, $n. Is the artifact destroyed? What about its guardian?
english.completion: Love of Elune, look at you. That must've been some fight! You're covered in what looks like... chowder. If a mere minion could cause so much agony here in Darkshore, I can't even imagine the suffering that a true Old One could bring about. Well, at least the animals are safe for now. I will plant the sapling you created to help rebuild this shattered land. Thank you, $n! I'd give you a hug but, you know. Chowder.
english.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.giverWindow: Who knows what you might find...

text.title: 不着痕迹
text.objectives: 用黑豹雕像潜入主宰之剑刺探暮光之锤的行动。
text.description: 西南边遗留着的一具尸体，似乎和暮光之锤邪教徒所崇拜的上古众神有关。$B$B他早在我们的时代之前就被击败了——不是被泰坦，就是被他们的造物之一。$B$B我们注意到那一地区邪教日盛，毫无疑问来者不善。$B$B我们要弄清楚他们在计划些什么，以及为什么。带上这尊雕像，它能让你在收集情报的时候不被发现。
text.completion: This is dire news, $n.  If you are correct, then we'd best act swiftly and decisively. We cannot allow this "Soggoth" to be brought back to life.

english.title: Leave No Tracks
english.objectives: Sneak into the Master's Glaive using the Panther Figurine and spy on the Twilight's Hammer.
english.description: To the southwest lies the corpse of a being somehow related to the Old Gods that the Twilight's Hammer cultists worship.$B$BHe was defeated before our time -- if not by the Titans themselves, certainly by one of their creations.$B$BWe've noted an increase in cult activity in that area which can only mean something terrible is amiss.$B$BWe're going to need to find out what they're planning to do there and why.  Take this figurine, it'll help you avoid being detected while you gather intelligence.
english.completion: This is dire news, $n.  If you are correct, then we'd best act swiftly and decisively. We cannot allow this "Soggoth" to be brought back to life.

text.title: 索苟斯与克洛恩
text.objectives: 把你获得的情报告诉古树之林的拉蕾。
text.description: 主宰之剑曾是一处古战场，$N。泰坦们派二十名石巨人挑战索苟斯。$B$B在二十名巨人里，只有一个活了下来。$B$B石板上记载道，石巨人中最庞大的克洛恩让自己被索苟斯的触手缠住——直到他被送到那怪物的头颅面前……恰能递出手中那一剑。$B$B他死了不失为一件好事……我们可再也没有办法召集二十位石巨人一起来阻止他了。
text.completion: The dwarf's story is unsettling... yet informative.  It seems we have few options left.

english.title: Soggoth and Kronn
english.objectives: Return to Larien at the Grove of the Ancients with the information you've obtained.
english.description: The Master's Glaive was the site of an ancient battle, $N.  The titans sent twenty of their stone giants against Soggoth.$B$BOf those twenty giants, one survived.$B$BThe tablets say that Kronn, the largest of the stone giants allowed himself to be entangled by Soggoth's tendrils -- just long enough to be lifted close enough to the creature's skull... within reach of his mighty sword.$B$BIt's a good thing he's dead... we don't really have twenty stone giants lying around to stop him again.
english.completion: The dwarf's story is unsettling... yet informative.  It seems we have few options left.

text.title: 休眠的古树
text.objectives: 去找黑海岸古树之林东北的阿洛斯。
text.description: 我们也许没有二十个石巨人可以和敌人对抗，但我们古木巨人依然同顽石一般强壮。 $B$B看看你的四周，$R。我的同胞们沉睡着……但只要时机一到，他们自会响应守护者的号角。$B$B你可以到东北方的桥那里找到阿洛斯，古树之林的守护者。$B$B把我们的紧急情况告诉他。
text.completion: Aros's body appears to be lifeless yet still warm.  Perhaps his killers are nearby.

english.title: The Slumbering Ancients
english.objectives: Find Aros northeast of the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.description: We may not have twenty stone giants to take on our enemy, but we giants of ancient lumber are as strong as any rock.$B$BLook around you, $r.  My kindred sleep... yet they will heed the keeper's horn when the time of need is upon them.$B$BYou will find Aros, the keeper of the grove, beyond the bridge northeast of here.$B$BTell him the urgency of our situation.
english.completion: Aros's body appears to be lifeless yet still warm.  Perhaps his killers are nearby.

text.title: 出土的知识
text.objectives: 跟雷姆塔维尔挖掘场的考古学家格罗夫谈一谈。
text.description: 听着，$N。我们得知道我们要对付的是什么才行。$B$B西南边主宰之剑后面，有一群矮人勘测员在发掘附近的废墟。$B$B也许他们的考古知识能帮上我们的忙。
text.completion: Oh, we know a thing or two about this Soggoth.  The question is... do you really want to know?

english.title: Unearthed Knowledge
english.objectives: Speak to Archaeologist Groff at Remtravel's Excavation.
english.description: Listen, $N.  We need to learn more about what we're up against.$B$BTo the southwest, beyond the Master's Glaive, there is a group of dwarven prospectors who were excavating the nearby ruins.$B$BPerhaps they have uncovered knowledge that is useful to us in this matter.
english.completion: Oh, we know a thing or two about this Soggoth.  The question is... do you really want to know?

text.title: 黑海岸之战
text.objectives: 在主宰之剑杀死索苟斯的化身。
text.description: 林地里的古树前来帮助我们了，$N。我现在就能通过他们的双眼看见这一切。$B$B暮光之锤不得不加速仪式，导致他们没有完全地复活可怕的索苟斯。$B$B把他消灭掉，$N，不然就太晚了。别的地方还需要我。$B$B这一切都结束之后，回到古树之林的德鲁伊们那里去，他们会给你进一步的指示。
text.completion: We can finally rest here now, $n.  It appears Darkshore has been saved -- and we have you to thank for it.
text.completed: 去找黑海岸古树之林的利爪德鲁伊巴尔伦。
text.giverWindow: Send him back into the depths, where he belongs.

english.title: The Battle for Darkshore
english.objectives: Slay the Avatar of Soggoth at the Master's Glaive.
english.description: The ancients of the grove have come to our aid, $N.  I can see through their eyes even as we speak.$B$BThe Twilight's Hammer has been forced to hasten their ritual and have thus only managed to resurrect but a remnant of dread Soggoth.$B$BDestroy it before it's too late, $N.  I am needed elsewhere.$B$BReturn to the druids at the Grove of the Ancients when it is all over they will direct you further.
english.completion: We can finally rest here now, $n.  It appears Darkshore has been saved -- and we have you to thank for it.
english.completed: Return to Balren of the Claw at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.giverWindow: Send him back into the depths, where he belongs.

text.title: 形势对我们不利
text.objectives: 杀死8名暗鳞随从。
text.description: 我们不能就这么让纳迦给逃了，$N。杀害古树之林的守护者形同宣战。$B$B你可以在西南远处纳兹维尔岛的一个洞里发现他们的老巢。$B$B我要你将清楚的信息送过去。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  The naga seek the destruction and subjugation of all surface-dwellers -- do not hesitate to drive them out of our lands and back into the shadowy ocean depths where they belong.
text.completed: Return to Felros at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

english.title: The Tides Turn Against Us
english.objectives: Slay 8 Darkscale Myrmidons.
english.description: We cannot let the naga get away with this, $N.  Slaying the keeper of the grove amounts to a declaration of war.$B$BYou'll find their den inside a cave on the island of Naj'vel, far to the southwest.$B$BI want you to send them a clear message.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  The naga seek the destruction and subjugation of all surface-dwellers -- do not hesitate to drive them out of our lands and back into the shadowy ocean depths where they belong.
english.completed: Return to Felros at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 暗鳞督军
text.objectives: 击败纳兹维尔的怒脊督军。
text.description: 要是纳迦打算同暮光之锤同流合污，那愿艾露恩怜悯他们。$B$B去纳兹维尔岛他们的巢穴里，找到他们的首领，纳迦督军怒脊。$B$B也许远古之角还有救。
text.completion: The walord doesn't seem to have the horn on him.  Perhaps he was telling the truth.

english.title: The Darkscale Warlord
english.objectives: Slay Warlord Wrathspine inside Nazj'vel.
english.description: If the naga want to throw in their lot with the Twilight's Hammer, then may Elune have mercy on them.$B$BGo into their lair in the island of Nazj'vel and find their leader, the naga warlord known only as Wrathspine.$B$BPerhaps the horn of the ancients can still be saved.
english.completion: The walord doesn't seem to have the horn on him.  Perhaps he was telling the truth.

text.title: 献给艾萨拉
text.objectives: 阻止暗鳞女祭司将远古之角献给纳兹维尔上的艾萨拉。
text.description: 督军称远古之角被献给了纳兹维尔上的艾萨拉。$B$B也许为时还不晚，能让远古圣物免遭摧毁。
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  Unfortunately the battle is far from over.

english.title: The Offering to Azshara
english.objectives: Stop the Darkscale Priestesses from offering the Horn of the Ancients to Azshara above Nazj'vel.
english.description: The warlord said the horn of the ancients was being offered to Azshara above Nazj'vel.$B$BPerhaps it's not too late to save the ancient relic from being destroyed.
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  Unfortunately the battle is far from over.

text.title: 绝望深渊
text.objectives: 杀死6名黑暗深渊海潮祭司。
text.description: There is more to this Naga problem than meets the eye, $c.  It appears that the issue will not be resolved by merely thinning their numbers. To humble them, a more severe impression must be made.$b$bTravel to the northern end of Zoram Strand and enter Blackfathom Deep. Once there, demonstrate to the naga that their presence in this region will no longer be tolerated!
text.completion: Excellent! Let the naga retreat back into the seas where they belong!
text.completed: Return to Marukai at Zoram'gar in Ashenvale.

english.title: Deep Despair
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackfathom Tide Priestesses.
english.description: There is more to this Naga problem than meets the eye, $c.  It appears that the issue will not be resolved by merely thinning their numbers. To humble them, a more severe impression must be made.$b$bTravel to the northern end of Zoram Strand and enter Blackfathom Deep. Once there, demonstrate to the naga that their presence in this region will no longer be tolerated!
english.completion: Excellent! Let the naga retreat back into the seas where they belong!
english.completed: Return to Marukai at Zoram'gar in Ashenvale.

text.title: 组织进攻
text.objectives: 跟黑海岸古树之林的利爪德鲁伊巴尔伦谈一谈。
text.description: 我们在黑海岸的工作还没有结束。虽然我们阻止了大陆分崩离析，但敌人在这里的势力依然强大。$B$B我要你去南方的古树之林联系一群德鲁伊。他们的首领是我的一个老朋友，利爪德鲁伊巴尔伦。$B$B告诉他们，与敌人决战的时刻到了。这里一旦稳定下来，我就去帮助他们。
text.completion: If Malfurion placed his trust in you, then so shall I.  You'll find that our enemies greatly outnumber us this far south.$B$BWhere brute force and numbers fail us, strategy and guile will prove our biggest advantages.

english.title: Mounting the Offensive
english.objectives: Speak to Balren of the Claw at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.description: Our work in Darkshore is not yet done.  We might have stopped the landmass from shattering, but our enemies still have a strong presence in the area.$B$BI want you to contact a group of druids at the Grove of the Ancients, far to the south.  They are led by an old friend of mine, Balren of the Claw.$B$BTell them that the time has come to take the battle to our foes.  I will come to aid them as soon as we stabilize the area.
english.completion: If Malfurion placed his trust in you, then so shall I.  You'll find that our enemies greatly outnumber us this far south.$B$BWhere brute force and numbers fail us, strategy and guile will prove our biggest advantages.

text.title: 格里什幼虫
text.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
text.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in the center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
text.completion: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

english.title: Gorishi Grub
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in the center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
english.completion: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 水煮、爆炒还是生吃？
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它12枚异种蝎卵。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙崽的肚皮发出“咕咕”的响声。它挥舞胳膊，引起了你的注意。然后它在土地上画出一些异种蝎，又在蝎子下面画了一些小的椭圆形。$B$B那一定是异种蝎的卵。你可以到位于塔纳利斯西部，靠近安戈洛环形山边界的腐化之巢去。那里可是一个收集异种蝎卵的好地方。
text.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

english.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.
english.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: Searing Roc Feathers
text.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to get 5 pieces of Searing Roc Plumage.
text.description: The hatchling looks at you for a moment, almost as if wondering whether you'll understand. It scrawls a picture of a pair of feathers in the dirt, then points with one claw to the bindings at its elbows and knees.$B$BIt doesn't seem hungry, but what could the feathers be for?$B$BIt must want them for adornments like the ones you've seen on other raptors. The largest feathers come from the searing rocs that congregate around the bones of large creatures in western Tanaris, northeast of Thistleshrub Valley.
text.progress: Your venomhide hatchling looks at you with anticipation.
text.completion: The venomhide hatchling accepts the feathers and begins looking them over, holding several up to its armbands.
text.completed: Return to Venomhide Hatchling.

text.title: 飞速成长
text.objectives: 将20枚毒皮暴掠幼龙牙齿、你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽，还有20块符文布、20块硬甲皮和80金币交给位于安戈洛环形山沼泽地东南的莫维克。
text.description: 在你的悉心照料和喂养下，你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽长大得很快。它的乳齿很快就会被成年暴掠龙的牙齿取代了。如果你注意保留你的龙崽在成长过程中脱落的牙齿，那么你就能明确地判断它在何时成长到了可以被训练成坐骑的程度。$B$B你的毒皮暴掠龙会让你知道它需要什么。所以，你要密切注意它的一举一动。等到它的全部乳齿都已脱落的时候，就带着它和制作龙鞍的材料回来见我。我会帮你完成其余的事情。
text.progress: Have you been taking good care of that raptor?
text.completion: It looks like both of you have managed to do some growing without killing one another. There, everything's finished. I've trained your venomhide ravasaur to respond when you blow this whistle. Few have the dedication to hand-feed and raise a venomhide, but they're well worth the effort.
text.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

english.title: They Grow Up So Fast
english.objectives: Return 20 Venomhide Baby Teeth,  the Venomhide Hatchling, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeastern part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
english.description: With your expert feeding and care, your venomhide hatchling will grow quickly. As they grow, their hatchling teeth will be replaced by adult teeth. If you keep the teeth shed by your hatchling as it grows, you'll have an easy way to tell when it's mature enough to be trained as a mount.$B$BYour venomhide will let you know what it needs, so pay close attention. When it has shed all of its baby teeth, return to me with your venomhide and the materials for your saddle and I'll do the rest.
english.progress: Have you been taking good care of that raptor?
english.completion: It looks like both of you have managed to do some growing without killing one another. There, everything's finished. I've trained your venomhide ravasaur to respond when you blow this whistle. Few have the dedication to hand-feed and raise a venomhide, but they're well worth the effort.
english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 清扫废墟
text.objectives: 消灭共计10只占据在雷姆塔维尔挖掘场的灰雾智者和灰雾难民。
text.description: 铁炉堡的大胡子们一听到灾变的消息，就把我派来检查雷塔维的挖掘工作了。瞧瞧！无价的神器被冲到海里，几个月的血汗挖掘毁于一旦。$B$B浪潮袭来的时候，他们把沿岸的鱼人营地都摧毁了。好事情？不，我可没那么走运。幸存者们都窝在废墟的庇护所里，他们比元素还要能折腾。你介不介意把胶鞋穿上，处理一下这些玩意儿？
text.completion: Bravo, $n! Now let's take a look-see at our new situation. What? MORE murlocs? I swear on my stones, the more murlocs you kill, the more murlocs appear. Is it just me? We're going to need a new approach.
text.completed: Return to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

english.title: Sweeping Clean the Ruins
english.objectives: Kill 10 of any combination of Greymist Oracles or Greymist Refugees squatting within Remtravel's Excavation.
english.description: The big beards at Ironforge sent me here to check on Remtravel's dig the moment they got word of the disaster. Look at it! Precious artifacts washed to sea, months of tedious digging undone in a moment.$B$BWhen the tidal waves hit, they demolished the murloc encampments along the shore. Good news? Naw, not with my luck. The survivors are squatting in the shelter of the ruins, and they're doing more damage than the elements ever could. Would you mind getting your waders on and taking care of things?
english.completion: Bravo, $n! Now let's take a look-see at our new situation. What? MORE murlocs? I swear on my stones, the more murlocs you kill, the more murlocs appear. Is it just me? We're going to need a new approach.
english.completed: Return to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

text.title: Gearing Up To Ride
text.objectives: Bring 20 Rugged Leather, 20 Runecloth, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.
text.description: Your venomhide is strong and healthy and you've developed quite a bond. You'll be ready to ride him once I've completed your saddle and bridle. Just like you, they have to be specially conditioned to stand up to the toxins the raptor produces.$B$BAll you'll need to do is bring me some rugged leather, runecloth, and money to buy the rest of the supplies and I'll have that saddle for you in no time.
text.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

english.objectives: Bring 20 Rugged Leather, 20 Runecloth, and 80 gold to Mor'vek in the southeast part of the Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

english.completed: Return to Mor'vek at The Marshlands in Un'Goro Crater.

text.title: 有废料吗？
text.objectives: 在雷姆塔维尔挖掘场海岸附近的水域里收集5片可回收的灰雾残骸。
text.description: 我们能弄明白的，$N。只要靠矮人的聪明才智。想啊，格罗夫，使劲想！$B$B这些鱼人只是想找个家，对吧？那么咱们就干些有建设性的，顾名思义，就是盖屋子。$B$B大灾变时许多残骸都被冲上了岸，有些被毁的鱼人小屋还能够回收。沿着这里的海岸收集所有能够为鱼人所用的建筑材料。不用说，那标准是相当的低。
text.progress: Wet enough for ya?
text.completion: Well, not much here that don't look stepped on, sat on, or soaked in a toilet. But toss some thatch on top and it'll do. Tell me, $n, do you consider yourself an architect?
text.completed: Bring the wreckage to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

english.title: Got Some Flotsam?
english.objectives: Collect 5 pieces of Salvageable Greymist Wreckage from along the shore and in the water near the Remtravel Excavation.
english.description: We can figure this out, $N. We just need some Dwarven ingenuity. Think, Groffy, think!$B$BThese murlocs are just looking for a home, right? Let's do something constructive. I mean that literally.$B$BAll sorts of debris was washed ashore during the catastrophe, and some of the decimated murloc hovels may still be salvageable. Run along the shore here and gather up any building materials fit for a murloc. That's an admittedly low standard.
english.progress: Wet enough for ya?
english.completion: Well, not much here that don't look stepped on, sat on, or soaked in a toilet. But toss some thatch on top and it'll do. Tell me, $n, do you consider yourself an architect?
english.completed: Bring the wreckage to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

text.title: 新家
text.objectives: 格罗夫用旗子在附近的海滩上标记了一个施工点，去那里建一所鱼人小屋。
text.description: 我们能建成吗？是的我们能！挖掘场西边我在岸上插了一面旗帜。那里的沙地紧实，是块再好不过的地方了。带上我的工具还有你找到的材料，给这些臭脾气的讨厌鬼建个新住处。
text.progress: How goes our new seaside condo?
text.completion: Har har, that sounds like quite a heap you built there. Did they take to it? Good, good! Let's see if my plan comes to fruition. What have I done?
text.completed: Return to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

english.title: A New Home
english.objectives: Build a murloc hovel at a site Groff marked with a flag on the nearby shore.
english.description: Can we build it? Yes we can! Just west of the dig site I planted a banner on the shore. The sand is firm and it's as good a site as any. Take my tools and the parts you collected and build these ornery pests a different place to live.
english.progress: How goes our new seaside condo?
english.completion: Har har, that sounds like quite a heap you built there. Did they take to it? Good, good! Let's see if my plan comes to fruition. What have I done?
english.completed: Return to Archaeologist Groff at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

text.title: 心不在焉的勘察员
text.objectives: 护送迷糊的勘察员雷塔维去找他遗失的日志。完成之后跟挖掘场的初级考古学家费德谈一谈。
text.description: 你是谁来着？$N？我们见过吗？你要是协会派来的，告诉他们我不走！没有发现之前决不。我曾经有过，曾经就攥在手中！然后就是尖叫。然后就是潮湿。$B$B听好了你那谁，潮汐来的那天我把整件事都记录在日志里了。我知道我把东西落在哪儿了。日志。不是说我的发现。帮我找到一样，就能找到另一样！要么反过来也成！你听明白了吗？明白了就跟着我！
text.completion: Ah, you've helped the Prospector find his missing journal! To think it was here all along. Someday you'll have to show me this other set of ruins he's always going on about.
text.completed: Talk to Jr. Archaeologist Ferd at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore.

english.title: The Absent-Minded Prospector
english.objectives: Escort the confused Prospector Remtravel to his missing journal. Talk to Jr. Archaeologist Ferd at the dig site when you're done.
english.description: Who are you again? $N? Have we met? If you're here from the League, you can tell them I'm not leaving! Not without my find. I had it, right in my hands! Then the screaming. Then the wetness.$B$BListen here whos-yer-name, I documented the whole thing in my journal the day the tidal wave hit. And I know just where I left it! The journal. Not the find. Help me get the one so we can get the other! Or vice-versa! Do you follow? Follow me!
english.completion: Ah, you've helped the Prospector find his missing journal! To think it was here all along. Someday you'll have to show me this other set of ruins he's always going on about.
english.completed: Talk to Jr. Archaeologist Ferd at Remtravel's Excavation in Darkshore.

text.title: 埋没的秘密
text.objectives: 在附近的废墟里找到一个裹着泥巴的古老圆盘。
text.description: 在雷塔维健忘的外表下是一个天才的大脑，被昏聩所掩藏的谜团。但我不打算放弃这老人。瞧瞧我在他的笔记里发现了什么……不是那儿……不，那是购物清单……这里，他试图找出年份的这页：圆盘！$B$B我们认为这件泰坦神器是某种加密储存环。灾难来临时我们正在小心地将其出土，好在它还在那些废墟里。去把它给我带回来！
text.progress: Did you find it? Groff wants to clear out of these ruins as soon as possible!
text.completion: Spectacular! Good work, $n. I'm sure Remtravel would thank you himself if he could remember your name. Look at the surface of the disc - these microscopic etchings - this is amazing. I'm certain this strange wheel holds information, if only we could read it...
text.completed: Bring the Disc back to Jr. Archaeologist Ferd at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

english.title: Swamped Secrets
english.objectives: Find a Mud-Crusted Ancient Disc from within the nearby ruins.
english.description: Underneath Remtravel's forgetful exterior is the mind of a genius, an enigma cloaked in senility. But I'm not about to give up on the old man. Look at what I found in his notes... not there... no, that's a shopping list... Here, on the page where he's trying to figure out what year it is: The Disc!$B$BWe think this Titan artifact is some sort of encrypted storage wheel. We were carefully unearthing it when the disaster hit, but hopefully it's still in the ruins. Dive in and grab it for me!
english.progress: Did you find it? Groff wants to clear out of these ruins as soon as possible!
english.completion: Spectacular! Good work, $n. I'm sure Remtravel would thank you himself if he could remember your name. Look at the surface of the disc - these microscopic etchings - this is amazing. I'm certain this strange wheel holds information, if only we could read it...
english.completed: Bring the Disc back to Jr. Archaeologist Ferd at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

text.title: 他们抓走了我们的侏儒
text.objectives: Rescue Boog the "Gear Whisperer" and Minx from Painmaster Thundrak's Wagon of Unending Agony.$B$B
text.description: The gnome explosives squad we requested from Tinker Town arrived last week. Just in time to face an assault by the Horde. We lost a lot of soldiers that day. Most of the gnome team was taken as well. Now we're neck deep in Horde, Silverwind Refuge has been lost and we're down a dozen gnomes.$B$BI'm begging for your help here, $N. Travel east to Silverwind Refuge and look for any gnome survivors. They were all carted off by a big, merciless orc named Thundrak. Find him and you'll find our gnomes.
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Grim news you bring of the rest of the gnome team, but at least you managed to save a few. For that I am grateful.
text.completed: 去找灰谷星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳。

english.objectives: Rescue Boog the "Gear Whisperer" and Minx from Painmaster Thundrak's Wagon of Unending Agony.$B$B

english.completion: Thank you, $n. Grim news you bring of the rest of the gnome team, but at least you managed to save a few. For that I am grateful.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

text.title: Hungry, Hungry Hatchling
text.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 15 pieces of Fresh Dinosaur Meat.
text.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe drawings are rough, but you can make out the shapes of diemetradons, stegodons, and pterrordaxes. As the raptor finishes the sketch, it looks up at you, bares its teeth, and makes a biting motion.$B$BYour venomhide hatchling must be craving fresh meat from these animals. Find and kill any type of diematradon, stegodon, or pterrordax in Un'Goro Crater and feed its meat to your hungry hatchling.
text.completion: The venomhide hatchling seems satisfied with the giant meal you've provided, but there's no way of telling when it will be hungry again.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Fresh Dinosaur Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 水煮、爆炒还是生吃？
text.objectives: 你的毒皮暴掠龙幼崽想要你喂它12枚异种蝎卵。
text.description: 这只毒皮暴掠龙崽的肚皮发出“咕咕”的响声。它挥舞胳膊，引起了你的注意。然后它在土地上画出一些异种蝎，又在蝎子下面画了一些小的椭圆形。$B$B那一定是异种蝎的卵。你可以到位于塔纳利斯西部，靠近安戈洛环形山边界的腐化之巢去。那里可是一个收集异种蝎卵的好地方。
text.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

english.title: Poached, Scrambled, Or Raw?
english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 12 Silithid Eggs.
english.description: The venomhide hatchling's stomach growls as it gestures to get your attention. It begins scratching pictures of silithids into the dirt, adding small ovals underneath them. It looks at you hopefully and gestures at the circles.$B$BThey can only mean silithid eggs. The Noxious Lair, in western Tanaris and near the border with Un'Goro Crater, would probably be a great place to find the eggs your little hatchling wants.
english.completion: Your hatchling licks its lips after devouring the meal of silithid eggs. For a moment, you think it seems disappointed that feeding time has come to an end.
english.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
english.objective1: Silithid Eggs fed to Venomhide Hatchling

text.title: 格里什幼虫
text.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
text.description: The venomhide hatchling looks at you expectantly, then begins to scrawl a pictogram into the dirt.$B$BThe hatchling's drawings seem to resemble various types of large insects, perhaps the gorishi silithids. The hatchling finishes his picture, then gestures at it with one short arm, snaps its jaws, and licks its lips.$B$BIt must want you to go to the Slithering Scar, in the center of the southern part of Un'Goro Crater, and gather silithid meat. When you have the meat, feed it to your hungry hatchling.
text.completion: Your venomhide hatchling flashes you a toothy smile and then settles in for a nap.
text.completed: Speak to your Venomhide Hatchling.
text.objective1: Silithid Meat fed to Venomhide Hatchling

english.objectives: Your Venomhide Hatchling wants you to feed it 10 Silithid Meat.
