text.title: 泰坦终端
text.objectives: 在雷姆塔维尔挖掘场附近的海滩使用地底圣物探测器找到5枚远古圣物碎片。把它们合成组装完成的远古圣物。
text.description: 一旦有了圆盘，许多早期发现就有了意义。就在我到来后不久，勘察员雷塔维出土了一个被认为是史前烤面包炉的文物。$B$B我个人认为这个带槽的盒子是某种数据读取器。不幸的是，它在潮汐来袭时被摔成了几瓣，同我们的营地一起被冲走了！$B$B应该不会很远，$N。碎片一定就埋在附近的沙地里。给，用我这台靠得住的地底圣物探测器把海滩给搜个遍。
text.progress: Did you assemble all the pieces of the slotted device? We may need to remove Prospector Remtravel's sandwich from the ancient data interface.
text.completion: Why yes, yes, this is it! See here, the slot is the exact dimensions of the ancient disc, just as I'd surmised. Here's your reward, $n - you've earned it. Are you ready to meet history face to face? Let's see what the ancients have to say!
text.completed: Bring the device to Jr. Arcaheologist Ferd at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

english.title: The Titans' Terminal
english.objectives: Use Buried Artifact Detector on the beach near Remtravel's Excavation site to locate 5 Ancient Device Fragments. Combine them to create the Ancient Slotted Device.
english.description: Now that we have the disc, a lot of our earlier finds are starting to make sense. Shortly after my arrival, Prospector Remtravel unearthed what he presumed to be a prehistoric toaster.$B$BIt's my belief that this slotted box is some sort of data reader. Unfortunately, it broke apart and washed away with the rest of our base camp when the tidal wave struck!$B$BIt can't have gone far, $N. Pieces must be buried in the nearby sand. Here, use my trusty buried artifact detector to comb the beach for them.
english.progress: Did you assemble all the pieces of the slotted device? We may need to remove Prospector Remtravel's sandwich from the ancient data interface.
english.completion: Why yes, yes, this is it! See here, the slot is the exact dimensions of the ancient disc, just as I'd surmised. Here's your reward, $n - you've earned it. Are you ready to meet history face to face? Let's see what the ancients have to say!
english.completed: Bring the device to Jr. Arcaheologist Ferd at the Remtravel Excavation site in Darkshore.

text.title: 月亮井之旅
text.objectives: 在灰谷纯净月亮井中净化艾露恩之泪。
text.description: 没起作用。$B$B<皮尔图拉斯一副悲伤无奈的表情，将泪水从汤剂中轻轻捞起，温柔地洗净。>$B$B一定是雷鸣峰的爆发影响了它。你必须将泪水带到火山脚下东南方的纯净月亮井那儿去，在女神之力的保护下，它依然完好无损。$B$B你要用艾露恩的圣水洗涤它。之后会发生什么，我也不好说。我担心女儿的性命，$N，它现在就在你手上了。

english.title: A Trip to the Moonwell
english.objectives: Take the Tear of Elune and cleanse it in the waters of the Moonwell of Purity in Ashenvale.
english.description: It didn't work.$B$B<A sorrowful and resigned expression upon his face, Pelturas removes the tear from the soup and gently washes it.>$B$BThe eruption of Thunder Peak must have affected it in some way. You must take the tear to the Moonwell of Purity, which still lies intact, protected by the goddess' power, at the southeast base of the volcano.$B$BThere, you will wash it in the sacred waters of Elune. What happens beyond that, I cannot say. I fear for my daughter's life. It is in your hands now, $N.

text.title: 你走之前……
text.objectives: 将带5块鹿肉排带给佐拉姆加的指挥官怒牙。
text.description: 地狱咆哮岗哨急需优秀的$C，$N。不过在你出发之前，这里还有事情要你处理。$B$B咱们的口粮多半都因为联盟的袭击而沉到海里去了。为了灰谷的战役，我们必须储存足够多的食物才行。$B$B你可以在东边找到大量的野生动物。给我们的士兵们打来最上等的野味！
text.progress: 怎麽了，$R?
text.completion: These venison should make our soldiers' spirits rise for the coming battles. Here's something for your troubles.

english.title: Before You Go...
english.objectives: Bring 5 Venison Steaks to Commander Grimfang in Zoram'gar.
english.description: We have urgent need for good $cs at Hellscream's Watch, $n. But before you're dispatched, there remains something that needs doing here.$b$bMost of our perishable goods were lost at sea due mainly to Alliance attacks. We must stock enough food to carry out our Ashenvale campaign.$b$bJust east of here, you should find wildlife in abundance. Bring back the best meat you can find for our troops!
english.progress: Yes, $r?
english.completion: These venison should make our soldiers' spirits rise for the coming battles. Here's something for your troubles.

text.title: 那应被原谅之人
text.objectives: 跟灰谷林中树塔的阿夫鲁斯·病语谈一谈。
text.description: <一个声音从月亮井里飘进你的脑海，带给你一种完美的宁静感。>$B$B你想要治疗一个孩子，但万事都有代价。东边便是林中树塔。在塔的外面，我的月亮井旁边，有一名坠入腐化的人。$B$B阿夫鲁斯·病语寻求原谅和救赎，$N。你是否愿意帮他完成心愿，并以此达成你自己的目标？
text.completion: Finally, my redemption is at hand. I have waited long for this day and I think I know how to help you in turn.

english.title: He Who Would Be Forgiven
english.objectives: Speak with Avrus Illwhisper at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.
english.description: <A voice from inside the moonwell flows over your mind, bringing you a perfect sense of peace.>$B$BYou seek to cure a child, but know that all things come at a cost. To the east lies Raynewood Tower. Standing outside the tower, next to my moonwell, is one who has fallen into corruption.$B$BAvrus Illwhisper seeks forgiveness and redemption, $N. Will you help him to attain that which he desires and in so doing achieve your own goal?
english.completion: Finally, my redemption is at hand. I have waited long for this day and I think I know how to help you in turn.

text.title: 误入贼手
text.objectives: 获得5块陨落的月亮石。
text.description: 我曾经的氏族，夜道谷的魔草氏族，前些时候袭击了坠星湖，偷走了那里特有的月亮石。$B$B那里的月亮石以治愈力著称，肯定能治好阿斯特兰纳那个生病的小女孩。$B$B在这条通往北方的大路的东侧，就是夜道谷。有很多条小路可以通往东侧的山丘，你可以在那里找到我那些不知悔改的弟兄们。他们手里有你要的东西。
text.progress: Five moonstones are required to assure that the girl is healed.
text.completion: You have all of the moonstones that are needed. And yet, it is said that a sacrifice of life is the only way to be ensure the saving of another. I will ensure that no matter what, the moonstones will cure Relara.
text.completed: Return to Avrus Illwhisper at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

english.title: In the Hands of the Perverse
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Fallen Moonstones.
english.description: My former clan, the Felmusk of Night Run, raided Fallen Sky Lake some time ago, stealing the moonstones that were unique to the area.$B$BThose moonstones are known to have great healing properties and surely can be used to cure the little girl that lies sick in Astranaar.$B$BNight Run rests up the road to the east that runs north. There are multiple paths that lead up into the hills on its eastern side, and it is there that you will find my unrepentant brethren. They will have what you seek.
english.progress: Five moonstones are required to assure that the girl is healed.
english.completion: You have all of the moonstones that are needed. And yet, it is said that a sacrifice of life is the only way to be ensure the saving of another. I will ensure that no matter what, the moonstones will cure Relara.
english.completed: Return to Avrus Illwhisper at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

text.title: 到地狱咆哮岗哨去
text.objectives: 跟地狱咆哮岗哨的高戈斯上尉谈一谈。
text.description: 上战场啦，$R！$B$B地狱咆哮岗哨是我们在灰谷争夺得最为激烈的前线之一。你在那里将会获得宝贵的经验……假如你能活下来的话。$B$B一切准备好以后，就去告诉安德鲁克。我已经安排他把你直接送往岗位。$B$B你到了以后，就去找高戈斯上尉。他会进一步指导你。$B$B去把痛苦和死亡带给敌人吧！为了部落！
text.completion: You come here as a child, $r. You shall leave here a battle-hardened $c of the Horde! That, or a corpse....

english.title: To Hellscream's Watch
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Goggath at Hellscream's Watch.
english.description: Into the fray with you, $r!$b$bHellscream's Watch is one of our most contentious fronts in Ashenvale. The experience should serve you well... assuming you survive.$b$bWhen you've made ready, speak with Andruk. I've arranged for him to transport you directly to your station.$b$bOnce you've arrived, seek out Captain Goggath. He will guide you further.$b$bBring pain and death to our enemies! For the Horde!
english.completion: You come here as a child, $r. You shall leave here a battle-hardened $c of the Horde! That, or a corpse....

text.title: 结果好，一切都好
text.objectives: Deliver the Sanctified Moonstones to Pelturas Whitemoon at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
text.description: Thank you for saving me from a fate worse than death, $N! For saving both the child and myself!$B$BWell, the child is almost saved. All you have to do is take the moonstones back west down the road to Astranaar. Hand them to Pelturas and he will know what to do.$B$BGo in peace, my friend. Elune be praised!
text.progress: $n, is that you? Have you returned with the cure for Relara?
text.completion: Oh, $n, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstones will give back my daughter her strength! I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.

english.title: All's Well
english.objectives: Deliver the Sanctified Moonstones to Pelturas Whitemoon at Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: Thank you for saving me from a fate worse than death, $N! For saving both the child and myself!$B$BWell, the child is almost saved. All you have to do is take the moonstones back west down the road to Astranaar. Hand them to Pelturas and he will know what to do.$B$BGo in peace, my friend. Elune be praised!
english.progress: $n, is that you? Have you returned with the cure for Relara?
english.completion: Oh, $n, you have saved my daughter! I know the power of the moonstones will give back my daughter her strength! I can never repay you fully for the aid you have given me, but... please, take this. Other than Relara, it is my most dear possession.

text.title: 一点预防措施
text.objectives: 在附近任意健康的灰斑蓟熊、白尾鹿或月夜雌/雄虎身上实验予生者幼苗。
text.description: 你熟悉上古诸神么，$N？安努和我一致认为你在湖底发现的神器只有可能是它们的造物，而且它正在侵蚀黑海岸。一些我们以为逝去已久的东西正在死灰复燃，比你我更要强大的东西。但我现在主要考虑的还是保护动物们。$B$B给，这株幼苗蕴含着你为我收集的生命精华。我相信它可以保护当地的族群。在附近未被感染的熊、鹿或者月夜虎身上试验一下，把结果告诉我！
text.progress: The sapling you carry grows in power even as we speak. Life is regenerative, $n. Did it work?
text.completion: Interesting ... It sounds like our cure will keep the wildlife safe, but you say you saw something else? Some kind of angry presence? This is a good sign, $n. Whatever is behind this isn't happy, and that means we're on to something.
text.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

english.title: An Ounce of Prevention
english.objectives: Test the Lifebringer Sapling on any nearby healthy Grizzled Thistle Bear, Whitetail Stag, or Moonstalker Matriarch/Sire.
english.description: Are you familiar with the Old Ones, $n? Onu and I agree that the artifact you found in the lake can only be their work, and it's devouring Darkshore. Something is stirring up terrors we thought dead long ago. This is bigger than you or me, but my first concern is protecting the wildlife.$B$BHere, this sapling contains the life essence you gathered for me. I believe it can protect the local fauna. Test it out on a nearby un-consumed bear, stag, or moonstalker, and let me know what happens!
english.progress: The sapling you carry grows in power even as we speak. Life is regenerative, $n. Did it work?
english.completion: Interesting ... It sounds like our cure will keep the wildlife safe, but you say you saw something else? Some kind of angry presence? This is a good sign, $n. Whatever is behind this isn't happy, and that means we're on to something.
english.completed: Return to Kathrena Winterwisp at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 神谕者孤儿鲁鲁
text.objectives: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用神谕者孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
text.description: 孤儿们一直都很期待能有像你这样的朋友，$N。我非常高兴你能答应照顾他们其中的一个。$B$B带上这只哨子。有了它，你随时都能召唤受你照顾的孤儿。你不需要照顾他太久——大概也就是儿童周这段时间。$B$B好了，$N，请召唤你的孤儿吧。他一定会非常喜欢你的。你们一定会在诺森德各处渡过不少愉快的旅程。
text.completion: You take us away from puppy-men hatchlings? Good. We like you already. Mean puppy-men hatchlings took all our favorite toys away.
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Little Orphan Roo Of The Oracles
english.objectives: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Oracle Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.
english.description: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $N. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $N, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.
english.completion: You take us away from puppy-men hatchlings? Good. We like you already. Mean puppy-men hatchlings took all our favorite toys away.
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 狼獾人孤儿科科
text.objectives: 同孤儿监护员艾蕊娅交谈，然后使用狼獾人孤儿哨召唤你要在儿童周照顾的孤儿。
text.description: 孤儿们一直都很期待能有像你这样的朋友，$N。我非常高兴你能答应照顾他们其中的一个。$B$B带上这只哨子。有了它，你随时都能召唤受你照顾的孤儿。你不需要照顾他太久——大概也就是儿童周这段时间。$B$B好了，$N，请召唤你的孤儿吧。他一定会非常喜欢你的。你们一定会在诺森德各处渡过不少愉快的旅程。
text.completion: You take Kekek hunting? Good to get away from mean old orphan lady who doesn't let Kekek hunt.
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Little Orphan Kekek Of The Wolvar
english.objectives: Speak to Orphan Matron Aria, then use the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to call the orphan you will be taking care of during Children's Week.
english.description: The orphans have been looking forward to the opportunity to meet friends like you, $N. It's wonderful that you've agreed to take one into your care.$B$BTake this whistle.  With it, you will be able to call for the orphan you have agreed to sponsor.  It will only last for a limited time - not much longer than Children's Week itself, in fact.$B$BPlease, $N, call upon your orphan.  He will be excited to meet you and see the sights of Northrend with you.
english.completion: You take Kekek hunting? Good to get away from mean old orphan lady who doesn't let Kekek hunt.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 抢救阵亡将士
text.objectives: 带回10具欢笑姐妹的遗骸。
text.description: 守护者奥达努斯命令我和我的哨兵们留在这里坚守高塔。目前我们已经成功地击退了部落，但现在他们绕过我们，直接去攻打北边的树居了。$B$B守护者派他的树妖们防御大树，但看样子她们不是战歌兽人前锋的对手。$B$B我要你到那里去，尽可能地把欢笑姐妹的遗骸带回来，然后把它们交给树居大树里的哈兰尼娅。她知道该怎么做。
text.progress: I'm amazed that you broke through the Horde lines and managed to get in here, $r.
text.completion: Thank you, $c. We have our hands full defending the retreat, but when I can catch my breath, I'll see to it that these sisters are returned to life, the goddess willing. You've demonstrated your prowess... we can use your help.
text.completed: Speak with Halannia on the second level of the tree at Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale.

english.title: Recover the Fallen
english.objectives: Recover 10 Laughing Sister's Corpses.
english.description: I and my sentinels have been ordered by Keeper Ordanus to stay here and hold the tower. So far we've been able to repel the Horde, but now they're going around us to directly attack the retreat to the north.$B$BThe keeper sent out his dryads to defend the tree, but they do not seem to be much of a match for the vanguard of the Warsong orcs.$B$BI need you to go out there and recover as many laughing sister corpses as you can. Take them to Halannia inside the tree at the retreat. She will know what to do.
english.progress: I'm amazed that you broke through the Horde lines and managed to get in here, $r.
english.completion: Thank you, $c. We have our hands full defending the retreat, but when I can catch my breath, I'll see to it that these sisters are returned to life, the goddess willing. You've demonstrated your prowess... we can use your help.
english.completed: Speak with Halannia on the second level of the tree at Raynewood Retreat in Ashenvale.

text.title: 史上最巨大的树！
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿鲁鲁前往灰喉堡。当你进入到那棵大树的树干里时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 在大战爆发，我们离开自己的村庄之前，索乌塞和我们讲过历史上最巨大的树！$B$B索乌塞管那棵树叫灰喉堡。索乌塞告诉我们，它就在灰熊丘陵的中央。不，等等，这不是索乌塞说的。索乌塞说的是灰熊丘陵。肯定没错！那棵好大的树就在灰熊丘陵的中央。绝对没有错！$B$B你带我们去那里好不好？我们要好好看看那棵大树。索乌塞告诉我们，有许多大熊怪就住在那棵树里。也许我们还能看见他们呢。
text.completion: We never knew trees got that big! Nope. Maybe Great Ones had special plan for it?
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Biggest Tree Ever!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
english.description: Before there was a big war and we left the village, we remember Soo-say telling us all about the biggest tree ever!$B$BSoo-say call it Grizzlemaw or something. Soo-say tell us it in the middle Grizzle Hills. No, wait, that not what Soo-say say. Soo-say say Grizzly Hills. Now we remember! Tree is big and right in middle of Grizzly Hills. Can't miss!$B$BYou take us there, oki? We see inside of giant tree? Soo-say tell us big bear men live in tree too. Maybe we see them.
english.completion: We never knew trees got that big! Nope. Maybe Great Ones had special plan for it?
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 熊怪的家园
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科前往灰喉堡。当你进入那棵巨树的树干时，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克总是向我们讲强大武士的故事。其中有些故事发生在很远的地方。有时候，他会讲巨大的熊怪为了保卫树城而英勇战斗的故事。$B$B也许你能带科科到那里去，去看看那些大树，还有那里的战场！高阶萨满祭司拉克亚克告诉科科，那座巨大的树城灰喉堡就矗立在灰熊丘陵的正中心。$B$B科科在遇到监护员之前从没有见过一座城市。但这座城市里没有战士，只有穿着紫袍子的人。科科想去看看真正的战士为了真正的城市作战的样子！
text.completion: This is Kekek's kind of city. Bear-men fight for home just like Frenzyheart do. Orphan lady tell Kekek not to fight with other pups, but Kekek fight anyway.
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Home Of The Bear-Men
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Grizzlemaw. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you enter the trunk of the great tree.
english.description: High Shaman Rakjak always tell stories of mighty warriors, even ones far away. Sometimes he tell stories about giant bear-men fighting great battle for tree-city.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek there, see tree, see battle! High Shaman Rakjak tell Kekek that giant tree-city Grizzlemaw stand in the middle of Grizzly Hills.$B$BKekek never see a city before meeting orphan lady, but this city have no warriors, only men in purple dresses. Kekek want to see real warriors fight for real city.
english.completion: This is Kekek's kind of city. Bear-men fight for home just like Frenzyheart do. Orphan lady tell Kekek not to fight with other pups, but Kekek fight anyway.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
text.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
text.description: Not only are we supplying brew to everyone, we also have steins to give out!  Beautiful, commemorative steins all obtained by the most legal of means!  Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.
text.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.

text.title: Another Year, Another Souvenir.
text.objectives: 去美酒节营地的贝尔比那里兑换美酒节礼品券。
text.description: Brewfest isn't just about racing rams, it's also about drinking!  When you have a moment, take this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch.  She's near the back of the Brewfest camp.  If you can't see her, don't worry, she'll be sure to see you.$b$bIn any case, take this voucher to her to get your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.
text.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

She'll also be more than happy to handle any and all other Brewfest transactions.
english.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 青铜巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 有时候，高阶神谕者索乌塞会讲一些关于一座巨龙祭坛的故事。那和雨水巨石可不一样。索乌塞告诉我们，也许我们能在那里看到我们自己，只不过不会像我们现在这样闪光光。索乌塞的意思是说，我们能在那里看到自己许多年以后的样子。$B$B你要带我们去那里？我们记得青铜巨龙圣地是在一个叫龙骨荒野的地方。索乌塞说，雨水巨石让他知道，那个圣地就在龙眠神殿的东北方，或者是暮冬要塞的西北方。我们现在出发吗？
text.completion: We very glad you brought us here, $n. We always worried what would happen to us when the orphan matron found us in Sholazar.
text.end: Roo taken to visit Bronze Dragonshrine
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Sometimes High-Oracle Soo-say tell stories about a shrine to dragon-things, not like great rain stone, but different. Soo-say tell us maybe we see ourselves there, but not like in a shiny. Soo-say mean we could see what we are like many years from now.$B$BYou take us there? We remember shrine to bronze dragon-things in place called Dragonblight. Soo-say say great rain stone show him shrine to northeast of Wyrmrest Temple, or northwest of place dryskins call Wintergarde Keep. We go?
english.completion: We very glad you brought us here, $n. We always worried what would happen to us when the orphan matron found us in Sholazar.
english.end: Roo taken to visit Bronze Dragonshrine
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 青铜巨龙圣地
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿科科前往青铜巨龙圣地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 当科科还是小孩子的时候，他经常会听长者们说起一个遥远的圣地。有时候，长者们会说，在青铜巨龙圣地能知道关于未来的一切事情。$B$B科科要告诉你，他要成为强大的战士。所以我们现在就要到那里去看看。青铜巨龙圣地就在龙骨荒野，在一个被称作龙眠神殿的东北方，一座被称为暮冬要塞的人类城镇的西北方。$B$B我们要到那里去，看看未来。我要让监护员知道，她是错的。科科是战士，不是傻瓜。
text.completion: See? Kekek never get tired of saying, "Kekek tell you so." Maybe now you believe other things Kekek tell you, like how sky is green.
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Bronze Dragonshrine
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit the Bronze Dragonshrine. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: When Kekek was a pup, he sometimes heard elders talking about a far-off shrine. Sometimes they say that bronze dragon-things there know all about future.$B$BKekek tell you he be great warrior, now we go see. Bronze dragon-thing shrine somewhere in Dragonblight, northeast of dragon-thing temple called Wyrmrest, also northwest of man-town called Wintergarde.$B$BWe go there, see future. Prove orphan-lady wrong about Kekek. Kekek warrior, not bully.
english.completion: See? Kekek never get tired of saying, "Kekek tell you so." Maybe now you believe other things Kekek tell you, like how sky is green.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 保卫大树！
text.objectives: 跟哈兰尼娅谈一谈，召唤猎影之影，用它的力量在林中树居消灭任意50名战歌敌人。
text.description: 我们一直在用森林之心的力量抵御部落对大树的进攻，但它的力量并非无穷无尽。我们必须借助它的力量向敌人主动进攻！$B$B森林里最强大的豹子猎影就在附近潜伏着。从她身上，我们找到了灵感。你将与猎影之影合而为一。你要接受猎豹的精华，让那些胆敢挑战灰谷权威的人尝尝厉害！
text.completion: A brutal display, but one fitting for the enemies of Ashenvale. The Horde dares to think that they can take our beloved forest away from us. They are fatally mistaken! You have saved Raynewood from destruction, $n. Surely we can find a reward suitable for our champion?
text.completed: Speak with Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

english.title: Defend the Tree!
english.objectives: Speak with Halannia to summon the Shade of Shadumbra and use its power to destroy any 50 Warsong enemies at Raynewood Retreat.
english.description: We have been using the power of the Forest Heart to defend the tree from the Horde, but its power is not without limit. We must use it to take the fight to them!$B$BShadumbra, the great cat of the forest, prowls nearby. It is from her that we shall draw our inspiration. You will become one with the shade of Shadumbra. You will take the essence of the panther into you and lay waste to those who dare attack the might of Ashenvale!
english.completion: A brutal display, but one fitting for the enemies of Ashenvale. The Horde dares to think that they can take our beloved forest away from us. They are fatally mistaken! You have saved Raynewood from destruction, $n. Surely we can find a reward suitable for our champion?
english.completed: Speak with Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.

text.title: 愚蠢的特维德
text.objectives: 高戈斯上尉要你跟地狱咆哮岗哨的特维德谈一谈。
text.description: 延期，延期，延期！我没辙了！$B$B人家都说这个地精聪明——他肯定能带着一堆玩意让敌人缴械投降。目前为止，他除了空头支票什么都没开出来。要是他还两手空空地过来，我就把他从悬崖上扔下去！$B$B你去跟他谈谈，$C。让他知道我已经没什么耐心了！
text.completion: Let me tell ya somethin' $c! The bossman simply doesn't appreciate the art and craftsmanship that goes into making fine explosives.

english.title: Tweedle's Dumb
english.objectives: Captain Goggath wants you to speak with Tweedle at Hellscream's Watch.
english.description: Delays, delays, delays! I'm at wit's end!$b$bI was told that this goblin was brilliant - that he'd come up with gadgets sure to shock the enemy into submission. So far he's produced nothing but empty promises. If he comes up empty-handed again, I'm going to toss him off the cliff!$b$bYou go and speak to him, $c. Let him know that my fuse is running short!
english.completion: Let me tell ya somethin' $c! The bossman simply doesn't appreciate the art and craftsmanship that goes into making fine explosives.

text.title: 前往奇妙玩具店的旅行
text.objectives: 在奇妙玩具店购买一只小型纸飞艇，然后把它掷给你的孤儿鲁鲁。
text.description: 我们还有时间去下一站？我们听说达拉然有一间玩具店，但我们从来没有去过那里。监护员说，如果大家都要去那里的话，那里就会被挤爆了。也许我们可以去那里？只有我们？我们可以在那里得到一只小型纸飞艇吗？他们就会把那种小飞艇送到达拉然的奇妙玩具店去。我们一直都想要一只那样的小飞艇。也许你能给我们一只？
text.completion: That was fun! We like toy store. Maybe orphan matron take us sometimes. We ask. Maybe you tell her too?
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
text.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Roo

english.title: A Trip To The Wonderworks
english.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at the Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Roo.
english.description: We have time for one more stop? We heard Dalaran has toy store, but we never get to go there. Orphan mistress says too many orphans would crowd the store. Maybe we can go, just us?$B$BWe can have a small paper zeppelin? We think they have those at Wonderworks in Dalaran. We always wanted to play with one. Maybe you throw one to us?
english.completion: That was fun! We like toy store. Maybe orphan matron take us sometimes. We ask. Maybe you tell her too?
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
english.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Roo

text.title: A Visit To The Wonderworks
text.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at The Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Kekek.
text.description: You take Kekek one more place? Orphan lady say Dalaran have toy store called Wonderworks, but Kekek never seen it. She say that if one orphan go, she have to take everyone. Maybe you take Kekek?$B$BKekek seen other children playing with small paper zeppelin? Kekek hear those come from Wonderworks. Maybe you get one and throw it around with Kekek?
text.completion: Kekek like playing with paper zeppelin. Not as good as hunting, but give something to do when bored at orphanage.
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
text.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Kekek

english.title: A Visit To The Wonderworks
english.objectives: Purchase a Small Paper Zeppelin at The Wonderworks and then throw it to your orphan, Kekek.
english.description: You take Kekek one more place? Orphan lady say Dalaran have toy store called Wonderworks, but Kekek never seen it. She say that if one orphan go, she have to take everyone. Maybe you take Kekek?$B$BKekek seen other children playing with small paper zeppelin? Kekek hear those come from Wonderworks. Maybe you get one and throw it around with Kekek?
english.completion: Kekek like playing with paper zeppelin. Not as good as hunting, but give something to do when bored at orphanage.
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.
english.objective1: Throw Small Paper Zeppelin to Kekek

text.title: 腐化的魔苔
text.objectives: Collect 6 Fel Moss.
text.description: I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely.  Something fowl lingers.$B$BThe corruption of the wicked fel moss still threatens to turn peaceful creatures against us. The grells and gellkin still infest the area and threaten Shadowglen's residents.$B$BEngage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked fel moss. Once we know for certain, we will know how to proceed.$B$B
text.completed: Return to Tarindrella in Shadowglen.

english.title: Fel Moss Corruption
english.objectives: Collect 6 Fel Moss.
english.description: I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely.  Something fowl lingers.$B$BThe corruption of the wicked fel moss still threatens to turn peaceful creatures against us. The grells and gellkin still infest the area and threaten Shadowglen's residents.$B$BEngage these grells and grellkin, $N, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked fel moss. Once we know for certain, we will know how to proceed.$B$B
english.completed: Return to Tarindrella in Shadowglen.

text.title: 离开梦境
text.objectives: 跟黑海岸漩涡之眼的玛法里奥谈一谈。
text.description: 抓紧，$N。精神和肉体若没准备好，回到苏醒世界的旅程可要有点颠簸。
text.completion: You're just in time, $N.  I don't know how much longer we can hold.

english.title: Leaving the Dream
english.objectives: Speak to Malfurion at the Eye of the Vortex in Darkshore.
english.description: Hold on tight, $N.  The journey back to the waking world can be a little rough on unprepared minds and bodies.
english.completion: You're just in time, $N.  I don't know how much longer we can hold.

text.title: 邪恶的触摸
text.objectives: 将饱胀的毒囊交给奥达希尔底部的迪兰妮亚·月光。
text.description: 众所周知，邪恶的基塞伊斯的毒液比其它任何树林蜘蛛的毒液都更加致命。奥达希尔底部的迪兰妮亚·月光肯定对于使用基塞伊斯的巨大毒囊制作特效解药很感兴趣，甚至可能会给你一些奖励呢……

english.title: Vile Touch
english.objectives: Bring the Engorged Venom Sac to Dirania Silvershrine at the base of Aldrassil.
english.description: Githyiss the Vile was known for possessing a poison more potent than any other webwood spider. Dirania Silvershrine at the base of Aldrassil would surely be interested in using Githyiss' engorged venom sac to concoct an antidote equally as potent. Perhaps so interested as to even offer a reward...

text.title: 给我们把炸弹弄好
text.objectives: Tweedle at Hellscream's Watch wants you to collect 10 samples of Moon-kissed Clay.
text.description: I'm definitely on to something here!$b$bI have enough volatile elements salvaged from our arsenal to make the explosives Goggath wants, but I need to stabilize it and pack it into bombs.$b$bWhat I need is some clay - and not just any clay... Moon-kissed Clay.$b$bIt's only found on the northern banks of Astranaar Lake, and it possesses the qualities I need to bring out the full potential of my discovery!
text.progress: Let's see what you've brought me, $r.
text.completion: This is PERFECT! Oh, just wait 'til you see what I can do with this....

english.title: Set Us Up the Bomb
english.objectives: Tweedle at Hellscream's Watch wants you to collect 10 samples of Moon-kissed Clay.
english.description: I'm definitely on to something here!$b$bI have enough volatile elements salvaged from our arsenal to make the explosives Goggath wants, but I need to stabilize it and pack it into bombs.$b$bWhat I need is some clay - and not just any clay... Moon-kissed Clay.$b$bIt's only found on the northern banks of Astranaar Lake, and it possesses the qualities I need to bring out the full potential of my discovery!
english.progress: Let's see what you've brought me, $r.
english.completion: This is PERFECT! Oh, just wait 'til you see what I can do with this....

text.title: 喘息的空间
text.objectives: 高戈斯上尉要你杀死10名阿斯特兰纳步兵和3名阿斯特兰纳军官。
text.description: 我们的部队还没有准备好攻打阿斯特兰纳，$C。他们知道我们要来，而且，他们还不乐意坐着等咱们上门。他们在悬崖脚下搭建了一个营地，每每都从那里借着月光发动进攻，不胜其扰。$B$B趁这些步兵自我感觉良好之前，我要你带着部落的愤怒去拜访他们一下！让他们收敛点，然后再回来找我。
text.completion: Well done, $r. But there is much that remains to be done here.

english.title: Breathing Room
english.objectives: Captain Goggath wants you to kill 10 Astranaar Skirmishers and 3 Astranaar Officers.
english.description: Our forces are not ready to assault Astranaar just yet, $c. They know we're coming, though, and they're not content to sit and wait for us. At the base of this cliff they've created a camp from which they launch bothersome attacks by the light of the moon.$b$bBefore these skirmishes bolster their confidence any further, I want you to visit them with the wrath of the Horde! Return to me when the elves have been humbled a bit.
english.completion: Well done, $r. But there is much that remains to be done here.

text.title: 手小火绳短
text.objectives: 在地狱咆哮岗哨的残破的马车上使用速成炸药。
text.description: <特维德手舞足蹈地做着手势，你发现他的手套松垮得不太正常。>$B$B我成功了！这下就算高戈斯也该满意了！$B$B我们应该做个试验，炫耀一下咱们的成果……啊——那货车！$B$B大老板说要把那烂玩意儿扔掉已经好多天了。用我的炸药把它除掉，看看这下上尉怎么说！
text.completion: So, Tweedle found a way to get those explosives working, eh? It's about time...
text.completed: Speak to Captain Goggath at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.

english.title: Small Hands, Short Fuse
english.objectives: Use the Improvised Explosive Stick on the Broken-down Wagon at Hellscream's Watch.
english.description: <As Tweedle gesticulates emphatically, you see that his gloves are unusually loose.>$b$bI've done it! This should satisfy even Goggath!$b$bWe just need a test that will sufficiently show off our efforts... ahh - the wagon!$b$bThe bossman's wanted that rotted out piece of junk hauled off for days. Use my explosives to get rid of it, then see what the captain has to say!
english.completion: So, Tweedle found a way to get those explosives working, eh? It's about time...
english.completed: Speak to Captain Goggath at Hellscream's Watch in Ashenvale.

text.title: 常驻的危险
text.objectives: 在班尼希尔兽穴附近杀死20只瘤背熊怪。
text.description: 瘤背熊怪的侵袭让我们应接不暇。我们没有人愿意对曾经是朋友的生物兵戈相向，但我担心他们不久就要瞄准多兰纳尔了。$B$B最让我头疼的是班尼希尔山谷和班尼希尔兽穴的熊怪。我要你到西边去，进入兽穴，尽你所能把瘤背熊怪杀掉。我们削弱他们实力的机会可能不多了——动作快点。
text.completion: Impressive. I hope my huntress carried her weight. If we continue with this fervor, we may yet still free Teldrassil from the corruption that Alexstrasza herself could not burn out.
text.completed: Return to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.

english.title: Resident Danger
english.objectives: Kill 20 Gnarlpine Furbolg in and around Ban'ethil Barrow Den.
english.description: The Gnarlpine aggression is limiting our options. None of our kind are eager to bring blade and arrow against creatures that were once our friends, but I grow fearful that they are going to set their sights on Dolanaar soon.$B$BThe biggest concern to me are the furbolg in Ban'ethil Hollow and Ban'ethil Barrow Dens. I need you to travel to the west, make your way into the Barrow Den, and kill as many of the Gnarlpine as you can. We probably won't have many more chances to limit their strength - be swift.
english.completion: Impressive. I hope my huntress carried her weight. If we continue with this fervor, we may yet still free Teldrassil from the corruption that Alexstrasza herself could not burn out.
english.completed: Return to Sentinel Kyra Starsong in Dolanaar.

text.title: 自然的报复
text.objectives: 在地狱石使用怒根之种教训12只劣魔。
text.description: 我很高兴你能补偿自己犯下的错误——它很大程度上反映出了你的人格。$B$B我还有一个任务要交给你。我收集了一些怒根之种。它们有点像魔锥果，不过效力更强。自然对恶魔的反应通常都很激烈，这些怒根之种正是其仇恨的集中表现。$B$B在北方的地狱石那里，劣魔们已经无可救药了。在他们构成严重威胁之前，用怒根之种教训教训它们。
text.completion: Good. I know this probably wasn't very pleasant work, but we greatly appreciate it. I fear for our dear Teldrassil... it seems it is becoming more corrupt by the day, and our ignorance to the cause is plaguing me greatly.
text.completed: Return to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.
text.objective1: Fel Rock grellkin killed with Ireroot Seeds

english.title: Nature's Reprisal
english.objectives: Use ireroot seeds to kill 12 grellkin in Fel Rock.
english.description: I'm glad you were willing to atone for your mistake - it speaks a great deal about your character.$B$BI have another task for you. I have gathered some ireroot seeds. They are somewhat like fel cones, but quite a bit more potent. Nature often responds very negatively to demons, and these ireroot seeds prompt a very concentrated form of that reprisal.$B$BTo our north, in Fel Rock, there are grellkin that are far beyond redemption. Use the ireroot seeds to route them before they become a more serious threat.
english.completion: Good. I know this probably wasn't very pleasant work, but we greatly appreciate it. I fear for our dear Teldrassil... it seems it is becoming more corrupt by the day, and our ignorance to the cause is plaguing me greatly.
english.completed: Return to Syral Bladeleaf in Dolanaar.
english.objective1: Fel Rock grellkin killed with Ireroot Seeds

text.title: 轰炸阿斯特兰纳！
text.objectives: 高戈斯上尉要你用特维德的速成炸药杀死20名阿斯特兰纳哨兵，并摧毁10辆阿斯特兰纳投刃车。
text.description: 这么说，特维德可算是把炸药做成了，嗯？$B$B时机好得不能再好了。眼下，阿斯特兰纳的精灵正打算对我们的营地发动一次毁灭性的打击。$B$B从天上把我们的新武器给他们丢下去！阿斯特兰纳的毁灭将会是所有暗夜精灵的心头刺！$B$B你做好进攻准备了，就告诉萨拉卡。$B$B瞄准点，$C。
text.completion: Your deeds today shall live long in the Horde's glorious history. Your efforts have dealt a devastating blow to the enemy!

english.title: Blastranaar!
english.objectives: Captain Goggath wants you to use Tweedle's Improvised Explosives to kill 20 Astranaar Sentinels and destroy 10 Astranaar Throwers.
english.description: So, Tweedle finally came through on those explosives, eh?$b$bThey couldn't have come at a better time. The elves of Astranaar are preparing to make a devastating assault on our camp as we speak.$b$bDrop our new weapon on them from the skies! The destruction of Astranaar will be a dagger in the heart of night elves everywhere!$b$bSpeak with Thraka when you're ready to begin the assault.$b$bAim true, $c.
english.completion: Your deeds today shall live long in the Horde's glorious history. Your efforts have dealt a devastating blow to the enemy!

text.title: 上前监视
text.objectives: 用黑豹雕像潜入主宰之剑刺探平台上暮光之锤首领的行动。
text.description: 邪教徒们似乎在挖掘一个叫做深渊滑行者索苟斯的残骸。$B$B也许他们顶头的上司有更多的情报。
text.completion: This is dire news, $n.  If you are correct, then we'd best act swiftly and decisively. We cannot allow this "Soggoth" to be brought back to life.
text.completed: 去找黑海岸古树之林的利爪德鲁伊巴尔伦。

english.title: Stepping Up Surveillance
english.objectives: Sneak into the Master's Glaive using the Panther Figurine and spy on the Twilight's Hammer leaders on the platform above.
english.description: The cultists appear to be digging out the remains of a being known as Soggoth the Slitherer.$B$BPerhaps their superiors on the rafters above have more information.
english.completion: This is dire news, $n.  If you are correct, then we'd best act swiftly and decisively. We cannot allow this "Soggoth" to be brought back to life.
english.completed: Return to Balren of the Claw at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.

text.title: 十字路口商队的便车
text.objectives: 跟前沿哨所的哈尔迦·血眼谈一谈，护送下一批十字路口商队前往格罗多姆农场。
text.description: <Halga grins disarmingly, holding up an enormous firearm.>$B$BHave you ever used one of these, $N? It's a beast. Hell with a handgrip. Too heavy to use on foot, but perfect when riding at the head of a caravan. I call it my 'street sweeper.'$B$BWe need to get those supplies you've collected to Crossroads, and I expect trouble. I'd like for you to ride shotgun. Literally! Say the word when you're ready and I'll put you at the head of our next caravan.
text.progress: Mok'ra, stranger. Are you here from Far Watch?
text.completion: You're a sight, $r. That's the first caravan to make it through this week!
text.completed: Speak with Kranal Fiss at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Crossroads Caravan Pickup
english.objectives: Speak with Halga Bloodeye at Far Watch Post to escort the next Crossroads Caravan to Grol'dom Farm.
english.description: <Halga grins disarmingly, holding up an enormous firearm.>$B$BHave you ever used one of these, $N? It's a beast. Hell with a handgrip. Too heavy to use on foot, but perfect when riding at the head of a caravan. I call it my 'street sweeper.'$B$BWe need to get those supplies you've collected to Crossroads, and I expect trouble. I'd like for you to ride shotgun. Literally! Say the word when you're ready and I'll put you at the head of our next caravan.
english.progress: Mok'ra, stranger. Are you here from Far Watch?
english.completion: You're a sight, $r. That's the first caravan to make it through this week!
english.completed: Speak with Kranal Fiss at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 伙伴！
text.objectives: 带领你的孤儿鲁鲁前去拜访冬鳞避难所。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 你要知道，孤儿们都是很孤独的。有时候，我们很想去别的地方看看，结交一些新的朋友。$B$B也许你能带我们去闯一闯？我们听说有一个叫冬鳞避难所的地方。那就在北风苔原里面。要去那里，我们应该向西北方前进，走到靠近考达拉岛边缘的地方。$B$B监护员说有一个勇敢的人也在那里养育着一群孤儿。他们一定也很孤单，一定也需要朋友。你愿意带我们去那里吗？
text.completion: That was fun! We go again sometime? We can't wait to see our new friend again!
text.end: Roo taken to visit Winterfin Retreat
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Playmates!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Winterfin Retreat. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Orphanage gets real lonely, you know? Sometimes we want to go places, meet new friends.$B$BMaybe you can take us somewheres with other hatchlings? We heard about a place called Winterfin Retreat, in the big Borean Tundra. We think it's way in the northwest, near the edge of the Coldarra-island.$B$BThe orphan lady say someone brave save a bunch of hatchlings there. We think they lonely, too. We think they need friends. You take us there?
english.completion: That was fun! We go again sometime? We can't wait to see our new friend again!
english.end: Roo taken to visit Winterfin Retreat
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 伙伴！
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科前往飘雪林地。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 除了监护员照顾的小孩子，科科还想有别的朋友。也许我们能去一些别的地方？$B$B科科知道有一个部落居住在龙骨荒野。他们住的地方叫做飘雪林地。你知道吗？飘雪林地在莫亚基港口的北边和红玉巨龙圣地的南边。$B$B<提到海象人的时候，科科的脸上现出一副生气的表情。>$B$B你带科科去那里。去拜访那里的村子。也许我们能遇到新的狼獾人，让他们知道，狂心氏族有多厉害！
text.completion: Kekek like new Snowfall friends, maybe come back and go hunting together sometime. Maybe we go tip over walrus-men when they sleeping.
text.end: Kekek taken to visit Snowfall Glade
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Playmates!
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Snowfall Glade. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Kekek think there not enough other pups living with orphan-lady. Maybe we go visit some others?$B$BKekek know a tribe that lives in Dragonblight, at place called Snowfall Glade. You know? Snowfall Glade north of walrus-men town of Mo'aki Harbor and south of Ruby Dragonshrine.$B$B<Kekek scowls at the mention of the tuskarr.>$B$BYou take Kekek there, to some of the villages there. Maybe we meet new wolvar, show them how fierce Frenzyheart are!
english.completion: Kekek like new Snowfall friends, maybe come back and go hunting together sometime. Maybe we go tip over walrus-men when they sleeping.
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Snowfall Glade
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 死者的感激
text.objectives: 弄到悼念糕饼，并把它交给暴风城墓地的欢快的人类灵魂。$B$B你必须使用一朵橙菊，才能看到那个隐形的灵魂。
text.description: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
text.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
text.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
text.completed: Return to Cheerful Human Spirit in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: The Grateful Dead
english.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Human Spirit in Stormwind's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.
english.description: It's good to visit with friends and family again, though I may have overdone it... I've already eaten everything they made for me!$B$BMight I trouble you for some more of that delicious Bread of the Dead? I'd be most grateful...$B$BChapman there sells the recipe, I think.
english.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
english.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
english.completed: Return to Cheerful Human Spirit in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 我们中的纳迦
text.objectives: 去找黑海岸古树之林的利爪德鲁伊巴尔伦。
text.description: 这生物的脑袋在和阿洛斯战斗时被打碎了。看上去它符合你所知的对纳迦的描述。$B$B据说除去怪物般的特征，纳迦实际上是被艾萨拉女王用奥术魔法转化过的暗夜精灵。$B$B看来他们不打算让你拿到远古之角。
text.completion: The naga are in league with the Twilight's Hammer?  Just what we needed.

english.title: Naga In Our Midst
english.objectives: Return to Balren of the Claw at the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore.
english.description: The creature appears to have had its skull broken in a fight with Aros.  It looks like what you've heard described as a naga before.$B$BIt is said that despite their monstrous features, naga are night elves warped by the arcane magic of Queen Azshara.$B$BIt seems they've decided to stop you from obtaining the horn of the ancients.
english.completion: The naga are in league with the Twilight's Hammer?  Just what we needed.

text.title: 红龙女王
text.objectives: 带上你的孤儿鲁鲁去拜访阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者，她就在龙眠神殿的顶端。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶神谕者索乌塞有一个故事，说的是造物主造出了所有的龙和一位统驭所有巨龙的女王。我们想看一看那位女王！你能带我们去龙眠神殿的最高处吗？索乌塞告诉我过我们，那个神庙就在龙骨荒野的中心。$B$B我们真的很想见到红龙女王。她一定又大又美丽。也许她能帮助我们找到新的爸爸妈妈。$B$B你会带我们去吗？
text.completion: Do you think she ever saw an oracle before? We might be the first one ever to meet her! We thinks she liked us, but we're not sure. She doesn't talk a lot. Nope. But that was fun!
text.end: Roo taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: One of High-Oracle Soo-say's stories says Great Ones made all the dragons and a queen for the dragons, too. We want to see her! Would you take us to the top of Wyrmrest Temple? We remember Soo-say telling us the temple-thing was in the middle of Dragonblight.$B$BWe really want to meet dragon queen. She must be so big and pretty. Maybe she help us find new parents.$B$BYou take us?
english.completion: Do you think she ever saw an oracle before? We might be the first one ever to meet her! We thinks she liked us, but we're not sure. She doesn't talk a lot. Nope. But that was fun!
english.end: Roo taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 红龙女王
text.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
text.description: Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.$B$BKekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!
text.completion: Queen not what Kekek expected, but Kekek understand why. Queen's visitors get crushed if she was always big dragon! Still want to see someday.
text.end: Kekek taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at the top of Wyrmrest Temple. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Kekek always liked dragons. Always wanted to be one, but orphan-lady said no. But she did say maybe you take Kekek to meet dragon queen.$B$BKekek think orphan-lady have good idea for once. You take Kekek to Wyrmrest Temple in the middle of Dragonblight? Fly all the way to top to meet dragon queen. She must be really big, to be queen of all dragons. Kekek can't wait to see!
english.completion: Queen not what Kekek expected, but Kekek understand why. Queen's visitors get crushed if she was always big dragon! Still want to see someday.
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Alexstrasza the Life-Binder
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 拜访一位造物主
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿鲁鲁前往塑造者之台的源生石像那里。当你到达那里的时候，如果他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 高阶神谕者索乌塞总是告诉我们，造物主如何建起圣地，而我们则让它们发光。但他从没有见过一位造物主。没有人见过造物主。不过，也许你能找到一位造物主？$B$B索乌塞告诉我们，造物主建造了一座界门，并把它安放在索拉查南部的正中心。索乌塞没有说它会通向哪里。但也许我们能借助它走到一位造物主的面前！带我们走进那道界门，让我们看看门的另一边到底有些什么吧，$N。
text.completion: We got to meet a Great One! Too bad it was during his nap time, but we understand. We like naps, too! Maybe we learn naps from Great Ones like we learn about shrines and shinies! Can we come back and visit the Great One again when not sleeping?
text.end: Roo taken to visit The Etymidian
text.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: Meeting a Great One
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Roo, to visit the Etymidian at the Shaper's Terrace. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: High-Oracle Soo-say always tell us about how Great Ones built shrines and we give them shinies, but he never see Great Ones. No one see Great Ones, but maybe you know how to find one?$B$BSoo-say told us the Great Ones made a waygate and put it in the center of the southern part of Sholazar. Soo-say not say where it goes, but maybe it take us to a Great One! Take us through that waygate and let's find out, $N.
english.completion: We got to meet a Great One! Too bad it was during his nap time, but we understand. We like naps, too! Maybe we learn naps from Great Ones like we learn about shrines and shinies! Can we come back and visit the Great One again when not sleeping?
english.end: Roo taken to visit The Etymidian
english.completed: Speak to your Oracle Orphan. Use your Oracle Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 强大的赫米特·奈辛瓦里
text.objectives: 带着你的孤儿科科去拜访赫米特·奈辛瓦里。他就在奈辛瓦里营地。如果当你到达那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 你知道科科一直想要见到的人是谁吗？赫米特·奈辛瓦里。$B$B也许你能带科科去见他？长者哈尔卡克把他的所有事情都告诉我们了。他来到索拉查就是为了猎捕当地最大的怪物！就连狂心氏族的长老们也尊敬赫米特·奈辛瓦里，称他为伟大的猎人。$B$B长者哈尔卡克告诉科科，奈辛瓦里营地就在索拉查西侧的中部，碎浪河附近。我们去那里拜访他，学习如何像赫米特那样狩猎好不好？
text.completion: You help Kekek learn him a book? Then, Kekek hunt with Hemet Nesingwary!
text.end: Kekek taken to visit Hemet Nesingwary
text.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

english.title: The Mighty Hemet Nesingwary
english.objectives: Take your orphan, Kekek, to visit Hemet Nesingwary at the Nesingwary Base Camp. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you get there.
english.description: Know who Kekek always wanted to meet? Hemet Nesingwary.$B$BMaybe you take Kekek to see him? Elder Harkek tell us all about him. He come to Sholazar to hunt biggest creatures anywhere! Even Frenzyheart elders respect Hemet Nesingwary as great hunter.$B$BElder Harkek tell Kekek that Nesingwary Base Camp in the middle of west side of Sholazar, right on river called Seabreach Flow. We go visit and learn how to hunt like Hemet?
english.completion: You help Kekek learn him a book? Then, Kekek hunt with Hemet Nesingwary!
english.end: Kekek taken to visit Hemet Nesingwary
english.completed: Speak to your Wolvar Orphan. Use your Wolvar Orphan Whistle if your orphan is not nearby.

text.title: 情况危急！
text.objectives: Goggath wants you to bring the Battle Triage Kit to Thagg at Raynewood Retreat.
text.description: 敌人抱头鼠窜。胜利在握了！$B$B不过，还不是庆祝的时候，$C。还要做很多事情，部落才能真正占领灰谷。$B$B战斗已经在东边的林中树居打响了。报告指出，部落的伤亡不少。$B$B将这些医疗补给送到那边的萨格手里。把我们进攻阿斯特兰纳的捷报告诉他，这将有助于鼓舞士气。
text.completion: This is good news indeed, $r. But right now, we need more than just good news here. These triage kits will be put to good use!

english.title: Condition Critical!
english.objectives: Goggath wants you to bring the Battle Triage Kit to Thagg at Raynewood Retreat.
english.description: We have the enemy on their heels. Victory is within sight!$b$bIt is not yet time to celebrate though, $c. There remains much to be done before the Horde can lay claim to Ashenvale.$b$bAt Raynewood Retreat to the east a battle has been joined. Reports indicate many Horde wounded.$b$bTake these medical supplies there and give them to Thagg. Tell him of our assault on Astranaar. It may help to bolster morale.
english.completion: This is good news indeed, $r. But right now, we need more than just good news here. These triage kits will be put to good use!

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
text.description: We had the best time with you, $N. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $N. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?
text.completion: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.
text.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: We had the best time with you, $N. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $N. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?
english.completion: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
text.description: Know what? You not so bad after all, $N. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.$B$BKekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.
text.completion: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.
text.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: Know what? You not so bad after all, $N. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.$B$BKekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.
english.completion: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 诱捕野猪人
text.objectives: 使用格罗多姆之网来诱捕一只钢鬃抢劫者，再把他拖回来交给格罗多姆农场的托格莉。
text.description: 反击入侵者是我们的本能，但是智慧却指给我们另一条路。我们应该抓来一名野猪人入侵者，然后通过审讯他来了解敌人。拿上这个，$N，然后去西边诱捕一只攻击我们农场的钢鬃抢劫者。把他打昏然后带给我。
text.progress: Don't be too harsh with our captive, he will still need his head attached to answer our questions.
text.completion: Oh my. We want to question this Quilboar, not tenderize him!
text.completed: Speak with Togrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Drag it Out of Them
english.objectives: Use the Grol'dom Net to ensnare a Razormane Pillager and drag it back to Togrik at Grol'dom Farm.
english.description: It is our instinct to simply lash out at our attackers, but wisdom dictates another path. We should interrogate one of these quilboar invaders and learn all we can. Take this net, $N, and ensnare a quilboar pillager attacking our farm just west of here. Club the beast unconscious and bring him to me.
english.progress: Don't be too harsh with our captive, he will still need his head attached to answer our questions.
english.completion: Oh my. We want to question this Quilboar, not tenderize him!
english.completed: Speak with Togrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 僵局
text.objectives: 林中树居的萨格要你去杀掉守护者奥达努斯。
text.description: 医疗包可以帮助我们保持战力，但我们目前处于僵持阶段。$B$B树妖弱不禁风，可她们的首领转眼又能将她们复活。我们面对的这些害虫简直是无穷无尽！$B$B守护者奥达努斯就藏在那棵变异的大树里。我们想杀到他那里，结果都是无功而返。也许我们同他的树妖缠斗时，你可以摸过去……$B$B自然，对征服了阿斯特兰纳的人来说，这就跟过家家一样简单。不是吗？
text.completion: Very well, $n. You have succeeded where I could not. You have earned my respect.

english.title: Stalemate
english.objectives: Thagg at Raynewood Retreat wants you to kill Keeper Ordanus.
english.description: The triage kits will help us keep up the fight, but we are at a stalemate.$b$bThe dryads die easy enough, but their leader is resurrecting them soon after they fall. We face an endless stream of the vermin!$b$bKeeper Ordanus hides in that mutated tree. Our efforts to fight our way to him have been in vain. Perhaps you could work your way to him while we contend with his dryads...$b$bSurely, this is child's play for someone who has conquered Astranaar. No?
english.completion: Very well, $n. You have succeeded where I could not. You have earned my respect.

text.title: 你到底招不招？
text.objectives: 审讯附近的钢鬃野猪人。如果他不在那里或者处于昏迷状态，托格莉能救活他。
text.description: 朝他脸上泼点冷水估计他就会醒过来。你觉得他会告诉我们什么？$B$B我会把他关押在我身后的牲畜栏里。我觉得他的神志不会清醒太久。赶紧从他嘴里问出来为什么野猪人要袭击我们的农场！这些情报对我们很重要，想点好办法。
text.completion: Very interesting - our brute here seems both enthralled and terrified of the one they call "Tortusk." A powerful leader can inspire his people to acts of greatness or atrocity... but we orcs would know that more than others. We should turn our attention to this Tortusk problem.
text.completed: Speak to Togrik at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

english.title: By Hook Or By Crook
english.objectives: Question the nearby Razormane prisoner. If he's not there or unconscious, Togrik can revive him for you.
english.description: I suppose he'll come around with some cold water to the face. What do you think he'll tell us?$B$BI'll secure him inside our livestock pen behind me here. I don't think he'll stay conscious long. Find out what you can about why the quilboar are attacking our farms! I'll leave the interrogation methods up to your better judgment.
english.completion: Very interesting - our brute here seems both enthralled and terrified of the one they call "Tortusk." A powerful leader can inspire his people to acts of greatness or atrocity... but we orcs would know that more than others. We should turn our attention to this Tortusk problem.
english.completed: Speak to Togrik at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 到塔那里去
text.objectives: 跟星尘塔的哨兵维尔莉妮·星坠谈一谈。
text.description: 银风避难所失陷了！我们只知道部落发动了一次奇袭，不知怎地，他们就让密斯特拉湖的元素守护者们临阵倒戈。$B$B幸存者们已经逃回了星尘塔。$N，他们需要你的帮助。$B$B往东南偏南，你可以在通往石爪山脉的石爪小径入口那里找到高塔。我相信哨兵维尔莉妮·星坠正在那里帮忙组织反击。
text.completion: Good to finally meet you, $n. I've heard all about what you've been up to and let me just say that I'm impressed! Think you can lend us your expertise?

english.title: To the Spire
english.objectives: Speak with Sentinel Velene Starstrike at Stardust Spire.
english.description: We've lost Silverwind Refuge! All that I know is that there was a surprise attack by the Horde and that they somehow turned Mystral Lake's elemental guardians against us.$B$BThe survivors have fallen back to Stardust Spire. $N, they need your help.$B$BHead south by southeast. You'll find the spire at the mouth of the Talondeep Pass, which leads into the Stonetalon Mountains. I'm sure that you'll find Sentinel Velene Starstrike helping with the counter-offensive there.
english.completion: Good to finally meet you, $n. I've heard all about what you've been up to and let me just say that I'm impressed! Think you can lend us your expertise?

text.title: 拜访埃杜恩一家
text.objectives: 跟灰谷埃杜恩的小屋的本亚利·埃杜恩谈一谈。
text.description: $N，如果你有空的话，我希望你能帮一个小忙。$B$B我的朋友埃杜恩一家已经很久没有消息了。不知道你能不能到西边转一圈，看看他们的情况？$B$B谢谢你。他们的小屋就在艾森娜神殿西边的那片地上。
text.completion: You say that Faldreas sent you?  Good man. As it happens, we could use your help.

english.title: Check in on the Edunes
english.objectives: Speak with Benjari Edune at the House of Edune in Ashenvale.
english.description: $N, if you have a moment to spare, I would enlist your aid in a simple matter.$B$BI have not heard from my friends, the Edunes, in some time. I was wondering if you could swing west and check in on them?$B$BYou have my thanks. Their cottage sits on a small plot of land just to the west of the Shrine of Aessina.
english.completion: You say that Faldreas sent you?  Good man. As it happens, we could use your help.

text.title: 消减牧群的……数量？
text.objectives: 银风避难所的塞娜尼·雷心要你从污林图腾师和污林巨熊怪身上收集15副熊怪的耳饰。
text.description: 南部地区的熊怪数量比我们预想的要多。他们的侵略性也超出了我们可以忍受的程度。$B$B我们的资源被消耗在捕杀精灵和采集更为重要的木材上，因此只有你才能帮我们将这些叫人分心的熊怪解决掉。$B$B我这里还有研究要做。与此同时，我要你稍稍亲力亲为一下。把附近熊怪的耳饰带来，作为麻烦已经解决的证据，把它们交给塔坎。
text.progress: Well, $n. Is it done?
text.completion: Good work, $r. This should keep them licking their wounds for a time.

english.title: Thinning the... Herd?
english.objectives: Senani Thunderheart at Silverwind Retreat wants you to collect 15 Furbolg Ears from Foulweald Totemics and Foulweald Ursas.
english.description: The furbolg are more numerous than we expected in these southern regions. They have also been far more aggressive here than we would like.$b$bWith our resources divided between hunting down elves and harvesting much-needed lumber, that leaves you to help me put an end to our furbolg distraction.$b$bI have research to conduct here. In the meantime, I need you to take a more hands-on approach. Bring me the ears of nearby furbolg as proof to Tarkan that the problem is being dealt with.
english.progress: Well, $n. Is it done?
english.completion: Good work, $r. This should keep them licking their wounds for a time.

text.title: 扳倒突牙
text.objectives: 杀死钢鬃野猪人的头目，突牙。
text.description: 祸端起于南部，这个名叫“突牙”的野蛮人把所有的钢鬃野猪人难民都招致到了他的麾下。在他的带领下，这些难民变成了土匪。对突牙这货没什么商量的，必须干掉他。$B$B如果我们的囚犯没说假话，你可以在东南边的荆棘岭找到突牙。他通常会在那里的悬崖上俯瞰路上的情况，找到并干掉他，$N，这样这股威胁就会被瓦解。
text.completion: Ah, so Tortusk behaved as I expected? Went right for your throat? It is good that he's dead. The Razormane quilboar have been separated from their leadership in the southern Barrens, no doubt allowing an animal like him to come to power. Perhaps without his influence we can start a dialogue with the survivors... Although hotter heads may prevail.
text.completed: Return to Togrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: The terrible quilboar of Thorn Hill.

english.title: The Tortusk Takedown
english.objectives: Kill the Razormane leader, Tortusk.
english.description: In the wake of the chaos down south, this "Tortusk" brute seems to have rallied all of the Razormane refugees to his banner. Under his leadership, he's turned them into little more than brigands. There's no negotiating with his type; Tortusk must be destroyed.$B$BIf our prisoner is to be believed, you'll find Tortusk southeast of here at a place called Thorn Hill. Search the bluffs where he has a commanding view of the road. Kill him, $N, and the immediate threat should cease.
english.completion: Ah, so Tortusk behaved as I expected? Went right for your throat? It is good that he's dead. The Razormane quilboar have been separated from their leadership in the southern Barrens, no doubt allowing an animal like him to come to power. Perhaps without his influence we can start a dialogue with the survivors... Although hotter heads may prevail.
english.completed: Return to Togrik at the Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: The terrible quilboar of Thorn Hill.

text.title: 丢失的科多兽
text.objectives: 去北贫瘠之地的荆棘岭，寻找一头丢失的格罗多姆科多兽。
text.description: 朋友，如果你要向南去往荆棘岭，我想你能不能帮我顺路找回一头丢失的科多兽？不是所有前沿哨所的车队都能平安抵达。那些野蛮的钢鬃野猪人昨天早上劫走了一只驮货的科多兽。它也许被杀了，但要是它还活着，千万带它回来，我们不能再损失家畜了。
text.completion: This poor battered kodo looks to be on the verge of death, but is still breathing. The Razormane haven't even plundered its cargo yet. If it can be revived, you may be able to save the entire shipment.
text.completed: Find a missing Grol'dom Kodo somewhere within Thorn Hill in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Grol'dom's Missing Kodo
english.objectives: Find a missing Grol'dom Kodo somewhere within Thorn Hill in Northern Barrens.
english.description: Friend, if you are traveling south to Thorn Hill, I was wondering if you could locate one of our missing kodos? Not every caravan has made it up the pass from Far Watch Post. Those Razormane brutes hijacked a pack animal yesterday morning. It may not still be alive, but if it is, we cannot afford to lose more of our livestock.
english.completion: This poor battered kodo looks to be on the verge of death, but is still breathing. The Razormane haven't even plundered its cargo yet. If it can be revived, you may be able to save the entire shipment.
english.completed: Find a missing Grol'dom Kodo somewhere within Thorn Hill in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 喂饱科多兽
text.objectives: 从荆棘岭的钢鬃野猪人营地里收集5袋被偷走的粮食。
text.description: 科多兽生性顽强。只要吃点东西，这个大家伙就能起身行走。$B$B钢鬃野猪人从上一辆货车那里偷走了一些谷物。你可以从附近的营地里收集些被偷走的谷物来。
text.progress: The creature doesn't lift its head, but looks at you imploringly with large, watery eyes.
text.completion: The Kodo is voracious! You might as well be pouring those sacks of grain into a hole! Already the animal is beginning to perk up.
text.completed: Bring the grain to the Grol'dom Kodo at Thorn Hill in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Animal Services
english.objectives: Gather 5 sacks of Stolen Grain from the Razormane camps on Thorn Hill.
english.description: Kodos are resilient creatures. With some food, the big guy may come around.$B$BThe Razormane have stolen plenty of grain from previous caravans. You can gather up stolen grain from the nearby camps.
english.progress: The creature doesn't lift its head, but looks at you imploringly with large, watery eyes.
english.completion: The Kodo is voracious! You might as well be pouring those sacks of grain into a hole! Already the animal is beginning to perk up.
english.completed: Bring the grain to the Grol'dom Kodo at Thorn Hill in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 归家的科多兽
text.objectives: 与格罗多姆农场的卡纳尔·菲斯聊聊，确定他那只遗失的科多兽已经安全到家了。
text.description: 这头巨兽缓慢地走在贫瘠之地上，重新恢复活力的四肢带起了片片松散的泥土。它本能地向它在格罗多姆农场的家踱去。$B$B你要去找卡纳尔·菲斯来确认这头科多兽顺利到家了。
text.completion: So that was your handiwork, $r? Yes, the missing Kodo arrived just minutes ago. It will take many nights to nurse the poor beast's wounds, but thanks to you it's alive. And you saved a whole shipment! Please, take your pick of the gear that the kodo was carrying.
text.completed: Speak with Kranal Fiss at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens to ensure that his missing kodo arrived safely.

english.title: The Kodo's Return
english.objectives: Speak with Kranal Fiss at Grol'dom Farm to ensure that his missing kodo arrived safely.
english.description: The great beast rises slowly to its feet, the loose Barrens soil spilling from its revitalized limbs. Instinctively it trudges back toward its home at Grol'dom Farm.$B$BYou'll want to check in with Kranal Fiss to make sure the kodo made it.
english.completion: So that was your handiwork, $r? Yes, the missing Kodo arrived just minutes ago. It will take many nights to nurse the poor beast's wounds, but thanks to you it's alive. And you saved a whole shipment! Please, take your pick of the gear that the kodo was carrying.
english.completed: Speak with Kranal Fiss at Grol'dom Farm in Northern Barrens to ensure that his missing kodo arrived safely.

text.title: 恢复人性
text.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg.
text.description: Finally!  It looks like Grennan's potion worked on at least one of you ferals.$B$BYou should be able to stay in control for the most part -- just watch your temper.$B$BMajor Arsmtead's going to want to speak to you.  Gilneas is under attack and we need every able-bodied combatant to take up arms.

english.title: Among Humans Again
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg.
english.description: Finally!  It looks like Grennan's potion worked on at least one of you ferals.$B$BYou should be able to stay in control for the most part -- just watch your temper.$B$BMajor Arsmtead's going to want to speak to you.  Gilneas is under attack and we need every able-bodied combatant to take up arms.

text.title: 格罗多姆的民兵
text.objectives: 杀死6只钢鬃抢劫者。
text.description: 不知道它们是从哪里冒出来的，$C！漫山遍野都是野猪人。挺着鬃毛，拱着鼻子，疵着獠牙。 我们被迫退回了农场，但是它们还是没完没了。$B$B我们最好的卫士在战场上阵亡了，至今农夫拉尔东也是杳无音信。我想让你替我出击！在山坳那里挡住那些猪头人，这样我才能保护伤员直到援兵到来。
text.completion: I see you've left a string of corpses in your wake, $r. I couldn't have done better. The livestock may be lost, but the land remains ours - thank you!
text.completed: Return to Una Wolfclaw at Grol'dom Farm in North Barrens.

english.title: The Grol'dom Militia
english.objectives: Slay 6 Razormane Pillagers.
english.description: They came out of nowhere, $c! Quilboar from horizon to horizon. Spines and snouts and teeth. We fell back to the farm but they kept on coming.$B$BOur best defenders have fallen in the field, and we've no sign of Farmer Ralton. I need you to go on the offensive for me! Hold these swine at bay while I defend the wounded until help arrives.
english.completion: I see you've left a string of corpses in your wake, $r. I couldn't have done better. The livestock may be lost, but the land remains ours - thank you!
english.completed: Return to Una Wolfclaw at Grol'dom Farm in North Barrens.

text.title: 特维德的小包裹
text.objectives: Tweedle wants you to take Tweedle's Tiny Package to Flooz at Silverwind Refuge.
text.description: 哇哦！！$B$B瞧它们烧成这样！真是一场革命！爆破科技上一次真正的突破——它，当然，也是唯一管用的科技……$B$B诺森德以南的所有地精都要嫉妒我！$B$B信不信由你，我实际上已经把配方进一步精炼，以发挥更大的潜力！$B$B给。拿上一份样本送到东南的银风避难所去。也许我的堂兄弗洛兹可以用它帮助部落占领他们的目标。
text.completion: Well, look at this! Little Tweedle has really come through this time. This stuff blew up Astranaar, you say? As you can see, we don't need any help taking over Silverwind Refuge, but Tweedle's ideas are as small as his hands. If this stuff's really as good as you say, there's no limit to what we might do....

english.title: Tweedle's Tiny Package
english.objectives: Tweedle wants you to take Tweedle's Tiny Package to Flooz at Silverwind Refuge.
english.description: Wahoo!!$b$bLook at 'em burn! It's revolutionary! A real breakthrough in explosive technology - which, of course, is the only kind that matters....$b$bI'm gunna be the envy of every goblin south of Northrend!$b$bBelieve it or not, I've actually refined the formula to be even more potent!$b$bHere. Take a sample of this stuff southeast to Silverwind Refuge. Maybe my cousin Flooz can use it to help the Horde capture that objective.
english.completion: Well, look at this! Little Tweedle has really come through this time. This stuff blew up Astranaar, you say? As you can see, we don't need any help taking over Silverwind Refuge, but Tweedle's ideas are as small as his hands. If this stuff's really as good as you say, there's no limit to what we might do....

text.title: 十字路口商队
text.objectives: Talk to Rocco Whipshank at Grol'dom Farm and escort his caravan all the way to Crossroads.
text.description: <Rocco hands you a familiar-looking shotgun.>$B$BI took the liberty of cleaning up Halga's artillery for you. I'm sure I don't need to warn you about the kickback. Just ask me when you're ready to mount up for Crossroads! Thork is waiting for you there. Be sure not to give him any lip.$B$BDon't stop for nothing, $N, and if someone gets too close, just give 'em a thump with the butt-end of your gun. Do us proud!
text.progress: Was that you I saw waving a gun around from the back of my last caravan?
text.completion: It's about time we got some supplies through here. It's bad enough to be severed from Mulgore, but this city would fall apart if we lost our trade with Orgrimmar.
text.completed: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

english.title: Crossroads Caravan Delivery
english.objectives: Talk to Rocco Whipshank at Grol'dom Farm and escort his caravan all the way to Crossroads.
english.description: <Rocco hands you a familiar-looking shotgun.>$B$BI took the liberty of cleaning up Halga's artillery for you. I'm sure I don't need to warn you about the kickback. Just ask me when you're ready to mount up for Crossroads! Thork is waiting for you there. Be sure not to give him any lip.$B$BDon't stop for nothing, $N, and if someone gets too close, just give 'em a thump with the butt-end of your gun. Do us proud!
english.progress: Was that you I saw waving a gun around from the back of my last caravan?
english.completion: It's about time we got some supplies through here. It's bad enough to be severed from Mulgore, but this city would fall apart if we lost our trade with Orgrimmar.
english.completed: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

text.title: 林中三友
text.objectives: 跟灰谷波尔温营地的波尔温谈一谈。
text.description: 介意去南边走一趟吗？那儿有我的三个朋友，好久没他们的消息了。北边有奇怪的触手从地里冒出来，到处都有恶魔在活动，我不敢抛下家人不管。$B$B波尔温在森林的西南角建起了营地，就在那可恶的火痕神殿西北边。奥林达尔和哈鲁恩和他在一起，所以他们应该不会有事，但我也说不准。$B$B谢谢你啦，$N。
text.completion: $c, you must be wary! Kaliva, the foul demoness who has chained us is nearby!

english.title: Three Friends of the Forest
english.objectives: Speak with Bolyun at Bolyun's Camp in Ashenvale.
english.description: Care to make a quick trip to the south? I've three friends that I haven't heard from in a while. With these strange tentacles popping out of the ground to the north, and all of the demonic activity, I don't dare leave my family.$B$BBolyun set up his camp in the southwest corner of the forest, just to the northwest of that damnable Fire Scar Shrine. Alenndaar and Harlown joined him, so they should all be okay, but you never know.$B$BThanks, $N.
english.completion: $c, you must be wary! Kaliva, the foul demoness who has chained us is nearby!

text.title: 大规模生产
text.objectives: 弗洛兹要你将特维德的砰砰粉末交给研发部的金科斯。
text.description: Wahoo!! Did you SEE that?!$b$bWe need to get this into production right away!$b$bHere. Take the rest of the stuff to Jinx. You'll find him setting up our new facility just west of here.$B$B
text.progress: Whatcha got there, boss?
text.completion: Hmmm. It'll take a little time. But yes, we can put this into a bomb....

english.title: Mass Production
english.objectives: Flooz wants you to take Tweedle's Pow-Pow Powder to Jinx at The Skunkworks.
english.description: Wahoo!! Did you SEE that?!$b$bWe need to get this into production right away!$b$bHere. Take the rest of the stuff to Jinx. You'll find him setting up our new facility just west of here.$B$B
english.progress: Whatcha got there, boss?
english.completion: Hmmm. It'll take a little time. But yes, we can put this into a bomb....

text.title: Lurkers in the Mist
text.objectives: Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg wants you to slay 8 Orc Scouts.
text.description: We built walls and gates to protect us from our enemies... yet here they are, at our doorstep.$B$BThe militia was forced to move out to meet their main force, leaving the town wide open.$B$BMy worst fears have been realized and Grimmburg is now surrounded by orcs.$B$BThey're either waiting for orders to move in or reporting our movements to a larger force.  Either way, they need to be dealt with.$B$BYou might be a feral, but you're still Gilnean.  Drive the enemy away and reclaim your humanity, $N.

english.title: Lurkers in the Mist
english.objectives: Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg wants you to slay 8 Orc Scouts.
english.description: We built walls and gates to protect us from our enemies... yet here they are, at our doorstep.$B$BThe militia was forced to move out to meet their main force, leaving the town wide open.$B$BMy worst fears have been realized and Grimmburg is now surrounded by orcs.$B$BThey're either waiting for orders to move in or reporting our movements to a larger force.  Either way, they need to be dealt with.$B$BYou might be a feral, but you're still Gilnean.  Drive the enemy away and reclaim your humanity, $N.

text.title: 地精智囊
text.objectives: 获得斯普劳德的徽记。
text.description: 只要我们阻止地精们该死的轰炸，就能发动反攻夺回银风避难所！$B$B根据我的经验，地精们不是又懒惰散漫不事生产，就是过于积极，葬身在自己制造的炸药上。不幸的是，在卓越的首席炸弹工程师斯普劳德监督下，他们工作热情高涨。$B$B去避难所西边的研发部，把首席炸弹工程师的徽记拿到再回来！
text.progress: Did you shut that disgusting, wart-ridden goblin up for good?
text.completion: That's better. Without him, their technicians are sure to fall back to their normal laziness, which should result in fewer bombs and more accidents.
text.completed: 去找灰谷星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳。
text.giverWindow: Hopefully his head won't explode!

english.title: The Goblin Braintrust
english.objectives: Obtain Sploder's Head.
english.description: If we could just stop the damned bombing from the goblins' creations we'd be able to launch a counter-offensive to take back Silverwind Refuge!$B$BIt's been my experience that goblins are either lazy and unproductive, or too productive and end up killing themselves with their own explosives. Unfortunately for us, they're being motivated by the brilliant Chief Bombgineer Sploder.$B$BGet up to the Skunkworks on the west side of the refuge and don't come back until you have the Chief Bombgineer's head!
english.progress: Did you shut that disgusting, wart-ridden goblin up for good?
