english.completion: That's better. Without him, their technicians are sure to fall back to their normal laziness, which should result in fewer bombs and more accidents.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Hopefully his head won't explode!

text.title: 他们在那儿！
text.objectives: 研发部的金科斯要你杀死12名灰谷刺客。
text.description: 他们在那儿，$C。他们盯上我们了。$B$B我手下有几个人都死了，毫无疑问，是精灵干的。$B$B我猜你在阿斯特兰纳干的好事，让他们绝望地想要阻止我们在这里的工程。为了不致失败，他们打算背水一战！$B$B拿上这副护目镜。就算那些精灵潜伏得再隐蔽，也会被它发现。在我们完成你的炸药之前，别让他们找上来。
text.completion: Nice work, friend. Your skills have bought us the time we needed to prepare the bomb. It's almost complete!

english.title: They're Out There!
english.objectives: Jinx at The Skunkworks wants you to kill 12 Ashenvale Assassins.
english.description: They're out there, $c. And they're on to us.$b$bSome of my men have begun turning up dead. Elf attacks, no question about it.$b$bMy guess is that your work at Astranaar has them desperate to stop our progress here. A last ditch effort to escape defeat!$b$bTake these goggles. They'll help you see even the sneakiest of the elves. Keep them off my back while we finish weaponizing your explosives.
english.completion: Nice work, friend. Your skills have bought us the time we needed to prepare the bomb. It's almost complete!

text.title: 他们造了一个大炸弹！
text.objectives: 把大炸弹的存在报告给灰谷星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳。
text.description: 这显然是你见过的最大的爆炸物了。地精们究竟要疯狂到什么程度，才能造出如此的庞然大物？$B$B在你看来，这东西基本上完工了。地精们把它造得非常好——看起来你对它造成不了多少伤害，而且这么大你也带不走。$B$B你最好把大炸弹的事情报告给西南边星尘塔的女猎手嘉琳！
text.completion: They what? IT'S HOW BIG?!!! I have a very bad feeling about this, $n.

english.title: They Set Them Up The Bomb!
english.objectives: Report the existence of The Bomb to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.
english.description: This is clearly the biggest explosive that you've ever laid eyes upon. What in the world could the goblins be thinking about bombing with such a monstrosity?$B$BTo your eye the thing looks like it's almost complete. The goblins appear to have built it well -- it looks as if it's impervious to any damage that you could do to it, and certainly too big for you to carry out of here.$B$BYou'd better report The Bomb to Huntress Jalin at Stardust Spire to the southwest!
english.completion: They what? IT'S HOW BIG?!!! I have a very bad feeling about this, $n.

text.title: 左右为难
text.objectives: 获得卡丽瓦的魔能之核。
text.description: $N，你一定要当心。卡丽瓦还在附近，当她抓住我们的时候，还特别提到了你的名字。$B$B只有她的魔能核心可以把我们从这些锁链中解救出来，但我认为这都是给你下的圈套！
text.progress: If we are to be free, we must have Kaliva's heart.
text.completion: Disgusting, I know, but if we three are to be free of Kaliva's chains, it is not enough that she is dead. We must eat of her fel heart!
text.completed: Return to Bolyun at Bolyun's Camp in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: Foul demon dominatrix. Get her heart!

english.title: In a Bind
english.objectives: Obtain Kaliva's Heart.
english.description: $N, you must be cautious. Kaliva is still about and when she captured us, she specifically mentioned your name.$B$BOnly her heart can free us from these chains, but I think it's all a trap for you!
english.progress: If we are to be free, we must have Kaliva's heart.
english.completion: Disgusting, I know, but if we three are to be free of Kaliva's chains, it is not enough that she is dead. We must eat of her fel heart!
english.completed: Return to Bolyun at Bolyun's Camp in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Foul demon dominatrix. Get her heart!

text.title: 自掘坟墓
text.objectives: 工头金科斯要你收集3枚青铜齿轮、3块铜质镀饰，以及5只锁紧螺栓。
text.description: 炸弹一完工，我们就把它送给索博兹。$B$B我说“我们”，其实指的是“你”。$B$B敌人十面埋伏，我得给你造件特别的东西，好让你有成功的机会。$B$B我可以在这些坏掉的伐木机上做些改动，但还缺点零件。西边的林子里就有，不难找。$B$B我把炸弹弄完，你去收集零件。
text.progress: You got those parts I need, friend?
text.completion: This looks right, $c. I should have your shredder put together in no time.

english.title: Building Your Own Coffin
english.objectives: Foreman Jinx wants you to collect 3 Bronze Cogs, 3 pieces of Copper Plating, and 5 Locking Bolts.
english.description: Once it's complete, we're going to need to get this bomb down to Saurboz.$b$bAnd by 'we', I mean 'you'.$b$bWith so many of the enemy prowling about, I'll need to create something special if you're to have any chance of success.$b$bI can modify one of these busted shredders, but I'll need a few parts. You should have no trouble finding them in the woods to the west.$b$bRound them up while I finish work on the bomb.
english.progress: You got those parts I need, friend?
english.completion: This looks right, $c. I should have your shredder put together in no time.

text.title: Tracking Our Every Move
text.objectives: Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg wants you to bring her 3 Spiked Wolf Collars.
text.description: The orc scouting party is using tracking wolves.  There's a good chance their leader's a wolf-handler himself.$B$BGet me the collars worn by their wolves and we'll get one of our bloodhounds on their trail.

english.title: Tracking Our Every Move
english.objectives: Gwen Armstead in Grimmburg wants you to bring her 3 Spiked Wolf Collars.
english.description: The orc scouting party is using tracking wolves.  There's a good chance their leader's a wolf-handler himself.$B$BGet me the collars worn by their wolves and we'll get one of our bloodhounds on their trail.

text.title: 清理神殿
text.objectives: 消灭火痕神殿的12名恶魔。
text.description: 必须把燃烧军团的邪恶铲除！$B$B$N，你把他们中最厉害的一个消灭掉了，但还有大量的恶魔在侵害着火痕神殿的树林。$B$B作为森林的一名朋友，你能不能杀掉那些邪恶的生物，然后去艾森娜神殿的东北边警告战争古树巴奥柏呢？
text.completion: A fine job, my little $r friend. But as you can see, I am a little busy here.
text.completed: Speak with Big Baobob at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.
text.objective1: Demons at Fire Scar Shrine slain

english.title: Clear the Shrine
english.objectives: Slay any 12 demons at Fire Scar Shrine.
english.description: An end must be put to the Burning Legion's evil!$B$B$N, you have defeated one of their most powerful, but there are still multitudes of demons infesting the woods to the east in Fire Scar Shrine.$B$BAs a friend of the forest, will you slay these foul creatures and then warn Big Baobob, the great ancient of war at the Shrine of Aessina to the northeast?
english.completion: A fine job, my little $r friend. But as you can see, I am a little busy here.
english.completed: Speak with Big Baobob at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.
english.objective1: Demons at Fire Scar Shrine slain

text.title: 受伤的同伴
text.objectives: 将破旧的部族护盾交给奥伯妮·亮鬃。她就在雷霆崖里的长者高地。
text.description: $C，相信你已经知道，这里的战斗相当艰苦。我们还能守住战线，但我们的战士已死伤惨重。$B$B我们的一个名叫奥伯妮·亮鬃的战士手臂上的伤口感染了。她被送回到雷霆崖进行急救。不过，她在混乱中把盾牌遗失在了这里。你能把这面盾牌连同我们的祝福一起给她带过去么？我们非常想念她的微笑。$B$B你可以在雷霆崖的长者高地那里找到她。
text.progress: Oh! Hello there. I don't think we've met; is there something I can do for you?
text.completion: Oh, my shield! I won't be using it anytime soon, but thank you. I hate that I'm sitting here useless when I could be helping on the front, but fighting with my arm like this won't help anyone. Take care out there, won't you?
text.completed: Return to Aponi Brightmane in Mulgore.

english.title: An Injured Colleague
english.objectives: Take the Battered Tribal Shield to Aponi Brightmane on Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff.
english.description: The fight's been hard up here, $c, as I'm sure you know. We're holding out, but not everyone has gone unscathed.$b$bA warrior in our band, Aponi Brightmane, was taken ill by an infected wound in her arm. She's been taken back to Thunder Bluff for recuperation. It seems she left her shield here at the front in the confusion, however - could you take it to her, along with our well-wishes? Her smile is missed around here.$b$bYou can find her on Elder Rise on the Bluff.
english.progress: Oh! Hello there. I don't think we've met; is there something I can do for you?
english.completion: Oh, my shield! I won't be using it anytime soon, but thank you. I hate that I'm sitting here useless when I could be helping on the front, but fighting with my arm like this won't help anyone. Take care out there, won't you?
english.completed: Return to Aponi Brightmane in Mulgore.

text.title: 背水一战
text.objectives: 杀死30个恶魔入侵者。
text.description: $N，我非常需要你的帮助！我没法永远抵挡住恶魔的猛攻。假如我倒下了，阿斯特兰纳就不保了！$B$B请帮帮我！
text.completion: You've saved us all, $n! I have the power to finish off these final few. No longer will the forest have to fear the Burning Legion!
text.completed: Speak with Big Baobob at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.

english.title: The Last Stand
english.objectives: Slay 30 Demonic Invaders.
english.description: $N, I desperately need your help! I cannot hold out forever against this demonic onslaught. If I fall, Astranaar is next!$B$BPlease help me!
english.completion: You've saved us all, $n! I have the power to finish off these final few. No longer will the forest have to fear the Burning Legion!
english.completed: Speak with Big Baobob at the Shrine of Aessina in Ashenvale.

text.title: 成长的麻烦
text.objectives: 把图加之眼带到棘齿城西南的电角蜥蜴之峰。
text.description: 贫瘠的土壤里绽放出了新生命……我的同伴杰瑞克报告说，在贫瘠之地其他地方也有同样的情况。我应该亲自看看，但我不能擅离职守。$B$B给，$N，我把我的“眼睛”借给你。自从我行冠名仪式起，这只老鹰就一直跟随着我。请和他一起前往电角蜥蜴之峰，杰瑞克在那里等你们，我们将对此进行调查。$B$B沿着十字路口往东，看见一座涂满图画的巨石后朝南，就能到达山峰。
text.progress: Tonga knows these lands better than any of us, and I believe it physically hurt him to see it torn asunder.
text.completion: I am glad Tonga was able to witness the overgrowth firsthand - words can't convey the scope of the damage. Did you bring his totem? I will return it to him when I am finished here.
text.completed: Speak to Jerrik at Thunderhead Summit in North Barrens.

english.title: A Growing Problem
english.objectives: Bring Tonga's Eyes to Thunderhead Summit southwest of Ratchet.
english.description: An explosion of life from barren soil... My companion Jerrik has described similar events happening elsewhere in the Barrens. I shall have to see this for myself, but I cannot abandon my post.$B$BHere, $N, I will loan you my 'eyes.' My eagle companion here has served me since I was named. Please accompany him to Thunderhead Summit, where Jerrik awaits, and we will investigate.$B$BTo get to the peak, follow the road east out of the Crossroads. Turn south when you reach a large stone scrawled with paintings.
english.progress: Tonga knows these lands better than any of us, and I believe it physically hurt him to see it torn asunder.
english.completion: I am glad Tonga was able to witness the overgrowth firsthand - words can't convey the scope of the damage. Did you bring his totem? I will return it to him when I am finished here.
english.completed: Speak to Jerrik at Thunderhead Summit in North Barrens.

text.title: 污林之王
text.objectives: 将血牙战旗插在污林图腾堆上。不要让熊怪在他们酋长到来之前摧毁战旗。击败穆戈特酋长。
text.description: 我不太关心你是谁，$R。我关心的是熊怪的救赎。$B$B把这面血牙部落战旗带到东北不远的绿爪村里，将它插在他们的图腾堆上。他们会将此视为敌对之举，并要摧毁战旗。守住它，直到他们的酋长穆戈特代表部族出面，然后杀掉那叛徒！$B$B好好地分配你的体力，朋友，你要打的是一场持久战。
text.completion: Good. Murgut sold his own tribe out to the Horde, allying with them when they took your precious Silverwind Refuge in order to 'save' his people. He sold them into slavery, or worse. And now he has gotten what he deserved! Let us speak now of a different traitor, one whom I believe has something that will make that rod of yours even more powerful.
text.completed: Return to Krolg at Krolg's Hut in Ashenvale.
text.giverWindow: Slay the furbolg chief.

english.title: King of the Foulweald
english.objectives: Place the Bloodtooth Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner before their chief arrives. Defeat Chief Murgut.
english.description: I care little for who you are, $r. What I do care about is the salvation of the furbolg.$B$BTake this Bloodtooth tribe banner a short ways northeast into Greenpaw Village and place it upon their totem mound. They will consider this an act of aggression and try to destroy the banner. Hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe, then kill the traitor!$B$BGovern your strength wisely, friend, you're in for a long fight.
english.completion: Good. Murgut sold his own tribe out to the Horde, allying with them when they took your precious Silverwind Refuge in order to 'save' his people. He sold them into slavery, or worse. And now he has gotten what he deserved! Let us speak now of a different traitor, one whom I believe has something that will make that rod of yours even more powerful.
english.completed: Return to Krolg at Krolg's Hut in Ashenvale.
english.giverWindow: Slay the furbolg chief.

text.title: 被偷走的薪水
text.objectives: 与站在棘齿城入口旁的加兹罗格聊聊。
text.description: 好吧，$N。我得承认你的确够资格在我挚爱的部落中立足。你已经向我展示了你的力量、狡黠、积极……就连索克最近都提到了你的名字，要知道我们两个的眼光可是很挑剔的。你干的很好。$B$B现在有一个让你大展拳脚的机会。本周要发给十字路口守卫的薪水不见了。棘齿城的加兹罗格正在负责这个案子。去跟他谈谈吧！$B$B沿着东边的路一直朝海边走就到了。
text.completion: I was hoping for a squad of grunts... but if you earned Sergra's respect, I suppose you'll be more than enough. Let me explain what's happening here.
text.completed: Speak to Gazrog near the entrance to Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: The Purloined Payroll
english.objectives: Speak to Gazrog near the entrance to Ratchet.
english.description: Well, $N. I admit there's a place for you in my beloved Horde. You've shown me strength, cunning, initiative ... Even Thork recently mentioned you by name, and neither of us are easily impressed. Well done.$B$BNow it's time to start pulling your weight. This week's payroll for the Crossroads guards has gone missing. Gazrog in Ratchet is heading up the investigation. Talk to him!$B$BSimply follow the road East of here to the coast.
english.completion: I was hoping for a squad of grunts... but if you earned Sergra's respect, I suppose you'll be more than enough. Let me explain what's happening here.
english.completed: Speak to Gazrog near the entrance to Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: 诱敌之计
text.objectives: 杀死8匹科卡尔半人马。
text.description: 我是被派到这里来侦查半人马的动向的。几天来我一直在跟踪他们的一举一动！ 我本应该现在去刺探他们的动静，但是他们把这个绿洲团团包围了。$B$B你看上去像个狠角色。你能替我弄出点大动静来吗？把他们搅个鸡犬不宁！见人马就杀！等他们一窝蜂出去逮你的时候，我就能偷偷地去给雷戈萨·死门刺探情报了。
text.completion: Oh, ho! That was beautiful. I probably shouldn't have stayed to watch. Now that they're looking for you, I'll slip quietly away in the dust of their aimless gallopin'. Be sure to look for my buds at the other pools. Boss has agents at every one.
text.completed: Return to Ta'jari at the Forgotten Pools in North Barrens.

english.title: A Little Diversion
english.objectives: Kill 8 Kolkar Centaur.
english.description: I was sent here to scout out the centaur activity. I've been trackin' their every movement for days! It's time for me ta sneak out, but they've got this oasis surrounded.$B$BYou look like a dangerous one. Can you make a lot of noise for me? Stir 'em up! Start killin' indiscriminately. While they're looking out for you I'll slip out to get my info to Regthar Deathgate.
english.completion: Oh, ho! That was beautiful. I probably shouldn't have stayed to watch. Now that they're looking for you, I'll slip quietly away in the dust of their aimless gallopin'. Be sure to look for my buds at the other pools. Boss has agents at every one.
english.completed: Return to Ta'jari at the Forgotten Pools in North Barrens.

text.title: 你就是炸弹！
text.objectives: Foreman Jinx wants you to ride the Repurposed Shredder to Stonetalon Mountains and speak to Saurboz.
text.description: Okay, $n. You're all set.$b$bI've pre-programmed the path to Stonetalon, so all you'll need to worry about is keeping the bomb intact.$b$bYou can use the sawblades to mow down any enemies from a distance, or short-circuit a fuse to zap anyone who gets too close.$b$bYou have ONE chance to repair the bomb if it gets dangerously damaged. Use it wisely!$b$bSpeak to me when you think you're ready.$b$bGood luck!

english.title: You're the Bomb!
english.objectives: Foreman Jinx wants you to ride the Repurposed Shredder to Stonetalon Mountains and speak to Saurboz.
english.description: Okay, $n. You're all set.$b$bI've pre-programmed the path to Stonetalon, so all you'll need to worry about is keeping the bomb intact.$b$bYou can use the sawblades to mow down any enemies from a distance, or short-circuit a fuse to zap anyone who gets too close.$b$bYou have ONE chance to repair the bomb if it gets dangerously damaged. Use it wisely!$b$bSpeak to me when you think you're ready.$b$bGood luck!

text.title: (DEPRECATED)
text.objectives: Speak to Inquisitor Blackwell in Grimmburg.
text.description: Listen, $N.  You must do as the inquisitor asks.$B$BHe claims that the Horde is attacking Gilneas, and if that's true then someone must pass word along to the Wolfheart clan before it's too late.$B$BBesides, Balvus Wolfheart would skin me alive if he found out I let you rot on Greymane's stocks.$B$BGo, $N.  Save yourself... and when the time is right... warn our brethren in the Blackwald.

english.title: (DEPRECATED)
english.objectives: Speak to Inquisitor Blackwell in Grimmburg.
english.description: Listen, $N.  You must do as the inquisitor asks.$B$BHe claims that the Horde is attacking Gilneas, and if that's true then someone must pass word along to the Wolfheart clan before it's too late.$B$BBesides, Balvus Wolfheart would skin me alive if he found out I let you rot on Greymane's stocks.$B$BGo, $N.  Save yourself... and when the time is right... warn our brethren in the Blackwald.

text.title: 半人马山之王
text.objectives: 保护格高·怒痕在骚扰半人马的时候不被杀掉，并帮助他杀掉库拉克。
text.description: 我们被派到这里追踪科卡尔半人马的动向，不过一周来我净看这帮肮脏的野兽在这绿洲周围尥蹶子撒欢了。我的手有点痒了，真想操起斧子剁上几匹半人马爽一下。你说什么，$C？想要跟我一起杀个痛快？看看我们能否引起他们最强壮的战士，库拉克的注意。
text.completion: Aw mon, why you have to go settin' Gorgal off like that? Still, I can't argue with results. We'll need to watch these animals closely to see what they do with Kurak outta the way. More watchin' and waitin'. Gorgal won't like that.
text.completed: Talk to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis in North Barrens.
text.giverWindow: His presence is an affront to the senses. Even his flies have flies.

english.title: King of Centaur Mountain
english.objectives: Keep Gorgal Angerscar alive as he starts some trouble with the centaur, and help him to slay Kurak.
english.description: We were sent here to track movements of the Kolkar centaur, but after a week of watching these dirty animals scamper all around this oasis, I'm itching to give my axe a taste of their necks. What do you say, $c? Want to cause a little havoc with me?$B$BLet's see if we can attract the attention of their strongest warrior, Kurak.
english.completion: Aw mon, why you have to go settin' Gorgal off like that? Still, I can't argue with results. We'll need to watch these animals closely to see what they do with Kurak outta the way. More watchin' and waitin'. Gorgal won't like that.
english.completed: Talk to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis in North Barrens.
english.giverWindow: His presence is an affront to the senses. Even his flies have flies.

text.title: Can You Get This Quest While I'm In Combat?
text.objectives: ELM Daze Target on Designer Island has asked you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!
text.description: Your mission, if you are able to read this while I'm in combat, is to kill 5 of these insufferable little kobolds that are constantly keeping me in combat.$B$BJust the fact that you are reading this is a huge WIN!  Isn't Dan awesome?!!

english.title: Can You Get This Quest While I'm In Combat?
english.objectives: ELM Daze Target on Designer Island has asked you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!
english.description: Your mission, if you are able to read this while I'm in combat, is to kill 5 of these insufferable little kobolds that are constantly keeping me in combat.$B$BJust the fact that you are reading this is a huge WIN!  Isn't Dan awesome?!!

text.title: 如果在我战斗的时候，你读到了这个……
text.objectives: ELM Daze Target想要你为Dan和Great Justice消灭5个ELM Attacker
text.description: Dan是全世界最可怕的程序员……我说的是魔兽世界！$B$B当我战斗的时候，你却没办法和我说话，难道这不是很奇怪的事情吗？而现在这种怪事已经不会再发生了，我的朋友。Dan对我的一个生物特性做了大规模改进！$B$B和我一起庆祝吧，消灭这些可怕的怪物。正是它们让我陷入了永远无法停息的战斗之中。
text.completed: Return to ELM Daze Target in Designer Island.

english.title: If You're Reading This While I'm In Combat...
english.objectives: ELM Daze Target wants you to kill 5 ELM Attackers for Dan and Great Justice!
english.description: Dan is the most awesome programmer in the world... the World of Warcraft!$B$BIsn't it weird that you used to not be able to talk with me at all while I was fighting?  No longer, my friend, now that Dan has made significant improvements to one of my creature flags!$B$BCelebrate with me by snuffing out the lives of these awful creatures that perpetually have me in combat.
english.completed: Return to ELM Daze Target in Designer Island.

text.title: 我们信仰真菌
text.objectives: 在死水绿洲附近种植一株真菌植株并观察结果。
text.description: 我培植了些你挖来的奇异孢子，用的是我喜欢的一种最棒的试剂……鸡尾酒……我等不及要看看我培植的孢子会对十字路口绿洲的水有什么影响。$B$B东南边的死水绿洲是一块尚未被污染的地方，可以用来做我们的实验。将这株培植品种植在绿洲附近的潮湿土壤中，然后替我记录下日志。$B$B记得捂住嘴哦，$C。$B$B<赫布瑞姆咧着嘴，笑容让人笃定。>
text.completion: Explosive spore clouds? You don't say ... tell me more. Choking? Stinging? Burning of the eyes? Was there itching? Nausea? Mortification? Delightful, DELIGHTFUL! You've certainly earned your commission, $n. That skin rash of yours should pass in a day or two.
text.completed: Report your findings to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

english.title: In Fungus We Trust
english.objectives: Plant a Fungal Culture near the Stagnant Oasis and observe the results.
english.description: I've cultured these unusual spores you dug up with a most magnificent cocktail of ... reagents ... that I'm fond of. I'm eager to see how my manipulated spores react to the waters of the Crossroads oases.$B$BThe Stagnant Oasis to the southeast should provide us an uncontaminated site for our experiment. Simply plant this culture in the moist soil anywhere near the oasis, and document the results for me.$B$BBe sure to cover your mouth, $c.$B$B<Helbrim grins disarmingly.>
english.completion: Explosive spore clouds? You don't say ... tell me more. Choking? Stinging? Burning of the eyes? Was there itching? Nausea? Mortification? Delightful, DELIGHTFUL! You've certainly earned your commission, $n. That skin rash of yours should pass in a day or two.
english.completed: Report your findings to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads in North Barrens.

text.title: 蘑菇特工
text.objectives: 去北贫瘠之地的棘齿城，将赫布瑞姆的研究成果交给那里的萨莎雅。
text.description: 设想一下这种蘑菇孢子带来可能性，$N！疾速生长，并且可以成为任何毒素的触媒。我在幽暗城的同伴们会很想听到这个消息的。$B$B这里是我的笔记和一些额外的样本。如果我们够快，我们就能赶上下一艘去往东部王国的船。从这里沿着路向东，去往地精城镇棘齿城。在城南找到断骨旅店旅店，将这些东西交给店里的萨莎雅，那是我的接头人。
text.progress: Who are you? Did Helbrim send you? Keep a low profile.
text.completion: Quiet! Give me those notes. Were you followed here?
text.completed: Deliver Helbrim's Research to Sashya at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: Who's Shroomin' Who?
english.objectives: Deliver Helbrim's Research to Sashya at Ratchet in North Barrens.
english.description: Think of the possibilities, $N! Fast-growing fungal delivery agents for any manner of toxins. My companions in the Undercity will want to hear about this.$B$BHere are my notes and some additional samples. If we're fast, we can catch the next ship bound for the Eastern Kingdoms. Take the road east of here and follow it to the goblin town of Ratchet. Look for the Broken Keel tavern toward the south side of town and deliver these to my associate Sashya within.
english.progress: Who are you? Did Helbrim send you? Keep a low profile.
english.completion: Quiet! Give me those notes. Were you followed here?
english.completed: Deliver Helbrim's Research to Sashya at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: Hunt or Be Hunted
text.objectives: Bring the Spiked Wolf Collars to Huntsman Rusell in Grimmburg.
text.description: These should suffice to track down whoever's in charge of their wolves.$B$BTake these collars to huntsman Russell.  I've asked him to set aside one of his best bloodhounds for this task.

english.title: Hunt or Be Hunted
english.objectives: Bring the Spiked Wolf Collars to Huntsman Rusell in Grimmburg.

text.title: 地精逃生舱
text.objectives: 营救6名地精幸存者。
text.description: $N，对不起，我以为你死了！$B$B太可怕了。我们的船卷进了联盟与部落的混战！$B$B落难的兄弟姐妹们还在等待救援。$B$B<他指着漂浮在附近海面上的逃生舱。>$B$B我得再坐会儿喘口气。你去救他们如何？穿上这双热电液压蛙蹼吧，它可以提升游泳速度。$B$B请转告莎希，我待会就跟她汇合。
text.completion: Oh, thank heavens that you survived, $n! I thought for sure that you'd drowned when I saw you go over the side! Look at all of these folks you saved!
text.completed: Report to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Goblin Escape Pods
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Goblin Survivors.
english.description: $N, I'm sorry, I thought you were dead!$B$BThis is just crazy. We sailed into a fight between the Alliance and Horde!$B$BYou know, our brothers and sisters still need to be rescued.$B$B<He points out all of the escape pods in the water around you.>$B$BI think I'm going to sit here a while longer and catch my breath. Can you swim around and let them out? Take my pair of thermohydratic flippers so you can get around faster.$B$BLet Sassy know that I'll swim in shortly.
english.completion: Oh, thank heavens that you survived, $n! I thought for sure that you'd drowned when I saw you go over the side! Look at all of these folks you saved!
english.completed: Report to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

text.title: A Job for a Bloodhound
text.objectives: Use the Spiked Worg Collars near the cages behind Huntsman Russell.  Follow the Gilnean Bloodhound to find and kill the leader of the Orc Scouts.
text.description: Take the collars over to those cages in the back.  Show it to any of my bloodhounds -- they know what to do.$B$BOnce they find what you're looking for, you'd better be ready to fight.  Report back to the mayor when you're done.

text.title: 修理主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 将损坏的主动式负载平衡器交给营地里的布拉克·布拉斯派普。
text.description: 事与愿违，我想我把它搞坏了。$B$B不过别紧张。帮我个忙，把这个给对面营地里的布拉克送去。他转眼就能把这个破玩意修好！
text.progress: Did you say ... samophlange!?
text.completion: Sputtervalve scored us a Samophlange? Lemme see that thing! Yeah, we can get this working again, no problem. Hand me that huge mallet...
text.completed: 将损坏的主动式负载平衡器交给营地里的布拉克·布拉斯派普。

english.title: Samophlange Repair
english.objectives: Walk the Broken Samophlange over to Brak Blusterpipe within the encampment.
english.description: Well that didn't go as expected. I think I busted it.$B$BNo need to panic, though. Do me a favor and walk this across the way to Brak here in the camp. He'll bang this sucker back into shape real quick!
english.progress: Did you say ... samophlange!?
english.completion: Sputtervalve scored us a Samophlange? Lemme see that thing! Yeah, we can get this working again, no problem. Hand me that huge mallet...
english.completed: Walk the Broken Samophlange over to Brak Blusterpipe within the encampment.

text.title: 归还主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 把修理过的主动式负载平衡器残骸带给诺兹波特的哨站的斯布特瓦夫。同维妮交谈，就能直接传送到斯布特瓦夫那里去。
text.description: 嘿，这么干根本没用。主动式负载平衡器的结构完整性测量读数都总是过低。我可以再安装几个仪表，试试能不能修正它的问题，不过……我想那只会让事情变得更糟。$B$B不过你看，我在阻塞排泄阀，炸飞差速箱的盖子时发现了这个：“考博普拉格老大”的私人钢印。把这个给斯布特瓦夫带回去，告诉他去找这个叫考博普拉格的天才。你在这里的事情搞定之后来找我，我会用布拉克的传送器送你回去。
text.progress: Is that my samophlange? I don't even recognize it.
text.completion: Wenikee said what? Copperplug? BOSS Copperplug? Oh no, this might be tricky.
text.completed: Take the Re-engineered Samophlange Wreckage back to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.  Talk to Wenikee to port directly to him.

english.title: Return to Samophlanger
english.objectives: Take the Re-engineered Samophlange Wreckage back to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost. Talk to Wenikee to port directly to him.
english.description: Well, that didn't work. The structural integrity of the samophlange is at an all-time low. I could add some more dials to try and fix it, but...that might make things even worse.$B$BLook what I discovered when I blocked the release valve and blew the cover off the differential casing, though: the personal stamp of "Boss Copperplug."$B$BTake this back to Sputtervalve and tell him to find this Copperplug genius. When you're done here, just talk to me and I'll send you back using Brak's teleporter.
english.progress: Is that my samophlange? I don't even recognize it.
english.completion: Wenikee said what? Copperplug? BOSS Copperplug? Oh no, this might be tricky.
english.completed: Take the Re-engineered Samophlange Wreckage back to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.  Talk to Wenikee to port directly to him.

text.title: 艾露恩的复仇
text.objectives: 用塔琳德拉赋予你的能力杀到腐败之源处，将其摧毁。
text.description: 腐化的力量这么多年以来都在阻止泰达希尔的生长，随着它的净化，一种不怀好意的赘生正在南面树木的边缘成形。我们已经有机会出击，能将污染瘤背、林精及其他一切的魔苔源头净化。$B$B有了你从月井里打来的水，还有泰达希尔重新恢复的力量，我就能在短时间内赐予你强大的能力。阻止这场腐败，$N。
text.completion: Elune be praised! Everything I had encountered suggested this corruption to be buried deep within Teldrassil itself... I had worried we might never be able to strike at the source without killing the world tree. I am thankful I was wrong! Malfurion was the start to this great turn of fortune. Perhaps I will seek him out before I depart to the wilds again. Thank you, $n. Thank you for everything you have done. You are sure to be a great hero someday!
text.completed: Return to Tarindrella at the Pools of Arlithrien.
text.giverWindow: As Malfurion tore the remains of Xavius from Teldrassil, a great weight was lifted from the dying world tree. One last remnant of Xavius remains to torment the night elf people, but Elune's champion approaches to finally free the tree completely.

english.title: The Vengeance of Elune
english.objectives: Use the powers granted to you by Tarindrella to fight your way to the Heart of Corruption and destroy it.
english.description: As Teldrassil purges itself of the corruption that has perverted it's growth for all of these years, a malevolent growth has formed near the tree's edge, south of here. We have an opportunity to strike out and purge the source of the fel moss that has tainted the gnarlpine, the timberlings, and everything else.$B$BWith the water that you've collected from the moonwells and the renewed strength of Teldrassil herself, I can grant you great power for a short while. Put an end to this corruption, $n.
english.completion: Elune be praised! Everything I had encountered suggested this corruption to be buried deep within Teldrassil itself... I had worried we might never be able to strike at the source without killing the world tree. I am thankful I was wrong! Malfurion was the start to this great turn of fortune. Perhaps I will seek him out before I depart to the wilds again. Thank you, $n. Thank you for everything you have done. You are sure to be a great hero someday!
english.completed: Return to Tarindrella at the Pools of Arlithrien.
english.giverWindow: As Malfurion tore the remains of Xavius from Teldrassil, a great weight was lifted from the dying world tree. One last remnant of Xavius remains to torment the night elf people, but Elune's champion approaches to finally free the tree completely.

text.title: 阅读说明书
text.objectives: 装订主动式负载平衡器说明书。
text.description: 我还在修补匠协会的时候，考博普拉格老大就是我们的头号工程师。我走后不久，他就带着最了不起的技术叛变，投靠了风险投资公司。他把那些秘密都藏得紧紧的，只对最信任的内部人员透露一点点只言片语。$B$B假如主动式负载平衡器是他造的，那他也许会有说明书。我听到的最新消息是，他在东北边石矿洞外面有所活动。从他那里拿到说明书，他的追随者身上则有正文的书页。
text.progress: Did you find Copperplug?
text.completion: You found it! Wow, it's over 600 pages, only 30 of which are intentionally left blank. Let's see. Chapter three: Backsplicing the Reverse Crankshaft Flywheel Pulley? Interesting. Chapter seven: Valve Timing for the High-Pressure Expansion Condenser!? This stuff is great! And I still don't even know what this thing does. Here, have some of my old tools. Let's fire this thing up one last time!
text.completed: Bring the Manual to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.

english.title: Read the Manual
english.objectives: Assemble the Samophlange Manual.
english.description: Back when I was in the Tinker's Union, Boss Copperplug was the best engineer we had. He defected to the Venture Company shortly before I left, and took his greatest techniques with him. He hoarded his secrets, doling out bits and pieces of knowledge to his trusted inner circle.$B$BIf he built the samophlange, then he's probably got the manual. Last I heard, he was operating right here, out of Boulder Lode mine to the northeast. Get the manual from him, and collect the pages from his followers.
english.progress: Did you find Copperplug?
english.completion: You found it! Wow, it's over 600 pages, only 30 of which are intentionally left blank. Let's see. Chapter three: Backsplicing the Reverse Crankshaft Flywheel Pulley? Interesting. Chapter seven: Valve Timing for the High-Pressure Expansion Condenser!? This stuff is great! And I still don't even know what this thing does. Here, have some of my old tools. Let's fire this thing up one last time!
english.completed: Bring the Manual to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in North Barrens.

text.title: 稳固射击
text.objectives: Speak with Bamm Megabomb and train Steady Shot, then shoot a Training Dummy with it 3 times.
text.description: I'm Bamm Megabomb, your personal trainer, $g sir : ma'am;.$B$BI understand that you're interested in some new insight about being a $c? Look no further.$B$BI think you'll gain a great deal by me teaching you how to perform a Steady Shot. It just might help you climb the corporate ladder if you know what I mean.$B$BLearn the ability from me and then practice it on a training dummy here.
text.completion: There you go, boss! Come back anytime you want more training. I'll teach you what I know.
text.completed: Speak with Bamm Megabomb at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.completion: $c-Matic NX-01 is programmed to serve. Return anytime you seek more training. This unit will teach you what it knows.

text.title: 夺回工具箱！
text.objectives: 取回8箱工具。
text.description: 我们的炸弹和工具！栖息在东边的那群猴子趁夜深人静的时候将它们偷走了！$B$B你可以帮我们抢回来吗，$N？没有工具的话，我们是没有办法离开这座岛屿的！
text.progress: Bomb-throwing monkeys?! The nerve!!!
text.completion: I thought we were doomed for sure. But now we can start working on a way to get off of this island!
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Get Our Stuff Back!
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 Crates of Tools.
english.description: Our bombs and tools! Those sneaky monkeys to the east stole them all in the dead of night!$B$BCan you go out there and get them back for us, $N? Without those tools, we have absolutely no way to get off of this island!
english.progress: Bomb-throwing monkeys?! The nerve!!!
english.completion: I thought we were doomed for sure. But now we can start working on a way to get off of this island!
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

text.objectives: Bring the Soaked Map to Mayor Armstead in Grimmburg.
text.description: You open the scroll, revealing a fairly accurate map of Gilneas with one exception.  The entirety of the area between the coast and the cliffs behind Grimmburg appears to be missing.$B$BThere are also arrows that appears to represent Horde movement deeper in Gilneas.  Mayor Armstead might find this to be of interest.

text.title: The Black Knight's Curse
text.objectives: Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to investigate the Black Knight's Grave.
text.description: 我想在胜利后从比赛场地中移除黑骑士的遗体，但是忏悔者Paletress坚持让他得到一个体面的埋葬。从那时起，黑暗的存在已经在公墓里徘徊，人们不敢去那里参观堕落的人。$B$B你是否参观过比赛场地东端的公墓，看看你能发现什么发生了什么？
text.completion: Do you think they've been planning this? I suppose it doesn't matter, but I don't like the implication that we've been playing into their hands. Whatever is going on, we have to stop it.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Black Knight's Curse
english.objectives: Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to investigate the Black Knight's Grave.
english.description: I wanted to remove the Black Knight's remains from the tournament grounds after your victory, but Confessor Paletress insisted that he receive a decent burial. Ever since, a dark presence has lingered in the cemetery and people are afraid to go there to visit the fallen.$B$BWould you visit the cemetery just past the eastern end of the tournament grounds and see if you can discover what's happening?
english.completion: Do you think they've been planning this? I suppose it doesn't matter, but I don't like the implication that we've been playing into their hands. Whatever is going on, we have to stop it.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: The Black Knight's Fate
text.objectives: Capture Doctor Kolher's Orders at Deathspeaker's Watch, then return to Crusader Rhydalla at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: You said the body was taken by cultists? I can only think of one place they would have gone, Deathspeaker's Watch, the encampment on the rise west of the tournament grounds.$B$BWhatever the cultists are doing must be stopped. The rumors I've heard can only be true, then. The infamous Doctor Kohler must be among the cultists, practicing his arts. Look for a rise or an altar overlooking the cultist camp, slay the doctor, and look for proof of his plans. Slow down his work in any other way you can.
text.progress: Did you find out what they're doing with the Black Knight's remains?
text.completion: The doctor will not have time to complete his work, but his plan is already in motion. From what you've reported, the Lich King's servants have reanimated and empowered the Black Knight and there's no telling what the knight's master has in mind. You have done well in uncovering this plot. I will tell High Crusader Adelard of your findings and together, we will alert the tournament's participants.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Rhydalla at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 那应被原谅之人
text.objectives: 跟灰谷林中树塔的阿夫鲁斯·病语谈一谈。
text.description: The voice of the goddess spoke to you at the moonwell, $N. The cure for Relara lies to the east at Raynewood Tower. The one who has fallen into corruption.$B$BAvrus Illwhisper seeks forgiveness and redemption. It is up to you to assist him and in so doing, hopefully help my child as well.

english.title: He Who Would Be Forgiven
english.objectives: Speak with Avrus Illwhisper at Raynewood Tower in Ashenvale.
english.description: The voice of the goddess spoke to you at the moonwell, $N. The cure for Relara lies to the east at Raynewood Tower. The one who has fallen into corruption.$B$BAvrus Illwhisper seeks forgiveness and redemption. It is up to you to assist him and in so doing, hopefully help my child as well.

text.title: 闯祸的猴子
text.objectives: 将硝化钾香蕉抛向掷弹猴子，喂饱10只猴子。
text.description: 东边丛林里的猴子捅了大娄子。它们偷走了我们的炸弹，互相抛着玩。$B$B有时候还会朝我们丢一颗！$B$B我让“点火器”菲兹在这些香蕉里放了点硝化甘油。猴子最喜欢香蕉了！$B$B拿去喂它们吧。
text.completion: They launched up into the air when they ate the bananas?! That is hilarious! I think I'm going to take a bunch out there and feed them myself!
text.completed: Return to Bamm Megabomb at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Monkey Business
english.objectives: Feed 10 Bomb-Throwing Monkeys by tossing Nitro-Potassium Bananas to them.
english.description: We've got major problems with the monkeys in the jungle to the east. They've stolen all of our explosives, and now they're going around throwing them.$B$BSometimes at us!$B$BI had Fizz Lighter take some of his nitro and put it in these bananas. No monkey can resist a bunch of bananas!$B$BAll you have to do is go out there and feed them.
english.completion: They launched up into the air when they ate the bananas?! That is hilarious! I think I'm going to take a bunch out there and feed them myself!
english.completed: Return to Bamm Megabomb at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

text.title: The Curse
text.objectives: Krennan Aranas in Grimmburg wants you to obtain 8 Black Mandrakes.
text.description: The Curse caught us by surprise.  Everything was normal one day, entire villages were turned into packs of howling worgen the next.BBy Lord Greymane's orders we toiled night and day to find a cure for it.  Alas, we did not.$B$BWe found the next best thing, however.  The distilled essence of the black mandrake allows us to mitigate most of the Curse's effects.$B$BUnfortunately, my supply has been cut off by this orc attack.  Bring me any black mandrake you find so I can distill more of the essence.

english.title: The Curse
english.objectives: Krennan Aranas in Grimmburg wants you to obtain 8 Black Mandrakes.
english.description: The Curse caught us by surprise.  Everything was normal one day, entire villages were turned into packs of howling worgen the next.BBy Lord Greymane's orders we toiled night and day to find a cure for it.  Alas, we did not.$B$BWe found the next best thing, however.  The distilled essence of the black mandrake allows us to mitigate most of the Curse's effects.$B$BUnfortunately, my supply has been cut off by this orc attack.  Bring me any black mandrake you find so I can distill more of the essence.

text.title: 矿工的麻烦
text.objectives: 护送惊恐的矿工进入卡亚矿洞。
text.description: 智能采矿猴！$B$B洞里到处是挥着锄头的……猴子！这太不正常了，我觉得这是因为卡亚矿石的影响！$B$B我派出去的矿工都没能回来。可供差遣的人也所剩无几了！$N，我陷入了困境。$B$B<工头压低了嗓门。>$B$B这些家伙跟丛林巨魔简直没法比。啊，真怀念往昔的日子。$B$B你能护送我仅剩的这名矿工进入矿洞，并保护他免受猴子的伤害吗？我们急需卡亚矿石！
text.completion: We've hit the mother lode!!! Now, what's all this about a pygmy witchdoctor in charge of the monkeys? Is he dead? Because if he's dead, then legally I can stake my claim... not that I wasn't going to do that anyway. By $r law, all Kaja'mite belongs to us!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick outside of the Kaja'mite Cavern on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Miner Troubles
english.objectives: Escort the Frightened Miner through the Kaja'mite Cavern.
english.description: Smart mining monkeys!$B$BThey're all over the inside of the cavern, mining... with picks! It's just not natural and I'm sure it's because of the kaja'mite!$B$BNone of my miners have come back out. I don't have many left! You can see my predicament, $N.$B$B<The foreman lowers his voice.>$B$BThese guys are nowhere near as good as my old group of jungle trolls. Ah, those were the days.$B$BMaybe you can escort my last miner here through the cavern and keep those monkeys off of him? We need that kaja'mite!
english.completion: We've hit the mother lode!!! Now, what's all this about a pygmy witchdoctor in charge of the monkeys? Is he dead? Because if he's dead, then legally I can stake my claim... not that I wasn't going to do that anyway. By $r law, all Kaja'mite belongs to us!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick outside of the Kaja'mite Cavern on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 感恩节
text.objectives: 同暴风城大门外的格雷戈里·塔波交谈。
text.description: $N，难道你不想和我们一起庆祝感恩节吗？在这个时刻，你可以回忆以前的旅行趣事和各种收获，同朋友们分享各种美食和故事。$B$B你可以参加精彩的感恩节盛宴。这些宴会都被安排在每一座主城的附近。你可以坐在那里的宴会桌旁，尽情享用桌上的美食。$B$B如果你有兴趣学习如何烹调传统的感恩节美食，那么就去找格雷戈里·塔波吧。你可以在暴风城的大门外找到他。
text.completion: If you'd like to learn to cook Pilgrim's Bounty foods, I can help. If you're not already a cook, all you have to do is train and you'll be cooking in no time!

english.title: Pilgrim's Bounty
english.objectives: Speak with Gregory Tabor just outside the city gates of Stormwind.
english.description: Won't you celebrate Pilgrim's Bounty with us, $N? It's a time for reflecting on your journeys and your good fortune, sharing plentiful food and stories with friends.$B$BYou can partake of wonderful Pilgrim's Bounty feasts near major towns by sitting at a bountiful table and serving the foods you find there.$B$BIf you're interested in learning how to cook the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty foods, seek out Gregory Tabor. You will find him just outside Stormwind's gates.
english.completion: If you'd like to learn to cook Pilgrim's Bounty foods, I can help. If you're not already a cook, all you have to do is train and you'll be cooking in no time!

text.title: 玉米馅料
text.objectives: 制作5份玉米馅料，把它们交给加斯帕·摩尔，他就在暴风城大门外的宴会区。
text.description: 我们的玉米馅料是感恩节宴席的基石。这道菜肴一直都是暴风城的一道名菜。现在它更是在盛宴食谱中占据了举足轻重的位置。$B$B如果你已经是一名厨师，就去找感恩节商人，他会给你这道大餐的盛宴食谱，告诉你准备一份这样的假日大餐都需要哪些原料。如果你还不是一名厨师，那么现在就开始研习厨艺吧！$B$B做好玉米馅料之后，就把它交给那些桌子旁边的加斯帕·摩尔。
text.progress: We can always use more of that delicious spice bread stuffing. It's very popular.
text.completion: Excellent. This is just what we needed. It's going to be a chore keeping all the tables stocked with fresh food, but it's well worth it.
text.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
english.objectives: Cook 5 servings of Spice Bread Stuffing and then bring them to Jasper Moore at the feasting area just outside Stormwind's gates.
english.description: Our spice bread stuffing is the cornerstone of the Pilgrim's Bounty table. The recipe has always been a favorite in Stormwind and now it has taken its place in the bountiful cookbook.$B$BIf you are already a cook, pay a visit to the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor to get your copy of the cookbook and all the local ingredients you'll need to prepare holiday fare. And if you're not yet a cook, there's no better time to start!$B$BOnce you've made the stuffing, bring it to Jasper Moore over near the tables.
english.progress: We can always use more of that delicious spice bread stuffing. It's very popular.
english.completion: Excellent. This is just what we needed. It's going to be a chore keeping all the tables stocked with fresh food, but it's well worth it.
english.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 南瓜馅饼
text.objectives: 制作5份南瓜馅饼，将它们交给铁炉堡外宴会区的爱德华·文斯洛。
text.description: 你做的玉米馅料闻起来真是香极了，但如果没有一块南瓜馅饼，那么感恩节就永远都不会完整。那是我们在暴风城最喜欢的另外一道菜。因为艾尔文南瓜只会生长在这里。$B$B如果你还不知道该如何制作南瓜馅饼，那么你现在就可以在你的盛宴食谱上找到这道菜的做法了。$B$B你是否愿意制作一些南瓜馅饼，并把它们交给铁炉堡外的爱德华·文斯洛？现在他的南瓜馅饼一定已经不够了。
text.progress: More pumpkin pie? Just in time.
text.completion: The pumpkin pie's been a big hit up here. I've never seen a dwarf get so excited about anything made from a vegetable.
text.completed: Return to Edward Winslow at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Pumpkin Pie
english.objectives: Make 5 slices of Pumpkin Pie and bring them to Edward Winslow at the feasting area right outside Ironforge.
english.description: That spice bread stuffing you made smells delicious, but no Pilgrim's Bounty feast is complete without a slice of pumpkin pie. It's another one of our favorite dishes here in Stormwind, since it uses ripe Elwynn pumpkins that only grow here.$B$BIf you don't know how to make pumpkin pie already, there's a recipe in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BWould you mind cooking up a few slices and bringing them to Edward Winslow outside Ironforge? He's bound to be running low by now.
english.progress: More pumpkin pie? Just in time.
english.completion: The pumpkin pie's been a big hit up here. I've never seen a dwarf get so excited about anything made from a vegetable.
english.completed: Return to Edward Winslow at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: Face to Face
text.objectives: Lieutenant Wright wants you to kill 10 Orc Invaders.
text.description: My men can certainly use the help, $N.  We're trying as hard as we can to hold the orcs back, but it's not good enough.$B$BKill as many orcs as it takes to tip the scales back in our balance.  Let's see if the ferocity your clan is known for is as good against the orcs as it is against our livestock.

english.title: Face to Face
english.objectives: Lieutenant Wright wants you to kill 10 Orc Invaders.
english.description: My men can certainly use the help, $N.  We're trying as hard as we can to hold the orcs back, but it's not good enough.$B$BKill as many orcs as it takes to tip the scales back in our balance.  Let's see if the ferocity your clan is known for is as good against the orcs as it is against our livestock.

text.title: 酸果蔓酱
text.objectives: 制作5份酸果蔓酱，并把它们送到暴风城外宴会区的加斯帕·摩尔那里去。
text.description: 如果你还没有试过酸果蔓酱，那么你的人生肯定还不完整。它是用味道最清新的湿地酸果蔓制作的。如果你想要尝试自己制作酸果蔓酱，那就找感恩节商人吧。$B$B做这道菜的方法应该就在你的盛宴食谱中。$B$B如果你有空，能不能制作一些酸果蔓酱，并把它们送到暴风城外的加斯帕·摩尔那里去？我答应过他，会给他一些东西以作为你带过来的那些馅饼的交换。
text.progress: Is that cranberry chutney I smell?
text.completion: Finally, the cranberry chutney I was promised. You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through the stuff here.
text.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Cranberry Chutney
english.objectives: Make 5 servings of Cranberry Chutney and bring them to Jasper Moore at the feasting area outside Stormwind.
english.description: If you haven't tried the cranberry chutney yet, you're in for a treat. It's made with the freshest tangy Wetlands cranberries. Just pick some up from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor if you want to try your hand at making chutney.$B$BThe recipe should be in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BIf you've got some extra time on your hands, would you mind making some of the chutney and bringing it down to Jasper Moore outside Stormwind? I promised him I'd trade some for the pie you brought.
english.progress: Is that cranberry chutney I smell?
english.completion: Finally, the cranberry chutney I was promised. You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through the stuff here.
english.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 达纳苏斯的人都饿极了
text.objectives: 将5份玉米馅料和5份南瓜馅饼送给达纳苏斯入口处附近的艾萨克·奥勒登。
text.description: 感谢你带来了酸果蔓酱。这里要做的烹调工作太多了，我几乎没有时间去想别的事情。而现在对我来说，最重要的一件事就是达纳苏斯的艾萨克·奥勒登几乎已经把一切物资都用光了。你愿意帮我们一个忙，给那里送去一些玉米馅料和南瓜馅饼吗？你可以那边的商人手中购得你所需要的一切原料。$B$B你可以在达纳苏斯入口附近的宴会区找到艾萨克·奥勒登。那里就在战士区的外面。
text.progress: Have you come to partake of the Pilgrim's Bounty feast?
text.completion: Thanks for bringing everything. I was starting to get worried. While you're here, you should try your hand at making some candied sweet potatoes.
text.completed: Return to Isaac Allerton at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

english.title: They're Ravenous In Darnassus
english.objectives: Bring 5 servings of Spice Bread Stuffing and 5 Pumpkin Pies to Isaac Allerton near the entrance to Darnassus.
english.description: Thanks for bringing the cranberry chutney. There's so much cooking to do, I hardly have time to think of anything else. And on top of my responsibilities here, Isaac Allerton in Darnassus is out of almost everything. I don't suppose you'd be willing to step in and whip up some more spice bread stuffing and pumpkin pie? The vendor should have all the ingredients you need$B$BYou should be able to find him near the feasting tables near the entrance to Darnassus just beyond the Warrior's Terrace.
english.progress: Have you come to partake of the Pilgrim's Bounty feast?
english.completion: Thanks for bringing everything. I was starting to get worried. While you're here, you should try your hand at making some candied sweet potatoes.
english.completed: Return to Isaac Allerton at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

text.title: 捕获未知的信息
text.objectives: 使用卡亚罗牌自动成像机拍摄指定的三处壁画以及俾格米神坛。
text.description: 洞里随处可见奇怪的壁画和器物。$B$B取下别在腰间的卡亚罗牌自动成像机，在指定的地点捕获影像，并拍下洞穴深处的祭坛。$B$B我确定莎希会对这个情报很感兴趣。
text.completion: What are these? Clearly that pygmy witchdoctor is from some new race never seen before. Maybe we should call them $n-ians? They must be the ones that painted all of that stuff in the cavern. I'm not sure that I like what you're describing. It sounds to me like they're paintings of them and us on an island with an exploding volcano!
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Capturing the Unknown
english.objectives: Using your KTC Snapflash, capture images at the bouncing cameras of the three cave paintings and the pygmy altar.
english.description: Heya, $N, there are strange cave paintings and other artifacts all over the cavern.$B$BDo you think you could use your belt-mounted KTC Snapflash camera to capture images at the designated spots? Also, snap a pic of the altar in the back of the cavern.$B$BI'm sure that Sassy will want the intel.
english.completion: What are these? Clearly that pygmy witchdoctor is from some new race never seen before. Maybe we should call them $n-ians? They must be the ones that painted all of that stuff in the cavern. I'm not sure that I like what you're describing. It sounds to me like they're paintings of them and us on an island with an exploding volcano!
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 清理狗头人营地
text.objectives: 杀死10只狗头人歹徒，然后向治安官玛克布莱德复命。
text.description: 你的第一个任务是清剿工作，$N。一个狗头人部族占据了北边的森林。到那儿去，把你能看到的狗头人歹徒都杀掉。尽量减少他们的数量，好让我们有一天能把他们从北郡彻底赶出去。

english.title: Kobold Camp Cleanup [Programming Test]
english.objectives: Kill 10 Kobold Vermin, then return to Marshal McBride.
english.description: Your first task is one of cleansing, $N.  A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north.  Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find.  Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.

text.title: 糖心甜薯
text.objectives: Make 5 servings of Candied Sweet Potatoes and bring them to Gregory Tabor just outside the gates of Stormwind.
text.description: While you're here, you might want to stock up on Teldrassil sweet potatoes. They're used to make the most delicious candied sweet potatoes you've ever tasted.$B$BIf you don't believe me, look up the recipe in your bountiful cookbook and give it a try. And if there are any extras, you might want to share them with Gregory Tabor at the feasting area just outside Stormwind. They're one of his favorites, but to hear him tell it, everything's his favorite!
text.progress: $n, it's good to see you again.
text.completion: Ah, candied sweet potatoes! My favorite! Did Isaac tell you?
text.completed: Return to Gregory Tabor at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Candied Sweet Potatoes
english.objectives: Make 5 servings of Candied Sweet Potatoes and bring them to Gregory Tabor just outside the gates of Stormwind.
english.description: While you're here, you might want to stock up on Teldrassil sweet potatoes. They're used to make the most delicious candied sweet potatoes you've ever tasted.$B$BIf you don't believe me, look up the recipe in your bountiful cookbook and give it a try. And if there are any extras, you might want to share them with Gregory Tabor at the feasting area just outside Stormwind. They're one of his favorites, but to hear him tell it, everything's his favorite!
english.progress: $n, it's good to see you again.
english.completion: Ah, candied sweet potatoes! My favorite! Did Isaac tell you?
english.completed: Return to Gregory Tabor at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 招呼福特
text.objectives: 从棘齿城断骨旅店的首席工程师福特那里获得舰船图纸。
text.description: 在联盟和部落所有的这些摩擦里，我都能借机发一笔横财，直到海军少将哈特利驶进了我的港口，在我的买卖里横插一脚。他到处搜寻并扣押挂着部落旗帜的船，想要阻止他们使用中立口岸。$B$B我可不打算让肥头大耳的人类染指我的好处！把他的旗舰的设计图给我弄来。哈特利的首席工程师就在山上的断骨旅店里买醉……
text.progress: You got the goods?
text.completion: Ah, this is it - this is it right here! So his flagship is named "The Bellipotent" eh? Let's see what it'll take to send this nuisance to the bottom of the sea.
text.completed: Bring the schematics to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: He holds the schematics we need.

english.title: Club Foote
english.objectives: Get the Ship Schematics from Chief Engineer Foote at the Broken Keel Tavern in Ratchet.
english.description: All this new friction between the Alliance and the Horde was leading to windfall profits, until Rear Admiral Hartley sailed into MY harbor and started poking his prow into my business. He's been searching and seizing vessels flying horde colors with the goal of depriving them use of a neutral port.$B$BI'm not about to allow some fat-fingered human to cut into my profits! Get me the schematics of his flagship. Hartley's Chief Engineer is soaking himself at the Broken Keel Tavern just up the hill...
english.progress: You got the goods?
english.completion: Ah, this is it - this is it right here! So his flagship is named "The Bellipotent" eh? Let's see what it'll take to send this nuisance to the bottom of the sea.
english.completed: Bring the schematics to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: He holds the schematics we need.

text.title: 慢烤火鸡
text.objectives: Make 5 Slow-Roasted Turkeys and bring them to Isaac Allerton near the gates of Darnassus.
text.description: Every Pilgrim's Bounty feast requires a magnificent centerpiece, and I'm not talking about a decorative horn of plenty, either. No, the focus of the meal is a magnificent roast turkey.$B$BThere's a good recipe for it in your bountiful cookbook. Why not hunt some wild turkeys and prepare a few? The turkeys wander all over Elwynn Forest, so you shouldn't have a problem finding one.$B$BOnce you're done roasting them, will you bring them to Isaac Allerton near the gates of Darnassus?
text.progress: What brings you back to Darnassus, $n?
text.completion: These are beautiful and just in time to feed hungry feasters. Thank you, $n. You've truly mastered all the courses of a traditional Pilgrim's Bounty meal.
text.completed: Return to Isaac Allerton at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

text.title: 感恩节
text.objectives: 同幽暗城庭院里的米尔斯·斯坦迪什谈谈。
text.description: 你来到这里是为了和我们一起庆祝感恩节吗？我们总需要一段这样的时光，来回想自己的旅程与幸运，与朋友们分享美食，并举行其它各种庆祝活动。$B$B你能在大型城镇附近参加感恩节宴会。只要你找到了宴席餐桌，就可以坐在它旁边享用美食了。$B$B如果你想学习如何烹调传统的感恩节大餐，那么就去幽暗城寻找米尔斯·斯坦迪什吧。你可以在幽暗城上面的庭院里找到他。
text.completion: If you'd like to learn to cook Pilgrim's Bounty foods, I can help. If you're not already a cook, all you have to do is train and you'll be cooking in no time.

english.title: Pilgrim's Bounty
english.objectives: Speak with Miles Standish in the courtyard above Undercity.
english.description: Are you here to celebrate Pilgrim's Bounty with us? It was once a time for reflecting on your journeys and your good fortune while sharing a meal with friends. Many still mark the occasion.$B$BYou can partake of Pilgrim's Bounty feasts near major towns by sitting at a bountiful table and serving the foods you find there.$B$BIf you're interested in learning how to cook the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty foods, seek out Miles Standish. You will find him in the courtyard above Undercity.
english.completion: If you'd like to learn to cook Pilgrim's Bounty foods, I can help. If you're not already a cook, all you have to do is train and you'll be cooking in no time.

text.title: 玉米馅料
text.objectives: 制作5份玉米馅料，把它们交给威廉·穆林，他就在幽暗城上方庭院的宴会区里。
text.description: 我们的玉米馅料是感恩节宴席的基石。这道菜肴的烹饪方法可以追溯到洛丹伦的美好时代。而现在，它已经在传统菜肴中占据了不可动摇的地位。$B$B如果你已经是一名厨师，就去找感恩节商人，他会给你这道大餐的盛宴食谱，告诉你准备一份这样的假日大餐都需要哪些原料。如果你还不是一名厨师，那么现在就开始研习厨艺吧！$B$B做好玉米馅料之后，就把它交给那些桌子旁边的威廉·穆林.
text.progress: The tables could really use more of that spice bread stuffing.
text.completion: It's a chore keeping all these tables stocked. If you stop and think about it, it's strange going to so much trouble when we needn't eat anymore. Tradition is tradition.
text.completed: Return to William Mullins at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Spice Bread Stuffing
english.objectives: Cook 5 servings of Spice Bread Stuffing and then bring them to William Mullins at the feasting area in the courtyard above the Undercity.
english.description: Our spice bread stuffing is the cornerstone of the Pilgrim's Bounty table. The recipe dates from better times in Lordaeron and now it has taken its place in the traditional meal.$B$BIf you are already a cook, pay a visit to the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor to get your copy of the bountiful cookbook and all the local ingredients you'll need to prepare holiday fare. And if you're not yet a cook, there's no better time to start!$B$BOnce you've made the stuffing, bring it to William Mullins over near the tables.
english.progress: The tables could really use more of that spice bread stuffing.
english.completion: It's a chore keeping all these tables stocked. If you stop and think about it, it's strange going to so much trouble when we needn't eat anymore. Tradition is tradition.
english.completed: Return to William Mullins at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 不爱它就炸了它
text.objectives: 将一枚刺贝水雷安放在强力号船壳最薄弱的地方。
text.description: <Gazlowe spreads the plans on the table and jabs a tiny finger aft of the ship below the waterline.>$B$BThere! The hull is thinnest here, where the crankshaft meets the paddlewheel. And it's right next to the magazine!$B$B$N, I can't be held responsible if some enterprising Horde $c were to attach a limpet mine to that part of the hull. Not even if I supplied the mine. And paid $ghim:her;. Handsomely. The ship is anchored just southeast of here... go to it!$B$BThen radio me with this stolen gnomecorder.
text.completion: Excellent! I wish I could've seen the look on that Rear Admiral's face when his flagship went up like a candle. Let me use my telescope here to take a look at the damage. What - Whhhaaatt!? That thing is still floating? Hartley must've moved the munitions ashore in case his ship was mined. I underestimated you, Hartley... but for the last time!
text.completed: Talk with Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
text.turninWindow: Gazlowe's voice crackles through the stolen gnomecorder...

english.title: Love it or Limpet
english.objectives: Plant a Limpet Mine at the thinnest part of the hull of the Bellipotent.
english.description: <Gazlowe spreads the plans on the table and jabs a tiny finger aft of the ship below the waterline.>$B$BThere! The hull is thinnest here, where the crankshaft meets the paddlewheel. And it's right next to the magazine!$B$B$N, I can't be held responsible if some enterprising Horde $c were to attach a limpet mine to that part of the hull. Not even if I supplied the mine. And paid $ghim:her;. Handsomely. The ship is anchored just southeast of here... go to it!$B$BThen radio me with this stolen gnomecorder.
english.completion: Excellent! I wish I could've seen the look on that Rear Admiral's face when his flagship went up like a candle. Let me use my telescope here to take a look at the damage. What - Whhhaaatt!? That thing is still floating? Hartley must've moved the munitions ashore in case his ship was mined. I underestimated you, Hartley... but for the last time!
english.completed: Talk with Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
english.turninWindow: Gazlowe's voice crackles through the stolen gnomecorder...

text.title: 卡多雷的家
text.objectives: 将装满月亮井水的瓶子交给达纳苏斯的泰兰德·语风。
text.description: 毫无疑问，能遇见你很荣幸。你就是你们种族高尚的证明。$B$B现在去完成这最后一项任务吧。将这些水交给达纳苏斯的泰兰德·语风。
text.progress: How fare you, young one?
text.completion: Ah, the blessed waters from our moonwells. You have borne witness to the Spirit of the Kaldorei, then? In recent times, I've come to find that the spirit offers more questions than it does answers, but such is the continuing nature of discovery that drives us in our darkest hours. I will offer you the simplest answers that I can. Malfurion has returned to me... to us... but harsh times are yet upon us. Staghelm is gone and the world is wracked with pain - Malfurion has much to mend, and he will need help.

english.title: Home of the Kaldorei
english.objectives: Bring the Filled Vessel to Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
english.description: It has been an undeniable honor to have met you. You are a testament to the nobility of your race.$B$BGo now and finish this final task. Take the waters to Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.
english.progress: How fare you, young one?
english.completion: Ah, the blessed waters from our moonwells. You have borne witness to the Spirit of the Kaldorei, then? In recent times, I've come to find that the spirit offers more questions than it does answers, but such is the continuing nature of discovery that drives us in our darkest hours. I will offer you the simplest answers that I can. Malfurion has returned to me... to us... but harsh times are yet upon us. Staghelm is gone and the world is wracked with pain - Malfurion has much to mend, and he will need help.

text.title: 南瓜馅饼
text.objectives: Make 5 slices of Pumpkin Pie and bring them to Francis Eaton at the feasting area right outside Orgrimmar.
text.description: That spice bread stuffing you made is a hit, but no Pilgrim's Bounty feast is complete without a slice of pumpkin pie. It's another traditional local dish, since it uses ripe Tirisfal pumpkins that only grow around here.$B$BIf you don't know how to make pumpkin pie already, there's a recipe in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BWould you mind cooking up a few slices and bringing them to Francis Eaton outside Orgrimmar? He's bound to be running low by now.
text.progress: We can always use more pumpkin pie.
text.completion: The pie always goes first. I think people must be skipping the meal and going directly for the dessert. Have you given it a try yet?
text.completed: Return to Francis Eaton at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

text.title: 酸果蔓酱
text.objectives: 制作5份酸果蔓酱，并把它们交给雷霆崖西侧升降梯底层的多金·辽原。
text.description: Have you tried the cranberry chutney yet? It's made with fresh tangy Southfury cranberries. Just pick some up from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor if you want to try your hand at making chutney.$B$BThe recipe should be in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BIf you've got some extra time on your hands, would you mind making some of the chutney and bringing it to Dokin Farplain at the base of the elevator on the western side of Thunder Bluff?
text.progress: How are you enjoying Pilgrim's Bounty, $c?
text.completion: Ah, more cranberry chutney! You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through it.
text.completed: Return to Dokin Farplain in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Cranberry Chutney
english.objectives: Make 5 servings of Cranberry Chutney and bring them to Dokin Farplain at the base of the elevator on the western side of Thunder Bluff.
english.description: Have you tried the cranberry chutney yet? It's made with fresh tangy Southfury cranberries. Just pick some up from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor if you want to try your hand at making chutney.$B$BThe recipe should be in your bountiful cookbook.$B$BIf you've got some extra time on your hands, would you mind making some of the chutney and bringing it to Dokin Farplain at the base of the elevator on the western side of Thunder Bluff?

english.completion: Ah, more cranberry chutney! You wouldn't believe how fast the celebrants go through it.

text.title: 军火大爆破
text.objectives: 摧毁海岸边的5处塞拉摩军火物资。
text.description: 哈特利肯定把所有的军械都堆在海滩上。咱们来把他的牙给拔了，$N！$B$B沿岸留意他的军需堆，把它们都点着，这样等强力号修好了，他也会手无寸铁，被困在岸上。$B$B我们回头在棘齿城见。
text.completion: Hah! Beautiful work, $n. Those Alliance cretins will never trace this back to me. Meanwhile, it's back to business as usual: smuggling, double-dealing, price-gouging... I've got a lot of work to catch up on. Here, I'll let you in on a cut of my future profits. Enjoy!
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Gazlowe's voice crackles through the stolen gnomecorder...

english.title: Ammo Kerblammo
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Theramore Ammunition Stockpiles along the coast.
english.description: Hartley must've unloaded all of his ordnance along the beach. Let's pull his teeth out, $N!$B$BRun along the shore and look for his munitions stockpiles. Light 'em up and he'll be land-locked and unarmed while the Bellipotent is repaired.$B$BI'll meet you back here in Ratchet.
english.completion: Hah! Beautiful work, $n. Those Alliance cretins will never trace this back to me. Meanwhile, it's back to business as usual: smuggling, double-dealing, price-gouging... I've got a lot of work to catch up on. Here, I'll let you in on a cut of my future profits. Enjoy!
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Gazlowe's voice crackles through the stolen gnomecorder...

text.title: 糖心甜薯
text.objectives: Make 5 servings of Candied Sweet Potatoes and bring them to Francis Eaton just outside of Orgrimmar.
text.description: While you're here, you might want to stock up on Mulgore sweet potatoes. They're used to make delicious candied sweet potatoes, my favorite part of the Pilgrim's Bounty meal.$B$BIf you don't believe me, look up the recipe in your bountiful cookbook and give it a try. If you're headed back to Orgrimmar, bring them to Francis Eaton at the feasting area just outside the city. I've been trying to keep him supplied, but everything goes so fast over there.
text.progress: 欢迎回来，$N。
text.completion: So Dokin drafted you to help with the candied sweet potatoes? It's the only way he can keep up. Thanks for bringing these.
text.completed: Return to Francis Eaton at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

text.title: 幽暗城急需美食
text.objectives: 将5份玉米馅料和5份酸果蔓酱交给幽暗城入口附近的米尔斯·斯坦迪什。
text.description: 感谢你带来的糖心甜薯。我要做的烹饪工作实在是太繁重了，让我几乎无法应付。现在，米尔斯又送信给我们说，他的玉米馅料和酸果蔓酱都差不多快用光了。你能为他提供一些这两种食物吗？这里的商人应该有你所需要的一切原料。$B$B你应该能在幽暗城上方废墟庭院的宴会区里找到米尔斯·斯坦迪什。
text.progress: It's good to see you again. $n.
text.completion: Thanks for bringing everything. Some of the tables were starting to look a little bereft of serving dishes.
text.completed: Return to Miles Standish at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: Undersupplied in the Undercity
english.objectives: Bring 5 servings of Spice Bread Stuffing and 5 servings of Cranberry Chutney to Miles Standish near the entrance to Undercity.
english.description: Thanks for bringing the candied sweet potatoes. There's so much cooking to do, I can hardly keep up. And then, Miles sends me a note saying he's on the verge of running out of stuffing and cranberry chutney. I don't suppose you'd be willing to step in and whip up some more of each? The vendor should have all the ingredients you need.$B$BYou should be able to find Miles Standish near the feasting tables in the courtyard in the ruins above Undercity.
english.progress: It's good to see you again. $n.
english.completion: Thanks for bringing everything. Some of the tables were starting to look a little bereft of serving dishes.
english.completed: Return to Miles Standish at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 寻找巴隆·朗绍尔
text.objectives: 找到臭名昭著的海盗巴隆·朗绍尔，跟他谈一谈。
text.description: 在联盟把巴隆·朗绍尔的舰队击沉、将他的人一网打尽之前，此人乃是这片水域的一霸。那么我现在高不高兴呢？$N，你看我像是欢呼雀跃的样子么？$B$B朗绍尔被俘之前，打劫了我最值钱的货物，还在被逮捕之前把它埋了起来。我想把货要回来！在南边的联盟营地里找到朗绍尔，看你能不能让他说出我的那些财物在哪里。
text.completion: Hah-har! So ol' Gazzy ain't given up on his goods yet, has he? Well, looks like that ol' floppy-eared goldgrubbler jes' gave me somethin' ta bargain with.
text.completed: Find and speak to the notorious pirate Baron Longshore in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Find Baron Longshore
english.objectives: Find and speak to the notorious pirate Baron Longshore.
english.description: That dirty pirate Baron Longshore was the terror of these waters before the Alliance demolished his fleet and rounded up the survivors. Am I happy about it? Do I look like a bundle of joy and good cheer, $N?$B$BLongshore raided some of my most valuable cargo before his capture. Rumor has it he buried it before he was caught. I want my goods back! Find Longshore in the Alliance camp just south of here and see if you can get him to reveal where my treasure is.
english.completion: Hah-har! So ol' Gazzy ain't given up on his goods yet, has he? Well, looks like that ol' floppy-eared goldgrubbler jes' gave me somethin' ta bargain with.
english.completed: Find and speak to the notorious pirate Baron Longshore in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 巴隆的要求
text.objectives: 如果你信得过，就跟巴隆·朗绍尔谈一谈，把他放出来。
text.description: 我是注定要被绞死了，伙计。那些财宝眼下对我没用处……$B$B除非我能用它来买条命。我要和你做笔交易，$R。把这镣铐砸碎，我就告诉你财宝藏在哪儿。$B$B哦，我说话算话，朋友。要知道，我从前可是个货真价实的男爵。
text.completion: Oh I won't be runnin' off just yet. I'll free me mates and murder my way out of here at a time of me choosin'. As fer you - a deal's a deal. Let's talk about that treasure...
text.completed: If you trust him, talk to Baron Longshore to free him from his manacles.

english.title: The Baron's Demands
english.objectives: If you trust him, talk to Baron Longshore to free him from his manacles.
english.description: I'm bound fer that gallows fer sure, mate. That treasure's no good to me now...$B$BUnless I can use it ta buy me life. I'll make a deal with ye, $r. Smash these manacles and I'll tell ye where me treasure's buried.$B$BOh, me word is good, friend. I used ta be a real Baron, ye know.
english.completion: Oh I won't be runnin' off just yet. I'll free me mates and murder my way out of here at a time of me choosin'. As fer you - a deal's a deal. Let's talk about that treasure...
english.completed: If you trust him, talk to Baron Longshore to free him from his manacles.

text.completion: These look perfect. Thank you, $n. You've truly mastered all the courses of a traditional Pilgrim's Bounty meal.
text.completed: Return to Francis Eaton at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
