text.title: 火鸡还是缺
text.objectives: 将20份慢烤火鸡交给铁炉堡外面的凯特琳·铁壶。
text.description: 从这次节日一开始，我就在毫不停歇地烹调菜肴。但我提供的食品还是无法满足大家的需要。你愿意帮我一把么？$B$B这里的火鸡供应量远远不够。所以，如果你能做一些慢烤火鸡，那你可是帮了我一个大忙。如果你愿意的话，你可以在艾尔文森林各地猎捕野生火鸡。同时感恩节商人会向你出售烹调这道菜所需要的一切材料。
text.progress: Did you manage to find those turkeys?
text.completion: These are just what I need. Thanks, $n. You're a lifesaver.
text.completed: Return to Caitrin Ironkettle at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Can't Get Enough Turkey
english.objectives: Bring 20 Slow-Roasted Turkeys to Caitrin Ironkettle outside Ironforge.
english.description: I've been cooking nonstop since before the start of the holiday, and I still can't keep up with the demand. I don't suppose I could persuade you to help with one of the dishes, could I?$B$BTurkey is hard to come by here, so if you could supply some slow-roasted turkeys, it would be a big help. If you intend to prepare them yourself, you can hunt fresh wild turkeys anywhere in Elwynn Forest. You should be able to buy everything else you need from any of the Pilgrim's Bounty vendors.
english.progress: Did you manage to find those turkeys?
english.completion: These are just what I need. Thanks, $n. You're a lifesaver.
english.completed: Return to Caitrin Ironkettle at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 最不寻常的地图
text.objectives: 从联盟营地入口处拿到刺青牛头。
text.description: 是这样的，伙计：为了保护藏宝图，我把它纹在了船上养的牛身上。$B$B当然，和我船上的海盗们一样，那头可怜的牛也已经完蛋了。联盟根本就不知情——那个牛头正挂在这个营地的入口处示众。$B$B把它拿下来去交给棘齿城的加兹鲁维。
text.progress: Was Baron Longshore alive? Do you have anything for me?
text.completion: What? What is this? I send you out to fetch my treasure and you bring me a big filthy head?
text.completed: Deliver the Tattooed Head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: A Most Unusual Map
english.objectives: Get the Tattooed Head from the entrance to the Alliance compound.
english.description: Here's the deal, mate: to protect me treasure map, I tattooed it onto me first mate's scalp.$B$BOf course, he's dead now, along with most of me crew. The Alliance doesn't even know what they have - his severed head is hanging from a tree at the entrance to this camp.$B$BGrab that head and take it to Gazlowe back in Ratchet.
english.progress: Was Baron Longshore alive? Do you have anything for me?
english.completion: What? What is this? I send you out to fetch my treasure and you bring me a big filthy head?
english.completed: Deliver the Tattooed Head to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 加兹鲁维的财富
text.objectives: 加兹鲁维要你从俯瞰棘齿城的悬崖上挖出他的宝藏。
text.description: 老天，你是对的！这上面确实纹了张地图。$B$B那该死的巴隆——他就把财宝埋在我的鼻子底下。或者说，我的头顶上。不管了，地图指示的地方在南边，棘齿城的悬崖上。$B$B出城沿着路往西走，上山，然后朝南，接着转向海岸，找一颗俯瞰海湾的大树。把我的财宝找回来，我可以跟你分！
text.progress: I'm going to close my eyes, $n. And when I open them, I expect to see wall-to-wall treasure. Deal?
text.completion: Nice work, $n! Oh, the Baron tried to stop you, did he? Well, I hope you gave him a pounding. Now, I promised you a cut of the goods you recovered. Let's see... what's one percent of a half percent? Ah, here you go.
text.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Gazlowe's Fortune
english.objectives: Gazlowe wants you to dig up his buried treasure from atop the cliffs overlooking Ratchet.
english.description: Sink me, you were right! There's a map tattooed on the skull.$B$BThat cursed Baron - he buried my treasure right under my nose. Or, above my head, anyway. The map points to a place on the bluffs over Ratchet, to the south.$B$BFollow the road west out of the city, get atop the hill, head south, then run back towards the coast and look for an enormous tree overlooking the bay. Fetch my treasure and I'll split it with you!
english.progress: I'm going to close my eyes, $n. And when I open them, I expect to see wall-to-wall treasure. Deal?
english.completion: Nice work, $n! Oh, the Baron tried to stop you, did he? Well, I hope you gave him a pounding. Now, I promised you a cut of the goods you recovered. Let's see... what's one percent of a half percent? Ah, here you go.
english.completed: Return to Gazlowe at Ratchet in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 别忘了那馅料！
text.objectives: 将20份玉米馅料交给凯特琳·铁壶。 他就在铁炉堡宴会区外面。
text.description: 在这些宴席桌上摆满美食实在是一个能累死人的工作！我在制作酸果蔓酱的时候还在盯着那些甜味土豆，又要保证那些馅饼不被烤糊。$B$B看样子，我已经把所有东西都准备好了。不，等等，我还忘了一样东西。玉米馅料！哦，不。我已经没有时间再去准备玉米馅料了。你愿意帮我一个忙吗？这并不难，你只需要在这里购买一些原料，就能制作出香喷喷的玉米馅料了。
text.progress: Were you able to get that stuffing?
text.completion: Thank goodness! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.
text.completed: Return to Caitrin Ironkettle at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Don't Forget The Stuffing!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Spice Bread Stuffing to Caitrin Ironkettle at the feasting area outside Ironforge.
english.description: Keeping these tables stocked can be overwhelming! I've got to make the cranberry chutney while keeping my eye on the sweet potatoes, and making sure the pies don't burn.$B$BI think I've got everything covered. No, wait, I'm forgetting something. The stuffing! Oh, no. There won't be time to get another batch of stuffing started before everything else is done. Would you be willing to help me out? It shouldn't take long to buy or make some stuffing and you can buy the ingredients right here.
english.progress: Were you able to get that stuffing?
english.completion: Thank goodness! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.
english.completed: Return to Caitrin Ironkettle at Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 和托尼一起干
text.objectives: 跟北贫瘠之地勇士岛的托尼·双牙谈一谈。
text.description: 海盗的活动把我的生意都搅了。嘉维伊船长看到船只就攻击，那些给我交了所谓“保护”费的船主的船也没能幸免。我们得把这些海盗打点好，而且要快！$B$B我认识一个人，他是嘉维伊的副手，对我迪兹维格玩弄的手腕倒也不排斥。他答应替我安排一次小小的“叛乱”。只要我们让这些人替我们卖命，钱就不成问题，明白吗？$B$B去跟南边勇士岛的托尼·双牙谈一谈。
text.completion: Hey hey mon, did Dizzywig send you? Good, good. Did you bring the money? No? ...what about the guns?
text.completed: 跟北贫瘠之地勇士岛的托尼·双牙谈一谈。

english.title: Take it up with Tony
english.objectives: Talk to Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island in Northern Barrens.
english.description: This pirate situation is really crimping my operation. Cap'n Garvey is attacking any vessel in sight, even the ones whose owners paid me my bogus "protection" money. We need to get these pirates on the take, and fast!$B$BI know just the guy, one of Garvey's Lieutenants who's open to wheeling and dealing the Dizzywig way. He's offered to arrange a little 'mutiny' for me. Once we get these guys working for us, it's all gravy, see?$B$BTalk to my boy Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island to the south.
english.completion: Hey hey mon, did Dizzywig send you? Good, good. Did you bring the money? No? ...what about the guns?
english.completed: Talk to Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 酸果蔓酱又吃完了？
text.objectives: 将20份酸果蔓酱交给暴风城外宴会区的艾伦·摩尔。
text.description: 我的丈夫加斯帕需要更多的酸果蔓酱。而他现在还要保证宴会上能有足够的糖心甜薯。你愿意帮我们一下么？如果你是一名厨师，你可以从铁炉堡城外的感恩节商人那里买到味道浓烈的湿地酸果蔓。$B$B如果你不想自己做菜，你也能请别人为你制作酸果蔓酱。
text.progress: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?
text.completion: Thanks. This looks great, and you're a fair bit faster than Jasper, but don't tell him I said so.
text.completed: Return to Ellen Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
english.objectives: Bring 20 servings of Cranberry Chutney to Ellen Moore at the feasting area outside Stormwind.
english.description: My husband, Jasper, was going to make more cranberry chutney, but it looks like he's busy trying to make sure there's enough candied sweet potatoes for all the guests. Would you be willing to help? If you're a cook, you can get the tangy Wetlands cranberries you'll need from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Ironforge.$B$BIf you don't feel up to cooking, you could always ask someone else to make the chutney, too.
english.progress: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?
english.completion: Thanks. This looks great, and you're a fair bit faster than Jasper, but don't tell him I said so.
english.completed: Return to Ellen Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 小菜一碟
text.objectives: 将20份南瓜馅饼交给达纳苏斯大门附近宴会区的玛丽·奥勒登。
text.description: 艾萨克一直在努力帮助庆祝节日的人们了解感恩节的传统，以及如何将我们在一年中这个时候收获的各种食才制作成美味佳肴。我竭尽全力让宴会桌上时刻摆满各种菜肴，但我们现在却少了一种艾萨克最喜欢的美食——南瓜馅饼。$B$B你愿意给我们弄一些南瓜馅饼来吗？如果你想亲手制作这种馅饼，那么你就需要在暴风城外面的感恩节商人那里购买成熟的艾尔文南瓜。
text.progress: How are those pies coming along?
text.completion: These are perfect. Isaac, and everyone else, will love them!
text.completed: Return to Mary Allerton at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

english.title: Easy As Pie
english.objectives: Bring 20 pieces of Pumpkin Pie to Mary Allerton at the feasting area near the gates of Darnassus.
english.description: Isaac's been hard at work helping celebrants learn about the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty feast and how to make dishes out of all the ingredients we harvest at this time of year. I've been trying to keep the tables stocked with as many of the dishes as I can, but we're running out of one of Isaac's favorites, pumpkin pie.$B$BWould you be able to get some for us? If you want to make the pies yourself, you'll need to buy ripe Elwynn pumpkins from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Stormwind.
english.progress: How are those pies coming along?
english.completion: These are perfect. Isaac, and everyone else, will love them!
english.completed: Return to Mary Allerton at Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus.

text.title: 她喜欢土豆
text.objectives: 将20份糖心甜薯交给暴风城外面宴会区的加斯帕·摩尔。
text.description: 我的妻子艾伦求我帮她为宴会准备餐点。但她一直都没有个准主意。一开始，她要我做南瓜馅饼，现在她又改变了主意，想要糖心甜薯了。$B$B但我正在做南瓜馅饼。所以你也许能帮我弄一些甜薯来。如果我们能把我妻子的需求全部满足，她一定会非常高兴的。$B$B如果你要自己烹制糖心甜薯，你就要从达纳苏斯的感恩节商人那里购买你所需要的土豆。
text.progress: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?
text.completion: These are perfect. Thanks for helping me with this, $n. The meal will get served on time and Ellen will be happy.
text.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: She Says Potato
english.objectives: Bring 20 Candied Sweet Potatoes to Jasper Moore at the feasting area outside of Stormwind.
english.description: My wife Ellen has enlisted my help in keeping the tables stocked, but she can't make up her mind. First I was making pumpkin pie, but now she's changed her mind and she wants candied sweet potatoes.$B$BWell, I've already started on the pie, so maybe you can help me whip up those sweet potatoes. She'll be pleasantly surprised if we can get everything she's asked for.$B$BIf you're going to cook the sweet potatoes yourself, you'll have to buy them from the Pilgrim's Bounty merchant in Darnassus. Thanks, $N.
english.progress: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?
english.completion: These are perfect. Thanks for helping me with this, $n. The meal will get served on time and Ellen will be happy.
english.completed: Return to Jasper Moore at Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 葛洛普挡道了
text.objectives: 杀死葛洛普，拿到葛洛普的赃物。
text.description: 什么？让迪兹维格来办，这叛乱就搞不成了。$B$B没关系，伙计，我们能搞定。首先我们需要的是钱。嘉维伊船长喜欢把我们抢来的赃物都藏起来，那钱可以用来给我精心挑选的人手当报酬。$B$B财宝堆就在兵营外面。不过，你首先得当心嘉维伊船长的“宝库管理员”。这么说吧，葛洛普可不是好惹的。相信我，我曾经跟他较过一次劲。他可不会轻易让步。
text.progress: You got the cash? That money will go a long way to winnin' over the hearts and minds of heartless, thoughtless cutthroats.
text.completion: Look at that. We're loaded! In mutiny, you gotta make the money first. Then when you get the money, you get the power. Let's go get some power, $n...
text.completed: Take the Booty to Tony Two-Tusk at Fray Island in North Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Beware his low center of gravity.

english.title: Glomp is Sitting On It
english.objectives: Kill Glomp and grab Glomp's Booty.
english.description: What? Leave it to Dizzywig to expect a mutiny on the cheap.$B$BNo matter, mon, we can make this work. First we need the money. Cap'n Garvey likes to hoard the loot we've been earnin', money I can use to pay off my handpicked mutineers.$B$BThe treasure pile is just outside the barracks here. You'll need to take care of Cap'n Garvey's "treasurer" first. Now, Glomp ain't no pushover. Believe me, I tried pushing him over once. He don't budge for nothin'.
english.progress: You got the cash? That money will go a long way to winnin' over the hearts and minds of heartless, thoughtless cutthroats.
english.completion: Look at that. We're loaded! In mutiny, you gotta make the money first. Then when you get the money, you get the power. Let's go get some power, $n...
english.completed: Take the Booty to Tony Two-Tusk at Fray Island in North Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Beware his low center of gravity.

text.title: 枪。很多很多枪。
text.objectives: 获得六杆重型矮人步枪。
text.description: 好了，任何一场漂亮的叛乱需要的火力都非同小可。嘉维伊船长亲自掌管着所有像样的火器：一整批大号的重型矮人燧石火枪。他把它们藏在身边，就在岛对面的另一幢建筑里。给我弄六杆火枪来，我好把它们分发给将来的士官们……
text.progress: Guns, mon. You got the stuff?
text.completion: Oooh, very nice. Shiny. Loud. Now we're talkin'. Not much left to do but close the deal...
text.completed: Deliver the rifles to Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island in North Barrens.

english.title: Guns. We Need Guns.
english.objectives: Gather six Heavy Dwarven Rifles.
english.description: Now, any good mutiny is going to need serious firepower. Cap'n Garvey claimed all the best firearms for himself: A whole shipment of big, heavy dwarven flintlocks. He keeps them at his side in the other building across the island. Grab me six of those rifles and I'll distribute them to me future officers...
english.progress: Guns, mon. You got the stuff?
english.completion: Oooh, very nice. Shiny. Loud. Now we're talkin'. Not much left to do but close the deal...
english.completed: Deliver the rifles to Tony Two-Tusk on Fray Island in North Barrens.

text.title: 她喜欢土豆
text.objectives: 将20份糖心甜薯交给幽暗城上方宴会区里的威廉·穆林。
text.description: 罗贝塔·卡特请我为节日大餐准备糖心甜薯。我很想帮她，但现在我又答应了宴会服务员，要帮她为客人们上菜。$B$B如果你能帮助我准备糖心甜薯，那我一定会非常感激你的。因为如果我让她失望，她绝对不会饶了我。$B$B如果你要烹调糖心甜薯，你就要从雷霆崖的感恩节商人那里购买原料。非常感谢你，$N。
text.progress: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?
text.completion: Thanks, $n. Now, I can help the hostess out and still keep my word to Roberta.
text.completed: Return to William Mullins at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: She Says Potato
english.objectives: Bring 20 Candied Sweet Potatoes to William Mullins at the feasting area above Undercity.
english.description: Roberta Carter has recruited me to help prepare one of the feast dishes, candied sweet potatoes.  Normally, I'd love to help, but I've promised the hostess that I'd help her watch the tables.$B$BI'd really appreciate it if you would help me come up with those candied sweet potatoes. Roberta would never forgive me if I let her down.$B$BIf you're going to cook the sweet potatoes yourself, you'll have to buy them from the Pilgrim's Bounty merchant in Thunder Bluff. Thanks, $N.
english.progress: Do you have those candied sweet potatoes?
english.completion: Thanks, $n. Now, I can help the hostess out and still keep my word to Roberta.
english.completed: Return to William Mullins at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 酸果蔓酱又吃完了？
text.objectives: 将20份酸果蔓酱交给幽暗城庭院上方宴会区的罗贝塔·卡特。
text.description: 真不明白，我们的酸果蔓酱怎么会消耗得那么快。有时候，我甚至怀疑他们背着我把酸果蔓酱都喂给憎恶了。你能帮我再做一些酸果蔓酱吗？如果你是一名厨师，你就能在奥格瑞玛城外的感恩节商人那里购买到你所需要的南国之怒酸果蔓。$B$B如果你不想做烹饪的工作，你也可以请求别人制作这种酸果蔓酱。
text.progress: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?
text.completion: Thanks for your help, and let me know if you ever get to the bottom of the case of the disappearing chutney.
text.completed: Return to Roberta Carter at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

english.title: We're Out of Cranberry Chutney Again?
english.objectives: Bring 20 servings of Cranberry Chutney to Roberta Carter at the feasting area in the courtyard above Undercity.
english.description: I wish I knew why we're going through cranberry chutney so fast. Sometimes, I think they're feeding it to the abominations when I'm not looking. Would you be willing to help me make up a new batch? If you're a cook, you can get the tangy Southfury cranberries you'll need from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside Orgrimmar.$B$BIf you don't feel up to cooking, you could always ask someone else to make the chutney, too.
english.progress: Were you able to get your hands on any cranberry chutney?
english.completion: Thanks for your help, and let me know if you ever get to the bottom of the case of the disappearing chutney.
english.completed: Return to Roberta Carter at Ruins of Lordaeron in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 小菜一碟
text.objectives: 将20份南瓜馅饼交给雷霆崖外宴会区的玛哈拉·金穗。
text.description: 多金和拉哈一直在为感恩节而努力工作，我们要在这个节日里将我们在今年收获的所有食材都做成美味的大餐。我正在努力在所有餐桌上都摆满美食，但现在我们却没有足够的南瓜馅饼。$B$B你能为我们提供一些南瓜馅饼吗？如果你想自己做这种馅饼，你就需要从幽暗城外的感恩节商人那里购买提瑞斯法南瓜。
text.progress: How are those pies coming along?
text.completion: These are great! Thank you for helping, $n.
text.completed: Return to Mahara Goldwheat in Mulgore.

english.title: Easy As Pie
english.objectives: Bring 20 pieces of Pumpkin Pie to Marhara Goldwheat at the feasting area outside Thunder Bluff.
english.description: Dokin and Laha have been hard at work helping celebrants learn about the traditional Pilgrim's Bounty feast and how to make dishes out of all the ingredients we harvest at this time of year. I've been trying to keep the tables stocked with as many of the dishes as I can, but we're running low on pumpkin pie.$B$BWould you be able to get some for us? If you want to make the pies yourself, you'll need to buy ripe Tirisfal pumpkins from the Pilgrim's Bounty vendor outside the Undercity.
english.progress: How are those pies coming along?
english.completion: These are great! Thank you for helping, $n.
english.completed: Return to Mahara Goldwheat in Mulgore.

text.title: 火鸡还是缺
text.objectives: 将20份慢烤火鸡交给奥格瑞玛外面的昂丹尼。
text.description: 从这次节日一开始，我就在毫不停歇地烹调菜肴。但我提供的食品还是无法满足大家的需要。你愿意帮我一把么？$B$B这里的火鸡供应量远远不够。所以，如果你能做一些慢烤火鸡，我会非常非常感激你的。如果你愿意的话，你可以在提瑞斯法林地各地猎捕野生火鸡。同时感恩节商人会向你出售烹调这道菜所需要的一切材料。
text.progress: How's your turkey hunt going?
text.completion: These turkeys are exactly what I needed. Thanks for helping me out of a tough situation.
text.completed: Return to Ondani Greatmill at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

english.title: Can't Get Enough Turkey
english.objectives: Bring 20 Slow-Roasted Turkeys to Ondani Greatmill outside Orgrimmar.
english.description: I've been cooking nonstop since before the start of the holiday, and I still can't keep up with the demand. I don't suppose I could persuade you to help with one of the dishes, could I?$B$BTurkey is hard to come by here, so if you could supply some slow-roasted turkeys, it would be a big help. If you intend to prepare them yourself, you can hunt fresh wild turkeys anywhere in the Tirisfal Glades. You should be able to buy everything else you need from any of the Pilgrim's Bounty vendors.
english.progress: How's your turkey hunt going?
english.completion: These turkeys are exactly what I needed. Thanks for helping me out of a tough situation.
english.completed: Return to Ondani Greatmill at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

text.title: 别忘了那馅料！
text.objectives: 将20份玉米馅料交给奥格瑞玛外面的昂丹尼。
text.description: 在这些宴席桌上摆满美食实在是一个能累死人的工作！我在制作酸果蔓酱的时候还在盯着那些甜味土豆，又要保证那些馅饼不被烤糊。$B$B看样子，我已经把所有东西都准备好了。不，等等，我还忘了一样东西。玉米馅料！哦，不。我已经没有时间再去准备玉米馅料了。你愿意帮我一个忙吗？这并不难，你只需要在这里购买一些原料，就能制作出香喷喷的玉米馅料了。
text.progress: Were you able to get that stuffing?
text.completion: Perfect timing! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.
text.completed: Return to Ondani Greatmill at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

english.title: Don't Forget The Stuffing!
english.objectives: Bring 20 Spice Bread Stuffing to Ondani Greatmill outside Orgrimmar.
english.description: Keeping these tables stocked can be overwhelming! I've got to make the cranberry chutney while keeping my eye on the sweet potatoes, and making sure the pies don't burn.$B$BI think I've got everything covered. No, wait, I'm forgetting something. The stuffing! Oh, no. There won't be time to get another batch of stuffing started before everything else is done. Would you be willing to help me out? It shouldn't take long to buy or make some stuffing and you can buy the ingredients right here.
english.progress: Were you able to get that stuffing?
english.completion: Perfect timing! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.
english.completed: Return to Ondani Greatmill at Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.

text.title: 叛变，伙计！
text.objectives: 用海盗信号喇叭召唤托尼·双牙和他的人登上女武士之匕号。帮他击败甲板下的艾丽希娅·卡斯伯特。
text.description: 现在就是所有叛变过程中我最喜欢的部分：收拾老东家！对海盗而言，谁当头谁掌舵都不重要。岛屿的最东边停泊着女武士之匕号，那是嘉维伊船长从前的旗舰。他让自己最信任的士官艾丽希娅·卡斯伯特掌管。击败她，不光船是我们的，制海权也将是我们的。$B$B我会派人划小艇过去。你则要登上女武士之匕号，在甲板上吹响这支号角——那就是我们登船的信号。上呀！
text.progress: Is that the Maiden's Dagger I see weighing anchor in the distance? Did you have anything to do with that?
text.completion: So Tony is running the show there now? Good! We need more pirates like him in these waters. He's a real businessman. Speaking of business, I suppose I owe you a cut. Would you be interested in insuring any of your new loot? You never know what can happen in a town like this...
text.completed: Report your success to Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: Mutiny, Mon!
english.objectives: Use the Pirate Signal to summon Tony Two-Tusk and his crew to the Maiden's Dagger. Help him to defeat Alicia Cuthbert below decks.
english.description: Now for my favorite part of any mutiny: the killin'! For pirates, it doesn't matter who's supposed to be in charge, only who's in control of the ships. Anchored on the east end of this island is the Maiden's Dagger, Cap'n Garvey's old flagship. He left his most trusted officer in charge: Alicia Cuthbert. Once we take her out, the ship is ours, and so's the sea.$B$BI'll get the men onto the boats. I need you to board the Dagger and blow this horn from on deck - that'll be our signal to board. Yar!
english.progress: Is that the Maiden's Dagger I see weighing anchor in the distance? Did you have anything to do with that?
english.completion: So Tony is running the show there now? Good! We need more pirates like him in these waters. He's a real businessman. Speaking of business, I suppose I owe you a cut. Would you be interested in insuring any of your new loot? You never know what can happen in a town like this...
english.completed: Report your success to Wharfmaster Dizzywig at Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: 分享盛宴大餐
text.objectives: 在盛宴餐桌旁将每一种食物都吃过五份，以此获得分享之魂。
text.description: 如果不在盛宴餐桌旁吃个痛快，就绝对不算是庆祝过感恩节。$B$B请坐下来尽情享用这里的美食吧！如果想品尝不同的菜肴，你可以从一个座位上移动到另一个座位上，或者请求宴会桌旁的其他人将他们面前的菜式传递给你。$B$B当你吃过桌上的所有美食之后，你的体内就会充满分享之魂。
text.completion: What a feast, hmmm? I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.
text.completed: Return to Bountiful Table Hostess.

english.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
english.objectives: Eat five helpings of every food at a Bountiful Table until you gain the Spirit of Sharing.
english.description: You've not celebrated Pilgrim's Bounty properly until you've eaten your fill at a Bountiful Table.$B$BPlease, sit down, feast, and try everything! You can move from chair to chair yourself, or ask others at the table to pass you some of their food.$B$BOnce you eat enough of every dish, you'll be infused with the Spirit of Sharing.
english.completion: What a feast, hmmm? I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.
english.completed: Return to Bountiful Table Hostess.

text.title: 分享盛宴大餐
text.objectives: 在盛宴餐桌旁将每一种食物都吃过五份，以此获得分享之魂。
text.description: 如果不在盛宴餐桌旁吃个痛快，就绝对不算是庆祝过感恩节。$B$B请坐下来尽情享用这里的美食吧！如果想品尝不同的菜肴，你可以从一个座位上移动到另一个座位上，或者请求宴会桌旁的其他人将他们面前的菜式传递给你。$B$B当你吃过桌上的所有美食之后，你的体内就会充满分享之魂。
text.completion: What a feast, hmmm? I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.
text.completed: Return to Bountiful Feast Hostess.

english.title: Sharing a Bountiful Feast
english.objectives: Eat five helpings of every food at a Bountiful Table until you gain the Spirit of Sharing.
english.description: You've not celebrated Pilgrim's Bounty properly until you've eaten your fill at a Bountiful Table.$B$BPlease, sit down, feast, and try everything! You can move from chair to chair yourself, or ask others at the table to pass you some of their food.$B$BOnce you eat enough of every dish, you'll be infused with the Spirit of Sharing.
english.completion: What a feast, hmmm? I'm so glad you could celebrate the spirit of Pilgrim's Bounty with us.
english.completed: Return to Bountiful Feast Hostess.

text.title: 调查残骸
text.objectives: 在棘齿城和十字路口的路上找到商队残骸，在那一区域寻找线索。
text.description: 不久以前，一车银币在前往十字路口的路上被偷了。它本来是发给卫兵们的工资，我们得把银币找回来。$B$B我会在附近问问有没有什么线索，不过你要去调查一下犯罪现场。到西边去，你能在通往十字路口的大路北边找到倾覆的商队马车。搞清楚是谁拿了我们的银币，把它夺回来！
text.completion: This Horde caravan was not merely robbed. It was savagely brutalized. Crates of supplies have been ripped apart by sharp claws. The wagon has been demolished. The food has been eaten and the silver is gone, and yet useful supplies have been left behind...
text.completed: Find the wrecked caravan near the road between Ratchet and Crossroads and search the area for clues.

english.title: Investigate the Wreckage
english.objectives: Find the wrecked caravan near the road between Ratchet and Crossroads and search the area for clues.
english.description: Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen en route from here to Crossroads. It was meant as payroll to the guards, and we want that silver back.$B$BI'll ask around here for clues, but I want you to investigate the scene of the crime. Head west and look for a crashed caravan wagon just north of the road between here and Crossroads. Find out who took our silver and get it back!
english.completion: This Horde caravan was not merely robbed. It was savagely brutalized. Crates of supplies have been ripped apart by sharp claws. The wagon has been demolished. The food has been eaten and the silver is gone, and yet useful supplies have been left behind...
english.completed: Find the wrecked caravan near the road between Ratchet and Crossroads and search the area for clues.

text.title: 被偷走的银币
text.objectives: 杀死8头赤鳞破坏者s，4头赤鳞镰爪龙，并找到被偷走的银币。
text.description: 很明显这些迅猛龙是独自将部落的银币偷走的。$B$B该教训教训这些畜生了。
text.progress: You look roughed up, $c. Did you tussle with the thieves?
text.completion: What!? Raptors? Just the raptors? Assaulting our caravans and looting them? Perhaps they are as intelligent as the rumors say. As if we didn't have enough problems, now we've got to deal with brainy lizards with a lust for coin. Here, $n - you've earned a share of the rescued silver. Thank you.
text.completed: Return the Stolen Silver to Gazrog outside of Ratchet in North Barrens.

english.title: The Stolen Silver
english.objectives: Kill 8 Sunscale Ravagers, 4 Sunscale Scytheclaws, and locate the Stolen Silver.
english.description: It's clear that these raptors acted alone to steal the Horde's silver.$B$BIt's time to teach these beasts a lesson.
english.progress: You look roughed up, $c. Did you tussle with the thieves?
english.completion: What!? Raptors? Just the raptors? Assaulting our caravans and looting them? Perhaps they are as intelligent as the rumors say. As if we didn't have enough problems, now we've got to deal with brainy lizards with a lust for coin. Here, $n - you've earned a share of the rescued silver. Thank you.
english.completed: Return the Stolen Silver to Gazrog outside of Ratchet in North Barrens.

text.title: 迅猛龙陷阱
text.objectives: 使用卡拉玛的“迅猛龙陷阱”捕获5只小迅猛龙。
text.description: 用陷阱抓捕迅猛龙很危险，但我设计的新陷阱可以大大降低其风险性。$B$B在地上设好陷阱以后，它会发出迅猛龙的尖叫，把同伴吸引到陷阱里来。$B$B一旦踩中我的陷阱，迅猛龙就会被缩小，也就不那么危险了。非常简单！我本可以亲自来干，但最近我碰巧遇到了镰爪之王。
text.progress: Where's the wittle waptors?
text.completion: Hooway! You twapped the waptors I was wooking for! Now we will twain them for twolls to wide to swaughter the Awwiance!
text.completed: Bring the Wittle Waptors to Kala'ma in North Barrens.

english.title: Waptor Twapping
english.objectives: Use Kala'ma's "Waptor Twap" to capture 5 Wittle Waptors.
english.description: Waptor twapping can be wough, but I've designed new waptor twaps that ewiminate much of the wisk.$B$BSet the twap on the gwound and it will scweech wike a waptor, luwing one into the twap.$B$BWhen a waptor steps on my waptor twap, it'll shwink down so that it's wess dangewous. It's wewwy easy! I would do it myself but wecentwy I wan acwoss King Weapercwaw.
english.progress: Where's the wittle waptors?
english.completion: Hooway! You twapped the waptors I was wooking for! Now we will twain them for twolls to wide to swaughter the Awwiance!
english.completed: Bring the Wittle Waptors to Kala'ma in North Barrens.

text.title: 好帮手很难找
text.objectives: 教训8名抗命的巨魔。
text.description: 我败了！我绞尽脑汁地想让卡亚矿石的产量达标，但是你也知道巨魔奴隶都是些什么嘴脸。要找到一个好帮手真是太难了！$B$B我觉得你应该亲自上阵。用你身上那条地精百宝腰带去好好教训他们一下。我相信，随便教训几个抗命的巨魔，其他的奴隶就会乖乖听话了。杀鸡儆猴嘛。$B$B必须确保卡亚可乐的产量，不然贸易大王会砍了我们所有人的脑袋！
text.completion: I couldn't have done better myself. In fact, I didn't. I'm sure that in no time at all we'll all be talking about the great and powerful, and may I add extremely wealthy, Trade Prince $n!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Good Help is Hard to Find
english.objectives: Adjust the attitudes of 8 Defiant Trolls.
english.description: I've failed! I tried to meet our Kaja'Cola quotas, but you know troll slaves these days. Good help is hard to find!$B$BI think your personal touch is called for. A shock from the battery on your Goblin All-In-1-Der Belt should do the trick. Adjust their attitudes and the rest will fall in line.$B$BKaja'Cola production must continue or the Trade Prince will have all of our heads!
english.completion: I couldn't have done better myself. In fact, I didn't. I'm sure that in no time at all we'll all be talking about the great and powerful, and may I add extremely wealthy, Trade Prince $n!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 亲自动手
text.objectives: 讨回布鲁诺·防火棉、弗兰基·吉尔斯利普、“锤子”杰克和萨德希·玛格的欠款。
text.description: 我们要给一些欠债鬼捎个信。当然，这些卑鄙的家伙都躲藏在苦工镇上。头儿，我知道你讨厌去贫民窟，但是我们别无选择。$B$B<莎希翻阅着文件。>$B$B我建议你来个“私人拜访”。去和那些欠债不还的家伙好好谈谈。别怕事儿，头儿，我们要让别的欠债人以及你的竞争者都瞧好了。$B$B$N不是好惹的！
text.completion: A complete success if I do say so myself, sir! Your debtors will think twice now about not paying up! Perhaps we should increase interest rates on loans across the board?
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Do it Yourself
english.objectives: Beat down Bruno Flameretardant, Frankie Gearslipper, Jack the Hammer, and Sudsy Magee.
english.description: We need to send a message to several deadbeats. Of course, they're hiding out in Drudgetown, the scum. I know how you hate going into the slums, boss-$g man : lady;, but what can we do?$B$B<Sassy rifles through some paperwork.>$B$BI have all of the names right here.$B$BMight I suggest a little 'personal visit'? A couple of strategic beatdowns will send a message to the other debtors AND your competition.$B$B$N is not a goblin to be trifled with!
english.completion: A complete success if I do say so myself, sir! Your debtors will think twice now about not paying up! Perhaps we should increase interest rates on loans across the board?
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 呼朋唤友
text.objectives: 驾驶改装跑车去接你的朋友：王牌、大胖和小静。
text.description: $N，听说你待会要主持一场盛况空前绝无仅有的财阀聚会。根据我多年的研究成果，如果你能成功搞出一台聚会并且让大家都尽兴而归的话，你的晋升机会就会猛涨到爆棚！$B$B基于此，我建议你开着改装跑车去镇上兜一圈，把你的朋友们都接来。$B$B等你荣升新的贸易$G大王:女王;的时候，记得我曾经助过你一臂之力啊，说定了？
text.completion: Well done, sir. You all look very good riding around in the hot rod. I'm sure you made quite an impression on the citizenry.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
text.objective1: Keys to the Hot Rod used

english.title: Rolling with my Homies
english.objectives: Drive the Hot Rod around and pickup your friends: Ace, Gobber, and Izzy.
english.description: $N, you're about to host the corporate party to end all corporate parties. My research says that if you're seen having a good time at the party, your promotion quotient will skyrocket and explode!$B$BSo, with that in mind, might I suggest that you take your new company hot rod out for a spin?$B$BGo pick up your friends. Just remember me on the way up when it all comes together and you're the new Trade $g Prince : Princess;, okay?
english.completion: Well done, sir. You all look very good riding around in the hot rod. I'm sure you made quite an impression on the citizenry.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.objective1: Keys to the Hot Rod used

text.title: 搜捕维罗戈
text.objectives: 在死水绿洲附近找到4份半人马情报。
text.description: 雷戈萨·死门派我来观察半人马的活动，但他们的首领实在是很难找。我只查到他的名字叫“狂热的维罗戈”，但他在哪儿就不清楚了。$B$B你能帮我调查一下吗？我知道“半人马情报”听上去像是在开玩笑，但在他们的营地里，重要的书信往来常常被到处乱丢。去死水绿洲半人马的帐篷里找找看，有什么消息就带回来给我。
text.progress: Search those tents, $n. Try to ignore the stench.
text.completion: Good work, $n. Did you look through these? They're barely legible - more like angry graffiti than war plans. Hatred, jealousy, rage, personal conflicts - it's a wonder Verog can keep these centaur from killing each other, much less form them into an army. We can use this to our advantage.
text.completed: Bring the Intelligence to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis in North Barrens.

english.title: Flushing Out Verog
english.objectives: Gather 4 pieces of Centaur Intelligence from around the Stagnant Oasis.
english.description: Regthar Deathgate sent me here to observe the centaur activity, but the leader of this group is hard to pin down. I've discovered that his name is "Verog the Dervish," but his whereabouts are a mystery.$B$BCan you help me do some digging? I know that "Centaur Intelligence" sounds like an oxymoron, but their camps are often littered with important communications. Search the centaur tents all around the Stagnant Oasis here and bring me back some info.
english.progress: Search those tents, $n. Try to ignore the stench.
english.completion: Good work, $n. Did you look through these? They're barely legible - more like angry graffiti than war plans. Hatred, jealousy, rage, personal conflicts - it's a wonder Verog can keep these centaur from killing each other, much less form them into an army. We can use this to our advantage.
english.completed: Bring the Intelligence to Shoe at the Stagnant Oasis in North Barrens.

text.title: 增援雷戈萨
text.objectives: 去北贫瘠之地的十字路口，在十字路口西边找到雷戈萨·死门的哨站，并向他报到。
text.description: $N！你在部落最近声名鹊起啊。从遗忘之池和死水绿洲传来的消息说，你让那些半人马闻风丧胆。干的漂亮。$B$B雷戈萨·死门是我们在北贫瘠之地地区对抗半人马行动的总指挥。像你这样勇敢的$C会得到他的重用。从这里沿着路向西，去他的哨站找他报到，并全力协助他。
text.completion: Ah, I've heard about your work, $c. Your timing is fortunate - I've got a major offensive in the works.
text.completed: Report to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost west of the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Deathgate's Reinforcements
english.objectives: Report to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost west of the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.
english.description: $N! Your reputation among the Horde grows. I've been hearing reports from both the Forgotten Pools and the Stagnant Oasis that you've been a real bane to our centaur foes. Well done, indeed.$B$BRegthar Deathgate is in charge of our operations against the centaur all over the Northern Barrens. He could use a bold $c like yourself to bolster his forces. Report to him at his outpost along the road west of here and aid him in any way he requires.
english.completion: Ah, I've heard about your work, $c. Your timing is fortunate - I've got a major offensive in the works.
english.completed: Report to Regthar Deathgate at his outpost west of the Crossroads in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 一腿之力
text.objectives: 夺回10条被偷走的陆行鸟腿，交给银色比武场的纳莱丝·晨雪。
text.description: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$B$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.
text.progress: Were you able to recover any of the missing supplies?
text.completion: These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've managed to recover some of the ship's cargo.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: A Leg Up
english.objectives: Recover 10 Stolen Tallstrider Legs for Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$B$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.
english.progress: Were you able to recover any of the missing supplies?
english.completion: These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've managed to recover some of the ship's cargo.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 矿井的麻烦事
text.objectives: 杀死6只矿道虫。
text.description: 头儿，卡亚矿井又出了麻烦事。矿道虫再次涌了出来，它们正在吞噬卡亚矿石，也就是卡亚罗贸易公司的利润！$B$B卡亚矿井的产量直线下降，对卡亚可乐的生产造成了极其严重的影响！$B$B我试图呼叫前任害虫终结者，但是这家伙拿到上一笔报酬后就跑了。$B$B你能不能进入三座矿井，把这件事摆平？我本来可以帮你一把的，但是我得去参加财阀规定的搏击训练研讨会。
text.completion: I say good riddance to those pests!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Trouble in the Mines
english.objectives: Slay 6 Tunneling Worms.
english.description: We've got trouble down in the Kaja'mine again, boss. The tunneling worms have returned and they're literally eating away at the Kajaro Trading Company's profits!$B$BKaja'mite mining is down, which is negatively impacting our production of Kaja'Cola!$B$BI tried calling the exterminator, but he's fled with the last payment we made to him.$B$BDo you think you could head into the three mines and take care of it? I'd help but I still haven't attended the cartel-mandated fighter training seminar.
english.completion: I say good riddance to those pests!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 勇士的早餐
text.objectives: 取得4只冰虫的卵鞘，将它们交给银色比武场的萨雯妮娅·慧歌。
text.description: 现在，演武场已经完成，银色北伐军请求我们帮忙照看那些将要和勇士们作战的怪兽。$B$B这其中，巨大冰虫的饲料也许是最奇怪的。如果喂它们吃同类的卵，他们就会变得更强大，而最优质的卵来自于深土冰虫。$B$B带上这只鼓，到风暴峭壁中心处的山底平原去，在那里的雪堆附近把鼓敲响，唤醒深土冰虫，然后消灭它们，并收集它们的卵鞘。
text.progress: Were you able to get those eggs? Those worms will start eating their handlers if they're not fed soon.
text.completion: Well done, $n. I'll take these to the Argent Crusade's keepers right away. They'll have no choice but to acknowledge that we're doing far more than the Sunreavers to keep the coliseum running smoothly.
text.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Breakfast Of Champions
english.objectives: Acquire 4 Jormungar Egg Sacs and bring them to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.$B$BThe giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.$B$BTake this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there.  Rouse the deep jormungar, kill them, and gather their egg sacs.
english.progress: Were you able to get those eggs? Those worms will start eating their handlers if they're not fed soon.
english.completion: Well done, $n. I'll take these to the Argent Crusade's keepers right away. They'll have no choice but to acknowledge that we're doing far more than the Sunreavers to keep the coliseum running smoothly.
english.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 圣光的仁慈
text.objectives: 使用神官的祈祷书，为8位被屠戮的图亚里克村民举行追悼仪式，然后返回银色比武场，去见纳莱丝·晨雪。
text.description: 我听神官帕尔崔丝讲过了。我要告诉你，她的话让我深思良久。与十字军并肩战斗是不够的，我们必须担负起他们的任务。$B$B在北方海岸的洛斯加尔登陆点发生了一桩血案。克瓦迪尔海盗们攻入一处古老的海象人居民区，将那里的村民屠杀殆尽。带上这本书，在那些村民的尸体旁边诵读书中的悼文。这样能让他们的灵魂离开那座被迷雾环绕的岛屿，得到最后的安息。
text.progress: Have you seen to the spirits of the slain Tualiq villagers?
text.completion: Thank you. The book was a gift from Confessor Paletress herself. She would  be honored to know that you have used it to bring tranquility to the slain.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Light's Mercy
english.objectives: Use the Confessor's Prayer Book to perform last rites for 8 Slain Tualiq Villagers and then return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have given me much to consider. It is not enough to fight beside the crusaders; we must take up their mission.$B$BOff the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.
english.progress: Have you seen to the spirits of the slain Tualiq villagers?
english.completion: Thank you. The book was a gift from Confessor Paletress herself. She would  be honored to know that you have used it to bring tranquility to the slain.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 一级戒备！
text.objectives: 在商人广场的西北角找到沃登中尉。
text.description: 嗨，你怎么还在这里？你不知道全城戒严了吗？$B$B去找沃登中尉吧，他会告诉你撤离此地的详细方案的。
text.completion: Deep claw marks run through the man's corpse.

english.title: Lockdown!
english.objectives: Find Lieutenant Walden in the northwestern end of the Merchant Square.
english.description: What are you still doing here, citizen?  Haven't you heard?  The city's under complete lockdown.$B$BGo see Lieutenant Walden -- he'll give you further directions for evacuation.
english.completion: Deep claw marks run through the man's corpse.

text.description: 这本关于骑乘训练和坐骑购买的广告小册子是由兰达尔·亨特派发出来的。$B$B你可以在艾尔文森林的东谷伐木场找到他，那里就在暴风城向东大道的路旁。
text.progress: Ah, you received my letter? Good.
text.completion: So, shall we begin your Apprentice Riding training?
text.completed: Return to Randal Hunter at Stone Cairn Lake in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 抗击侵略者
text.objectives: 银色比武场的纳莱丝·晨雪想让你消灭10名克瓦迪尔。
text.description: 那些恐怖的维库人强盗克瓦迪尔袭击我们的运输队，又对一座北方岛屿上的海象人居民进行了屠杀，并把那座岛重新命名为洛斯加尔登陆点。如果让他们在那里站稳脚跟，我们无疑会成为他们的下一个目标。$B$B北伐军为了抵抗天灾军团已经倾尽全力。而我们必须守住比武场。一直向北飞行，到达那座岛屿，消灭那里的克瓦迪尔，不要让他们将那里的一切尽数毁灭。
text.completion: Your actions have shown that we stand as one with the Argent Crusade, while the Sunreavers are too busy preening to take up their blades.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Stop The Aggressors
english.objectives: Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Kvaldir.
english.description: The Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders, have disrupted our shipments and murdered the tuskarr inhabitants of an island to the north, renaming it Hrothgar's Landing. If they are allowed to get a foothold there, there is no doubt that we will be their next target.$B$BThe crusade's forces have their hands full dealing with the Scourge, and we must defend the tournament grounds. Fly north from the grounds until you reach the island and take on the Kvaldir before they can destroy anything else.
english.completion: Your actions have shown that we stand as one with the Argent Crusade, while the Sunreavers are too busy preening to take up their blades.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 戈莫克想要他的狗头人
text.objectives: 使用强化渔网抓住8个雪盲追随者，并把它们交给银色比武场的萨雯妮娅·慧歌。
text.description: 我的两名部下在抓捕猛犸人穿刺者戈莫克的行动中丧生了。而那头怪物还在四处横行。他连续几个小时高声嗥叫，只是因为它找不到他喜欢的那个狗头人。$B$B如果银色北伐军不想在演武场中使用这头怪物，我会亲手把它杀了。不过，现在我们也许应该先给它找些玩具。拿上这张网，到风暴峭壁东南方的加姆雷区去。那里就在K3的东北方。在那里抓住一些狗头人。圣光保佑，但愿你能找到那头怪物喜欢的狗头人。
text.completion: The sooner we get these stinking things out of my sight and into their cage, the faster my mood will improve. I wish the Argent Crusade had given the Sunreavers the care of this creature. They're enough alike that they ought to be able to understand each other.
text.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
english.objectives: Use the Weighted Net to capture 8 Snowblind Followers and bring them to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Two of my men have already been killed trying to confine the magnataur called Gormok the Impaler, yet the creature still rages. It howls for hours about being without its favorite snobold.$B$BIf the Argent Crusade didn't wish to use this monster in the coliseum, I'd slay it myself. Perhaps it's time to bring the beast its playthings. Take this net and travel to Garm's Bane in southeast Storm Peaks. It's just northeast of K3. Capture some of those snobolds and pray to the Light you've found the right one.
english.completion: The sooner we get these stinking things out of my sight and into their cage, the faster my mood will improve. I wish the Argent Crusade had given the Sunreavers the care of this creature. They're enough alike that they ought to be able to understand each other.
english.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 事有蹊跷
text.objectives: 返回商人广场，向利亚姆·格雷迈恩王子复命。
text.description: 中尉好像死于伤势过重。应该把这个消息告诉王子。$B$B你听见市场方向传来了打斗声。
text.completion: It's you again.  Looks like you're not one to hide in the face of danger.  Very well, then.

english.title: Something's Amiss
english.objectives: Return to Prince Liam Greymane in the Merchant Square.
english.description: The lieutenant appears to have died from severe wounds.  The prince might want to hear this news.$B$BYou hear the sound of fighting coming from the market.
english.completion: It's you again.  Looks like you're not one to hide in the face of danger.  Very well, then.

text.title: 勇士的早餐
text.objectives: Acquire 4 Jormungar Egg Sacs and bring them to Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: Now that the coliseum is complete, the Argent Crusade has asked us to help look after the creatures that champions will be fighting.$B$BThe giant jormungar have perhaps the strangest diet; they grow strong by eating the eggs of their own kind and the best eggs come from deep jormungar.$B$BTake this drum to the Foot Steppes in central Storm Peaks and play them near the snow mounds you see there. The sound will rouse the deep jormungar. Kill them, collect their egg sacs, and return to the tournament grounds.
text.progress: Were you able to get those eggs? The jormungar are going to get nasty if they don't get fed.
text.completion: I'll let the crusaders know that you've just returned with a fresh load of food while the Silver Covenant was sitting on its heels.
text.completed: Return to Tylos Dawnrunner at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

The sound will rouse the deep jormungar. Kill them, collect their egg sacs, and return to the tournament grounds.

text.title: 天下大乱
text.objectives: 利亚姆·格雷迈恩王子要你杀死6名暴怒的狼人。
text.description: 狼人！父亲告诫过我，说大法师阿鲁高的造物完全失控了。$B$B这些怪物是从哪儿来的呢？$B$B不过这不重要。赶紧解决他们为妙。我要让他们尝尝吉尔尼斯人民的厉害！
text.progress: Have the worgen been dealt with?
text.completion: It's no use, $n!  They're not letting up.
text.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

english.title: All Hell Breaks Loose
english.objectives: Prince Liam Greymane wants you to slay 6 Rampaging Worgen.
english.description: Worgen!  My father had warned me that Archmage Arugal's creations had run amok.$B$BBut where are they coming from?$B$BI suppose it doesn't matter.  Help us make quick work of them.  We'll show them what we Gilneans are made of!
english.progress: Have the worgen been dealt with?
english.completion: It's no use, $n!  They're not letting up.
english.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: 抢救补给品
text.objectives: 回收4只补给箱。
text.description: 听着，$N。我们不能让物资受损。$B$B吉尔尼斯的高墙倒塌之后，我们便身处险境。如果物资储备继续受损，我们很可能撑不过这个冬天。$B$B请你竭尽所能地帮助我们抢救物资吧。
text.progress: Have you salvaged the supplies, $n?
text.completion: Excellent!  I'll make sure these get taken to a safe place.
text.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

english.title: Salvage the Supplies
english.objectives: Salvage 4 Supply Crates.
english.description: Listen, $N.  We can't let our supplies get destroyed.$B$BWith Gilneas walled off from the outside world, we won't last through winter if we lose much more of our stock.$B$BPlease help me salvage what you can.
english.progress: Have you salvaged the supplies, $n?
english.completion: Excellent!  I'll make sure these get taken to a safe place.
english.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: 鉴定遗留物
text.objectives: 带上海怪的牙齿作为你胜利的证明，去见北伐军战士希瓦多恩。
text.description: 从死亡的海怪身上找到的一颗完整的牙齿，这实在是一个稀有的发现。北伐军战士希瓦多恩一定会想要看看它的。
text.progress: What have you found, Champion?
text.completion: I knew that Kraken was not a match for the likes of you.  Without that Kraken disrupting those boats, those Kvaldir will have no choice but to retreat.  Great job, Champion!
text.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Identifying the Remains

english.description: A whole tooth from a dead Kraken is a rare find indeed.  Crusader Silverdawn will want to see this.
english.progress: What have you found, Champion?
english.completion: I knew that Kraken was not a match for the likes of you.  Without that Kraken disrupting those boats, those Kvaldir will have no choice but to retreat.  Great job, Champion!
english.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 这次你真的做到了，库尔
text.objectives: 在亡语者岗哨援救鲁莽的库尔和4名被俘虏的候选者，然后返回银色比武场，去见纳莱丝·晨雪。
text.description: 北伐军战士库尔又一次陷入了麻烦，只是这次遇到麻烦的不止他一个人。当他看到那些异教徒在比武场西边的亡语者岗哨扎下营地的时候，他就召集了一批候选者，向那里发动了突击。$B$B但他们很快就陷入了孤立无援的状态，成为异教徒的俘虏。如果我们不能尽快把他们救出来，异教徒肯定会把他们献祭给他们的邪神。任何一名异教徒都有可能带着他们的黑色牢笼钥匙。找到他们身上的钥匙，救出库尔和我们被俘虏的候选者。
text.completion: Thanks to you, Kul and the aspirants will live to fight the Scourge again. That's far from the first time someone's had to save Kul from himself. My only hope is that the crusaders can find a better outlet for his enthusiasm than allowing him to impart all of his bad habits to impressionable young aspirants.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
english.objectives: Rescue Kul the Reckless and 4 Captive Aspirants from Deathspeaker's Watch and return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tournament grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an assault.$B$BWithout reinforcements, Kul and his followers were easily captured. I have no doubt that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can mount a rescue. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.
english.completion: Thanks to you, Kul and the aspirants will live to fight the Scourge again. That's far from the first time someone's had to save Kul from himself. My only hope is that the crusaders can find a better outlet for his enthusiasm than allowing him to impart all of his bad habits to impressionable young aspirants.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: Get That Merchant Out of Here!

english.title: Get That Merchant Out of Here!

text.title: 疏散商人广场
text.objectives: 疏散3户平民。
text.description: 城里几乎没有安全的去处了。即便是在自己家中，也难保平安。$B$B我们一直在与狼人抗衡，阻止这些怪兽破门而入，但是他们的数量实在是太多了。$B$B帮助我们疏散城民吧。我的父亲在监狱区布有驻军，应该可以更好地保护他们。
text.completion: Good job, $n.  Thanks to you, many Gilneans will live to see another day.
text.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

english.title: Evacuate the Merchant Square
english.objectives: Evacuate 3 Civilian Homes.
english.description: The civilians aren't safe here anymore.  Not even inside their homes.$B$BWe're doing our best to stop the worgen from getting indoors, but their numbers are too great.$B$BHelp us by evacuating the civilian homes.  My father's army in the prison district will be able to better protect them.
english.completion: Good job, $n.  Thanks to you, many Gilneans will live to see another day.
english.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at the Merchant Square in Gilneas City.

text.title: 皇家命令
text.objectives: 前往东南方的军事区，跟格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $N，该动身了。跟其他的城民一同撤往军事区吧。$B$B当你跨越东南方的小桥后，向格温·阿姆斯特报到……确认大家是否平安。$B$B我和卫兵们留在这里，掩护撤离行动。$B$B走吧。这是命令！
text.completion: We're all fine here.  A little shaken... but alive.

english.title: Royal Orders
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in the Military District to the southeast.
english.description: It's time for you to leave, $N.  Go to the Military District with the other civilians.$B$BCheck in with Gwen Armstead when you cross the bridge to the southeast... see if everyone's okay.$B$BI will stay here with the guards and cover the civilians' retreat.$B$BGo now.  That is an order!
english.completion: We're all fine here.  A little shaken... but alive.

text.title: Relic of the Earthen Ring
text.objectives: Bring your four totems to Gotura Fourwinds in Orgrimmar.
text.description: You have progressed far in your training, $N. Now that you have mastered the four basic elements, you must strive to keep all four in balance. There is a practical benefit to this discipline - with practice, you may carry only a single relic instead of all four totems.$B$BSpeak to Gotura Fourwinds at the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, and hone your mastery of the elements.
text.progress: Hmmm, what brings you to seek the aid of the Earthen Ring?
text.completion: Ah, you've mastered the four totems. You should be proud of your accomplishments so far, young $R, but this is only the beginning of your journey.$B$BHere, accept this gift from the Earthen Ring. Carry this relic with you and you will have the power of all four elements at your command.$B$BContinue your training, friend. Grave challenges are ahead for this world - I can hear it in the wind and feel it in the rumblings of the earth. We must be prepared for the worst.
text.completed: Return to Gotura Fourwinds in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 德罗丁·洛斯加尔
text.objectives: 银色比武场的高阶十字军艾德拉德希望你去击败德罗丁·洛斯加尔。
text.description: The Kvaldir, seafaring vrykul who raid ships and coastal settlements, have overrun a tuskarr  island across the strait to the north. Their leader is a veteran raider, Drottinn Hrothgar, who seeks to control these seas.$B$BWith him in power, our shipments and troop transports will never be safe. We will be stranded here at the Lich King's mercy.$B$BTake this captured Kvaldir war horn to the circle of tuskarr statues on the northeastern part of Hrothgar's Landing and use it to challenge the Kvaldir leader.
text.completion: The defeat of the drottinn will set the kvaldir to fighting amongst themselves, buying us time to use our advantage. The crusade and the tournament are in your debt, champion.
text.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Drottinn Hrothgar
english.objectives: High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to defeat Drottinn Hrothgar.
english.description: The Kvaldir, seafaring vrykul who raid ships and coastal settlements, have overrun a tuskarr  island across the strait to the north. english.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 唤雾者伊戈瓦尔
text.objectives: 银色比武场的高阶十字军艾德拉德希望你能消灭唤雾者伊戈瓦尔。
text.description: 克瓦迪尔已经回到了诺森德的海岸，如果对他们的行动不加以阻止，他们一定会夺走我们的辎重给养，阻挠我们的援军及时到达。在他们之中有一个名叫唤雾者伊戈瓦尔的正驻扎在洛斯加尔登陆点西侧的一座岩洞里。在那里，他操纵海雾来隐藏克瓦迪尔和其手下的海兽。$B$B带上这个符咒，穿过比武场北部海滩前往洛斯加尔登陆点。寻找唤雾者的洞穴，使用这个符咒使他现身。
text.completion: You have bought us valuable time to move against the Kvaldir and free the seas of these pests. Once again, the Argent Crusade is in your debt.
text.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Mistcaller Yngvar
english.objectives: High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill Mistcaller Yngvar.
english.description: The Kvaldir have returned to the coasts of Northrend and if left unchecked, they will prevent our supplies and reinforcements from arriving. One of them, known as Mistcaller Yngvar, has taken up residence in a cave on the western side of Hrothgar's Landing. There, he manipulates the mists to conceal the Kvaldir and  the sea beasts they command.$B$BTake this charm and travel across the strait north of the tournament grounds, to Hrothgar's Landing. Find the mistcaller's cave and use the charm to reveal him.
english.completion: You have bought us valuable time to move against the Kvaldir and free the seas of these pests. Once again, the Argent Crusade is in your debt.
english.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 泰坦神铁粉末
text.completion: Wonderful!  Another batch of powder! Just between us jewelcrafters, I've been making hand over fist selling "pure titanium" jewelry to the local Dalaran mages.  Even with their superior intellect, they aren't particularly savvy with their gold.  If you get more, I'll be here.
text.completed: Return to Timothy Jones in Crystalsong Forest.

english.completed: Return to Timothy Jones in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 疤面者奥诺夫
text.objectives: High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill Ornolf the Scarred.
text.description: Ornolf the Scarred is a fearsome raider renowned among his Kvaldir brethren for raiding and capturing ships. From aboard Bor's Fury, he and his crew attack our ships and steal our goods.$B$BOrnolf and his men are among those who slaughtered the inhabitants of a tuskarr island to the north and renamed it Hrothgar's Landing. His ship sits at anchor at the eastern end of the island's harbor. Take this captured banner and display it on his ship to provoke him into facing you in battle.
text.completion: Ornolf's crew will want to avenge their leader, but without him, they will be easier to defeat. We must live to carry out our mission, to see Icecrown rid of the Scourge and other evils.
text.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.objectives: High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill Ornolf the Scarred.

text.title: 亡语者卡罗斯
text.objectives: 银色比武场的高阶十字军艾德拉德想让你消灭亡语者卡罗斯。
text.description: 诅咒教派大幅度加强了对我们的攻击力量，誓要置我们于死地。他们的行动也随之越来越猖獗了。现在，他们将力量集中在了位于比武场西侧山脊上的亡语者岗哨。$B$B残酷的亡语者卡罗斯命令他的部下在那里筑起坚固的工事，准备以他们的全部力量对我们发动突击。$B$B我的战士们已经做好了浴血奋战，保卫这片土地的准备，但我更需要像你这样的勇士，$N。你要领导我们的防御战斗。你的任务是找到亡语者卡罗斯，并消灭他。
text.completion: You are truly an example to all who have gathered beneath our banner, $n. Together, we will show the Scourge that we will not be defeated.
text.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Deathspeaker Kharos
english.objectives: High Crusader Adelard at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants to you kill Deathspeaker Kharos.
english.description: The Cult of the Damned has redoubled its efforts to see us destroyed. They have grown bold and are massing their strength at Deathspeaker's Watch on the ridge west of the tournament grounds.$B$BThe ruthless Deathspeaker Kharos has his men fortifying their positions, preparing to unleash all of the cult's weapons.$B$BMy men are preparing themselves and the valiants to defend the grounds, but I want champions like you, $N, to lead our efforts to blunt the attack. Find Deathspeaker Kharos and slay him.
english.completion: You are truly an example to all who have gathered beneath our banner, $n. Together, we will show the Scourge that we will not be defeated.
english.completed: Return to High Crusader Adelard at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: Na Kada's Quest Test
text.completed: Return to The Real Ronakada.

english.title: Na Kada's Quest Test
english.completed: Return to The Real Ronakada.

text.title: 阵亡者的命运
text.objectives: 北伐军战士希瓦多恩希望你让6位死去英雄的灵魂得到安息。
text.description: 银色北伐军正在冰冠冰川艰苦地与巫妖王作战。我们的敌人却图谋利用死者的力量攻击我们。$B$B那些灵魂在比武场西南方，奥尔杜萨和铁墙壁垒之间的陨落英雄之谷游荡。那里散布着被丢弃的灵魂水晶。收集那些灵魂水晶，用这件受到圣光祝福的圣物给予那些灵魂最终的安息。他们不应该再遭受折磨了。
text.completion: You have done our fallen brethren a great service and spared us the need to face them again on the field of battle. As our campaign against the Scourge progresses, I find myself thinking about my own fate. Should I fall, $n, I would want someone like you to do for me what you have done for the spirits of the fallen this day. I could not bear the thought of forcing my own brothers to slay me again and again.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Fate Of The Fallen
english.objectives: Crusader Silverdawn wants you to bring peace to 6 Fallen Hero's Spirits.
english.description: The Argent Crusade is hardly the first force to challenge the Lich King. Our enemy turns spirits of the fallen against us.$B$BTheir spirits wander the Valley of Fallen Heroes, southwest of the grounds and between Aldur'thar and the Ironwall Rampart. The area is littered with discarded soul crystals, used by the Scourge to control the spirits. Gather those soul crystals and use them with this Light-blessed relic to bestow the blessing of peace upon the spirits. They have more than earned their rest.
english.completion: You have done our fallen brethren a great service and spared us the need to face them again on the field of battle. As our campaign against the Scourge progresses, I find myself thinking about my own fate. Should I fall, $n, I would want someone like you to do for me what you have done for the spirits of the fallen this day. I could not bear the thought of forcing my own brothers to slay me again and again.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 猎捕海怪！
text.objectives: Crusader Silverdawn wants you to mount an Argent Hippogryph, throw 8 Flaming Spears at the North Sea Kraken and take out 6 Vrykul Deepcallers.$B$BYou can find the Argent Hippogryphs right outside the Argent Crusade tent at the Tournament Grounds.
text.description: 夺日者和银色盟约向北方派遣了战船，去进攻洛斯加尔登陆点的克瓦迪尔人。但他们的战船在半路上遭遇了一群克瓦迪尔海盗。而更加糟糕的是，这群克瓦迪尔人竟然能召唤深藏在北海深处的海怪。你必须将那头海怪击退，并破坏克瓦迪尔人的召唤仪式，才有可能救下那些遇险的船员。$B$B北伐军战士，拿上这些利矛。会有一只银色角鹰兽带你到那里去。
text.progress: Have you driven away the Kraken yet?  Hurry, Crusader! There isn't much time.
text.completion: Crusader, you may have bought those sailors just enough time to escape,  Maybe next time, those Silver Covenant and Sunreavers will listen before running head first at the enemy.
text.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
text.objective1: Hurl Spears at North Sea Kraken

english.title: Get Kraken!
english.objectives: Crusader Silverdawn wants you to mount an Argent Hippogryph, throw 8 Flaming Spears at the North Sea Kraken and take out 6 Vrykul Deepcallers.$B$BYou can find the Argent Hippogryphs right outside the Argent Crusade tent at the Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The Sunreavers and Silver Covenant sent ships north to engage the Kvaldir at Hrothgar's Landing, but were intercepted and detained by a Kvaldir Raiding vessel.  To make matters worse, the Kvaldir have found a way to call forth the dreaded Kraken that lives beneath the North Sea.  If anyone on board is to get out alive, that Kraken must be driven away and the Kvaldir's summoning ritual ... disrupted.$B$BCrusader, take these spears and an Argent Hippogryph will take you to the battle.
english.progress: Have you driven away the Kraken yet?  Hurry, Crusader! There isn't much time.
english.completion: Crusader, you may have bought those sailors just enough time to escape,  Maybe next time, those Silver Covenant and Sunreavers will listen before running head first at the enemy.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Silverdawn at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Hurl Spears at North Sea Kraken

text.title: 崭新的你
text.objectives: 从奸商街的“大金牙”盖比那里购买一些亮闪闪的珠宝，从苏扎博那里购买一套潮人装束，从“软糖”米萨那里购买一副清爽遮阳镜。
text.description: 新行头？你怎么不早说！大家都在沸沸扬扬地谈论这场聚会。岛上所有人，是所有人哦，都会参加的。$B$B祝你购物愉快。奸商街上到处都是好东西！
text.progress: Do you have it all, $N? I can't wait to see it on you!$B$BYou bought the good stuff, right?
text.completion: Oh, you are going to look so fine, but not as gorgeous as me! You're going to replace the Trade Prince any day now at the rate you're going! I can't wait to not have to work anymore! You're going to buy me everything that I want, right babe? Let me have all that stuff and I'll help you get into it right before the party.
text.completed: Return to your girlfriend, Candy Cane, at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: The New You
english.objectives: Buy some Shiny Bling from Gappy Silvertooth, a Hip New Outfit from Szabo, and some Cool Shades from Missa Spekkies on Swindle Street.
english.description: A new outfit? You don't say! There's quite a buzz surrounding your party. Everyone who's anyone on the island is going to be there.$B$BWell, happy shopping. Swindle Street has some of the best bargains anywhere!
english.progress: Do you have it all, $N? I can't wait to see it on you!$B$BYou bought the good stuff, right?
english.completion: Oh, you are going to look so fine, but not as gorgeous as me! You're going to replace the Trade Prince any day now at the rate you're going! I can't wait to not have to work anymore! You're going to buy me everything that I want, right babe? Let me have all that stuff and I'll help you get into it right before the party.
english.completed: Return to your girlfriend, Candy Cane, at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.objectives: Bring your four totems to Farseer Eannu in Ironforge.
text.description: You have progressed far in your training, $N. Now that you have mastered the four basic elements, you must strive to keep all four in balance. There is a practical benefit to this discipline - with practice, you may carry only a single relic instead of all four totems.$B$BSpeak to Farseer Eannu near the Great Forge in Ironforge. He will help you hone your mastery of the elements.
text.progress: The spirits stir within you. What brings you to seek the aid of the Earthen Ring?
text.completion: I see you've mastered use of the four totems. You are on your way to becoming one with the elemental spirits, but this is only the beginning of your journey.$B$BHere, accept this gift from the Earthen Ring. I sense a great many trials lie ahead for this world, and we will need the power of the elements behind us if we are to prevail.
