text.title: 你们到底喂雪人吃什么？
text.objectives: 银色比武场的萨雯妮娅·慧歌想让你带给她3块北海鲨鱼肉。
text.description: 北伐军抓住了一头雪人，他们称那头雪人为冰吼。那头雪人将参与演武场的战斗。而我们的任务就是训练并喂养他。$B$B我建议十字军应该把一些过剩的夺日者喂给雪人吃，但北伐军对此丝毫不感兴趣。这头怪兽喜欢鲨鱼肉。所以我希望你能够飞行到银锋号。它就漂浮在北方的那道海峡里。从那艘船上的桶中取得一些新鲜的鱼饵，然后把鱼饵撒进海中，把鲨鱼引出来。
text.progress: I hope you have something to feed Icehowl, otherwise I really will start bringing Sunreavers down to his cage.
text.completion: I'm glad we've gotten that done. It's not the most glorious task in the world, but when we partnered with the Argent Crusade, we promised to do all they asked of us without complaint. Of course, the same cannot be said of the Sunreavers.
text.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
english.objectives: Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring her 3 pieces of North Sea Shark Meat.
english.description: The crusaders have captured a yeti that they're calling Icehowl. He's to be a participant in the coliseum battles and we've been asked to help with his training and upkeep.$B$BThe crusaders weren't fond of my suggestion that we feed the beast surplus Sunreavers. The creature has a predilection for shark meat, so I want you to fly down to the Silver Blade, floating in the strait to the north. Get some fresh chum from one of the buckets on the boat, then spread it in the water to attract sharks.
english.progress: I hope you have something to feed Icehowl, otherwise I really will start bringing Sunreavers down to his cage.
english.completion: I'm glad we've gotten that done. It's not the most glorious task in the world, but when we partnered with the Argent Crusade, we promised to do all they asked of us without complaint. Of course, the same cannot be said of the Sunreavers.
english.completed: Return to Savinia Loresong at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 聚会生活
text.objectives: 穿戴好你的超酷派对套装（亮闪闪的珠宝、潮人装束和清爽遮阳镜），然后前往在卡亚罗贸易公司总部泳池边举行的聚会，款待10位科赞聚会者。
text.description: 天哪！大家都来啦！谁还关心什么龙不龙的呢！$B$B我们在泳池边设了宴。听起来他们玩得很开心呀！你赶紧穿戴好！$B$B快去那里款待聚会者吧。我待会来找你……我要打扮得美美的！
text.completion: Very nicely done, sir. The party appears to have been a smashing success! Er... what's that?
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Life of the Party
english.objectives: Put on your Awesome Party Ensemble (Cool Shades, Hip New Outfit, and Shiny Bling) and then head over to the party at the KTC Headquarters pool to entertain 10 Kezan Partygoers.
english.description: Oh my gosh, babe! Everyone is here! Who cares about some stupid dragon?$B$BWe setup the party around the pool. Sounds like they're having a great time. You are going to look so good!$B$BWhy don't you head over to the pool and keep everyone entertained? I'll join you in a moment... I just have to slip into something even more amazing!
english.completion: Very nicely done, sir. The party appears to have been a smashing success! Er... what's that?
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 捣乱的海盗
text.objectives: 杀死12名扰乱聚会的海盗，挽救你的事业。
text.description: Oh my gosh! Pirates!$B$B$N, there are Southsea pirates crashing your party!$B$BYou have to get in there and do something about this or your career, and any chance of you being the next Trade $G Prince : Princess;, is going to be ruined!
text.completion: Phew, that was close, boss. Unfortunately, I'm the bearer of more bad news. Please don't shoot me....
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Pirate Party Crashers
english.objectives: Kill 12 Pirate Party Crashers in order to save your career.
english.description: Oh my gosh! Pirates!$B$B$N, there are Southsea pirates crashing your party!$B$BYou have to get in there and do something about this or your career, and any chance of you being the next Trade $G Prince : Princess;, is going to be ruined!
english.completion: Phew, that was close, boss. Unfortunately, I'm the bearer of more bad news. Please don't shoot me....
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛上卡亚罗贸易公司总部主楼上层的贸易大王加里维克斯谈一谈。
text.description: 在你解决扰乱聚会的海盗的时候，我发现贸易大王悄悄地爬上了楼梯。他就站在顶楼的阳台。$B$B$N，我认为正是他派那些海盗来捣乱的。$B$B<莎希有点哆嗦。>$B$B你最好赶紧上去！千万别让他等太久。
text.completion: Well, well, well, if it isn't my wayward protege, Mr. $n. I'm hurt and disappointed. You didn't send me an invitation to your little party out there. Sorry about the crashers... you know how pirates can be. So, shall we get down to business?

english.title: The Uninvited Guest
english.objectives: Speak with Trade Prince Gallywix upstairs at the KTC Headquarters main building on Kezan.
english.description: While you were dealing with the pirates, I noticed the Trade Prince slip upstairs. He's up on the balcony at the top of the stairs.$B$B$N, I think he's the one that sent the pirates.$B$B<Sassy cringes.>$B$BYou'd better get up there A.S.A.P.! You wouldn't want to keep him waiting.
english.completion: Well, well, well, if it isn't my wayward protege, Mr. $n. I'm hurt and disappointed. You didn't send me an invitation to your little party out there. Sorry about the crashers... you know how pirates can be. So, shall we get down to business?

text.title: 灰谷之眼
text.objectives: 杀掉8个塔伦迪斯斥候。
text.description: 敌人到家门口了，$C，就在咱们鼻子底下，暗夜精灵增援了塔伦迪斯营地以阻挡我们对灰谷的攻势。眼下，他们的探子正在附近的山上，刺探我们的里里外外。$B$B我们得除掉灰谷的眼线。$B$B去，你的猎物就潜伏在这些大门附近，尤其是东边。宰了那些阴魂不散的探子！
text.completion: Excellent. As their scouts fail to report in, Talrendis will feel the terror they've tried in vain to inflict on us.
text.completed: Return to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

english.title: The Eyes of Ashenvale
english.objectives: Kill 8 Talrendis Scouts.
english.description: Our enemies abound, $c, even here at our very doorstep. The night elves have reinforced Talrendis Point in an attempt to stop our advance into Ashenvale. As we speak, their scouts patrol the nearby hills, reporting every movement to and from these gates.$B$BWe must remove these eyes of Ashenvale.$B$BGo. Your prey stalks all around these gates, especially to the east. Slay the scouts who shadow us!
english.completion: Excellent. As their scouts fail to report in, Talrendis will feel the terror they've tried in vain to inflict on us.
english.completed: Return to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

text.title: 军餐鹿肉
text.objectives: 在衰弱的苔蹄雄鹿身上收集15块鹿肉。
text.description: 由于我们为了战争机器而对这片地区进行的掠夺，这片区域已经不适合动物生存了。既然这些动物横竖都要死，奥格瑞玛的人们又饥肠辘辘，刚好不浪费。$B$B为了我们的步兵和苦工，杀掉这片区域内幸存下来的衰弱的苔蹄雄鹿。
text.progress: You smell of fresh kill, $c.
text.completion: Meat - and lots of it! Well done. This will keep bellies full as we build our arsenal.
text.completed: Bring the venison to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

english.title: Venison for the Troops
english.objectives: Collect 15 Slabs of Venison from Weakened Mosshoof Stags.
english.description: As we chew up the resources of this land for our war machines, we deprive the local animals of their homes. If they are to die anyway, we should not allow that meat to go to waste. Not when the maw of Orgrimmar gapes open, hungry.$B$BKill the weakened mosshoof stags that remain in this area and collect their meat for our peons and grunts.
english.progress: You smell of fresh kill, $c.
english.completion: Meat - and lots of it! Well done. This will keep bellies full as we build our arsenal.
english.completed: Bring the venison to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

text.title: Blank [PH]
text.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

english.title: Blank [PH]
english.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

text.title: 万亿杏仁币
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛上卡亚罗贸易公司总部的莎希·硬钳谈一谈。
text.description: $N，你还真是个雄心勃勃的小地精。我劝你还是收敛一点比较好。在你身上，我仿佛看到了当年的自己。$B$B我有个提议。卡亚罗山正在猛烈地喷发，这都得感谢你那条龙。科赞岛上的居民都会没命的！$B$B不过，如果你能赶在我的游艇离开之前，付我一万亿的杏仁币，我就保证带你逃离这里。机会不多哦。$B$B想活命的话，赶紧想法子给我弄一笔巨款来！
text.completion: A bazillion macaroons?!?! Where are we going to get that kind of moolah? Um... did the Trade Prince say anything about letting me escape with you on his yacht?

english.title: A Bazillion Macaroons?!
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.description: You're an extremely ambitious young goblin, $N. Maybe a little too ambitious for your own good. I see a lot of myself in you when I was your age.$B$BI have a proposition. You might have noticed that Mount Kajaro is exploding thanks to your dragon. Everyone on Kezan is going to die!$B$BBut, if you bring me a bazillion macaroons before my yacht leaves the island, I'll make sure that you're one of the lucky few to escape.$B$BIf you want to live, you better hurry and figure out how to get me my moolah!
english.completion: A bazillion macaroons?!?! Where are we going to get that kind of moolah? Um... did the Trade Prince say anything about letting me escape with you on his yacht?

text.title: 热力追踪
text.objectives: 驾驶改装跑车阻止12名受雇的抢掠者，收集12份被偷走的物品。
text.description: We're all going to die!!!$B$B<You slap Megs to calm her down.>$B$BSorry about that, $G Mr. : Ms.; $N. Okay, we need to find a way to get a lot of moolah quickly.$B$BThere are reports of the Trade Prince sending hired looters into the streets.$B$BYou could take the hot rod out there and run them down, snatching the loot that they've illegally stolen. There wouldn't be anything wrong with that, right?
text.progress: Were you able to steal a whole bunch of stolen loot?
text.completion: Wow, you really did it?! Well, they had it coming, I guess. That's an awful lot of loot. Do you think it's enough to get you a spot on the Trade Prince's yacht? Are you going to be able to bring anyone with you? I don't make too much working in marketing.
text.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Robbing Hoods
english.objectives: Use your Hot Rod to run over 12 Hired Looters, collecting 12 Stolen Loots in the process.
english.description: We're all going to die!!!$B$B<You slap Megs to calm her down.>$B$BSorry about that, $G Mr. : Ms.; $N. Okay, we need to find a way to get a lot of moolah quickly.$B$BThere are reports of the Trade Prince sending hired looters into the streets.$B$BYou could take the hot rod out there and run them down, snatching the loot that they've illegally stolen. There wouldn't be anything wrong with that, right?
english.progress: Were you able to steal a whole bunch of stolen loot?
english.completion: Wow, you really did it?! Well, they had it coming, I guess. That's an awful lot of loot. Do you think it's enough to get you a spot on the Trade Prince's yacht? Are you going to be able to bring anyone with you? I don't make too much working in marketing.
english.completed: Return to Megs Dreadshredder at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 紧急措施
text.objectives: 打开科赞第一银行的金库，取出你的私人财产。
text.description: 科赞第一银行大门紧闭，你的所有资产都被冻结了！$B$B头儿，你需要一大笔钱呐。只能去银行取回自己的钱财了！地精百宝腰带里放着很多小工具，应该能够帮你打开金库。$B$B我早就劝你未雨绸缪，多存点钱，希望你把我的话听进去了。你看……这下的就是滚烫的熔岩雨啊！！！
text.progress: Did you get it? Did you crack the safe and get your personal riches out of the bank?
text.completion: Hey, you have been saving! I'm so proud of you! Um, boss... this isn't nearly enough.
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: The Great Bank Heist
english.objectives: Crack the vault at the First Bank of Kezan to retrieve your Personal Riches.
english.description: All of your assets have been frozen and the First Bank of Kezan is out of business!$B$BYou need an awful lot of moolah, boss. I think you're going to have to go break your own money out of the bank! The different widgets in your Goblin All-In-1-Der belt should be enough to crack the vault.$B$BI just hope that you've been saving for a rainy day like I always told you to do. You might have noticed... it's raining hot liquid magma!!!
english.progress: Did you get it? Did you crack the safe and get your personal riches out of the bank?
english.completion: Hey, you have been saving! I'm so proud of you! Um, boss... this isn't nearly enough.
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 别墅漫步
text.objectives: 取回玛尔迪的猎鹰、地精丽莎的画像和终极炸弹。
text.description: 要凑到一万亿杏仁币，只有一个办法：取回你的收藏品！$B$B狡猾的贸易大王一直在搜罗古董和昂贵的艺术品，其中有不少就是从你手上“借走”的。是时候取回这些器物，交还给它们原本的主人……也就是我们！$B$B霍巴特留下了一顶他正在制作的帽子，可以令你变成警卫的模样。你只需要优雅地踏进加里维克斯的别墅，取回那些被他“借走”的贵重物品。$B$B当心他养的那些猪，它们会识破你的伪装。
text.progress: You got the goods, boss?
text.completion: Oh, wow! These are worth a fortune. I just hope that the Trade Prince doesn't notice them when you hand them over with the rest of your wealth....
text.completed: Return to Slinky Sharpshiv at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Waltz Right In
english.objectives: Obtain Maldy's Falcon, The Goblin Lisa, and The Ultimate Bomb.
english.description: There's only one way we're going to get a bazillion macaroons: stealing from the rich!$B$BThat slime, the Trade Prince, has stolen all kinds of antiques and expensive art. It's time to take them back and give them to the needy... mainly us!$B$BHobart left behind a cap he was working on. It's a disguise that'll make you look like one of Gallywix's mooks. All you have to do is waltz right in to his Villa to the west and 'procure' the items.$B$BJust watch out for his pigs who can smell through the disguise!
english.progress: You got the goods, boss?
english.completion: Oh, wow! These are worth a fortune. I just hope that the Trade Prince doesn't notice them when you hand them over with the rest of your wealth....
english.completed: Return to Slinky Sharpshiv at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 搜刮卡亚矿石
text.objectives: 收集12块大块卡亚矿石。
text.description: $G Sir : Ma'am;, we need tons of moolah to pay the Trade Prince and get off Kezan! Well, tons of it is just waiting for the taking down there in the Kaja'mine!$B$BThese are the last known deposits of kaja'mite anywhere. This is the raw stuff that made us the genius tinkerers and alchemists we are today. If that's not worth a bazillion macaroons, I don't know what is!$B$BTake some of my kablooey bombs and blowup the deposits. Then, pick up the chunks.$B$BJust watch out for the rebellious trolls!
text.progress: How much Kaja'mite do you have?
text.completion: Nicely done, sir, nicely done! That's a fortune you have there in your bags. With all of that, I bet the Trade Prince will let all of us come along on his yacht!
text.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Liberate the Kaja'mite
english.objectives: Collect 12 Kaja'mite Chunks.
english.description: $G Sir : Ma'am;, we need tons of moolah to pay the Trade Prince and get off Kezan! Well, tons of it is just waiting for the taking down there in the Kaja'mine!$B$BThese are the last known deposits of kaja'mite anywhere. This is the raw stuff that made us the genius tinkerers and alchemists we are today. If that's not worth a bazillion macaroons, I don't know what is!$B$BTake some of my kablooey bombs and blowup the deposits. Then, pick up the chunks.$B$BJust watch out for the rebellious trolls!
english.progress: How much Kaja'mite do you have?
english.completion: Nicely done, sir, nicely done! That's a fortune you have there in your bags. With all of that, I bet the Trade Prince will let all of us come along on his yacht!
english.completed: Return to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.objectives: 销毁隐藏在过载故障的发电机，渗漏的炉子，和易燃的床垫上的机密，然后使用燃气机器人完成整个清理工作！
text.description: 资金已经就位了。头儿，其实我早就知道你能行的，所以我已经在考虑出逃之后的事宜了，我们需要销毁所有的商业机密！$B$B我已经自作主张，在楼里放满了聚会用剩的焰火。你只需要进去销毁那些商业机密。$B$B那些机密保存在故障的发电机旁、渗漏的炉子里和易燃的床垫上。都处理好之后就回来这里，派出燃气型清理机器人去完成最后的清除工作！$B$B这真是个万无一失的计划！
text.completion: This is nothing. You should see Bilgewater Port... the whole thing is going up in flames! Fine, fine, I don't have time to inspect this place. Here's the moolah from the Bilgewater Cartel's insurance policy. I've got to find a way off the island! Good luck, $n!
text.completed: Speak with the Claims Adjuster at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
text.objective3: Drop a Cigar on the Flammable Bed
text.objective4: KTC Headquarters Set Ablaze with Gasbot!

english.objectives: Overload the Defective Generator, Activate the Leaky Stove, Drop a Cigar on the Flammable Bed, and use the Gasbot to set KTC Headquarters ablaze!
english.description: We're close, but we still don't have enough macaroons. But, I've got a plan: we're going to collect on the headquarters insurance policy!$B$BHope you don't mind, but I filled the place with the leftover fireworks from your party. All you have to do is go in there and sabotage things.$B$BMight I suggest the faulty generator, the leaky stove, and the flammable bed? Then, come back outside and use the control panel to send in the gasbot.$B$BIt's a foolproof plan!
english.completion: This is nothing. You should see Bilgewater Port... the whole thing is going up in flames! Fine, fine, I don't have time to inspect this place. Here's the moolah from the Bilgewater Cartel's insurance policy. I've got to find a way off the island! Good luck, $n!
english.completed: Speak with the Claims Adjuster at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.objective3: Drop a Cigar on the Flammable Bed
english.objective4: KTC Headquarters Set Ablaze with Gasbot!

text.title: 毕生积蓄
text.objectives: 将你的毕生积蓄交给贸易大王加里维克斯，他就在科赞岛港口的游艇上。
text.description: 总算把钱凑齐了。头儿，只剩一件事了：送你去贸易大王的游艇。它很快就要启程离开港口了！$B$B我们必须抓紧时间。上车，我来开车！
text.progress: Oh, $n, it's you. What an unexpected surprise.
text.completion: Congratulations, you just made it. I see that you've brought me all that I asked for, including your hot rod. A bazillion macaroons couldn't have been easy to come by. I'm now the wealthiest, most powerful, $r on all of Azeroth! TOO BAD FOR YOU THAT I'M CHANGING THE TERMS OF OUR DEAL! You're now my slave. Get below deck and take a turn shoveling coal. Next stop, Azshara! Muahahahahahahahaha!

english.title: Life Savings
english.objectives: Hand over your Life Savings to Trade Prince Gallywix aboard the Trade Prince's Yacht on Kezan.
english.description: We've got all of the moolah that we need. There's only one thing left to do now, boss: get you to the Trade Prince's yacht. It's about to leave port!$B$BWe're gonna have to hurry. Hop in, 'cause I'm driving!
english.progress: Oh, $n, it's you. What an unexpected surprise.
english.completion: Congratulations, you just made it. I see that you've brought me all that I asked for, including your hot rod. A bazillion macaroons couldn't have been easy to come by. I'm now the wealthiest, most powerful, $r on all of Azeroth! TOO BAD FOR YOU THAT I'M CHANGING THE TERMS OF OUR DEAL! You're now my slave. Get below deck and take a turn shoveling coal. Next stop, Azshara! Muahahahahahahahaha!

text.title: 上层精灵归来？
text.objectives: 将斥候的命令送往奥格瑞玛后门的阿格图·血拳处。
text.description: 手令上的封蜡刚被打开没多久。你看不懂行文整齐的暗夜精灵文字，但一副手绘地图标示出了附近的遗迹。地图的下面书写着另一种完全不同的语言，用闪烁着金属色泽的墨水书就的符文。$B$B阿格图一定很想看到这份重要情报。
text.progress: You found something on one of the bodies, you say? Give it here!
text.completion: No, I can't make sense of it either, but I don't like what I see. Are these arcane runes? I'll need you to deliver this to an expert.
text.completed: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

english.title: Return of the Highborne?
english.objectives: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the rear gate to Orgrimmar.
english.description: The wax seal on these orders has been freshly broken. You can't read the carefully-penned night elven script, but a small hand-drawn map indicates the nearby ruins. Underneath the map, written in a different language entirely, are a series of runes penned in a metallic, shimmering ink.$B$BAg'tor will no doubt want to see this important piece of intelligence.
english.progress: You found something on one of the bodies, you say? Give it here!
english.completion: No, I can't make sense of it either, but I don't like what I see. Are these arcane runes? I'll need you to deliver this to an expert.
english.completed: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Ag'tor Bloodfist at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate in Azshara.

text.title: 上层精灵归来？
text.objectives: 把斥候的命令交给奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站的梅琳妮·碎天者。
text.description: 我们的血精灵盟友正在对地图上的遗迹进行调查，说不定他们能读懂这神秘的文字。去找一个叫梅琳妮·碎天者的，她就在北边奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站——一种蛇行大陆的新型地精交通运输系统那儿指挥研究工作。快快前去！
text.progress: I trust this interruption is in regards to something important?
text.completion: What? Give that here, this instant! Ag'tor is correct, these are arcane runes. They're scouting out magical sites? Experimenting with the arcane arts? This is a marked departure from thousands of years of night elven history. Hmph! The idea that they will achieve any competence in this field - even those who once counted themselves among the highborne - is absurd.
text.completed: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Return of the Highborne?
english.objectives: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Our blood elven allies have been examining the ruins marked on this map, and can likely understand this mysterious script. Seek out the one called Malynea Skyreaver. She conducts her research from the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange just north of here - it's part of the new goblin transit system that snakes across this land. Quickly, now!
english.progress: I trust this interruption is in regards to something important?
english.completion: What? Give that here, this instant! Ag'tor is correct, these are arcane runes. They're scouting out magical sites? Experimenting with the arcane arts? This is a marked departure from thousands of years of night elven history. Hmph! The idea that they will achieve any competence in this field - even those who once counted themselves among the highborne - is absurd.
english.completed: Deliver the Scout's Orders to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 逃跑的伐木机！
text.objectives: Attack one of the runaway shredders near the rear gates of Orgrimmar and hop inside once it's been significantly damaged.
text.description: I've been trying to impress our new Horde allies with our legendary Goblin efficiency, but in hindsight automating the shredders was a bad idea. Now they're mindless killing machines, rampaging over the countryside. Don't get me wrong - that kind of thing has its place - but for the time being I need a brave $c to help me get these things under control.$B$BIt's easy. Automated shredders, like all machines, must first be beaten into submission. Afterwards, seize the controls and I'll radio you instructions.
text.progress: <Labor Captain Grabbit's voice crackles over the radio.>$B$BHey $N! Are you reading this?$B$BPiloting that sucker is easy. Push the pedals for your pedal controls and, ah, move the levers for your lever controls. Got it?
text.completion: Hey $n! Are you reading this? Piloting that sucker is easy. Push the pedals for your pedal controls and, ah, move the levers for your lever controls. Got it?
text.completed: Attack one of the runaway shredders near the rear gates of Orgrimmar and hop inside once it's been significantly damaged.

english.title: Runaway Shredder!
english.objectives: Attack one of the runaway shredders near the rear gates of Orgrimmar and hop inside once it's been significantly damaged.
english.description: I've been trying to impress our new Horde allies with our legendary Goblin efficiency, but in hindsight automating the shredders was a bad idea. Now they're mindless killing machines, rampaging over the countryside. Don't get me wrong - that kind of thing has its place - but for the time being I need a brave $c to help me get these things under control.$B$BIt's easy. Automated shredders, like all machines, must first be beaten into submission. Afterwards, seize the controls and I'll radio you instructions.
english.progress: <Labor Captain Grabbit's voice crackles over the radio.>$B$BHey $N! Are you reading this?$B$BPiloting that sucker is easy. Push the pedals for your pedal controls and, ah, move the levers for your lever controls. Got it?
english.completion: Hey $n! Are you reading this? Piloting that sucker is easy. Push the pedals for your pedal controls and, ah, move the levers for your lever controls. Got it?
english.completed: Attack one of the runaway shredders near the rear gates of Orgrimmar and hop inside once it's been significantly damaged.

text.title: 各色朋友
text.objectives: 在亚考兰神殿废墟的海岸上找到厄格尔罗。
text.description: 我和兄弟们正在遭到追猎。$B$B蓝龙之王刚刚遇害，黑龙军团想要斩草除根，把我们赶尽杀绝。我来是带艾索雷葛斯避难的，可他要是肯听话就好了。$B$B艾索雷葛斯交友不多，可品味却有点儿……奇特。据我所知这儿就有个叫做厄格尔罗的鱼人。你能在东北边的海岸那里找到他。$B$B无论如何都要让艾索雷葛斯来找我。$B$B求你赶快。
text.completion: Hello there! A new friend! So glad to meet you. My name is Ergll. The g is silent.

english.title: Friends Come In All Colors
english.objectives: Locate Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.description: My brothers and I are being hunted.$B$BOur sire was recently killed and the black dragonflight seeks to rout those of us that still live. I'm here to find Azuregos and take him to safety, if only he would let it be that easy.$B$BAzuregos doesn't make many friends, and his taste in them tends to be a bit... unique. The only one I know of here is a murloc named Ergll. You should be able to find him on the coast northeast of here.$B$BDo whatever it takes to find Azuregos and send him to me.$B$BPlease hurry.
english.completion: Hello there! A new friend! So glad to meet you. My name is Ergll. The g is silent.

text.title: 先提提神
text.objectives: 在亚考兰神殿废墟收集10颗卡啡豆。
text.description: 艾索雷葛斯……艾索雷葛斯。小艾？那条龙？当然，我们当然是朋友！他教的我说话，说是喜欢我的颜色……配色好吧？$B$B不记得他去哪儿了。唔……也许有什么东西能帮我想起来？$B$B我在海边种满了卡啡豆，它们长在沙子里，怪吧。$B$B能给我弄点儿来么？
text.progress: So tired, it's hard to concentrate.
text.completion: Beautiful beans! They smell absolutely delicious, don't they?
text.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

english.title: A Little Pick-me-up
english.objectives: Collect 10 Kawphi Beans from the plants in the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.description: Azuregos... Azuregos. Azy? The dragon? We're friends, definitely! Taught me to speak. Said he liked my hue... kinda colorist, eh?$B$BDon't remember where he went. Mmm... maybe something to help my memory?$B$BI plant Kawphi plants all over the beach. They like sand. Kinda weird.$B$BCould you go collect some?
english.progress: So tired, it's hard to concentrate.
english.completion: Beautiful beans! They smell absolutely delicious, don't they?
english.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

text.title: 没礼貌！
text.objectives: 去亚考兰神殿废墟杀掉10头玛科尼龙虾人。
text.description: 他们要我也给啊。就这么咔嚓咔嚓地把我的卡啡豆植株给剪了。真没礼貌！你去教训教训他们。$B$B愚蠢的玛科尼龙虾人。
text.completion: Too mean? Naw, not too mean. They deserved it. I don't gum up their plants. Not ever.
text.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

english.title: That's Just Rude!
english.objectives: Kill 10 Makrinni in the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.description: I'd share if they asked. They just go clickity-claking up my kawphi plants. So rude! You should teach them a lesson.$B$BDumb Makrinni.
english.completion: Too mean? Naw, not too mean. They deserved it. I don't gum up their plants. Not ever.
english.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

text.title: The Way to a Mage's Heart
text.objectives: Ask Ergll about Azuregos.
text.description: Now that you've finished his errands, it's time for Ergll to tell you about Azuregos. Talk to him and see if you can get any useful leads on Azuregos' possible location.

english.title: The Way to a Mage's Heart
english.objectives: Ask Ergll about Azuregos.
english.description: Now that you've finished his errands, it's time for Ergll to tell you about Azuregos. Talk to him and see if you can get any useful leads on Azuregos' possible location.

text.title: 队长的木料
text.objectives: 用重新编程的伐木机收集6堆艾萨拉木料。假如你失去了你的伐木机，攻击另一台，并重新编程。
text.description: 现在你算是把它控制住了，赶紧把我早该准备就位的木料归置起来。不然这些兽人非得用我造辆投石车不可！$B$B刚伐下来的木料应该就堆在附近，用伐木机尽可能多收集一些。
text.progress: How's the wood processing going? You should see what that thing does to broccoli!
text.completion: Great! You've loaded the shredder to capacity. You're getting pretty handy with that thing...
text.completed: 用重新编程的伐木机收集6堆艾萨拉木料。假如你失去了你的伐木机，攻击另一台，并重新编程。

english.title: The Captain's Logs
english.objectives: Use the Reprogrammed Shredder to collect 6 piles of Azshara Lumber. If you lose your shredder, another can be attacked and reprogrammed.
english.description: Now that you've got that thing under control, let's gather up the lumber I was supposed to be collecting. Otherwise these orcs are going to build a catapult out of ME!$B$BFresh lumber should be stockpiled all around the area. Use the shredder to collect all you can.
english.progress: How's the wood processing going? You should see what that thing does to broccoli!
english.completion: Great! You've loaded the shredder to capacity. You're getting pretty handy with that thing...
english.completed: Use the Reprogrammed Shredder to collect 6 piles of Azshara Lumber. If you lose your shredder, another can be attacked and reprogrammed.

text.title: 树上的敌人
text.objectives: 用伐木机的电锯砍倒5棵艾萨拉幼树，杀掉9个现身的塔伦迪斯狙击手。
text.description: 稍等一会儿，我来帮你把电锯控制系统连上线。$B$B塔伦迪斯的暗夜精灵狙击手已经藏身树林，恣意射杀我的工人多时了。我要你去料理掉这些狙击手……先要料理那些树。在主门东边可以发现艾萨拉幼树，你的伐木机知道怎么做，放倒它们！
text.completion: Great work, $n! That's how we took care of business back on Kezan.
text.completed: 用伐木机的电锯砍倒5棵艾萨拉幼树，杀掉9个现身的塔伦迪斯狙击手。

english.title: Up a Tree
english.objectives: Use the shredder's buzzsaw to cut down Azshara Saplings, and kill 9 Talrendis Snipers as they emerge.
english.description: Hold still a second, I'm going to bring your main buzzsaw controls online.$B$BNight elven snipers from Talrendis have been hiding in the trees, taking potshots at my workers. I want you to take care of those snipers... by first taking care of those trees. Look for Azshara saplings east of the main gates. Your shredder will know what to do. Chop to it!
english.completion: Great work, $n! That's how we took care of business back on Kezan.
english.completed: Use the shredder's buzzsaw to cut down Azshara Saplings, and kill 9 Talrendis Snipers as they emerge.

text.title: 海上救援
text.objectives: 银色比武场的身经百战的吉莱娜要你在炎鹰号上消灭8名克瓦迪尔狂暴者和3名克瓦迪尔持戟者。
text.description: 克瓦迪尔人在北方小岛洛斯加尔登陆点建立了营地。我们派遣了船长埃尔萨斯·炎鹰前往那一地区。但他的船却遇到了一群正在向比武场进军的克瓦迪尔海盗！现在炎鹰号正遭受到远多于他数倍的敌人进攻。赶快到那里去，让克瓦迪尔人知道，攻击夺日者是多么愚蠢的行为。$B$B炎鹰号就在破海者航道的西侧，也就是北方的洛斯加尔登陆点和比武场之间。
text.progress: Have you helped fend off the Kvaldir attack?
text.completion: Great job, Champion.  The fight continues, but now the Kvaldir know that we do not tolerate such attacks.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Rescue at Sea
english.objectives: Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds would like you to kill 8 Kvaldir Berserkers and 3 Kvaldir Harpooners aboard The Firehawk.
english.description: The Kvaldir have set up camp at Hrothgar's Landing, the small island to the North.  We sent Captain Aerthas Firehawk to the area, but they ran into a Kvaldir Raiding party heading to the Tournament Grounds!  The Firehawk is now under attack by the raiders and is vastly outnumbered. Get out there and show those Kvaldir why attacking the Sunreavers is a poor plan indeed. $B$BThe Firehawk is between Hrothgar's Landing to the north and the Tournament Grounds, on the western side of The Sea Reaver's Run.
english.progress: Have you helped fend off the Kvaldir attack?
english.completion: Great job, Champion.  The fight continues, but now the Kvaldir know that we do not tolerate such attacks.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 照看生意
text.objectives: 将莎希的奖励交给科赞岛上卡亚罗贸易公司总部的工头戴姆维克。
text.description: 卡亚矿井被搞得乌烟瘴气，工头戴姆维克像发了疯似的一直在找你。他说那里的巨魔矿工在闹事。$B$B由巨魔矿工开采的卡亚矿石是制造卡亚可乐的重要原料。这种气泡饮料让我们赚了不少钱，它也会令你晋升为贸易$G大王:女王;的！$B$B但是首先，我们必须确保生产线恢复正常运转。你可以在东边找到工头。把这个交给他，以此激励他的工作。
text.progress: Um... everything's going great. Yeah. What's that?
text.completion: A gift from Sassy? I hope it's a bonus!

english.title: Taking Care of Business
english.objectives: Deliver Sassy's Incentive to Foreman Dampwick at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.description: With all of the troubles down in the Kaja'mine, Foreman Dampwick's been going crazy trying to find you. He said something about some 'defiant trolls'.$B$BThe kaja'mite that our trolls are mining is critical ingredient in Kaja'Cola. That bubbly stuff is making us a fortune, and it's going to get you a promotion to Trade $g Prince : Princess;!$B$BBut first, we have to get production flowing again. You'll find the foreman to the east. Here, give him this as an incentive to get his act together.
english.progress: Um... everything's going great. Yeah. What's that?
english.completion: A gift from Sassy? I hope it's a bonus!

text.title: 抗击侵略者
text.objectives: Giranan the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Kvaldir.
text.description: 那些恐怖的维库人强盗克瓦迪尔袭击我们的运输队，又对一座北方岛屿上的海象人居民进行了屠杀，并把那座岛重新命名为洛斯加尔登陆点。如果让他们在那里站稳脚跟，我们无疑会成为他们的下一个目标。$B$B北伐军为了抵抗天灾军团已经倾尽全力。而我们必须守住比武场。一直向北飞行，到达那座岛屿，消灭那里的克瓦迪尔，不要让他们将那里的一切尽数毁灭。
text.progress: Have you shown the Kvaldir that we will not let them threaten us?
text.completion: Your actions have shown that we Sunreavers are far better allies to the Argent Crusade than the Silver Covenant and it is we who will be triumphant.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Stop The Aggressors
english.objectives: Giranan the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Kvaldir.
english.description: The Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders, have disrupted our shipments and murdered the tuskarr inhabitants of an island to the north, renaming it Hrothgar's Landing. If they are allowed to get a foothold there, there is no doubt that we will be their next target.$B$BThe crusade's forces have their hands full dealing with the Scourge, and we must defend the tournament grounds. Fly north from the grounds until you reach the island and take on the Kvaldir before they can destroy anything else.
english.progress: Have you shown the Kvaldir that we will not let them threaten us?
english.completion: Your actions have shown that we Sunreavers are far better allies to the Argent Crusade than the Silver Covenant and it is we who will be triumphant.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 戈莫克想要他的狗头人
text.objectives: Use the Weighted Net to capture 8 Snowblind Followers and bring them to Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: 我的两名部下在抓捕猛犸人穿刺者戈莫克的行动中丧生了。而那头怪物还在四处横行。他连续几个小时高声嗥叫，只是因为它找不到他喜欢的那个狗头人。$B$B如果银色北伐军不想在演武场中使用这头怪物，我会亲手把它杀了。不过，现在我们也许应该先给它找些玩具。拿上这张网，到风暴峭壁东南方的加姆雷区去。那里就在K3的东北方。在那里抓住一些狗头人。圣光保佑，但愿你能找到那头怪物喜欢的狗头人。
text.completion: The sooner we get these stinking things out of my sight and into their cage, the faster my mood will improve. I wish the Argent Crusade had given the Silver Covenant the care of this creature. They're going to have to get their hands dirty when the battle for Icecrown Citadel starts and I have a feeling they'll prove fragile and fussy allies.
text.completed: Return to Tylos Dawnrunner at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Gormok Wants His Snobolds
english.objectives: Use the Weighted Net to capture 8 Snowblind Followers and bring them to Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Two of my men have already been killed trying to confine the magnataur called Gormok the Impaler, yet the creature still rages. It howls for hours about being without its favorite snobold.$B$BIf the Argent Crusade didn't wish to use this monster in the coliseum, I'd slay it myself. Perhaps it's time to bring the beast its playthings. Take this net and travel to Garm's Bane in southeast Storm Peaks. It's just northeast of K3. Capture some of those snobolds and pray to the Light you've found the right one.
english.completion: The sooner we get these stinking things out of my sight and into their cage, the faster my mood will improve. I wish the Argent Crusade had given the Silver Covenant the care of this creature. They're going to have to get their hands dirty when the battle for Icecrown Citadel starts and I have a feeling they'll prove fragile and fussy allies.
english.completed: Return to Tylos Dawnrunner at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 这次你真的做到了，库尔
text.objectives: 在亡语者岗哨援救鲁莽的库尔和4名被俘虏的候选者，然后返回银色比武场，去见身经百战的吉莱娜。
text.description: Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tourney grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an attack.$B$BThey were easily captured, and now Kul languishes in a cage on the platform in the camp. I am sure that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can rescue them. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.$B$B
text.progress: Did you free Kul and those hopeless aspirants?
text.completion: Kul will live to embarrass himself again. That's far from the first time someone's had to save Kul from himself. With examples like him, it's no wonder most of the aspirants are taking up the habits of the Silver Covenant.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: You've Really Done It This Time, Kul
english.objectives: Rescue Kul the Reckless and 4 Captive Aspirants from Deathspeaker's Watch and return to Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Crusader Kul has gone and gotten himself into trouble again, only this time he's not alone. When he saw the cultists making camp at Deathspeaker's Watch, west of the tourney grounds, Kul gathered the aspirants for an attack.$B$BThey were easily captured, and now Kul languishes in a cage on the platform in the camp. I am sure that the cult will sacrifice the prisoners unless we can rescue them. Any of those cultists could carry keys to the black cages. Find the keys and free Kul and the captive aspirants.$B$B
english.progress: Did you free Kul and those hopeless aspirants?
english.completion: Kul will live to embarrass himself again. That's far from the first time someone's had to save Kul from himself. With examples like him, it's no wonder most of the aspirants are taking up the habits of the Silver Covenant.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 一腿之力
text.objectives: Recover 10 Stolen Tallstrider Legs for Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$B$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.
text.progress: Were you able to recover any of the missing supplies?
text.completion: These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've had some success. Maybe we can give the half-eaten ones to the Silver Covenant. That would make my day.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: A Leg Up
english.objectives: Recover 10 Stolen Tallstrider Legs for Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The Argent Crusade dispatched a fast ship carrying tallstrider meat and other supplies for us here at the tournament grounds, but it never arrived. Scouts reported seeing it attacked by the Kvaldir, fearsome vrykul raiders who roam the seas.$B$BThey've slain the crew and taken the cargo to an island called Hrothgar's Landing. If you look to the north, you can see it shrouded in the mist. Would you help us in recovering the stolen supplies? Without those tallstrider legs, we'll soon be out of food.
english.progress: Were you able to recover any of the missing supplies?
english.completion: These look a little worse for wear, but they're still edible. The crusaders will be glad to hear that we've had some success. Maybe we can give the half-eaten ones to the Silver Covenant. That would make my day.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 圣光的仁慈
text.objectives: Use the Confessor's Prayer Book to perform last rites for 8 Slain Tualiq Villagers and then return to Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have made me think. We fight beside the crusaders, but we can learn from them, too.$B$BOff the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.
text.progress: Have you seen to the spirits of the slain Tualiq villagers?
text.completion: Thank you. We don't always see eye-to-eye with the crusaders, but I've learned a lot from Confessor Paletress in my time here.
text.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: The Light's Mercy
english.objectives: Use the Confessor's Prayer Book to perform last rites for 8 Slain Tualiq Villagers and then return to Girana the Blooded at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I've been listening to Confessor Paletress speak, and I must tell you, her words have made me think. We fight beside the crusaders, but we can learn from them, too.$B$BOff the north coast is Hrothgar's Landing, where the seagoing Kvaldir have overrun an old tuskarr settlement and slain the villagers. Take this book and read the rites for the dead near the corpses of the villagers. It will allow their spirits to escape the mists engulfing the island and find peace.
english.progress: Have you seen to the spirits of the slain Tualiq villagers?
english.completion: Thank you. We don't always see eye-to-eye with the crusaders, but I've learned a lot from Confessor Paletress in my time here.
english.completed: Return to Girana the Blooded at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 你们到底喂雪人吃什么？
text.objectives: 银色比武场的泰罗斯·晨行者想让你带给她3块北海鲨鱼肉。
text.description: 北伐军抓住了一头雪人，他们称那头雪人为冰吼。那头雪人将参与演武场的战斗。而我们的任务就是训练并喂养他。$B$B我建议十字军应该把一些银色盟约的成员喂给雪人吃，但北伐军对此丝毫不感兴趣。这头怪兽喜欢鲨鱼肉。所以我希望你能够飞行到血色黎明号。它就漂浮在北方的那道海峡里。从那艘船上的桶中取得一些新鲜的鱼饵，然后把鱼饵撒进海中，把鲨鱼引出来。
text.progress: I hope you have something to feed Icehowl, otherwise I really will start bringing Silver Covenant members down to his cage.
text.completion: I'm glad we've gotten that done. It's not the most glorious task in the world, but when we partnered with the Argent Crusade, we promised to do all they asked of us without complaint. Of course, the same cannot be said of the Silver Covenant.
text.completed: Return to Tylos Dawnrunner at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: What Do You Feed a Yeti, Anyway?
english.objectives: Tylos Dawnrunner at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him 3 pieces of North Sea Shark Meat.
english.description: The crusaders have captured a yeti that they're calling Icehowl. He's to be a participant in the coliseum battles and we've been asked to help with his training and upkeep.$B$BThe crusaders weren't fond of my suggestion that we feed some Silver Covenant members to the beast. The creature prefers shark meat, so I want you to fly down to the Crimson Dawn, floating in the strait to the north. Get some fresh chum from one of the buckets on the boat, then spread it in the water to attract sharks.
english.progress: I hope you have something to feed Icehowl, otherwise I really will start bringing Silver Covenant members down to his cage.
english.completion: I'm glad we've gotten that done. It's not the most glorious task in the world, but when we partnered with the Argent Crusade, we promised to do all they asked of us without complaint. Of course, the same cannot be said of the Silver Covenant.
english.completed: Return to Tylos Dawnrunner at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 守卫大门！
text.objectives: 劳工队长格拉比特要你杀回奥格瑞玛后门干掉20个暗夜精灵袭击者。
text.description: 呃啊，发生什么事了？$B$B<尖叫、呼号，还有战斗的呐喊充斥着无线电>$B$B$N！给我马上回来，回防城门，我们遭到进攻了！$B$B帮我们挡住侵略者，我正在给你武装榴弹发射器！！
text.completed: Labor Captain Grabbit needs you to rush back to the Rear Gate of Orgrimmar to slay 20 Night Elf Raiders.

english.title: Defend the Gates!
english.objectives: Labor Captain Grabbit needs you to rush back to the Rear Gate of Orgrimmar to slay 20 Night Elf Raiders.
english.description: Egah - what's going on?$B$B<Screams, shouts, and the roar of combat fills the radio.>$B$B$N! Get back here right away. Hurry back to the gates - we're under attack!$B$BHelp us fend off the invaders. I'm arming your grenade launcher!!
english.completed: Labor Captain Grabbit needs you to rush back to the Rear Gate of Orgrimmar to slay 20 Night Elf Raiders.

text.title: 赤玉石
text.objectives: 达拉然的林奇·黑箭想让你以你的炼金术技能成功地转化5种史诗宝石。这五种史诗宝石是：紫黄晶、祖尔之眼、恐惧石、王者琥珀和巨锆石。
text.description: 据说，赤玉石是诺森德最好的宝石。$B$B在我教给你这种宝石的制作方法之前，我要你做的就是完成五颗史诗宝石的转变，为学习制作这种宝石而做好思想上的准备。你可以随意选择进行这些转化中的任何一种，甚至多次进行同样的转化也没有关系。$B$B当你最终做好准备的时候再回来见我。
text.completion: Very good, $n. Now, the trick is to align the facets just right...
text.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt in Dalaran.

english.title: Cardinal Ruby
english.objectives: Linzy Blackbolt in Dalaran wants you to successfully transmute 5 epic gems with your alchemy skill.  Acceptable transmutes include Ametrine, Eye of Zul, Dreadstone, King's Amber, and Majestic Zircon.
english.description: The Cardinal Ruby is said to be the finest gem in all of Northrend.  It sparkles like a crystal rose under the sun.$b$bBefore I teach you this recipe, I ask that you perform five epic gem transmutes to prepare your mind.  You can do any you like, and even do the same transmute many times.$b$bReturn to me when you are truly ready.
english.completion: Very good, $n. Now, the trick is to align the facets just right...
english.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt in Dalaran.

text.title: 海上救援
text.objectives: 前往北海，消灭攻击浪巅号的8个克瓦迪尔狂暴者和3个克瓦迪尔持戟者。
text.description: 勇士，船长伊尔琳·浪巅和她的船被派往北方，去阻击洛斯加尔登陆点的克瓦迪尔人。但他们在半路上遭遇了一群正在向比武场进军的克瓦迪尔海盗。不幸的是，克瓦迪尔强盗的数量远远超过了浪巅号上的水手们。他的船就要落入克瓦迪尔人的手中了。$B$B我们需要你前往北方，在破海者航道找到浪巅号。破海者航道就在比武场和洛斯加尔登陆点之间。你应该能在海岸东侧看到那艘船。请一定帮助伊尔琳船长击退敌人的攻击。
text.completion: It seems things are worse than we initially thought.  You still made a valiant effort and saved many of The Wavecrest's crew's lives.
text.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

english.title: Rescue at Sea
english.objectives: Head out to The North Sea and kill 8 Vrykul Berserkers and 3 Vrykul Harpooners attacking The Wavecrest.
english.description: Champion, Captain Wavecrest and her ship were sent north to disrupt the Kvaldir in Hrothgar's Landing when they were intercepted by a Kvaldir raiding party headed to the Tournament Grounds. Unfortunately, the Kvaldir far outnumber the crew on board and are slowly taking over the ship.$B$BWe need you to go north to The Wavecrest in The Sea Reaver's Run, between the Tournament Grounds and Hrothgar's Landing and help the crew fend off the attack.  You should see the ship on the east side of the pass.
english.completion: It seems things are worse than we initially thought.  You still made a valiant effort and saved many of The Wavecrest's crew's lives.
english.completed: Return to Narasi Snowdawn at the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 聚会生活
text.objectives: 穿戴好你的超酷派对套装（亮闪闪的珠宝、潮人装束和清爽遮阳镜），然后前往在卡亚罗贸易公司总部泳池边举行的聚会，款待10位科赞聚会者。
text.description: Oh wow, baby! Everyone is here! Who cares about some stupid dragon?$B$BWe setup the party around the pool. Sounds like they're having a great time already. You are going to look so fine!$B$BWhy don't you head over to the pool and keep everyone entertained? I'll join you in a moment... I just have to grab my stuff.
text.completion: Very nicely done, ma'am. The party appears to have been a smashing success! Er... what's that?
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

english.title: Life of the Party
english.objectives: Put on your Awesome Party Ensemble (Cool Shades, Hip New Outfit, and Shiny Bling) and then head over to the party at the KTC Headquarters pool to entertain 10 Kezan Partygoers.
english.description: Oh wow, baby! Everyone is here! Who cares about some stupid dragon?$B$BWe setup the party around the pool. Sounds like they're having a great time already. You are going to look so fine!$B$BWhy don't you head over to the pool and keep everyone entertained? I'll join you in a moment... I just have to grab my stuff.
english.completion: Very nicely done, ma'am. The party appears to have been a smashing success! Er... what's that?
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.

text.title: 命悬一线
text.objectives: 在吉尔尼斯城市监狱顶部抵御狼人的攻击，坚持2分钟。
text.description: One of those mangy fleabags got Dempsey real good.  We cannot move him until we stabilize his bleeding.$B$BGive us a hand holding back these mongrels.  A couple of minutes is all we need, $Gbrother:sister;!
text.progress: Getting there! Careful or we'll lose him!
text.completion: We did it, $n.  Thanks to you a good man has survived.
text.end: Survive while holding back the worgen for 2 minutes.
text.completed: Speak to Lord Darius Crowley at the top of Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City.

english.title: By the Skin of His Teeth
english.objectives: Hold back the worgen atop the Gilneas City Prison for 2 minutes.
english.description: One of those mangy fleabags got Dempsey real good.  We cannot move him until we stabilize his bleeding.$B$BGive us a hand holding back these mongrels.  A couple of minutes is all we need, $Gbrother:sister;!
english.progress: Getting there! Careful or we'll lose him!
english.completion: We did it, $n.  Thanks to you a good man has survived.
english.end: Survive while holding back the worgen for 2 minutes.
english.completed: Speak to Lord Darius Crowley at the top of Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City.

text.title: 砍大树
text.objectives: Use the shredder to destroy the Talrendis Ancient. Emergency Backup Shredders are available at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate if you lose yours.
text.description: 伐木机还吃得消么？我想我可以给你连上应急能量供应——它能在你受损的时候为你续能。$B$B听着，这些暗夜精灵有棵战争古树压阵，就扎根在了西边门外。他可是一棵老大的巨树！放倒他！$B$B你就是干这个的！！
text.completion: You did it, $n! The invaders have pulled back. And they told me I was crazy for installing a grenade launcher on a woodchipper... Great work with the Shredder. With an impressive showing like that right here on the Warchief's doorstep, the Horde can't doubt what goblin technology can do for them. I owe you a big thanks!
text.completed: Return to Labor Captain Grabbit at the rear gates of Orgrimmar.
text.giverWindow: Use your buzzsaws at close range to topple that tree!

english.title: Arborcide
english.objectives: Use the shredder to destroy the Talrendis Ancient. Emergency Backup Shredders are available at the Orgrimmar Rear Gate if you lose yours.
english.description: How's that shredder holding up? I think I can bring your emergency power supplies online - that'll recharge you when you're wounded.$B$BListen, these night elves are being strengthened by an ancient of war who's taken root just west of the gates. He's a big, giant tree. You know what to do! Take him out!$B$BYou were made for this!!
english.completion: You did it, $n! The invaders have pulled back. And they told me I was crazy for installing a grenade launcher on a woodchipper... Great work with the Shredder. With an impressive showing like that right here on the Warchief's doorstep, the Horde can't doubt what goblin technology can do for them. I owe you a big thanks!
english.completed: Return to Labor Captain Grabbit at the rear gates of Orgrimmar.
english.giverWindow: Use your buzzsaws at close range to topple that tree!

text.title: 打入内部
text.objectives: Find Sean Dempsey on the rooftop of the Gilneas City Prison.
text.description: If the king wants to rescue Lord Crowley and his band of traitors, then we will follow his orders.$B$BIt is just as well... one of my men was assigned to infiltrate Crowley's group in prison and it most certainly would be good to find out if he's survived this incident.$B$BApproach Sean Dempsey discretely... you do not want to give away his position among Crowley's men.  They might prove to be more dangerous to his life than the worgen.

english.title: Man on the Inside
english.objectives: Find Sean Dempsey on the rooftop of the Gilneas City Prison.
english.description: If the king wants to rescue Lord Crowley and his band of traitors, then we will follow his orders.$B$BIt is just as well... one of my men was assigned to infiltrate Crowley's group in prison and it most certainly would be good to find out if he's survived this incident.$B$BApproach Sean Dempsey discretely... you do not want to give away his position among Crowley's men.  They might prove to be more dangerous to his life than the worgen.

text.title: 旧日的分歧
text.objectives: 同吉尔尼斯城中斯通沃德监狱里的布罗德里克队长谈一谈。
text.description: 达利乌斯·克罗雷领主有很多称呼。譬如叛徒、卖国贼和恐怖分子。$B$B在内战爆发之前，我还亲切地叫他……朋友。$B$B他虽然背叛了我，但是我从来没有怪过他。吉尔尼斯高耸的石墙将克罗雷的领地以及臣民与我们隔离开来……这实属无奈之举。$B$B无论如何……眼下是用得着他的时候。$B$B穿越前面的庭院进入斯通沃德监狱，向布罗德里克队长询问一下克罗雷的下落。本来我应该派自己的手下去的，可是他们对克罗雷的仇恨极深，因此只能请你跑一趟了。
text.completion: Greymane wants to save Crowley?  Has he gone mad?

english.title: Old Divisions
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Broderick inside Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City.
english.description: Lord Darius Crowley has been called many things.  Rebel.  Traitor.  Terrorist.$B$BBefore the civil war I called him... friend.$B$BI never blamed him for leading an insurrection against me.  His land and people were separated from Gilneas by a stone wall... but we had no choice.$B$BRegardless... Crowley is exactly the type of person we need now.$B$BEnter Stoneward Prison and ask Captain Broderick about Crowley's whereabouts.  I'd send my own men, but there's still bad blood.
english.completion: Greymane wants to save Crowley?  Has he gone mad?

text.title: 叛军领主的军械库
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城军事区的约书亚·阿维利谈一谈。
text.description: 克罗雷提到的军械库就在此地以西的那座建筑物中。$B$B我的敌人竟然成功地将这批物资偷运进城了，真是令人震惊，但是它们或许能挽救吉尔尼斯城民的命运。$B$B找到约书亚·阿维利，并征用叛军军械库。我们得好好利用这些武器。
text.completion: Don't look at me!  Leave me alone!

english.title: The Rebel Lord's Arsenal
english.objectives: Speak to Josiah Avery at the Military District in Gilneas City.
english.description: The arsenal Crowley speaks of is in the cellar of a building just west of here.$B$BIt is unnerving that artillery was smuggled inside the city by my enemies, yet it might end up saving Gilnean lives today.$B$BFind Josiah Avery and requisition the rebel artillery.  We will put the weapons to good use.
english.completion: Don't look at me!  Leave me alone!

text.title: 功勋奖状
text.objectives: 将功勋状交给达拉然的提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 这张精致的羊皮纸上列出了$N在珠宝行业里取得的诸多成就。$B$B你要将这份文件交给达拉然的提莫斯·琼斯，他一定会给你一份不错的酬劳。
text.completed: Return to Timothy Jones at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.

english.title: Writ of Merit
english.objectives: Deliver the Writ of Merit to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.
english.description: This fine parchment lists a great many accomplishments, achieved by $N, in the tradition of jewelcrafting.$b$bReturn this writ to Timothy Jones in Dalaran for a proper reward.
english.completed: Return to Timothy Jones at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.

text.title: 灭除蜥蜴
text.objectives: 杀掉山麓矿场里的10只灰石蜥蜴。
text.description: 就为了露天开采矿产，我们把整座山都铲平了，可没有想到的是地下的蜥蜴现在，呃，变成地上了。你看上去有两下子，去帮忙杀掉那些害虫，我会在大笔资金现款里给你留一份。
text.completion: Good, good. One less nuisance to worry about.
text.completed: Report back to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Basilisk Bashin'
english.objectives: Kill 10 Greystone Basilisks in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine.
english.description: We moved this whole mountain to strip mine the minerals below. But what we didn't take into consideration were the subterranean basilisks that are now, uh, terranean. You look like you've got some initiative - go in there and kill some of those nuisances and I'll dip into our petty cash fund for you.
english.completion: Good, good. One less nuisance to worry about.
english.completed: Report back to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 向霍扎克汇报
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉找到位于奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站的霍扎克·齐格尼伯。
text.description: 在木料工程到位上你干的可真不赖。可风闻我们的石料份额不足了。你也许在想我们是不是能从山上弄点儿石头下来。$B$B不管怎么说，那都不是我的问题，不过你可以自告奋勇。到奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站找霍扎克·齐格尼伯，看看你是不是能帮他搞定。沿着路朝东北走，在火箭车换乘站里就能找到他。
text.completion: You're here to help? Excellent! Here, sign this indemnity waiver. And here, this noncompete clause. Let's get you started!
text.completed: Find Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Report to Horzak
english.objectives: Find Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.
english.description: You've done a bangup job getting our lumber operations in order. But word on the wire is that we're falling under our stone quota. You'd think if we could move mountains, we could gather up a few rocks...$B$BWell, that's not my problem, but maybe you can make it yours. Report to Horzak Zignibble up ahead at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange. See if you can't help him straighten out his operations. Just follow the road northeast and find him in the rocketway tower.
english.completion: You're here to help? Excellent! Here, sign this indemnity waiver. And here, this noncompete clause. Let's get you started!
english.completed: Find Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：征服之岛
text.objectives: 在征服之岛战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
text.description: 当我们在冰冠冰川距离胜利越来越近的时候，部落的军队却给我们制造了越来越多的麻烦，让我们的战士在同巫妖王作战的同时不得不抽出力量来对付他们。$B$B现在，部落派遣了他们的精英卫士库卡隆来阻挡我们对征服之岛的进军。那座岛是一个非常重要的战略要地。$N，你的任务就是为联盟在那里取下胜利的果实！
text.end: Victory in the Isle of Conquest
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest
english.objectives: Win an Isle of Conquest battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: As we get closer to victory in Icecrown, it's become more apparent that our armies are going to have to deal with the Horde before they can deal with the Lich King.$B$BThe elite guard known as the Kor'kron has been deployed to block our advance in the Isle of Conquest.  The isle is of vital strategic importance, $N.  See to it that our lads prevail!
english.end: Victory in the Isle of Conquest
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：征服之岛
text.objectives: 在征服之岛战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意部落主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的部落战争使者复命。
text.description: 我们很快就会在诺森德取得胜利……但我们必须在冰冠冰川取得一个立足点，用来为我们的部队提供后勤补给。$B$B征服之岛恰好是一个理想的地点。这里很容易进行防御，而且资源丰富。联盟也看中了这个地方，并派遣第七军团和我们争夺对这座岛屿的控制权。$B$B$N，赶快到那里去，不惜一切代价为部落夺取那个战略要地！
text.completion: Nothing will stand between us and total victory. For the Horde!
text.end: Victory in the Isle of Conquest
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.title: Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest
english.objectives: Win an Isle of Conquest battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: Victory in Northrend will be ours soon... but not until we obtain a foothold in Icecrown to transport and supply our forces.$B$BThe Isle of Conquest is an ideal location.  It is easily defensible and rich in resources.  The Alliance have reached the same conclusion and have sent the Seventh Legion to wrest control of it from our forces.$B$BGo, $N, and ensure that the Horde prevails at any cost!
english.completion: Nothing will stand between us and total victory. For the Horde!
english.end: Victory in the Isle of Conquest
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 冷若岩石
text.objectives: 去山麓矿场抱一个被石化的山麓矿工回来，交给奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站的霍扎克·齐格尼伯。
text.description: 这些工人，好像抱怨才是他们的本职。不是工作繁忙，就是薪资过低，这会儿被变成石头也算是理由了。总有借口！$B$B不过我觉得工人被石化这件事倒未必不是一桩发财的买卖。搞不好这些家伙还是上乘石料呢？比起作为劳动力的价值，这些爱发牢骚的工人作为豪华建筑材料说不定更值钱！给我去带个被石化的山麓矿工回来。
text.completion: Well well, let's take a look at what we got here... Bah! Crumbly! Useless. Wouldn't even make a good countertop. My miners may be mediocre workers, but they make lousy bricks. . Well, I suppose we should re-fleshify these guys so I can get some return on my investment.
text.completed: Talk to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Stone Cold
english.objectives: Collect a stonified Mountainfoot Miner from the Mountainfoot Strip Mine and bring him or her back to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Workers act like it's their job to complain. If it isn't the backbreaking labor, the long hours, or the low pay, it's being turned to stone by basilisks. It's always something!$B$BBut I'm thinking maybe this whole workers-to-stone business could be a big moneymaker for me. What if those guys are now high-quality stone? My whiny employees could be worth more to me as luxury building materials than a source of labor! Grab a stonified mountainfoot miner and haul him or her back to me.
english.completion: Well well, let's take a look at what we got here... Bah! Crumbly! Useless. Wouldn't even make a good countertop. My miners may be mediocre workers, but they make lousy bricks. . Well, I suppose we should re-fleshify these guys so I can get some return on my investment.
english.completed: Talk to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 死者的感激
text.objectives: 弄到悼念糕饼，并把它交给达拉然墓地的欢快的达拉然灵魂。$B$B你必须使用一朵橙菊，才能看到那个隐形的灵魂。
text.description: 真高兴能再次见到朋友和亲人，不过也许我做得有些太夸张了……我已经吃光了他们为我准备的一切！$B$B能不能帮我一个忙，再给我拿来一些那种美味的悼念糕饼？我会非常感激你的……$B$B我想，那边的查普曼正在出售食谱。
text.progress: You don't have any Bread of the Dead, do you?
text.completion: Ah, more delicious Bread of the Dead, thank you! Please, take this in return... a little something fun for the holiday.
text.completed: Return to Cheerful Dalaran Spirit at The Twilight Rivulet in Crystalsong Forest.

english.title: The Grateful Dead
english.objectives: Acquire some Bread of the Dead and give it to the Cheerful Dalaran Spirit in Dalaran's graveyard.$B$BUse an Orange Marigold to see the otherwise invisible spirit.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地
text.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: 事实上，我们在多线作战，$G小子:小姑娘;，而且我们不能把军队部署得太过分散，否则我们可能会全盘皆输！$B$B我们需要以天为单位来部署最关键的部队，今天，阿拉希盆地的战斗最需要勇敢的士兵！$B$B带着胜利的消息回来吧，$N。我们不允许部落狗来威胁属于我们的资源！
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
english.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The reality of fighting on multiple fronts, $g lad : lass;, is that we cannot spread our forces too thin or we risk losing it all!$B$BCritical troop deployments are necessary on a day by day basis.  Today it is the battle of Arathi Basin that demands immediate reinforcements.$B$BReturn to me with news of victory, $N.  We cannot allow the Horde scum to secure the resources that are rightfully ours!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：风暴之眼
text.objectives: 在风暴之眼战场中获得一场胜利，然后向任意联盟主城、冬拥湖、达拉然或沙塔斯城中的联盟准将复命。
text.description: 对抗部落的战斗是没有尽头的，$N。即使在外域，对于地盘的争夺和世代积累的仇恨同样引发了一场场战斗。$B$B现在，进入风暴之眼，为联盟夺取辉煌的胜利，就像我们在艾泽拉斯做的一样。
text.end: Victory in the Eye of the Storm
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Call to Arms: Eye of the Storm
english.objectives: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The fight against the Horde knows no boundaries, $N.  Even in Outland, territorial disputes and old hatreds are enough to tip the scales in favor of war.$B$BGo into the Eye of the Storm and make sure the Alliance prevails in Outland just like it has in Azeroth.
english.end: Victory in the Eye of the Storm
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：战歌峡谷
text.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: 银翼哨兵通过战斗来保护战歌峡谷的森林。我们帮助他们，并不是因为我们爱好树木，而是因为森林为联盟领地提供了天然的屏障。$B$B今天他们那里的情势非常危急，远远超过以往任何时候。我们必须立刻派出援军，除非我们希望看到灰谷成为贫瘠之地的附属地！
text.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

english.title: Call to Arms: Warsong Gulch
english.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the forest in Warsong Gulch.  We aid them, not because we're tree-lovers, but because the forest forms a natural protective barrier for Alliance territory.$B$BTheir need is greater today than it's ever been.  We need to deploy reinforcements right away unless we want to see Ashenvale annexed to the Barrens!
english.completed: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：阿拉希盆地
text.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
text.description: 阿拉希盆地快要让联盟夺走了，我们必须尽快派出援兵，否则我们所做的一切都将成为徒劳。$B$B不要拖延了，$C。去阿拉希盆地消灭敌人，胜利属于部落！
text.completion: You've brought great honor to the Horde, $n. Your victory today will ensure a thousand victories tomorrow!
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

english.title: Call to Arms: Arathi Basin
english.objectives: Win an Arathi Basin battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
english.description: Arathi Basin is on the verge of being lost to Alliance forces.  We must send reinforcements at this very moment or all our efforts will have been in vain.$B$BDo not delay, $c, go to Arathi Basin and crush the enemy.  Victory to the Horde!
english.completion: You've brought great honor to the Horde, $n. Your victory today will ensure a thousand victories tomorrow!
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 战斗的召唤：风暴之眼
text.objectives: Win an Eye of the Storm battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran,  or Shattrath.
text.description: We will fight and crush the enemy wherever we find them.  Azeroth, Outland, the place makes no difference.$B$BWe cannot allow the Alliance to establish superiority in the Eye of the Storm.  Take the battle to them today... tomorrow it might be too late!
text.end: Victory in Eye of the Storm
text.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.objectives: Win a Warsong Gulch battleground match and return to a Horde Warbringer at any Horde capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.$B$B
text.description: The Alliance is an insidious enemy, $N.  They claim to defend the Ashenvale forests to justify their acts of aggression against our territories in the Barrens.$B$BToday we have an opportunity to drive the enemy from our lands once and for all.  Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!
text.completion: The Horde is in your debt, $n. You've made your people proud with your courage in defending our lands.
