Go to Warsong Gulch and take back what is rightfully ours!
english.completion: The Horde is in your debt, $n. You've made your people proud with your courage in defending our lands.
english.completed: Return to Horde Warbringer.

text.title: 我的时候已经到了
text.objectives: 塔迪萨兰的弗瑞恩要你乘他的龙鹰前往弗瑞恩的哨站，去把他的死讯告诉他的姐姐瑟蕾莉亚。
text.description: <弗瑞虚弱地示意你凑近，挣扎着说道。>$B$B是我自己不当心……被联盟的火力打了下来……$B$B你必须……告诉我的姐姐。$B$B乘上我的坐骑，$R……它会把你带到她那里去……$B$B<弗瑞恩断了气。>
text.completion: What!? Furien!! My brother is no more? They must pay! All of them!

english.title: My Time Has Passed
english.objectives: Furien at Tethris Aran wants you to ride his Dragonhawk to Furien's Post and inform his sister, Cerelia of his death.
english.description: <Weakly, Furien beckons you near and struggles to speak.>$b$bCareless... I was shot down by Alliance fire...$b$bYou must... inform my sister.$b$bTake my mount, $r... he'll bring you to her...$b$b<Furien expires.>
english.completion: What!? Furien!! My brother is no more? They must pay! All of them!

text.title: 为弗瑞恩报仇！
text.objectives: 瑟蕾莉亚要你跟弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦谈一谈。
text.description: 这不可能！$B$B我亲爱的弟弟——被联盟的混账杀了！$B$B他们要为此遭罪，$R！想办法让他们痛不欲生！除非大仇得报，否则我将永不罢休……$B$B弗瑞恩生前一直在东部区域研究远古神器。去跟苏伦谈一谈，也许他可以将你指引到我弟弟的足迹上去。
text.completion: Furien's passing is... regrettable. I shall do all that I can to assist you in avenging his death.

english.title: Avenge Furien!
english.objectives: Cerelia wants you to speak with Sorrem at Furien's Post.
english.description: This cannot be!$b$bMy dear brother - slain by Alliance scum!$b$bThey must be made to suffer, $r! Find a way to bring them pain! I shall not rest until it is so...$b$bFurien had been researching ancient artifacts in the eastern regions before his death. Speak to Sorrem. Perhaps he can direct you in my brother's footsteps.
english.completion: Furien's passing is... regrettable. I shall do all that I can to assist you in avenging his death.

text.title: Translation
text.objectives: Sorrem wants you to find the Ancient Tablets.$b$bSpeak to Narimar at Furien's Post to ride to where Furien was known to study.
text.description: It is true that Furien dedicated his last days to a special research project. What that was, he would not share with me.$b$bFortunately, I was able to recover his journal, but it's written in a code that I cannot decipher.$b$bPerhaps there is a clue to its translation in the region to the east where he spent his time.$b$bTake the journal, $c, and speak with Narimar when you are ready to investigate this mystery.
text.completion: Comparing the characters on the ancient tablet to those in Furien's journal, it is clear that there is a distinct correlation.

english.title: Translation
english.objectives: Sorrem wants you to find the Ancient Tablets.$b$bSpeak to Narimar at Furien's Post to ride to where Furien was known to study.
english.description: It is true that Furien dedicated his last days to a special research project. What that was, he would not share with me.$b$bFortunately, I was able to recover his journal, but it's written in a code that I cannot decipher.$b$bPerhaps there is a clue to its translation in the region to the east where he spent his time.$b$bTake the journal, $c, and speak with Narimar when you are ready to investigate this mystery.
english.completion: Comparing the characters on the ancient tablet to those in Furien's journal, it is clear that there is a distinct correlation.

text.title: 完美的棱镜
text.objectives: 从山麓矿场的塔伦迪斯破坏者身上获得一副水晶坠饰。
text.description: 一定有什么办法化解蜥蜴的石化术。那些潜伏在矿区烦人的暗夜精灵破坏者肯定知道些什么，他们好像就对畜牲的招数免疫！$B$B我要你去找出他们的秘密，$N，除掉几个在山麓矿场后面鬼鬼祟祟的塔伦迪斯破坏者，把他们身上戴的护符啊还是别的什么拿一件过来。成事之后在铸造主楼用无线电联系我。
text.completion: Is that you, $n? Still alive? You aren't trashing my explosive stockpiles are you? Hmmm... you say you found a clear crystal pendant. That makes sense. A perfect prism would refract the gaze of the basilisk. Maybe we can use this to our advantage. Time to drop some science!
text.completed: Use the Headquarters Radio in the main forge building of the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara.

english.title: The Perfect Prism
english.objectives: Acquire a Crystal Pendant from a Talrendis Saboteur in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine.
english.description: There's got to be a way to reverse the basilisks' stonification. Those irritating night elf saboteurs who have been lurking around my mine must know something we don't. They seem to be immune to the gaze of the beast!$B$BI want you to find out their secret, $N. Pick off a few of the Talrendis saboteurs skulking about in the rear of the strip mine and get a sample of whatever charm or ding-dong they're wearing to give them immunity. Radio me from the main forge building once you're successful.
english.completion: Is that you, $n? Still alive? You aren't trashing my explosive stockpiles are you? Hmmm... you say you found a clear crystal pendant. That makes sense. A perfect prism would refract the gaze of the basilisk. Maybe we can use this to our advantage. Time to drop some science!
english.completed: Use the Headquarters Radio in the main forge building of the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara.

text.title: Furien's Footsteps
text.objectives: The Ancient Tablets at the Shrine of Elune have directed you to visit three of the prominent ruins in Sargeron.
text.description: You can decipher bits and pieces of the text, but it will require extensive study before Furien's work becomes coherent.$b$bFor now, as you look off to the northeast, you think you can make out some of the ruins depicted in the journal.$b$bFrom what you can tell, these ruins seem to have been of some significance to Furien's research.
text.completion: It is clear to you now that these ruins are those that Furien recorded in his journal. After examining the engravings upon the ruins themselves, you feel that you are able to decipher more of Furien's writings.

english.title: Furien's Footsteps
english.objectives: The Ancient Tablets at the Shrine of Elune have directed you to visit three of the prominent ruins in Sargeron.
english.description: You can decipher bits and pieces of the text, but it will require extensive study before Furien's work becomes coherent.$b$bFor now, as you look off to the northeast, you think you can make out some of the ruins depicted in the journal.$b$bFrom what you can tell, these ruins seem to have been of some significance to Furien's research.
english.completion: It is clear to you now that these ruins are those that Furien recorded in his journal. After examining the engravings upon the ruins themselves, you feel that you are able to decipher more of Furien's writings.

text.title: 棱镜的粉碎
text.objectives: 把水晶坠饰带到山麓矿场总部的武器柜旁。
text.description: 假如你的棱镜被调校用来反射蜥蜴的石化视线，那么也可以利用它的晶体属性逆转这一过程。我们所需要的是一束能量源。$B$B你右边的武器柜里放着我们的激光矿钻样机，我爱那玩意儿，可每天都有肢解事故也挺烦人。拿上激光钻，把镜头用水晶换下来……
text.completed: 把水晶坠饰带到山麓矿场总部的武器柜旁。

english.title: Prismbreak
english.objectives: Take the Crystal Pendant to the Weapons Cabinet in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine Headquarters.
english.description: If that prism of yours is tuned to refract a basilisk's gaze, we can use its crystal properties to reverse the process. All we need is a source of power.$B$BIn the weapons cabinet to your right, you'll find our prototype laser mining drill. I loved that thing but the near daily dismemberments got to be a real bother. Grab the laser drill and swap out the lens with that crystal of yours...
english.completed: Take the Crystal Pendant to the Weapons Cabinet in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine Headquarters.

text.title: 没什么是几颗瓜解决不了的
text.objectives: 收集8枚瓜果。
text.description: 废墟上的标记，让你明白了一件事：艾露恩庇护所的旧喷泉有什么蹊跷。$B$B看样子，如果用泉水洗脸的话，人们就能获得特殊的力量。当然，首先，远古喷泉里得有某样用来洗的东西才行。$B$B你正在思忖着，突然在附近的大树脚下发现了一颗瓜果……
text.completion: After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font. Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.
text.completed: Squeeze the Melonfruit juices into the Cup of Elune at Sargeron in Desolace.

english.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
english.objectives: Gather 8 Melonfruit.
english.description: The markings on the ruins here make one thing clear: There is something special about the old fountain in the Sanctuary of Elune.$b$bIt would seem that one could expect special power from washing their face in the fountain. First, of course, there would need to be something in the ancient fountain with which to wash.$b$bPondering this problem, you spot a melonfruit at the base of a nearby tree....
english.completion: After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font. Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess.
english.completed: Squeeze the Melonfruit juices into the Cup of Elune at Sargeron in Desolace.

text.title: 重塑血肉
text.objectives: 用血肉重塑器活化8个山麓矿场里的山麓矿工。
text.description: <附近的无线电在呼叫你。>$B$B嗨，$N，你拿到枪了吗？好的！别直接对着自己的眼睛。$B$B瞄准石化工人，折射光应该就能逆转石化进程。要么就是烧化他们，管它的，我的工人得能给我挣钱，要是活化重塑过程让他们精神不正常，杀了他们还能拿份保险。霍扎克完毕！
text.progress: Hey look, all your limbs are intact.
text.completion: Ah, good. Now we can get these slackers back to work. You've earned a cut of the profits though - minus the usual company fees. Take your pick!
text.completed: Return to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Refleshification
english.objectives: Use The Refleshifier to de-stonify eight Mountainfoot Miners within the Mountainfoot Strip Mine.
english.description: <The nearby radio calls out to you.>$B$BHey $N, you got that gun? Good! Don't point it directly at your eye.$B$BAim that baby at my stonified workers and the refracted light should reverse the petrification process. Or it will melt them. Whatever. Return my workers to a state of profitability! And if the refleshification process makes them crazy-go-nuts, they should be killed for insurance purposes. Horzak OUT!
english.progress: Hey look, all your limbs are intact.
english.completion: Ah, good. Now we can get these slackers back to work. You've earned a cut of the profits though - minus the usual company fees. Take your pick!
english.completed: Return to Horzak Zignibble at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 一切都变得更加清楚了
text.objectives: 弗瑞恩的日志指示你在北萨格隆找到艾露恩的宫殿。
text.description: 发生了某种变化……也许是艾露恩净化仪式的副作用。$B$B尽管不可能完全掌握日志上的远古语言，但你对它们的理解还是突飞猛进。$B$B萨格隆北部山川里的废墟似乎是弗瑞恩最为热衷的。他觉得，那里有某种东西可以帮他把联盟从这一地区赶走。$B$B你合上日志，决心要找到废墟，发现它的秘密。
text.completion: It is clear to you now why you were guided here. You recognize this ancient runestone from Furien's final journal entry: "The ancients revered the gems created by this mystical object, claiming that they were gifts from the goddess herself. It was believed that they were weapons capable of delivering them from any enemy."

english.title: All Becoming Clearer
english.objectives: Furien's Journal has directed you to find the ruined Palace of Elune in northern Sargeron.
english.description: Something has changed... perhaps a side-effect of Elune's cleansing ritual.$b$bWhile it's by no means perfect yet, your understanding of the ancient language in the journal has vastly improved.$b$bThe ruins in the northern mountains of Sargeron appear to be the main focus of Furien's enthusiasm. Something there, he felt, would aid him in driving the Alliance from this region.$b$bYou close the journal determined to find this ruin and discover its secrets.
english.completion: It is clear to you now why you were guided here. You recognize this ancient runestone from Furien's final journal entry: "The ancients revered the gems created by this mystical object, claiming that they were gifts from the goddess herself. It was believed that they were weapons capable of delivering them from any enemy."

text.title: 点火棒
text.objectives: You are to create a Raging Vortex by defeating 7 Disciples of Elune in the presence of your firestorm.$b$bShould you lose your Vortex Gem, another can be obtained from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
text.description: You are now able to understand the script in which the journal was written.$b$bAlong the runestone, it is explained that the monument's gemstones were imbued with the power to summon a firestorm.$b$bThe storm could grow to be a mighty weapon either through sustained worship of Elune, or charged by spiritual energies of the fallen.$b$bLooking down upon the newly revealed ghosts of Elune's disciples, you reason that you have neither the time, nor the inclination to worship the goddess of your enemy....
text.completion: It is done! Furien's exhaustive research was not in vain. The raging Vortex is ready to be unleashed upon your enemies at last!

english.title: Firestarter
english.objectives: You are to create a Raging Vortex by defeating 7 Disciples of Elune in the presence of your firestorm.$b$bShould you lose your Vortex Gem, another can be obtained from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
english.description: You are now able to understand the script in which the journal was written.$b$bAlong the runestone, it is explained that the monument's gemstones were imbued with the power to summon a firestorm.$b$bThe storm could grow to be a mighty weapon either through sustained worship of Elune, or charged by spiritual energies of the fallen.$b$bLooking down upon the newly revealed ghosts of Elune's disciples, you reason that you have neither the time, nor the inclination to worship the goddess of your enemy....
english.completion: It is done! Furien's exhaustive research was not in vain. The raging Vortex is ready to be unleashed upon your enemies at last!

text.title: 达成指标
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的山麓矿场拿20块山麓铁矿。
text.description: 山麓铁矿是种脆弱的合金，但只要上下打点好了，它就能达到地精的安全标准。负责生产的齐格尼伯出了岔子，但我的工期不能变。我手头是有指标的！$B$B到山麓矿场里去拿上你能找到的山麓铁矿，它们应该已经提炼好了准备装货。
text.progress: Did you get my shipment together?
text.completion: Well done! When it comes to iron, always pick quantity over quality.
text.completed: Bring the iron to Foreman Fisk at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: A Quota to Meet
english.objectives: Gather 20 ingots of Mountainfoot Iron from the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara.
english.description: Mountainfoot iron is a brittle alloy, but with the right bribes it meets goblin safety standards. Zignibble here is having trouble on the production end of things, but that doesn't change any of my deadlines. I've got a quota to fill!$B$BHead down into the Mountainfoot Strip Mine and gather up any ingots of Mountainfoot iron you find. There should be piles of it smelted and ready for shipment.
english.progress: Did you get my shipment together?
english.completion: Well done! When it comes to iron, always pick quantity over quality.
english.completed: Bring the iron to Foreman Fisk at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: Rider on the Storm
text.objectives: Use the Raging Vortex Gem at Nijel's Point Ruin. While commanding your firestorm, kill 40 Nijel's Point Defenders and burn 15 Nijel's Point Merchants.$b$bShould you lose your Raging Vortex Gem, you may acquire another from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
text.description: You cannot help but to feel a twinge of pride, having unlocked this long lost secret of the ancient worshippers of Elune.$b$bYou now possess the power to inflict great damage upon your enemy.$b$bAs it was Furien's tireless work that made this possible, it only seems right that the weapon should be unleashed upon those who took his life.$b$bThe Alliance scum at Nijel's Point shall pay for their offenses against the Horde!
text.completion: Very impressive, $c. You completed Furien's work and rained vengeance down upon his killers. You have brought peace to my brother's soul, and to my mind. Please accept this gift for your diligence.
text.completed: Return to Cerelia at Furien's Post in Desolace.

english.title: Rider on the Storm
english.objectives: Use the Raging Vortex Gem at Nijel's Point Ruin. While commanding your firestorm, kill 40 Nijel's Point Defenders and burn 15 Nijel's Point Merchants.$b$bShould you lose your Raging Vortex Gem, you may acquire another from the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
english.description: You cannot help but to feel a twinge of pride, having unlocked this long lost secret of the ancient worshippers of Elune.$b$bYou now possess the power to inflict great damage upon your enemy.$b$bAs it was Furien's tireless work that made this possible, it only seems right that the weapon should be unleashed upon those who took his life.$b$bThe Alliance scum at Nijel's Point shall pay for their offenses against the Horde!
english.completion: Very impressive, $c. You completed Furien's work and rained vengeance down upon his killers. You have brought peace to my brother's soul, and to my mind. Please accept this gift for your diligence.
english.completed: Return to Cerelia at Furien's Post in Desolace.

text.title: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight
text.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
text.description: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.
text.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at Forlorn Woods in Crystalsong Forest.

english.title: Proof of Demise: The Black Knight
english.objectives: Archmage Lan'dalock in Dalaran wants you to return with a Fragment of the Black Knight's Soul.$B$BThis quest may only be completed on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: My counterpart, Archmage Timear, has asked me to warn you of something dire. Soon, you will be participating in the Trial of the Champions at the Argent Coliseum in Icecrown. You must beware of interference from one known only as the Black Knight.$B$BBring me a fragment of his soul that the Kirin Tor will know he is dealt with. I am told that failing to do so will be your own undoing.
english.completed: Return to Archmage Lan'dalock at Forlorn Woods in Crystalsong Forest.

text.title: 一沙一世界
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉的门纳尔湖遗迹附近收集5件重见天日的神器。
text.description: 在东边门纳尔湖附近，遗迹有着自己的故事。低等种族——比如那些粗鄙的矮人——会用铲子和锄头来寻找真实。<梅琳妮皱皱鼻子。>我们的方法要高雅得多。$B$B我的占卜法术或许生疏了，可只要道具齐全，我还是能窥透时间的叠嶂。先祖的尸骨已经腐朽，可他们的陪葬或许还在——给我带些来。
text.progress: Have you gotten your hands dirty for me?
text.completion: So the spirits of the dead still haunt those old stones, hm? Well $n, as it happens, I'm counting on their help. Let's see what the dead have to say...
text.completed: Bring the recovered artifacts to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: A Thousand Stories in the Sand
english.objectives: Collect 5 Recovered Artifacts from the ruins around Lake Mennar in Azshara.
english.description: The ruins around Lake Mennar, to our east, have a tale to tell. The lesser races - like those clumsy dwarves - would go after the truth with picks and shovels. <Malynea wrinkles her nose.> We'll be using more elegant methods.$B$BMy scrying magic is somewhat rusty, but with the right trinket I should be able to peer through the shrouds of time. The bones of my forefathers have long since rotted away but some of their personal treasures may remain - bring me some.
english.progress: Have you gotten your hands dirty for me?
english.completion: So the spirits of the dead still haunt those old stones, hm? Well $n, as it happens, I'm counting on their help. Let's see what the dead have to say...
english.completed: Bring the recovered artifacts to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 调查湖畔
text.objectives: 护送一名初级地精勘测员前往门纳尔湖边的三处测量员设备处，并在抄取读数时保护她。你可以用勘测员的信标召唤另一名勘测员。
text.description: 要想挖掘艾萨拉的全部宝藏，这些脏兮兮的古代遗迹都得推平。往我的地图这儿瞧——你看到什么了？东边的门纳尔湖？告诉你，我在这儿看到了未来的火箭燃料仓贮一期工程！$B$B可在填湖造地，开山铺路之前，我们得有精确的地形测绘。我所有的勘测员都被这片地区的鬼脸嘟嘟吓跑了。护送一名初级勘测员到设置好的仪器那儿去抄取一下读数。
text.progress: No buncha dead elves can put a stop to progress. Not on my watch!
text.completion: Beautiful work! Now that we know the area better, we can tear this lake a new one.
text.completed: Return to Custer Clubnik at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Survey the Lakeshore
english.objectives: Escort a Goblin Surveyor to the three pieces of Surveyor's Equipment that surround Lake Mennar, and defend her while she takes readings. Another Surveyor can always be summoned with your Surveyor's Beacon.
english.description: All these cruddy ancient ruins have to be bulldozed if we're ever to see Azshara's full potential. Look on my map here - you see Lake Mennar, to the East? I'll tell you what I see: a future rocket fuel depot!$B$BBut we need an accurate lay of the land before we can clearcut, bulldoze, landfill, and pave over that lake. All of my surveyors have been spooked off by the oogly-boogleys haunting that area. Escort one of my Jr. grade surveyors to the area and take readings from the equipment that's been set up.
english.progress: No buncha dead elves can put a stop to progress. Not on my watch!
english.completion: Beautiful work! Now that we know the area better, we can tear this lake a new one.
english.completed: Return to Custer Clubnik at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 浸水的配方
text.objectives: 将被浸透的配方交给达拉然城中的克莉丝蒂·斯多克顿。
text.description: 看起来，这张被水浸透的纸上应该是记录着一种烈性酒的酿造配方。也许达拉然“再来一杯”的店主会对这个感兴趣……
text.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
text.completion: This is quite a find, $n.  I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.
text.completed: Return to Christi Stockton at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

english.title: Waterlogged Recipe
english.objectives: Bring the Waterlogged Recipe to Christi Stockton in the Dalaran city.
english.description: This appears to be the remains of a mixture for potent wine.  Perhaps the proprietor of One More Glass in Dalaran would be interested in it....
english.progress: Wine is only as fine as the person drinking it, I always say.
english.completion: This is quite a find, $n.  I can't have you selling this to anyone else, so I'm willing to offer generously.
english.completed: Return to Christi Stockton at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

text.title: 来自阴影
text.objectives: 击败6只血牙潜伏者。
text.description: 他也变成了怪物……是吗？我们要怎么才能去和那些会把我们变成怪物的东西作战？$B$B我想，好好利用我父亲的军械库会成为一个好的开端。$B$B狼人隐匿在前面的街巷中。我的猎犬可以帮你找出他们的踪迹。$B$B要搬运这些炮弹，就必须清掉沿途的障碍。
text.completion: Excellent.  I'll start rounding up some help to get these cannons positioned.
text.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at the Military District in Gilneas City.

english.title: From the Shadows
english.objectives: Defeat 6 Bloodfang Lurkers.
english.description: He turned into one of them... didn't he?  How do we even begin to fight an enemy that can do this to us?$B$BMy father's arsenal's certainly a good start, I suppose.$B$BWorgen are hiding in the alleys ahead.  Take one of my mastiffs to find them more easily.$B$BWe're going to need to clear the way ahead if we're going to move these cannons above ground.
english.completion: Excellent.  I'll start rounding up some help to get these cannons positioned.
english.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at the Military District in Gilneas City.

text.title: 黏糊糊的发动机
text.objectives: 检查克拉伯尼克的推土机，收集一份粘阻引擎的外溅液样本。
text.description: 那些古代遗迹历经了千万年的风吹雨打依然不倒，所以我让我最大最好的推土机出场来对付它们。我叫她“玛基尼”。$B$B但最近她让我挺失望。就在我开进那片闹鬼的林子时，只听引擎毛骨悚然的一声厉叫，熄火了。我的工程师说是阀门给什么堵住了。去检查一下玛基尼的发动机舱，把阻塞物给我带来。
text.progress: Margene is one heck of a machine, isn't she?
text.completion: Busted ball bearings! Look at this stuff - ugh, SMELL this stuff - my poor, poor dozer! $n, I consider myself a goop expert and this here goop ain't natural. It's supernatural. This is ghost goop. We're going to need more than a mechanic...
text.completed: Bring the Ectosplatter Sample to Custer Clubnik at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Gunk in the Trunk
english.objectives: Inspect Clubnik's Dozer and collect a sample of the Ectosplatter that's gumming up the engine.
english.description: Those ancient ruins have survived ten thousand years of wind and weather, so I brought out my biggest and bestest bulldozer to flatten 'em. I call her "Margene."$B$BBut my dozer's been letting me down lately, $N. The moment I drove her into those haunted woods, her engine seized up with a spine-chilling howl. Now my engineers tell me something's clogging her valves. Go over there and inspect Margene's engine compartment, and bring me back a sample of whatever gunk has her stalled.
english.progress: Margene is one heck of a machine, isn't she?
english.completion: Busted ball bearings! Look at this stuff - ugh, SMELL this stuff - my poor, poor dozer! $n, I consider myself a goop expert and this here goop ain't natural. It's supernatural. This is ghost goop. We're going to need more than a mechanic...
english.completed: Bring the Ectosplatter Sample to Custer Clubnik at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 牺牲
text.objectives: 与达利乌斯·克罗雷领主一同诱走30个血牙猎手。
text.description: $N，你不需要这样做。你给予我们的帮助已经够多了。$B$B当然如果你坚持留下的话……我也不会拒绝。$B$B我已经在教堂部署了防御兵力，随时准备迎敌。$B$B我正准备赶往那里，顺便诱走沿途那些浑身长虱的怪物。欢迎你与我同行。
text.completion: Brace yourself, $n. Here they come.
text.completed: Speak to Tobias Mistmantle at the Light's Dawn Cathedral in Gilneas City.

english.title: Sacrifices
english.objectives: Ride with Lord Darius Crowley and round up 30 Bloodfang Stalkers.
english.description: You don't have to do this, $N.  You've done more than enough already.$B$BBut if you decide to stay... I'd be a fool to turn you away.$B$BMy men have fortified their position inside the cathedral and are ready for what comes next.$B$BI'm about to head there and take as many of these flea-ridden devils with me as I can.  You're welcome to come along for the ride.
english.completion: Brace yourself, $n. Here they come.
english.completed: Speak to Tobias Mistmantle at the Light's Dawn Cathedral in Gilneas City.

text.title: 十枚魔印
text.objectives: 你要从萨格隆邪恶的萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放进艾露恩的火盆。
text.description: 根据弗瑞恩的日志，放在这里的远古火盆是为了举行牺牲仪式用的。$B$B就你从词条上所能辨认的来看，只要有人能将艾露恩敌人的魔印放进火盆的余烬中，他就能获得祝福。$B$B瞧了瞧四周，你认为现在支配着这一区域的萨特应该很合适。
text.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Ten Pounds of Flesh
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: According to Furien's Journal, this ancient brazier was placed here for the performing of sacrifices.$b$bAs far as you can make out from the entry, a blessing is bestowed upon the being who places the flesh of Elune's enemies on the brazier's burning embers.$b$bLooking around, you determine that the satyrs who now possess this region would likely qualify.
english.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 给格雷迈恩的消息
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: $N，好啦。接下来的事情就交给我们来负责吧。$B$B请转告格雷迈恩国王，我父亲的军械库内的物资任由他支配。这里的军火储备足够将狼人轰到北海去。
text.completion: I knew Crowley would come through.  His weapons will be more than useful to us.

english.title: Message to Greymane
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the Military District.
english.description: It's time, $N.  We'll take it from here.$B$BTell King Greymane that my father's arsenal will be at his disposal.  There's more than enough firepower here to blow the worgen from here to the north sea.
english.completion: I knew Crowley would come through.  His weapons will be more than useful to us.

text.title: 亡者的回忆
text.objectives: 把卡莱莎的指环带往门纳尔湖岸。触碰卡莱莎的灵魂重温她的回忆，同其他灵魂交谈，了解门纳尔湖的秘密。
text.description: 你发现的这枚戒指上，符文依然清晰可鉴：它是“卡莱莎”在学院的入学纪念。假以魔法，这件私人物品就能成为与其灵魂沟通的桥梁。$B$B把戒指带回门纳尔湖，卡莱莎的灵魂将在湖边显现。触碰它，戒指就能把你带回她的世界，重温她的最后时光。刺探她的想法，$N！同其他幽灵交谈，找出门纳尔湖的秘密……
text.completion: You reel as the spirit's vision fades, relieved to once again feel the earth beneath your feet and the comforting rhythm of your own quickened heart.
text.completed: 把卡莱莎的指环带往门纳尔湖岸。触碰卡莱莎的灵魂重温她的回忆，同其他灵魂交谈，了解门纳尔湖的秘密。

english.title: Memories of the Dead
english.objectives: Take Kalytha's Ring to the shores of Lake Mennar. Touch the Spirit of Kalytha to relive her memories. Speak to the other spirits until you've learned the secret of Lake Mennar.
english.description: The runes on this ring you found are still legible: it was given to "Kalytha" when she was granted admission to the Academy. With the right spell or two, this personal trinket of hers is the gateway to her soul.$B$BTake the ring back to Lake Mennar. Kalytha's spirit should now be visible to you on the shore of the lake. Touch her and the ring will allow you to see the world as she sees it, forever reliving her final hours. Probe her mind, $N! Speak to the others and learn the secrets of Lake Mennar...
english.completion: You reel as the spirit's vision fades, relieved to once again feel the earth beneath your feet and the comforting rhythm of your own quickened heart.
english.completed: Take Kalytha's Ring to the shores of Lake Mennar. Touch the Spirit of Kalytha to relive her memories. Speak to the other spirits until you've learned the secret of Lake Mennar.

text.title: 萨希恩之石的传说
text.objectives: 从门纳尔湖底找回萨希恩之石。
text.description: 临死之前，卡莱莎受人嘱托在湖底埋藏了一件东西，门纳尔的大法师们在生命最后一刻制造的强大神器。难怪梅琳妮·碎天者一定想要见识见识，只要它还存在。你定要在门纳尔湖底找到萨希恩之石。
text.progress: Did you discover anything at the lake? You're soaking wet.
text.completion: A Sarcen stone? That's the stuff of legend - let me see that! $n, Sarcen stones are used to redirect the ley lines of magical energy. You realize what this means? The mages of Mennar weren't staying behind out of misguided loyalty. They sacrificed their lives in order to create this artifact in an attempt to draw energy away from the portal through which the demons were flooding Azeroth. They were buying time for the rest of the world to fight back! History never recorded their deeds. What a discovery!
text.completed: Bring the Sarcen Stone to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

english.title: Mystery of the Sarcen Stone
english.objectives: Retrieve the Sarcen Stone from the bottom of Lake Mennar.
english.description: Before she died, Kalytha was charged with burying something at the bottom of the lake, a powerful artifact that the archmages of Mennar spent their last moments creating. No doubt Malynea Skyreaver will want to see the artifact, presuming it still exists. You resolve to search the bottom of Lake Mennar for the Sarcen Stone.
english.progress: Did you discover anything at the lake? You're soaking wet.
english.completion: A Sarcen stone? That's the stuff of legend - let me see that! $n, Sarcen stones are used to redirect the ley lines of magical energy. You realize what this means? The mages of Mennar weren't staying behind out of misguided loyalty. They sacrificed their lives in order to create this artifact in an attempt to draw energy away from the portal through which the demons were flooding Azeroth. They were buying time for the rest of the world to fight back! History never recorded their deeds. What a discovery!
english.completed: Bring the Sarcen Stone to Malynea Skyreaver at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange in Azshara.

text.title: 萨特贡品
text.objectives: 你要从萨格隆邪恶的萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放进艾露恩的火盆。
text.description: 远古遗迹就这样把本该赐予你敌人的祝福加持在了你的身上，你觉得很有意思。$B$B你决定尽量多占有一些这无心之赐。
text.progress: The brazier silently awaits an offering.
text.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Satyrical Offerings
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: You find it most amusing to think that this ancient relic is bestowing upon you a blessing meant for your enemies.$b$bYou determine to make as much as you can of this unintentional gift.
english.progress: The brazier silently awaits an offering.
english.completion: The divine brazier indiscriminately endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 以鲜血与灰烬之名
text.objectives: 使用叛军大炮杀死80个血牙猎手。
text.description: $N，时机已经成熟。想要大规模地削减他们的数量，就得抓住眼前这个难得的机会。$B$B我们占据了有利的地理位置。$B$B我们拥有强大的火药。$B$B接下来就要看我们有没有勇气了……我相信，你绝不是个懦夫。
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've done more than could be asked of any Gilnean. We're running low on ammunition.  It's time to regroup inside now.
text.completed: Return to Tobias Mistmantle outside the Light's Dawn Cathedral in Gilneas City.

english.title: By Blood and Ash
english.objectives: Slay 80 Bloodfang Stalkers using the Rebel Cannons.
english.description: The time has come, $N.  If we're going to put a dent in their numbers, the time is now.$B$BWe have the position.$B$BWe have the firepower.$B$BAll that remains to be seen is whether we have the courage... and I sure don't see a coward standing in front of me.
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  You've done more than could be asked of any Gilnean. We're running low on ammunition.  It's time to regroup inside now.
english.completed: Return to Tobias Mistmantle outside the Light's Dawn Cathedral in Gilneas City.

text.title: 追根问柄！
text.objectives: 你要从这一地区的武器架和邪恶的萨特身上收集20把萨特军刀，将它们贡给艾露恩的侍女像。
text.description: 你立刻从弗瑞恩日志的草图上认出了这座雕像。$B$B尽管附注词条上的字眼你难以理解，但草图本身就足够说明问题了。在战斗过后，敌人的武器要被弃在盆里，作为某种神圣馈赠的交换。$B$B正在你琢磨这个仪式的时候，一旁武器架上钢铁的反光映入了你的眼帘……
text.progress: The statue stands expectantly.
text.completion: With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift. You can't help but wonder what Elune would think of someone such as you receiving one of her boons.

english.title: To the Hilt!
english.objectives: You are to collect 20 Satyr Sabers from the weapon racks and various satyrs in the region, then place them upon the statue, Elune's Handmaiden.
english.description: You immediately recognize this statue from a sketch in Furien's Journal.$b$bThough the words associated with the entry elude you, the sketch seems self-explanatory. After battle, the enemies' weapons were to be cast upon the basin in exchange for a divine gift of some sort.$b$bAs you ponder this ritual, the glint of steel catches your eye from a nearby weapon rack....
english.progress: The statue stands expectantly.
english.completion: With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift. You can't help but wonder what Elune would think of someone such as you receiving one of her boons.

text.title: 绝不投降，偶尔撤退
text.objectives: 跟圣光黎明大教堂的达利乌斯·克罗雷领主谈一谈。
text.description: 这批弹药原本是为内战储备的。如果打内战，再耗上一个月都没问题。但是狼人的数量实在是太多了，军械库已经快空了。$B$B一旦弹药耗尽，我们可不想束手就擒。返回教堂，向领主汇报这一情况。我相信老克罗雷会知道接下来该怎么做的。
text.completion: We've given them everything we have... yet still they come.  Do not worry, $n.  We'll slay many more before today is over.

english.title: Never Surrender, Sometimes Retreat
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Darius Crowley inside the Light's Dawn Cathedral.
english.description: We had enough ammunition to carry on the civil war for another month.  Yet the worgen's numbers are such that we're nearly spent.$B$BWe don't want to be caught out here in the open when that happens.  Fall back inside the cathedral and report to the boss.  I'm sure old Crowley will know what to do next.
english.completion: We've given them everything we have... yet still they come.  Do not worry, $n.  We'll slay many more before today is over.

text.title: 破釜沉舟
text.objectives: 杀死8个狂暴猎手。
text.description: $N，我们已经占据了有利的位置。如果你想要祷告，请随意。$B$B来吧，杀死这些渣滓。
text.progress: We can do this, $N.
text.completion: They... they've stopped coming. No, $n.  That's not a good thing.
text.completed: Return to Lord Darius Crowley inside the Cathedral of Light in Gilneas City.

english.title: Last Stand
english.objectives: Kill 8 Frenzied Stalkers.
english.description: We've got a good chokepoint here, $N.  Feel free to say a prayer if that's your sort of thing.$B$BTake courage and let's kill these mutts.
english.progress: We can do this, $N.
english.completion: They... they've stopped coming. No, $n.  That's not a good thing.
english.completed: Return to Lord Darius Crowley inside the Cathedral of Light in Gilneas City.

text.title: 心平气和
text.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to kill Kohor.
text.description: We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Horde launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that nothing takes us by surprise.$b$bRecently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the east. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.$b$bTheir days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!
text.completion: It is done. Sorrem should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

english.title: Peace of Mind
english.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to kill Kohor.
english.description: We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Horde launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that nothing takes us by surprise.$b$bRecently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the east. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.$b$bTheir days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!
english.completion: It is done. Sorrem should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.

text.title: 眼见为实
text.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to find the Ancient Summoning Ritual in Thunder Axe Fortress.
text.description: With his dying breath, Kohor mentioned the summoning of a demon that could threaten the entire region.$b$bHe may have been bluffing, but that's not a chance worth taking.$b$bThis cannot wait for the Horde's invasion of Desolace to take shape. You must scour Thunder Axe Fortress for clues and bring an end to this potential threat.
text.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
text.completion: It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this. No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

english.title: You'll Know It When You See It
english.objectives: Sorrem at Furien's Post wants you to find the Ancient Summoning Ritual in Thunder Axe Fortress.
english.description: With his dying breath, Kohor mentioned the summoning of a demon that could threaten the entire region.$b$bHe may have been bluffing, but that's not a chance worth taking.$b$bThis cannot wait for the Horde's invasion of Desolace to take shape. You must scour Thunder Axe Fortress for clues and bring an end to this potential threat.
english.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
english.completion: It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this. No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!

text.title: 脚下的麻烦
text.objectives: 使用私人奥术助手将12名雷加什恶魔变成虫子碾死。
text.description: 瞧瞧你，都跑起腿来了。责任心挺强啊。你就这样天天向上，天天……向上！$B$B但是有恶魔在前，各种糟糕的恶魔，他们都要吃你的肚肠！雷加什恶魔开往东南方向，不过别紧张。别，别，别紧张。我给你来帮大忙！$B$B瞄准、变成虫子、一脚下去都死光。瞄准、变成虫子、一脚下去都死光！行之有效也很脏……不过真的别紧张。别，别，别紧张，因为完事之后我们不管打扫这地方！
text.completion: Do not fret, and better yet, do not forget, to do not let the bug juice set or you will regret... well, you'll regret the smell of your boots really! It won't smell good today and it won't smell good even more tomorrow!
text.completed: Return to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Ruins of Nordressa.

english.title: Trouble Under Foot
english.objectives: Use your Personal Arcane Assistant to turn 12 Legash demons into insects and then squash them.
english.description: Look at you. Doing errands. Quite responsible of you. You're moving up up up, you are... up up!$B$BThere be demons ahead! Demons of many unpleasant kinds. Demons that would quite like your innards! Legash demons of a southeasternly heading! But do not worry. No no, no reason to worry, for I shall provide you with a companion!$B$BPoint, bugify, squash. Point, bugify, squash! Quite efficient. Quite messy too... but again, worry not. No no, worry not, for afterwards, we don't have to clean up!
english.completion: Do not fret, and better yet, do not forget, to do not let the bug juice set or you will regret... well, you'll regret the smell of your boots really! It won't smell good today and it won't smell good even more tomorrow!
english.completed: Return to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Ruins of Nordressa.

text.title: 收集徽记
text.objectives: Collect 100 Bleached Skulls from Thunder Axe Fortress, place them at the Burning Blade Summoning Circle, then kill Nazargen.
text.description: 看来是真的……$B$B你在雷斧堡垒找到的羊皮纸上详细地记载着恶魔召唤仪式的步骤。它比火刃氏族掌握的所有召唤法阵还要强大。$B$B很明显，我们必须不惜代价破坏这个仪式！$B$B如果能提前将恶魔召唤出来，那么这场危机或许有化解的机会。
text.completion: You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c. If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with. Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.
text.completed: Speak to Sorrem at Furien's Post.

english.title: Putting Their Heads Together
english.objectives: Collect 100 Bleached Skulls from Thunder Axe Fortress, place them at the Burning Blade Summoning Circle, then kill Nazargen.
english.description: So it's true....$b$bThe parchment you discovered in Thunder Axe Fortress details a powerful summoning ritual. One stronger than the Burning Blade have ever been known to possess.$b$bClearly, this rite must be stopped at all costs!$b$bPerhaps if this demon were summoned forth prematurely the crisis could be averted.
english.completion: You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c. If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with. Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.
english.completed: Speak to Sorrem at Furien's Post.

text.title: 体力劳动
text.objectives: 从雷加什营地拿回护法师手册。
text.description: 这里的恶魔似乎很喜欢把我们的奥术卷册偷走。我高度怀疑他们是不是有能耐读懂，还只是为了折腾我们。$B$B其他的书也就算了，但是他们把护法师手册也拿走了。没有它我完全无法保证能让像你这样的学徒活过克希雷姆的“试炼”。去东南方雷加什营地找到那些恶魔，把护法师手册拿回来。$B$B就这些，跑起来。
text.progress: And here you are... back... talking to me again. I assume this means that you have my book?
text.completion: Peachy. Back to work then. Thanks, snookums.
text.completed: Return to Teresa Spireleaf at the Ruins of Nordressa.

english.title: Manual Labor
english.objectives: Retrieve the Abjurer's Manual from the Lagash Encampment.
english.description: The local demons seem to get quite a kick out of stealing all of our arcane manuals. I highly doubt most of them can even read, so they're probably doing it just to spite us.$B$BI could care less about most of the books they've taken, but they took an Abjurer's Manual that I'm going to need if there's any hope of keeping apprentices like you alive amidst Xylem's "trials." Find the demons at the Lagash Encampment to the southeast and retrieve the Abjurer's Manual.$B$BThat's all. Scoot.
english.progress: And here you are... back... talking to me again. I assume this means that you have my book?
english.completion: Peachy. Back to work then. Thanks, snookums.
english.completed: Return to Teresa Spireleaf at the Ruins of Nordressa.

text.title: 耳饰在燃烧
text.objectives: 你要给弗瑞恩的哨站的苏伦收集25个火刃耳饰。
text.description: 苏伦毫不掩饰自己对雷斧堡垒里火刃部族的厌恶。$B$B显然，他们一命呜呼的证据能在他那里换个好价钱。
text.progress: What have you there, $c?
text.completion: Ears of the Burning Blade? Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

english.title: Ears Are Burning
english.objectives: You are to bring 25 Burning Blade Ears to Sorrem at Furien's Post.
english.description: Sorrem has made no secret of his disdain for the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress.$b$bSurely, proof of their demise would be of value to him.
english.progress: What have you there, $c?
english.completion: Ears of the Burning Blade? Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!

text.title: 兽人会写字？
text.objectives: 将战地日记交给失落群岛船难海岸的莎希·硬钳。
text.description: 你在兽人的尸体上找到一本战地日记。书页严重浸水，勉强能辨认出上面的文字。$B$B你翻看着笔记，发现它记载了一个有趣的故事。还好你学过兽人语。$B$B和贸易大王的游艇一样，兽人的战舰也是被联盟击沉的。现在想想，在联盟开火前，你的确看到过一艘兽人战舰。或许联盟的目标本来就是兽人？$B$B愚蠢的兽人！都是因为他们，游艇才遭殃的！
text.progress: $n, find anything interesting in the cavern?
text.completion: Orcs?! They were sunk and stranded too?  And now the Alliance are on the island? Do you think they're going to kill us? I think it's time for a little sitdown with these orcs.

english.title: Orcs Can Write?
english.objectives: Take the Field Journal to Sassy Hardwrench at Shipwreck Shore on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Looking through the dead orc's belongings, you find a field journal. Though it is heavily water damaged, the writing is still legible, if barely.$B$BFlipping through the pages, an interesting story unfolds. Good thing you decided to study Orcish.$B$BLike the Trade Prince's yacht, the orcs were fired upon by Alliance warships. You do remember an orc warship that you passed right before the Alliance opened fire. Maybe they were firing on the orcs instead of your ship?$B$BStupid orcs! They got you sunk!
english.progress: $n, find anything interesting in the cavern?
english.completion: Orcs?! They were sunk and stranded too?  And now the Alliance are on the island? Do you think they're going to kill us? I think it's time for a little sitdown with these orcs.

text.title: 敌人的敌人就是……
text.objectives: 将战地日记交给失落群岛部落营地的阿格娜。
text.description: 我也不想让你跑这一趟，但是这不正是你的价值所在吗？将这本兽人的战地日记送去部落的营地吧。$B$B根据记载，沿着东南方卡亚矿洞旁边的斜坡一直走就可以抵达他们的营地。$B$B$N，祝你好运。我真的很喜欢你。
text.progress: You must have been on the $r slave ship that was sunk. What's that you have in your hand?
text.completion: I apologize. It has been a very rough couple of days for all of us. I am Aggra. All of us here are what remains of the crew of the Draka's Fury. Perhaps we can work together. We have a common enemy in the Alliance. Their SI:7 assassins are all over this island and they're not going to stop until we're all dead.

english.title: The Enemy of My Enemy
english.objectives: Deliver the Field Journal to Aggra at the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles.
english.description: I hate to ask you to do this, but I guess it's why they pay you the big bucks. Can you deliver that dead orc's field journal to whoever is in charge up at their camp?$B$BBased on the writing in the book, they should be located at the top of the island, up the incline past the Kaja'mite cavern to the southeast.$B$BGood luck, $N. I always liked you.
english.progress: You must have been on the $r slave ship that was sunk. What's that you have in your hand?
english.completion: I apologize. It has been a very rough couple of days for all of us. I am Aggra. All of us here are what remains of the crew of the Draka's Fury. Perhaps we can work together. We have a common enemy in the Alliance. Their SI:7 assassins are all over this island and they're not going to stop until we're all dead.

text.title: 恶花谷
text.objectives: Find Kilag Gorefang in the Vicious Vale on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Our hunter, Kilag Gorefang, and a few scouts, traveled into the vale down the path to the west. They're ...searching for... 'precious cargo'... that we were guarding when the filthy Alliance sunk our ship.$B$BThe way is blocked by deadly plants and they have not been able to break through.$B$B$N, prove your worth as a goblin and a $c. Journey into the Vicious Vale to find Kilag.
text.completion: $r, can you fight? For your sake, I hope so. Otherwise, there may be no breaking through this hell of killer plants.

english.title: The Vicious Vale
english.objectives: Find Kilag Gorefang in the Vicious Vale on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Our hunter, Kilag Gorefang, and a few scouts, traveled into the vale down the path to the west. They're ...searching for... 'precious cargo'... that we were guarding when the filthy Alliance sunk our ship.$B$BThe way is blocked by deadly plants and they have not been able to break through.$B$B$N, prove your worth as a goblin and a $c. Journey into the Vicious Vale to find Kilag.
english.completion: $r, can you fight? For your sake, I hope so. Otherwise, there may be no breaking through this hell of killer plants.

text.title: 割草機
text.objectives: Use the Weed Whacker within your Goblin All-In-1der Belt to mow down 100 of the plants within the Vicious Vale.
text.description: <Kilag barely has time to acknowledge you between rifle shots, but his eye does linger a moment on your Goblin All-In-1-der Belt appreciatively.>$B$BNow is the time for creative solutions. Pull something out of that belt and get to work!$B$B<Thinking about the situation for a moment, an idea comes to your mind and it's just crazy enough to work!>
text.completion: I saw it with my own eyes, and still I do not believe it! You have our thanks and the debt of our lives, little $r. I hope that soon we can repay you the honor. May I ask a small favor of you while my scouts and I move on?
text.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Vicious Vale on the Lost Isles.

english.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Vicious Vale on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Forward Movement
text.objectives: Find Kilag Gorefang and his scouts at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.
text.description: Kilag should be in position by now. It is time for you to move forward to the Wild Overlook. The rest of us will pack up here and move out soon.$B$BJust follow the path northwest through the Vicious Vale. Not so vicious any longer thanks to you, eh?$B$BKilag and his scouts will be keeping themselves hidden just off the path, but the SI:7 assassins are sure to spot them soon, so hurry!
text.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. We have a problem.

english.completion: Throm-Ka, $n. We have a problem.

text.title: Infrared = Infradead
text.objectives: Kill 10 SI:7 Assassins.$B$BIf something happens to your Orc Scout, return to Kilag to see if he has another for you to team up with.
text.description: Keep your voice down. The glen north and west of here is crawling with Alliance assassins.$B$BUnfortunately, we haven't been able to spot them. The cowards! They hide and won't fight face-to-face.$B$BYou goblins are known for your wondrous goggles. Surely you have a pair that will allow you to see them?$B$BI need you to team up with one of my scouts and kill any of the SI:7 assassins that you spot.
text.completion: Well done, $n, well done. We'll make an orc of you yet! Time to move on. We'd better hurry.
text.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.

english.completion: Well done, $n, well done. We'll make an orc of you yet! Time to move on. We'd better hurry.
english.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.

text.title: To the Cliffs
text.objectives: Speak with Scout Brax on the path down the cliffs north of the Savage Glen on the Lost Isles.
text.description: I sent Scout Brax forward along the road to the cliffs overlooking the beach to the west.$B$BI am going to put you onto Bastia. Travel down the path and let Brax know that we are going to take a different route.$B$BWe'll see you at the attack on the Alliance beachhead!
text.completion: Hello, little $r. Bastia is fast, no? We have something very important that needs doing. Can you help us?

english.title: To the Cliffs
english.objectives: Speak with Scout Brax on the path down the cliffs north of the Savage Glen on the Lost Isles.
english.description: I sent Scout Brax forward along the road to the cliffs overlooking the beach to the west.$B$BI am going to put you onto Bastia. Travel down the path and let Brax know that we are going to take a different route.$B$BWe'll see you at the attack on the Alliance beachhead!
english.completion: Hello, little $r. Bastia is fast, no? We have something very important that needs doing. Can you help us?

text.title: Get to the Gyrochoppa!
text.objectives: Retrieve the Gyrochoppa Keys.
text.description: The Alliance have stolen something of vital importance to the Horde. It is being held out on their ships.$B$BAt the other end of the beach is a gyrochoppa. Our battlesworn will cover your approach.$B$BGo retrieve the keys to the flying machine from one of their operatives.$B$BFly out to their flagship, the Vengeance Wake, and retrieve our precious cargo!
text.progress: Hmm, looks like overly-complicated gnomish engineering with lots of unnecessary instrumentation and safety precautions.
text.completion: Hmm, where the heck is the ignition? It'll be a wonder if it flies without doing something weird, like turning into a chicken or shrinking down to the size of an ant. Hey look, someone left their loose change in the ashtray! What else is in there?
text.completed: Go to the Gyrochoppa at the Alliance Beachhead on the Lost Isles.

english.completed: Go to the Gyrochoppa at the Alliance Beachhead on the Lost Isles.

text.title: Precious Cargo
text.objectives: Locate the precious cargo below deck on the Alliance ship, Vengeance Wake, off the shore of the Lost Isles.
text.description: They said that their "precious cargo", whatever that is, is being held out on the Alliance ship, the Vengeance Wake.$B$BThere's only one thing to do... fly this thing out there and retrieve it!
text.completion: If not for you, I would surely be on my way back to Stormwind to be paraded as a trophy and a slave. The Alliance dogs found me unconscious on the shore and put me in this magical cage. It was keeping me from connecting with the elements. No longer!

english.title: Precious Cargo
english.objectives: Locate the precious cargo below deck on the Alliance ship, Vengeance Wake, off the shore of the Lost Isles.
english.description: They said that their "precious cargo", whatever that is, is being held out on the Alliance ship, the Vengeance Wake.$B$BThere's only one thing to do... fly this thing out there and retrieve it!
english.completion: If not for you, I would surely be on my way back to Stormwind to be paraded as a trophy and a slave. The Alliance dogs found me unconscious on the shore and put me in this magical cage. It was keeping me from connecting with the elements. No longer!

text.title: Warchief's Revenge
text.objectives: Use the powers of the Cyclone of the Elements to slay 50 Alliance Sailors.$B$BOnce this is done, you will be flown to the Wild Overlook.
text.description: Brothers of Earth and Fire, hear me! Sisters of the Water and Air, heed my call!$B$BAzeroth stands on the brink, its existence near an end! Lend me your power as in times past with my ancient ancestors. Allow me to channel your will through this child of Kezan.$B$BLet us put an end to those who would keep us from healing the world!
text.completion: You have done what few others could have, $n. Our world owes you a debt larger than you can possibly understand.
text.completed: Speak with The Warchief at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Warchief's Revenge
english.objectives: Use the powers of the Cyclone of the Elements to slay 50 Alliance Sailors.$B$BOnce this is done, you will be flown to the Wild Overlook.
