english.completion: You have done what few others could have, $n. Our world owes you a debt larger than you can possibly understand.
english.completed: Speak with The Warchief at the Wild Overlook on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 爬升，爬升，火箭分离！
text.objectives: Survive the Rocket Sling shot across the Dire Strait.
text.description: While you were rescuing the Warchief and saving us all from the Alliance, Foreman Dampwick built this rocket sling to shoot us over the shark-infested strait to the bigger island.$B$BLuckily for us, the foreman managed to salvage a Town-In-A-Box from the shipwreck. Once you get it set up, we'll have a town of our own. I can't wait to sleep in a bed again!$B$BDampwick's down there at the Landing Site, waiting for you. Why don't you take the next rocket over?
text.completion: $n, I sure am glad you survived the trip... not everyone did!
text.completed: Speak with Foreman Dampwick at the Landing Site on the Lost Isles.

english.title: Up, Up & Away!
english.objectives: Survive the Rocket Sling shot across the Dire Strait.
english.description: While you were rescuing the Warchief and saving us all from the Alliance, Foreman Dampwick built this rocket sling to shoot us over the shark-infested strait to the bigger island.$B$BLuckily for us, the foreman managed to salvage a Town-In-A-Box from the shipwreck. Once you get it set up, we'll have a town of our own. I can't wait to sleep in a bed again!$B$BDampwick's down there at the Landing Site, waiting for you. Why don't you take the next rocket over?
english.completion: $n, I sure am glad you survived the trip... not everyone did!
english.completed: Speak with Foreman Dampwick at the Landing Site on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 胶囊镇
text.objectives: 爬到炸药堆上，使用胶囊镇活塞。
text.description: 贸易大王的游艇上有一座胶囊镇！在你为地精一族的存亡而战时，我从一堆残骸里找到了它。$B$B你愿不愿意为胶囊镇剪彩啊？你只需要爬上炸药堆并推动活塞，接下来嘛，唵嘛呢叭咪吽！速成城镇！
text.completion: Hey! Where's the dock?! Someone stole the dock and the oil refinery from our town-in-a-box! Who would do such a thing? Where's the Trade Prince?
text.completed: Speak with Foreman Dampwick at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

english.title: It's a Town-In-A-Box
english.objectives: Climb to the top of the mountain of explosives and use the Town-In-A-Box Plunger.
english.description: The trade prince had an entire town-in-a-box in the ship's hold! I managed to recover it while you were out saving all of our skins.$B$BDo you want to do the honors? All you have to do is climb to the top of that huge pile of explosives and push the plunger, and whamo kablamo, instant town!
english.completion: Hey! Where's the dock?! Someone stole the dock and the oil refinery from our town-in-a-box! Who would do such a thing? Where's the Trade Prince?
english.completed: Speak with Foreman Dampwick at the Town-In-A-Box on the Lost Isles.

text.title: 提前领养
text.objectives: 将3枚猛鹫的蛋放在猛鹫之巢里，在它们被带走之前保护好。
text.description: 这一地区突然变得充满生机，沙漠生物的栖息环境也被迫变得拥挤起来。$B$B最为显著的负面结果就是当地猛鹫濒临灭绝。捕食者们以这些鸟儿和它们的蛋为食，侵占它们的巢穴。$B$B我从塔纳利斯得到了几枚猛鹫的蛋，在上面涂了难以抗拒的信息素。在你找到的鸟巢里放一个，然后保护它，直到一头猛鹫飞来将其带走。$B$B你将为大地的平衡做出贡献。
text.completion: You have done well, $c. This land is in your debt.
text.completed: Return to Thunk at Thunk's Abode in Desolace.

english.title: Early Adoption
english.objectives: Place 3 Swoop Eggs in Swoop Nests and protect them until they are collected.
english.description: As the region becomes more lush, the creatures of the desert are being forced into increasingly confined spaces.$b$bA particularly distressing result is the impending extinction of the local swoops. Predators feast on the birds and their eggs when they take nest.$b$bI have acquired some swoop eggs from Tanaris and coated them with an irresistible pheromone. Place one in each nest you find, then protect it until a swoop comes to carry it off.$b$bYou will be doing a service to the balance of this land.
english.completion: You have done well, $c. This land is in your debt.
english.completed: Return to Thunk at Thunk's Abode in Desolace.

text.title: 固执的大地
text.objectives: 桑克的住所的桑克要你找到不自然的岩石。
text.description: 在塞纳里奥议会的授权下，我负责将这些环境恶劣的土地变成生机盎然的草原。$B$B南边的大地生长状况良好，可这儿却有什么东西在阻碍进程——抵抗着绿化。$B$B也许你的眼睛比我尖。$B$B拜托你，$R。搜索这些土地，找到沙漠负隅顽抗的源头。
text.completion: You look around, scanning the horizon for what might be responsible for placing this stone here....

english.title: Stubborn Lands
english.objectives: Thunk at Thunk's Abode wants you to find the Unnatural Outcropping.
english.description: By authority of the Cenarion Circle, I am charged with turning these harsh lands into lush prairie.$b$bThe lands south of here welcomed the growth, but something here is fighting back - resisting the replenishment.$b$bPerhaps your eyes can succeed where mine have failed.$b$bPlease, $r. Scour these lands and discover the source of the desert's stubbornness.
english.completion: You look around, scanning the horizon for what might be responsible for placing this stone here....

text.title: 急需帮助
text.objectives: 跟失落群岛卡亚矿洞外的工头戴姆维克谈一谈。
text.description: 好消息！工头戴姆维克在岛上发现了一座储量丰富的卡亚矿洞！运气大好啊！$B$B当然，有好消息就有坏消息。他带走了一批幸存者，派他们进入矿洞进行开采，但是没有人能活着出来。$B$B这听起来很不可信，但是工头说洞里有很多猴子……拿着矿锄的猴子！它们在开采卡亚矿石！这怎么可能呢？$B$B你能不能跑一趟，去东南边的矿洞看看？工头就在矿洞的入口处。
text.completion: Boss! Er, well, I guess you're not the boss anymore, but still, good to see you! Can you believe it? We've got a cave full of intelligent killer monkeys mining Kaja'mite!

english.title: Help Wanted
english.objectives: Speak with Foreman Dampwick outside of the Kaja'mite Cavern on the Lost Isles.
english.description: Great news! Foreman Dampwick has uncovered a cave full of kaja'mite on the island! What are the odds?$B$BOf course, there's a downside. He took some of the survivors with him to help mine the ore, but none of them have made it out.$B$BCrazy as it sounds, the foreman said that there are monkeys in the cave... with mining picks! They're mining the kaja'mite! How is that even possible?$B$BCan you head southeast to the cavern? The foreman is standing just outside the entrance.
english.completion: Boss! Er, well, I guess you're not the boss anymore, but still, good to see you! Can you believe it? We've got a cave full of intelligent killer monkeys mining Kaja'mite!

text.title: 剪羽毛
text.objectives: 从诺德雷萨废墟附近的角鹰兽身上采集80根完整的雷首角鹰兽羽毛。
text.description: 我会很了不起！成为了不起的大法师！但他却瞧我不上，就因为我没有穿袍戴帽。嗤。$B$B这片土地上有史以来最为了不起的大法师行头可不能随便。我得让他知道我很特别，我知道该怎么做。$B$B出去杀掉那些角鹰兽什么的，给我带上成吨的羽毛回来。你没听错！成堆成堆的羽毛！快快快，等你回来时我的袍子就缝好等着装饰了。
text.progress: My robes looking pretty good. Did you bring those feathers?
text.completion: Ha ha! Perfect! Let me toss this together really fast. The Archmage is sure to be taken in by my style!
text.completed: Return to Will Robotronic at the Ruins of Nordressa.

english.title: Shear Will
english.objectives: Obtain 80 Pristine Thunderhead Feathers from the Hippogryphs near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: I'd be amazing! At archmagery. Amazing! He won't even talk to me because I don't have a stupid robe and hat. Pffft.$B$BThe most amazing archmage this land has ever seen can't just have any robe and hat. I need to show him that I'm something special, and I know just how to do it.$B$BGo out there and kill some of those hippogryph things. Bring me back a TON of feathers.$B$BYou heard me! A whole bunch of feathers! Go go, I'll have the robe ready for them by the time you get back.
english.progress: My robes looking pretty good. Did you bring those feathers?
english.completion: Ha ha! Perfect! Let me toss this together really fast. The Archmage is sure to be taken in by my style!
english.completed: Return to Will Robotronic at the Ruins of Nordressa.

text.title: 可再生资源
text.objectives: 从诺德雷萨废墟的巴伯亚身上用奥术炸药收集5块活体玄武岩。
text.description: 我们还得要点儿活体玄武岩。附近只有一个可靠来源，一名叫做巴伯亚的高山巨人。杀鸡取卵的事情我们可不能做，得细水长流。$B$B你可以在东北和东边找到他的踪迹。预先放上炸药，藏好了等着引爆。等他清完场你就可以把玄武岩给带回来了。
text.progress: I heard a few explosions. I can hardly tell if one of them was yours or not... these goblins can be quite a nuisance.
text.completion: Good work. This should keep us for another few hours before we have to go back for more. He doesn't seem to be the brightest of giants. I expect we'll be able to keep doing this for a while before he catches on.
text.completed: Return to Tharkul Ironskull at the Ruins of Nordressa.

english.title: Renewable Resource
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Charge to retrieve 5 Animate Basalt from Balboa near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: We're going to need some more animate basalt. There's only one reliable source for that in the area, a mountain giant named Balboa. We can't be killing the mountain giant if we want to keep stocked in the stuff long term, so we've just been chipping off pieces at a time.$B$BYou'll be able to see his path northeast and east of here. Find him, place the charge ahead on the path, and then hide until it goes off. Once he's cleared the area, you should be able to retrieve the basalt and bring it back to me.
english.progress: I heard a few explosions. I can hardly tell if one of them was yours or not... these goblins can be quite a nuisance.
english.completion: Good work. This should keep us for another few hours before we have to go back for more. He doesn't seem to be the brightest of giants. I expect we'll be able to keep doing this for a while before he catches on.
english.completed: Return to Tharkul Ironskull at the Ruins of Nordressa.

text.title: 新的开始
text.objectives: 收集15根蝎刺。
text.description: There's never been danger of centaur attack this far north before. Someone put 'em up to it, I just know it!$b$bRegardless, I'm wiped out. I had everything invested in this haul.$b$bFortunately, there's one thing no centaur can take from me and that's goblin ingenuity! I'll start from scratch and build an empire!$b$b<Bizby spots a scorpion in the distance.>$b$bThere's always a market for poison. Whatdya say, friend?$B$B
text.progress: Let's have a look at those scorpion tails, friend.
text.completion: This is how I got my start, you know. Slingin' poison to the rogues in Orgrimmar. Ahh, those were the days....
text.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

english.title: New Beginnings
english.objectives: Collect 15 Scorpion Stingers.
english.description: There's never been danger of centaur attack this far north before. Someone put 'em up to it, I just know it!$b$bRegardless, I'm wiped out. I had everything invested in this haul.$b$bFortunately, there's one thing no centaur can take from me and that's goblin ingenuity! I'll start from scratch and build an empire!$b$b<Bizby spots a scorpion in the distance.>$b$bThere's always a market for poison. Whatdya say, friend?$B$B
english.progress: Let's have a look at those scorpion tails, friend.
english.completion: This is how I got my start, you know. Slingin' poison to the rogues in Orgrimmar. Ahh, those were the days....
english.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

text.title: 货次价高
text.objectives: 收集15条陈年蜥蜴尾。
text.description: 我需要一箱子尾巴，$C！不是随便什么动物的尾巴，要求是越老越好，越残越好！$B$B覆盖在蜥蜴尾部的鳞片非常奇特，它们会随着年龄的增长而变硬，丝毫不见破碎的迹象。这种硬化鳞片是制作护甲的上等材料。$B$B我已经好多年没做过蜥蜴鳞片的生意了，谁会料到呢，说不定我可以借此闯出一番新天地！如果可能的话……
text.progress: How's the search for tail coming, $n?
text.completion: That'll do, $c. A few more friends like you and I'll be back on my feet in no time!
text.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

english.title: Good Gold For Bad Tail
english.objectives: Find 15 Aged Basilisk Tails.
english.description: I need a crateload of tail, $c! And not just any kind of tail. The tail I'm after needs to be old - ancient even. The more decrepit the better.$b$bThe scales of a basilisk's tail are unique in that they harden with age without becoming brittle. The hardened scales are ideal for the production of certain armors.$b$bIt's been many years since I've been reduced to peddling lizard scales, but who knows, maybe it'll build even more character in me! If that's even possible....
english.progress: How's the search for tail coming, $n?
english.completion: That'll do, $c. A few more friends like you and I'll be back on my feet in no time!
english.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

text.title: 给我带些羽毛来！
text.objectives: 收集25根恐怖飞扑者之羽。
text.description: $C，在你探索这片沙漠时，不如顺便帮我个忙？$B$B留意一下恐怖飞扑者的踪迹。它们的油性羽毛是箭翎的绝佳材料，识货的买家愿意出大价钱购买的。$B$B幸运的是，我恰好认识所有识货的买家！
text.progress: How is the search for swoops coming?
text.completion: Well now, that's quite a load of feathers, $c. They'll make for a good pillow 'til I get 'em to market!
text.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

english.title: Fletch Me Some Plumage!
english.objectives: Collect 25 Dread Swoop Feathers.
english.description: Say, $c, while you're out there exploring the desert wastes, do me a favor?$b$bKeep an eye out for Dread Swoops. Their oily feathers make for the best fletching, and to the right buyer they can fetch a handsome price.$b$bLucky for you, I know all of the right buyers!
english.progress: How is the search for swoops coming?
english.completion: Well now, that's quite a load of feathers, $c. They'll make for a good pillow 'til I get 'em to market!
english.completed: Return to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan in Desolace.

text.title: 重金属
text.objectives: 你要收集7份116号元素，将它们带给比兹比车队的比兹比。
text.description: 你有一种强烈的预感，正是这块石头使得该地区拒绝着接受再生的良机。$B$B朝西看去，你发现一道由焚烧过的残骸组成的痕迹，似乎和这个神秘的物件有关。$B$B你估计把这些残骸清理掉可能会对桑克的努力有所帮助。$B$B而且，谁知道这东西能派什么用场呢？
text.progress: Whatcha got there, $c?
text.completion: What's this? Wahoo! I know someone who will be most interested in acquiring these samples. Most generous in payment for them as well, I'll wager. Here, $c. Take this as your finder's fee.

english.title: Heavy Metal
english.objectives: You are to collect 7 pieces of Element 116 and bring them to Bizby at Bizby's Caravan.
english.description: You have a strong feeling that this stone is somehow responsible for the region's refusal to accept the encroaching regrowth.$b$bLooking off to the west, you notice a trail of smoldering debris that appears to be related to this mystery.$b$bYou surmise that clearing the debris might assist Thunk's efforts here.$b$bAnd who knows what this stuff might be good for?
english.progress: Whatcha got there, $c?
english.completion: What's this? Wahoo! I know someone who will be most interested in acquiring these samples. Most generous in payment for them as well, I'll wager. Here, $c. Take this as your finder's fee.

text.title: 艾瑟雷索
text.objectives: Cerelia at Furien's Post wants you to speak to Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
text.description: We have plenty of enemies in this region without raising the ire of the Cenarion Circle.$b$bWhen we established our post here, we were asked to keep a watch over one of their researchers.$b$bKorrah was last seen at the tower to the west. Do be a dear and pay her a visit. It's been some time since we've bothered to check on her.
text.completion: It is good that you have come. There is grave danger looming here.

english.title: Ethel Rethor
english.objectives: Cerelia at Furien's Post wants you to speak to Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: We have plenty of enemies in this region without raising the ire of the Cenarion Circle.$b$bWhen we established our post here, we were asked to keep a watch over one of their researchers.$b$bKorrah was last seen at the tower to the west. Do be a dear and pay her a visit. It's been some time since we've bothered to check on her.
english.completion: It is good that you have come. There is grave danger looming here.

text.title: 新的威胁
text.objectives: 跟库拉谈一谈，她将为你展示纳迦的威胁。
text.description: 我和我的同伴奉命来到凄凉之地的海岸，查探这里的变化，如今只剩下我一个人了。$B$B我已经发出了纳迦数量剧增的报告，但是没有任何回应。$B$B同伴们都在关注其他事务，我只能请求你这样的陌生人帮助我继续研究。$B$B首先，请允许我为你展示我们所面临的威胁。
text.completion: So now you see. These are not a simple band of displaced naga, but a well organized army, capable of great devastation. Do you agree to assist me in my investigation?
text.completed: Speak to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

english.title: The Emerging Threat
english.objectives: Korrah wants you to speak to her when you are ready to be shown the Naga threat.
english.description: I am all that remains of my company, sent to monitor the many changes on this coast of Desolace.$b$bI have reported of the dramatic increase of naga here, but to no effect.$b$bMy peers are focused on other crises, so I must ask you, a stranger, to assist me in my research.$b$bFirst, though, allow me to show you the threat we face.
english.completion: So now you see. These are not a simple band of displaced naga, but a well organized army, capable of great devastation. Do you agree to assist me in my investigation?
english.completed: Speak to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

text.title: 滑刃之劫
text.objectives: 从滑刃纳迦身上收集10根滑刃之骨，从滑刃巫师身上收集30片滑刃鳞片，从滑刃战士身上收集4扇滑刃之鳍。
text.description: 纳迦一再地证明自己是自然平衡的大敌。对于挥洒他们的鲜血这种事，我毫无顾忌。$B$B就算你再努力，对他们的兵力而言也只是隔靴搔痒。一个倒下，就有两个站起来。$B$B我有个计划，$C。你的目标不仅仅是击败那些蛇怪，还要拿回一些鳞片、骨头和鱼鳍来，好进行后面的计划。
text.progress: 你收集好我要的材料了吗?
text.completion: You have done well, $c. But I'm afraid that your work here is just beginning.
text.completed: Return to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

english.title: Slitherblade Slaughter
english.objectives: Collect 10 Slitherblade Bones from Slitherblade Naga, 30 Slitherblade Scales from Slitherblade Sorceresses, and 4 Slitherblade Fins from Slitherblade Warriors.
english.description: Time and again, the naga have proven to be enemies to the balance of nature. I have no qualms with the spilling of their blood.$b$bYour best efforts though, would barely put a dent in their forces here. Where one falls, two seem to rise in their place.$b$bI have a plan, $c. Your objective is not merely to take the lives of the enemy, but to gather components necessary for the next stage of our investigation....
english.progress: Have you collected the components I require?
english.completion: You have done well, $c. But I'm afraid that your work here is just beginning.
english.completed: Return to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor in Desolace.

text.title: 炮轰纳迦
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的秘密实验室收集5颗地精迫击炮炮弹。
text.description: 我们建成火箭航站楼后，纳迦在半岛上开始有所行动。但世上没有什么问题是不可以用饱和炮火轰击来解决的！在出事之前，我爸常这么说。$B$B但是，我的补给不足了。帮我个忙，把我存放在西边秘密实验室的迫击炮弹运来。保证我的弹药，我就可以给你提供炮火打击！
text.progress: I hope you have more ammo for me. I've got nothing to shoot off over here but my mouth!
text.completion: Sweet! Beautiful! Brilliant! Who loves you? With my mortars re-supplied, I can help you as you assault the Naga east of here. Use these markers to call in an artillery strike anywhere on the cliffs, and I'll splatter the whole area with fiery hurt. Oh delicious, merciless, random destruction! I hope you're well-armored...
text.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Mortar the Point
english.objectives: Collect 5 Goblin Mortar Shells from the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
english.description: The Naga started making a move on the peninsula here after we finished building this rocketway terminal. But there's no problem in this world that can't be solved with gratuitous firepower! That's what my daddy used to say. Before the accident.$B$BI'm running short on supplies, though. Do me a favor and collect the mortar shells I left stockpiled in the Secret Lab just west of here. Keep me supplied and I'll let you call in the artillery strikes!
english.progress: I hope you have more ammo for me. I've got nothing to shoot off over here but my mouth!
english.completion: Sweet! Beautiful! Brilliant! Who loves you? With my mortars re-supplied, I can help you as you assault the Naga east of here. Use these markers to call in an artillery strike anywhere on the cliffs, and I'll splatter the whole area with fiery hurt. Oh delicious, merciless, random destruction! I hope you're well-armored...
english.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: More Mortars, More!
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉的秘密实验室收集5颗地精迫击炮炮弹。
text.description: Thanks for helping me restock my supplies, $N.$B$BI'll tell you what, bring me more mortars from the lab, and I'll keep supplying you with artillery signals. With me on the trigger and you in the field, we'll blast these cliffs until they go crashing into the sea!
text.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: More Mortars, More!
english.objectives: Collect 5 Goblin Mortar Shells from the Secret Lab complex in Azshara.
english.description: Thanks for helping me restock my supplies, $N.$B$BI'll tell you what, bring me more mortars from the lab, and I'll keep supplying you with artillery signals. With me on the trigger and you in the field, we'll blast these cliffs until they go crashing into the sea!
english.completed: Bring the shells to Bombardier Captain Smooks at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 深入敌后
text.objectives: 使用滑刃之魅。
text.description: 我设计了一道咒符，可以让你混入纳迦中去，把你的外表变得和他们一样。$B$B有了这个伪装，你还可以理解他们的语言，同他们交谈。他们没有办法看破你的真身。$B$B但要小心，鲨鱼和其它的海洋生物会把你暴露给所有人。尽量避开它们。$B$B现在去吧，跟艾萨拉的女祭司谈一谈，尽你所能了解他们在这里的目的。
text.completion: Don't just stand around, when there is so much to be done! Must I instruct everyone on each detail?
text.completed: Speak to Valishj at the Slitherblade Shore in Desolace.

english.title: Going Deep
english.objectives: Use the Slitherblade Charm.
english.description: I have fashioned a charm that will allow you to infiltrate the naga, giving you the appearance of one of their own.$b$bWith this disguise, you will be able to speak and understand their language. They will be unable to discern your true identity.$b$bBut beware! The sharks and other sea creatures here will expose you for all to see. Avoid them at all costs.$b$bNow go. Speak to the Priestess of Azshara and do what you must to learn of their purposes here.
english.completion: Don't just stand around, when there is so much to be done! Must I instruct everyone on each detail?
english.completed: Speak to Valishj at the Slitherblade Shore in Desolace.

text.title: 冰冰冷
text.objectives: 使用低温装置16号冷冻并杀死8条漆黑幼龙。
text.description: 我有个对付龙的好办法了。那就是我的低温装置16号。$B$B本来我设计它是为了冰冻工人，便于运输，还不用管吃管喝，可结果它会有……副作用。不过用来把龙从天上弄下来应该不会错！
text.completion: What? So you didn't bring any of the drake pieces back? Disappointing. I knew I should have made you sign a contract before I sent you out...
text.completed: Return to Feno Blastnoggin at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.

english.title: Ice Cold
english.objectives: Use the Cryomatic 16 to freeze and kill 8 Sable Drakes.
english.description: I've got the perfect solution to our drake problem. My very own Cryomatic 16.$B$BI originally developed it to freeze my workers during transport and between shifts so that I wouldn't have to feed and entertain them, but there were... complications. It should be perfect for dropping these drakes out of the sky though!
english.completion: What? So you didn't bring any of the drake pieces back? Disappointing. I knew I should have made you sign a contract before I sent you out...
english.completed: Return to Feno Blastnoggin at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.

text.title: 刮鳞破肠
text.objectives: 杀掉6只恶鞭怒雷武士和6只恶鞭唤海者。
text.description: 这些海里来的生物神出鬼没，对付它们让我抓狂。可除非它们从艾萨拉上绝迹，不然我绝不退缩。$B$B恶鞭纳迦已经从东侧游上峭壁，围攻这座岗哨了。干掉他们，$N，把他们开膛破肚，让他们领教我部落的厉害。
text.completion: And still they come! They are like a plague, $n. But with strength like yours, we will crush them. Someday.
text.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: To Gut a Fish
english.objectives: Slay 6 Spitelash Stormfuries and 6 Spitelash Seacallers.
english.description: It tries my patience, defending against creatures who can disappear into the sea at will and emerge where they please. But I will not back down until their like has been wiped from Azshara.$B$BSpitelash Naga have slithered up the cliff walls and are besieging this post from the east. Destroy them, $N. Gut them head to tail, so that they may know the full fury of my Horde.
english.completion: And still they come! They are like a plague, $n. But with strength like yours, we will crush them. Someday.
english.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 浪费百里香
text.objectives: 在诺德雷萨废墟附近采8束生命盛怒百里香。
text.description: 生命盛怒百里香！我还要！快给我弄点来成不？
text.progress: Do you have that thyme for me?
text.completion: Perfect. It's quite interesting how useful the most random things end up being to incantations of this sort. So much more to learn!
text.completed: Return to Quarla Whistlebeak at the Ruins of Nordressa.

english.title: Waste of Thyme
english.objectives: Collect 8 bundles of Living Ire Thyme near the Ruins of Nordressa.
english.description: Living Ire Thyme. I must have more! Be quick about it, will you?
english.progress: Do you have that thyme for me?
english.completion: Perfect. It's quite interesting how useful the most random things end up being to incantations of this sort. So much more to learn!
english.completed: Return to Quarla Whistlebeak at the Ruins of Nordressa.

text.title: 潮上加湿
text.objectives: 击败5名耐普图隆的仆从。（你必须以纳迦形态打败他们。）$B$B如果你丢失了滑刃三叉戟，就和瓦丽丝琪谈谈。$B$B如果你丢失了滑刃之魅，就和艾瑟雷索的库拉谈谈。
text.description: 耐普图隆的仆从来到这里，尽他们的一切努力来阻挠我们。很显然，他们已经发现了我们的动机。$B$B这恰恰证实了我的猜测，我们所寻找的东西就在废墟里某处！$B$B这些水元素同我们的大军相比不值一提！拿上这根三叉戟，用它消灭潮汐猎手的那些无足挂齿的仆役们。$B$B当我们找到了那样东西，耐普图隆就该担心自己的性命了！
text.completion: The enemy's ranks are thinning, little minnow. Perhaps you are worthy of assisting in our search....
text.completed: Return to Valishj at the Slitherblade Shore in Desolace.

english.title: Wetter Than Wet
english.objectives: Defeat 5 Servants of Neptulon. (You must be in naga form when you defeat them.)$b$bIf you lose your Slitherblade Trident, speak to Valishj.$b$bIf you lose your Slitherblade Charm, speak with Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: Neptulon's minions have arrived here and are doing all they can to thwart us. Clearly, they've discovered our motives.$b$bThis only confirms my suspicion that what we seek is indeed somewhere in these ruins!$b$bThese water elementals are no match for our forces! Take this trident and use it to destroy the worthless servants of the Tidehunter.$b$bWhen we find what we seek here, Neptulon himself shall fear for his life!
english.completion: The enemy's ranks are thinning, little minnow. Perhaps you are worthy of assisting in our search....
english.completed: Return to Valishj at the Slitherblade Shore in Desolace.

text.title: 你的导师
text.objectives: 跟军事区的克利希中士谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫克利希的家伙，他说你是他的学生，想确认你是否安全。
text.completion: $n!  Where have you been? Anyway... it's great to see you in one piece.

english.title: Your Instructor
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Cleese in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A fellow by the name of Cleese said you were one of his students and wanted to make sure you were all right.
english.completion: $n!  Where have you been? Anyway... it's great to see you in one piece.

text.title: 冲锋
text.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Cleese and learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: You're alive, $N!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But perhaps there's a thing or two I can teach you that might be handy in a time like this.$B$BTry out your new technique against the bloodfang worgen to our west.
text.completion: 真是精彩！

english.title: Charge
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Cleese and learn Charge. Practice using Charge against a Bloodfang Worgen.
english.description: You're alive, $N!  That must mean I did something right.$B$BIt's a shame our lessons were cut off a little short.  But perhaps there's a thing or two I can teach you that might be handy in a time like this.$B$BTry out your new technique against the bloodfang worgen to our west.
english.completion: Excellent work!

text.title: 调查海洋祭坛
text.objectives: 为托格·图卡斯调查纳迦祭坛。
text.description: 纳迦侵略者在悬崖边上矗立了一系列祭坛。我不知道是干吗用的，$N，但我肯定它们强化着我们的敌人。我需要有人去那儿清除这个威胁。$B$B附近有个祭坛防守不严：过了西边第一座桥然后向北朝海湾走，就在一个小岩包上。调查一下，帮我弄些有用的情报来。
text.completion: The stone in the center of this shrine emits a faint glow and roars with the power of the angry sea.
text.completed: Investigate the Naga shrine at the Storm Cliffs for Torg Twocrush.

english.title: Investigating the Sea Shrine
english.objectives: Investigate the Naga shrine for Torg Twocrush.
english.description: The Naga invaders have set up a series of shrines along the cliffs. I don't know their purpose, $N, but I believe they're strengthening our foes. I need someone to get in there and root out this threat.$B$BOne nearby shrine is lightly defended: Cross the first bridge east of here and then head north towards the bay. You'll find it on a small outcropping. Investigate that shrine and come back with some info I can use.
english.completion: The stone in the center of this shrine emits a faint glow and roars with the power of the angry sea.
english.completed: Investigate the Naga shrine at the Storm Cliffs for Torg Twocrush.

text.title: 深度撞击
text.objectives: 女祭司瓦丽丝琪要你找到耐普图隆的石板。
text.description: 艾萨拉女王寻找的是水元素位面的入口，至于为了什么，我就不清楚了。$B$B她相信这些废墟中藏有发现入口位置所在的关键。$B$B我被亲自受命搜查这片区域的废墟，找不到我们所要的秘密，谁都不准休息！$B$B北边是一处被淹没的废墟集中地。用这根法杖搜索瓦砾。$B$B找不到我们要的东西就别回来！
text.progress: Could it be....?
text.completion: Yes! You've found it! Neptulon's engravings... there can be no mistake!

english.title: Deep Impact
english.objectives: Priestess Valishj wants you to find the Ancient Engravings of Neptulon.
english.description: Queen Azshara seeks entrance into the plane of water, for what I do not know.$b$bShe believes that the ancients held the keys to finding its location.$b$bI have personally been charged with scouring the ruins in this region, and none shall rest until we discover the secrets we seek!$b$bSubmerged just to the north are a concentration of ruins. Use this staff to search through the rubble.$b$bReturn to me only when you have located that which we seek!
english.progress: Could it be....?
english.completion: Yes! You've found it! Neptulon's engravings... there can be no mistake!

text.title: Someone's Looking for You
text.objectives: Speak to Loren the Fence in the Military District.
text.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A woman named Loren... she seemed a little disappointed when I told her you were all right.$B$BI think she mentioned she owes you money.
text.completion: Oh, hey!  There you are!

english.title: Someone's Looking for You
english.objectives: Speak to Loren the Fence in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A woman named Loren... she seemed a little disappointed when I told her you were all right.$B$BI think she mentioned she owes you money.
english.completion: Oh, hey!  There you are!

text.title: 钥石碎片
text.objectives: 在附近找到钥石碎片。
text.description: 这块奇怪的石头冰冷平滑，发散的能量扰动着周围的空气，用手抚摸上去，能感到一阵阵脉动，又如惊涛拍岸。$B$B神器顶部的楔形部分似乎遗落了，“钥石碎片”看来就是解开这块石头秘密的关键，在神庙附近找找看。
text.progress: The Naga power stone pulses with an expectant hum.
text.completion: The keystone shard slides into place and previously invisible runes suddenly erupt onto the surface of the stone, shimmering in blue and violet hues. Your knees buckle as powerful arcane currents suddenly race into your body...
text.completed: Return the Keystone Shard to the Naga Power Stone at the Storm Cliffs in Azshara.

english.title: The Keystone Shard
english.objectives: Find the Keystone Shard nearby.
english.description: The air around this strange stone crackles with energy. The stone itself is smooth and icy cold. It pulses periodically as you run your hands over it, like the crashing of surf.$B$BA wedge-shaped piece appears to be missing from the top surface of the artifact. This 'keystone shard' is likely the key to unlocking the secrets of the stone. Search the grounds near the temple and locate the keystone shard.
english.progress: The Naga power stone pulses with an expectant hum.
english.completion: The keystone shard slides into place and previously invisible runes suddenly erupt onto the surface of the stone, shimmering in blue and violet hues. Your knees buckle as powerful arcane currents suddenly race into your body...
english.completed: Return the Keystone Shard to the Naga Power Stone at the Storm Cliffs in Azshara.

text.title: 向图卡斯汇报
text.objectives: 回到艾萨拉，向南部火箭车终点站的托格·图卡斯报告，告诉他你的发现。
text.description: 一道魔法屏障在你周身搏动，冷峭彻骨，你身置其中刀枪不入。$B$B托格·图卡斯会想要知道你在这儿究竟发现了什么！
text.completion: An energy barrier, you say? This explains a great deal! I've seen firsthand how Naga leaders have been able to turn aside the blades of some of my best warriors. Now we know the source of their power, $n. Let's finish this!
text.completed: 回到艾萨拉，向南部火箭车终点站的托格·图卡斯报告，告诉他你的发现。

english.title: Report to Twocrush
english.objectives: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara with news of your discovery.
english.description: A magical barrier pulses around you, chilling your bones. You feel secure behind this enchanted wall.$B$BTorg Twocrush will want to know what you've discovered here!
english.completion: An energy barrier, you say? This explains a great deal! I've seen firsthand how Naga leaders have been able to turn aside the blades of some of my best warriors. Now we know the source of their power, $n. Let's finish this!
english.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara with news of your discovery.

text.title: 刺骨
text.objectives: Speak to Loren the Fence and learn Eviscerate. Practice using Eviscerate against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: Good to see you alive!$B$BNo, of course I don't have that gold I owe you.  Now's not really the time to bring that up is it?$B$BListen, maybe I can teach you a trick or two that might save your skin with all the carnage going on.  I'd call it more than even then.  What do you say?$B$BAfter your lesson is over, try using your new technique against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.
text.completion: Don't get ahead of yourself now.  Just remember who taught you everything you know. And now let's see if we can get out of this city with our skins attached.

text.title: 神秘的联系人
text.objectives: 跟军事区的维图斯·暗行者谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是一个叫维图斯·暗行者的怪人……那家伙还真让我毛骨悚然。$B$B他一直念叨着说自己发现了什么“禁断的知识”之类的。
text.completion: A darkness has descended over our lands.  And not our kind of darkness, if you know what I mean.

english.title: Shady Associates
english.objectives: Speak to Vitus Darkwalker in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A strange fellow named Vitus... he was really giving me the creeps.$B$BHe kept talking about some "forbidden knowledge" he'd uncovered.
english.completion: A darkness has descended over our lands.  And not our kind of darkness, if you know what I mean.

text.title: 献祭
text.objectives: Speak to Vitus Darkwalker and learn Immolate. Practice casting Immolate on a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: It is true then!  You live!$B$BI never got a chance to share my greatest discovery with you.  From the depths of the nigh-indecipherable books of Balcephoth of the felshadows... I've learned the forbidden secrets of...$B$BImmolate!$B$BOf course I will share this knowledge with you... who else around here would appreciate such powerful understanding?$B$BGo now, and practice your new spell against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west.
text.progress: You're doing well, $N.
text.completion: Yes!  You can feel the power, can't you?

english.completion: Yes!  You can feel the power, can't you?

text.objectives: Speak to Huntsman Blake in the Military District.
text.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A man named Blake.  Said something about a plan to escape into the woods.
text.completion: $n!  I knew you had to be around here.

text.title: 稳固射击
text.objectives: Speak to Huntsman Blake and learn Steady Shot. Practice using Steady Shot 2 times against a Bloodfang Worg.
text.description: So I've got good news and bad news.$B$BThe bad news is that there are more worgen in the woods than in here... so we really have no safe place to go to.$B$BThe good news is that I still have a thing or two to teach you.  Who knows the sort of skill that might save your life in a time like this.$B$BTry your hand at it against the bloodfang worgen to our west.
text.progress: You're a fast learner. We'll show these worgen who the real hunters are.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  These $r will regret ever setting foot in our lands.

text.objectives: 跟军事区的米莉安·唤法者谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。是法师米莉安，她好像提到你已经“准备好了”之类的。
text.completion: A disciple of the arcane always finds a way forward.  I'm glad to see you, $n.

english.title: Arcane Inquiries
english.objectives: Speak to Myriam Spellwaker in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  It was a mage named Myriam.  She mentioned something about you being "ready."
english.completion: A disciple of the arcane always finds a way forward.  I'm glad to see you, $n.

text.title: 寻找修女
text.objectives: 跟军事区的艾尔米拉修女谈一谈。
text.description: 大多数人得以存活……但是这片区域仍有狼人出没。$B$B等一切准备妥当，我们就要继续往南推进了。$B$B这倒让我想起一件事来，有人想见你。对，就是教会的艾尔米拉修女，她说你面临巨大的危险，急需圣光的庇护。$B$B你应该跟她谈谈。她很关心你的安危。
text.completion: The Light is with you, $n.  It's still quite a relief to see you.

english.title: Seek the Sister
english.objectives: Speak to Sister Almyra in the Military District.
english.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  A member of the clergy, Sister Almyra, said that you were in great peril and needed the Light's protection.$B$BYou should go talk to her.  She seemed very concerned.
english.completion: The Light is with you, $n.  It's still quite a relief to see you.

text.title: 快速治疗
text.objectives: Speak to Sister Almyra and learn Flash Heal. Use Flash Heal 2 times on a Wounded Guard.
text.description: You have much to learn, $N.  And I've much to teach you.$B$BThese are perilous times, however, and I fear that we might have to accelerate certain lessons.$B$BHave no fear, $g brother:sister;.  The Light will guide us through this.
text.progress: You are learning swiftly, my dear.
text.completion: You are blessed, $n.  The Light shines upon you, even in these dark times.

text.objectives: Speak to Celestine of the Harvest in the Military District.
text.description: Most of us made it here alive... but there are worgen on this side of the city as well.$B$BWe're going to continue heading south once everyone's accounted for.$B$BThat reminds me, someone was asking about you.  It was that harvest-witch, Celestine; she said the winds spoke your name.$B$BYou'd best hurry, $N.  We're going to need you to get back to the worgen-smashing once you're done conversing with nature.
text.completion: We have been blessed today!  You are alive and well!

text.title: 奥术飞弹
text.objectives: Speak to Myriam Spellwaker and learn Arcane Missiles. Use Arcane Missiles against a Bloodfang Worgen.
text.description: The path ahead is difficult, $N.  We must devote the entirety of our mental power to the task at hand.$B$BYet sometimes, that is not enough.  Sometimes the situation calls for raw firepower.$B$BI know just the spell for such a situation and I'll be more than glad to share it with you. Once you've learned it, practice using it against the Bloodfang Worgen to our west. You'll only get the chance to use your new spell after casting a different spell.
text.progress: I always knew you were a quick study!
text.completion: You've learned with such speed and ease.  Soon you'll be the one doing the teaching.

text.title: 谜题解开了
text.objectives: 你得把耐普图隆的石板带给塞纳里奥研究员库拉。
text.description: 你的努力得到了回报。你所冒的巨大风险是值得的。$B$B你发现了纳迦所渴求的物品，也弄清了他们遍布凄凉之地海岸的原因。$B$B至于你找到的雕文，处理办法很明显……
text.progress: What have you learned, $c?
text.completion: The vision was true! You have singlehandedly succeeded where others have failed. The Circle will be have no choice but to pay attention to these findings.

english.title: Mystery Solved
english.objectives: You are to bring the Ancient Engravings of Neptulon to Cenarion Researcher Korrah.
english.description: Your efforts have paid off. The great risks you have taken have proven worthwhile.$b$bYou have discovered the object of the nagas' desire and their reason for overrunning the coast of Desolace.$b$bAs for the engravings you've discovered, your duty is clear...
english.progress: What have you learned, $c?
english.completion: The vision was true! You have singlehandedly succeeded where others have failed. The Circle will be have no choice but to pay attention to these findings.

text.title: A Rejuvenating Touch
text.objectives: Speak to Celestine of the Harvest and learn Rejuvenation. Practice using Rejuvenation on a Wounded Guard.
text.description: We were driven to the edge of extinction once before, $N.  But we druids, keepers of the old ways, saved our people from famine.$B$BWhen we cut ourselves off from the outside world and our crops failed, it was our order who called upon the earth's blessings and restored the harvest.$B$BJust as we did then, it is best to put our fate in the hands of a higher power.  Join me now and learn what the wild has to teach us.
text.progress: The earth speaks to us, $N.  It will not abandon us even in these perilous times.
text.completion: Not bad at all.  Perhaps there is still hope for the old ways.

text.title: 亡魂的复仇
text.objectives: 海卓尼斯要你骑在他的身上打败女祭司瓦丽丝琪。
text.description: 我乃海卓尼斯，是四海的君王、猎潮者耐普图隆的仆从。$B$B艾萨拉和她那些罪恶的纳迦陈兵攻打我的主人，向他发起挑战。这还是头一次要打的旷日持久的战斗。$B$B我苦苦奋战，$R，我有点力不能支了。$B$B看来我的行动引起了他们女祭司的注意。$B$B独自一人的我是无力与她抗衡的。不过也许携起手来，我们能够获胜。
text.completion: The priestess is no more...

english.title: A Revenant's Vengeance
english.objectives: Hydronis wants you to mount him and defeat Priestess Valishj.
english.description: I am Hydronis, a servant of Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord over all waters.$b$bAzshara and her sinister naga have arrayed themselves against my master, and seek a war with him. This is the first battle in what shall surely be a long struggle.$b$bI have fought bitterly, $r, and have grown weary.$b$bIt seems that my actions here have attracted the attention of their priestess.$b$bAlone, I haven't the strength to overcome her. but perhaps together, we may prevail.
english.completion: The priestess is no more...

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 狼人的攻击一波接着一波，我能教你的也就这么些了。$B$B我们应该考虑一下要不要跟其他的幸存者一同前往南边。据说格雷迈恩国王就在此地。$B$B大家聚集起来的话，生存的机会也会大一点……如果你身旁的人会治疗法术，那就更好了。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: There's only so much I can teach right now with all these worgen trying to dismember us.$B$BWe really should think about heading south with the other survivors.  We've been told that King Greymane is there.$B$BIf we stick together our chances of survival will increase... especially if you choose someone nutritious-looking to stand next to.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经将所有实用的技能传授给你了。$B$B与其他幸存者汇合的时候到了。据说格雷迈恩国王和他的皇家卫队就在此地以南。$B$B我们应该赶往那里，寻求庇护。人多的话，也会安全一点。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: I've taught you all that is practical for now.$B$BIt is time we joined with the other survivors.  The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.$B$BWe should go there and seek safety in numbers.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经将所有实用的技能传授给你了。$B$B与其他幸存者汇合的时候到了。据说格雷迈恩国王和他的皇家卫队就在此地以南。$B$B在这种危急时刻，人民更需要圣光的帮助。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: I've taught you all that is practical for now.$B$BIt is time we joined with the other survivors.  The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.$B$BThe others are going to need the aid of the Light in these troubling times.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.title: 人多安全
text.objectives: 跟军事区的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 我已经将所有实用的技能传授给你了。$B$B与其他幸存者汇合的时候到了。据说格雷迈恩国王和他的皇家卫队就在此地以南。$B$B我们应该赶往那里，寻求庇护。人多的话，也会安全一点。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.title: Safety in Numbers
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane in the military district.
english.description: I've taught you all that is practical for now.$B$BIt is time we joined with the other survivors.  The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.$B$BWe should go there and seek safety in numbers.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.description: 我已经将所有实用的技能传授给你了。$B$B与其他幸存者汇合的时候到了。据说格雷迈恩国王和他的皇家卫队就在此地以南。$B$B我们应该赶往那里，寻求庇护。人多的话，也会安全一点。
text.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

english.description: I've taught you all that is practical for now.$B$BIt is time we joined with the other survivors.  The others mentioned that King Greymane and his royal guard are just south of here.$B$BWe should go there and seek safety in numbers.
english.completion: You've done well in coming here.  If we Gilneans stick together we might yet defeat this terrible enemy.

text.title: 我们敌人的敌人
text.objectives: 塞纳里奥研究员库拉要你跟元素勋爵海卓尼斯谈一谈。
text.description: 你为我们做出了巨大的贡献，$C。$B$B尽管他们的兵力依然庞大，但你还是让一件重要的神器免入纳迦之手。$B$B我将把你的发现写信报告给我的同僚们。与此同时，拉纳加尔岛上的水流亡魂独力抵挡着纳迦的猛攻。$B$B我想让你去找到他，看我们是不是有什么办法可以帮助他。
text.completion: I have witnessed your actions here, $r. Your presence here is both welcome and timely.

english.title: The Enemy of Our Enemy
english.objectives: Cenarion Researcher Korrah wants you to speak with Lord Hydronis.
english.description: You have done us a great service, $c.$b$bWhile they remain an imposing force, your efforts have kept an important artifact from the naga.$b$bI shall write to my peers of your findings. Meanwhile, the water revenant on Ranazjar Isle has stood alone against a steady onslaught of naga.$b$bI would have you find him and determine if there is some way we can assist him.
english.completion: I have witnessed your actions here, $r. Your presence here is both welcome and timely.

text.title: 救援克雷南·阿朗纳斯
text.objectives: 营救克雷南·阿朗纳斯。
text.description: 内战已经结束多年，克罗雷竟然还能在地窖里藏匿这样一批军火，其威力足以摧毁半座城镇。$B$B真不幸，我们现在也许真得这么干了。$B$B但是现在还不能开火，有一位城民被困在监狱的另一头。$B$B他可不是普通的平民，克雷南·阿朗纳斯是位举世闻名的炼金师。$B$B我的女儿出生时十分虚弱，靠他配制的药水才得以保命。$B$B骑上我的马去营救他吧。克雷南必须活着。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  We'll make sure Krennan makes it out of the city alive.
text.completed: Speak to Lord Godfrey at the Military District in Gilneas City.

english.title: Save Krennan Aranas
english.objectives: Rescue Krennan Aranas.
english.description: All these years after the war and Crowley was still hiding enough firepower in that cellar to level half of the district.$B$BIt might have to come to that, unfortunately.$B$BWe can't open fire just yet, there is a civilian trapped on the other side of the prison.$B$BNot just any civilian, either.  Krennan Aranas is one of the most brilliant alchemists this world has known.$B$BOne of his potions saved my daughter, Tess, from dying soon after being born.$B$BTake my horse and rescue him.  Krennan must live.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  We'll make sure Krennan makes it out of the city alive.
english.completed: Speak to Lord Godfrey at the Military District in Gilneas City.

text.title: 重整旗鼓
text.objectives: 跟吉尔尼斯城格雷迈恩皇家庭院的吉恩·格雷迈恩国王谈一谈。
text.description: 请转告格雷迈恩国王，我们已经竭尽所能，总算争取到了一点时间。$B$B但我感觉狼人很快就会再次发动进攻，时间紧迫。$B$B看来，我们得撤回到西边的格雷迈恩皇家庭院。那是我们最后的据守点。如果庭院失守，我们都将成为瓮中之鳖。
text.completion: We're left with very few choices, $n.  What we do next will be a critical decision.

english.title: Time to Regroup
english.objectives: Speak to King Genn Greymane at Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
english.description: We've done all we can here.  Let King Greymane know we've bought some time.$B$BI've a feeling it won't be long 'til the worgen are back in force.$B$BWe'll need to fall back to Greymane Court to the west, if that's the case.  It's the last place we can hold out without being trapped like fish in a barrel.
english.completion: We're left with very few choices, $n.  What we do next will be a critical decision.

text.title: 海的姐妹
text.objectives: 破坏希莉丝拉女士和薇丝拉女士的能量石，杀了她们。
text.description: 对我们岗哨的进攻是由两个纳迦女巫主导的，她们把我最好的手下打得落花流水，但你能人所不能。$B$B去悬崖东边，古代暗夜精灵巨像遗迹附近，把希莉丝拉女士和薇丝拉女士找出来，杀了她们。你得先摧毁她们的能量石，不要让我失望，$C！
text.completion: Now THAT is how we used to handle serpents back in Durotar - we crushed them under our boots! You have done the Horde proud, $n. As soon as my reinforcements arrive we'll mop up the rest of those vermin and claim this peninsula once and for all.
text.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Sisters of the Sea
english.objectives: Kill Lady Silisthra and Lady Vesthra by disabling their power stones.
english.description: Two Naga witches have been masterminding the assault on this outpost. They've repelled direct attacks from some of my best grunts, but you can finish the job where others have failed.$B$BSeek out and slay Lady Silisthra and Lady Vesthra at the eastern edge of the cliffs, around the ruins of the ancient night elven colossus. You will first need to destroy the powerstones that give them their strength. Do not disappoint me, $c!
english.completion: Now THAT is how we used to handle serpents back in Durotar - we crushed them under our boots! You have done the Horde proud, $n. As soon as my reinforcements arrive we'll mop up the rest of those vermin and claim this peninsula once and for all.
english.completed: Return to Torg Twocrush at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 当心脚下
text.objectives: 在通往奥术之巅顶部的路上借助能量传导器收集6束能量束。
text.description: 说简单也简单，说不简单也不简单。往上面去一路上都有能量传导器。就跟这儿的这个差不多！没错，差不多。$B$B而现在呢，你要用我的弹跳板超越巅峰，一路上还要触碰所有你看见的传导器。等你到了顶上，应该就充满了能量了，因为这事它就是这样的。$B$B记得别停下来，不然你将会有一次难忘的旅行！
text.completion: It is in this moment that most of my apprentices wonder if there was a logical purpose to storing the energy for my portal in those conduits so that it has to be collected in such a fashion. Of course there's a purpose! I wish to study your behavior... your strategies, your mistakes, your frustrations, your triumphs. Those are the entire point of these trials. Now, more. More trials! Doesn't that sound exciting?! Of course it does.
text.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem atop of the Arcane Pinnacle.

english.title: Watch Your Step
english.objectives: Receive 6 Energized charges from the Energy Conduits as you ascend to the top of the Arcane Pinnacle.
english.description: This is somewhat simple and somewhat not simple. All the way up there are Energy Conduits. Rather like this one right here one might say! Indeed, I do say.$B$BNow for you. You must use my jump pads to ascend the pinnacle, and you must touch all of the conduits you see along the way. When you get to me at the top, you should be all juicy with energy, because really that's the only way to be.$B$BAnd be sure to keep moving or you're likely to be sent for quite a trip!
english.completion: It is in this moment that most of my apprentices wonder if there was a logical purpose to storing the energy for my portal in those conduits so that it has to be collected in such a fashion. Of course there's a purpose! I wish to study your behavior... your strategies, your mistakes, your frustrations, your triumphs. Those are the entire point of these trials. Now, more. More trials! Doesn't that sound exciting?! Of course it does.
english.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem atop of the Arcane Pinnacle.

text.title: 提前解放
text.objectives: 用教徒和龙人身上的铁铸钥匙释放漆黑山脊的4名地精工人。
text.description: 刚开始建这座塔的时候我就知道这些家伙会是个麻烦。拒绝我们的打点，偷走我们的工人。$B$B艾萨拉工程繁多，人工可不便宜。我得把我的人弄回来！
text.completion: Thanks there, pal. Here's your commission. If you'll excuse me, I've gotta get these slackers back to work.
text.completed: Return to Jellix Fuselighter at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.

english.title: Pro-liberation
english.objectives: Use Ironwrought Keys from cultists and dragonkin to free 4 Goblin Workers in Sable Ridge.
english.description: I knew these guys would be trouble as soon as we started building this tower. Scoffing our bribes. Stealing our workers.$B$BLabor isn't cheap with all the construction in Azshara. I need those men back!
english.completion: Thanks there, pal. Here's your commission. If you'll excuse me, I've gotta get these slackers back to work.
english.completed: Return to Jellix Fuselighter at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.

text.title: 克希雷姆疯人院
text.objectives: 进入传送门，回到大法师克希雷姆的高塔，去找乔安娜。
text.description: 真是太了不起了你！能观察你是我的荣幸。挺有研究意义的。$B$B去吧，回到我的塔里，乔安娜会安排下一步。我来给你开一道传送门。
text.completion: Welcome! You seem to have survived the trials relatively unscathed. Good for you, love. You look to have come with a purpose in mind as well. A question. Your thoughts are very loud, it's hard for me to not hear them. Go ahead then, hon. Ask away.

english.title: Xylem's Asylum
english.objectives: Take the portal to Archmage Xylem's tower and seek out Joanna inside.
english.description: Quite marvelous of you! A pleasure to observe. Much to study.$B$BOff you go now, retire to my tower. Joanna will get you situated. I shall open a portal for you.
english.completion: Welcome! You seem to have survived the trials relatively unscathed. Good for you, love. You look to have come with a purpose in mind as well. A question. Your thoughts are very loud, it's hard for me to not hear them. Go ahead then, hon. Ask away.

text.title: 火焰试炼
text.objectives: 在火焰符文中保持连续10波不被击中以完成火焰试炼。
text.description: The Trial of Fire... oooh... sounds intimidating, doesn't it? No? Hm. Well I kind of thought so. Firsts are first, you touch the fire crystal and the portal to the trial opens.$B$BTo beat this trial, you have to hop around in the fire runes without getting hit by the fire. If you stay unflamed long enough, you win!$B$BThere are little signs to help you - fire hopping to it's new rune, fizzles when a rune goes cold. You can figure that stuff out if you want. Or just guess! That's what most people do.
text.completion: Woo! Good for you! That trial really put a fire under your bottom.
text.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Fire.

english.title: The Trial of Fire
english.objectives: Complete the Trial of Fire by standing in the fire runes without getting hit by flame for 10 consecutive bursts.
english.description: The Trial of Fire... oooh... sounds intimidating, doesn't it? No? Hm. Well I kind of thought so. Firsts are first, you touch the fire crystal and the portal to the trial opens.$B$BTo beat this trial, you have to hop around in the fire runes without getting hit by the fire. If you stay unflamed long enough, you win!$B$BThere are little signs to help you - fire hopping to it's new rune, fizzles when a rune goes cold. You can figure that stuff out if you want. Or just guess! That's what most people do.
english.completion: Woo! Good for you! That trial really put a fire under your bottom.
english.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Fire.

text.title: 复命
text.objectives: 返回艾瑟雷索，向塞纳里奥研究员库拉复命。
text.description: 成功了！我们共同击败了可怕的敌人。$B$B$C，你的英雄事迹肯定会传到耐普图隆耳中的。请允许我代他向你致谢……$B$B你应该离开了。这里的安宁不会维持太久的。纳迦们很快就会卷土重来，为他们的女祭司复仇。
text.completion: Please accept this reward for your heroic accomplishments, $n. You have bought us precious time!

english.title: Return and Report
english.objectives: You are to return to Cenarion Researcher Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: It is done! Together we were able to bring down a dangerous adversary.$b$bNeptulon himself shall hear of your exploits here, $c. Allow me to extend you his thanks...$b$bYou should leave now. This place will not remain safe for long. Soon, the naga will seek vengeance for their priestess.
english.completion: Please accept this reward for your heroic accomplishments, $n. You have bought us precious time!

text.title: 官方评估
text.objectives: Cenarion Researcher Korrah wants you to take Korrah's Report to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
text.description: 你在对抗纳迦的努力中成果显著，$N。但恐怕这还远远不够……$B$B这是我对纳迦势力的官方评估。$B$B我肯定旷野中的同僚们会采取必要的行动。$B$B将它带给东南边塞纳里奥旷野中央林地里的卡隆。他知道该怎么做。$B$B谢谢你，$N。再会了。
text.completion: This is alarming news, indeeed, $r - something we have no shortage of here. I shall call a council regarding the issue. You will be summoned if you are needed.

english.title: Official Assessment
english.objectives: Cenarion Researcher Korrah wants you to take Korrah's Report to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
english.description: You have accomplished much in your efforts against the naga, $n. But I fear it is not nearly enough....$b$bThis is my official assessment of the naga presence.$b$bI'm confident that my peers in the wildlands will take the necessary action.$b$bBring this to Karnum at the grove in the center of the Cenarion Wildlands to the southeast. He will know what to do.$b$bThank you, $n. And farewell.
english.completion: This is alarming news, indeeed, $r - something we have no shortage of here. I shall call a council regarding the issue. You will be summoned if you are needed.

text.title: Back to Aggra
text.objectives: Inform Aggra at the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles of all that has transpired.
text.description: Return to the Horde Base Camp and let Aggra know that we still live, $N.$B$BTell her that I am moving on to the Wild Overlook and that we will all meet up on the northwest side of the island. I expect to see you there.$B$BWe will track down the Alliance and slay them to the last!
text.completion: I am not easily impressed, but if what you are telling me is true, then I have never before heard of such a thing. You have my thanks, $n.

english.title: Back to Aggra
english.objectives: Inform Aggra at the Horde Base Camp on the Lost Isles of all that has transpired.
english.description: Return to the Horde Base Camp and let Aggra know that we still live, $N.$B$BTell her that I am moving on to the Wild Overlook and that we will all meet up on the northwest side of the island. I expect to see you there.$B$BWe will track down the Alliance and slay them to the last!
english.completion: I am not easily impressed, but if what you are telling me is true, then I have never before heard of such a thing. You have my thanks, $n.

text.title: 血之理论
text.objectives: 收集10条吸满血的水蛭。
text.description: 凄凉之地并非只有地貌发生了变化。在这里，野生动植物以奇怪的方式适应新的环境，有的方式着实令人兴奋。$B$B我对西边那些返祖的雷霆蜥蜴很感兴趣。$B$B我需要蜥蜴的血样。$B$B将这些水蛭抛向蜥蜴。$B$B待它们吸饱血后，拿回来给我。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the samples I require?
text.completion: This should be enough. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Thressa Amberglen at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Blood Theory
english.objectives: Collect 10 Blood-filled Leeches.
english.description: The land is not all that has changed in Desolace. Here, the wildlife has responded to their new environment in strange and sometimes exciting ways.$b$bI am particularly interested in the Rejuvenated Thunder Lizards that roam just to the west.$b$bI need a sample of their blood.$b$bYou may begin helping me by using this jar of leeches on a few of them.$b$bOnce they've filled on the blood of those beasts, return them to me.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the samples I require?
english.completion: This should be enough. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Thressa Amberglen at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 收割时节
text.objectives: 收集10棵芦蓟草。
text.description: 只有塞纳里奥议会明白，这片绿洲很可能会迅速干涸，如同它的出现一样快。$B$B我们必须小心翼翼，绝不能干涉这一自然变迁，而应该保护这块绿地。$B$B大灾变后，绿洲附近密密麻麻地长出了一种新植株。$B$B请帮我收集它们的样本，或许我能研究出其中的奥秘。
text.progress: Have you collected the samples I require?
text.completion: These are fine specimens, $r. I shall commence my studies immediately.
text.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: A Time to Reap
english.objectives: Collect 10 Aloe Thistles.
english.description: No one knows better than the Cenarion Circle that this lush oasis could dry up as quickly as it appeared.$b$bWe must take care not to interfere with the processes taking place here, but to support and preserve them,$b$bA new species of plant, very plentiful in the surrounding region, has appeared since the great change.$b$bCollect samples of these for me, that I might study them and learn what they have to teach us,
english.progress: Have you collected the samples I require?
english.completion: These are fine specimens, $r. I shall commence my studies immediately.
english.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 清理杂草
text.objectives: 杀死7个拔根鞭笞者。
text.description: 自然生态在遭遇如此突变之后，某些植物和动物很可能会出现一些我们意想不到的反应。$B$B拔根鞭笞者就是个棘手的例子。游荡在绿洲的东部和南部的它们，对这个地区的环境是一个威胁，必须将它们除掉。$B$B如果你撞见了任何的拔根鞭笞者，就清理掉它们。
text.completion: On behalf of Desolace herself, I thank you, $r. Please accept our deepest gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Pulling Weeds
english.objectives: Kill 7 Uprooted Lashers.
english.description: With such an abrupt change to the ecology, it is to be expected that some of the flora and fauna don't react as well as we'd hope.$b$bThe uprooted lashers are a troublesome example of this. Roaming the fields to the east and south they are a detriment to the region and must be disposed of.$b$bWhile you're about, please deal with any of these pests that you find.
english.completion: On behalf of Desolace herself, I thank you, $r. Please accept our deepest gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 固执的风
text.objectives: 消灭5名旋风雷暴行者。
text.description: 风向正在变化，$R。这一点毫无疑问。$B$B我们被许多紧要事务搞得焦头烂额。最为主要的就是我们日益扩大的绿洲的散布。$B$B它们的生长超出了我们的预期，也超出了我们的理解，而现在它遇到了麻烦。$B$B在西边，草地和沙石交界的地方，旋风阻挡了它进入沙漠的势头。$B$B去消灭那些阻碍生命的敌对分子！
text.completion: You have done well, $c. We will doubtlessly call upon you for assistance with more significant matters in the future.
text.completed: Return to Karnum Marshweaver at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Stubborn Winds
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Whirlwind Stormwalkers.
english.description: The winds of change are blowing, $r. Of that there can be no doubt.$b$bThere are many pressing issues vying for our attention and action. Chief among them is the spreading of our growing oasis.$b$bIts growth has surpassed our hopes as well as our understanding, yet now it faces opposition.$b$bTo the west, where the grass meets the sand, whirlwinds prevent its penetration into the desert.$b$bGo and eliminate this hostile obstacle to life!
english.completion: You have done well, $c. We will doubtlessly call upon you for assistance with more significant matters in the future.
english.completed: Return to Karnum Marshweaver at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 科学发火了
text.objectives: 使用X-21型灭火器扑灭8处火场，从秘密实验室的烈焰中救出6名实习研究员。$B$B如果你丢失了X-21型灭火器，就去找南部火箭车终点站的助手格瑞里。
text.description: 你来的时候看见爆炸了么？秘密实验室再一次陷入一片火海！要是我们不把火扑灭，温控警戒就会超标，从而进入熔融连锁。$B$B给，我把这罐超低温高压液凝胶交给你：它是科学史上最具挥发性的阻燃剂！（让罐子远离明火。）把火扑灭，把我的实习生们带出来，然后用控制中心的通话器联系我。
text.progress: <Greely's squeaky voice peels through a set of speakers.>$B$BRocketway to Secret Lab! Rocketway to Secret Lab! Come in, Secret Lab...
text.completion: Nice work, $N! Now, we need to decouple the reaction core matrix from the fuel sumps, or that whole place is gonna blow itself to Outland...
text.completed: Contact Assistant Greely from the squawkbox at the western end of the Secret Lab in Azshara.

english.title: When Science Attacks
english.objectives: Use the Fireliminator X-21 to extinguish 8 fires and to rescue 6 Research Interns from the inferno at the Secret Lab.$B$BSee Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus if you lose your Fireliminator.
english.description: Did you see the explosions on the way in? The Secret Lab is engulfed in flames! Again! If we don't stamp out those flames we're going to hit critical temperatacity and resonate into a meltdown cascade.$B$BHere, I'm entrusting you with a canister of experimental hypercooled pressurized liquigel: The most volatile fire retardant known to science! (Keep that canister away from open flame.) Put out the fires and hose down my interns, then contact me via the squawkbox in central control.
english.progress: <Greely's squeaky voice peels through a set of speakers.>$B$BRocketway to Secret Lab! Rocketway to Secret Lab! Come in, Secret Lab...
english.completion: Nice work, $N! Now, we need to decouple the reaction core matrix from the fuel sumps, or that whole place is gonna blow itself to Outland...
english.completed: Contact Assistant Greely from the squawkbox at the western end of the Secret Lab in Azshara.

text.title: 安抚科多兽
text.objectives: 在5只暴怒的科多兽旁使用科多药汤。
text.description: 你也许已经看到了，这一地区的迅速变化对本地生物而言既有正面影响，也有负面影响。$B$B东面和南面，暴怒的科多兽已经对附近的人们形成了持续的威胁。$B$B该是把我的理论付诸实践的时候了。我用回春处理过的雷霆蜥蜴血制造了这药剂。希望当科多兽喝下后能够平静下来。$B$B把它放在一头暴怒的科多兽附近，一定要保持安全距离！
text.completion: Wonderful! Karnum will be so pleased! Please, accept this as my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Thressa Amberglen at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Calming the Kodo
english.objectives: Use the Kodo Concoction near 5 Enraged Kodos.
english.description: As you have by now witnessed, the rapid changes to this region can have both positive and negative effects on the native creatures.$b$bTo the south and east of here, enraged kodo are a constant threat to anyone nearby.$b$bIt's time to put my theory to the test. I've used the rejuvenated thunder lizard's blood in the making of this concoction. I'm hoping it will soothe the kodo when they eat it.$b$bPlace it near an enraged kodo and make sure you do it from a safe distance!
english.completion: Wonderful! Karnum will be so pleased! Please, accept this as my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Thressa Amberglen at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 总结段错误：卸除核心
text.objectives: 激活反应堆控制台，将艾萨莱特水晶核心送回南部火箭车终点站。万一核心过热，使用X-21型灭火器。
text.description: 一旦我们熄灭中央反应堆，你就把核心给我带回来。它是一颗100%精炼艾萨莱特水晶，威力巨大又危险，还很美妙。哦艾萨莱特水晶，改天换地的宝贝啊！$B$B拉动左手边的巨型杠杆，卸下核心用轨道系统送回来。它会过热，所以你一路上要经常性地用灭火器降温……不要让它升到临界温度！
text.progress: Don't worry about the residual effects of all those burning chemicals in the lab. Hair grows back!
text.completion: Whew, the sample is secure. And it's still steaming! Thank you, $N.$B$BAzsharite is a complex mystery wrapped in a velvety enigma of danger. Grapplehammer insists that we learn more about this strange substance.
text.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Segmentation Fault: Core Dumped
english.objectives: Activate the Reactor Control Console and escort the Azsharite Core back to the Southern Rocketway Terminus. Use the Fireliminator X-21 on the Core if it starts to overheat.
english.description: Once we flush the central reactor, I need you to return the core to me. It's 100% refined azsharite crystal, which is both powerful and dangerous. And lovely. Oh precious azsharite, the shaper of worlds to come!$B$BThe giant lever to your left will dump the core and send it to me via the rail system. The core will be superheated, so you'll need to periodically douse it with the Fireliminator on the way here... don't let it reach critical temperature!
english.progress: Don't worry about the residual effects of all those burning chemicals in the lab. Hair grows back!
english.completion: Whew, the sample is secure. And it's still steaming! Thank you, $N.$B$BAzsharite is a complex mystery wrapped in a velvety enigma of danger. Grapplehammer insists that we learn more about this strange substance.
english.completed: Speak with Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 参与其中
text.objectives: 前往塞纳里奥旷野，对5处肥沃土堆使用塞纳里奥之种。
text.description: 我们生活的时代是多么美好啊！$B$B曾经的荒土凄凉之地如今变得生机盎然。$C，想象一下，如果艾泽拉斯所有的废土都以这样的方式复苏！说不定有一天……$B$B当然，我们还面临着不少棘手的问题，但是没有理由不坐下来好好地欣赏这场生命的奇迹。$B$B事实上，我们应该参与其中。这是塞纳里奥之种。将它们撒在肥沃的土堆上。$B$B对疲惫的灵魂来说，这是完美的解药！
text.completion: The rejuvenation is so invigorating! Don't you think?
text.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Taking Part
english.objectives: Use the Cenarion Seeds next to 5 of the Fertile Mounds around the Cenarion Wildlands.
english.description: What a glorious time we live in!$b$bThe former wastelands of Desolace are blooming, bursting with life. Imagine, $c, if all of Azeroth's wastelands awoke in such a fashion! Perhaps someday...$b$bIt's true that there are weighty issues at hand here, but why not take a moment to appreciate the wondrous miracle we are witnessing?$b$bIn fact, why not take part in it? Here are some Cenarion Seeds. Use them at the more fertile spots of the wildlands.$b$bPerfect medicine for lifting a weary soul!
english.completion: The rejuvenation is so invigorating! Don't you think?
english.completed: Return to Botanist Ferrah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 准备见面
text.objectives: 卡隆林地的格伦·暗风要你去跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 我听说了你在凄凉之地的事迹，$N。我们欠你人情。$B$B但我恐怕得让你卷入另一场危机之中，而且比其它的还要紧迫。$B$B近来这里风云突变。旧的纷争形成了新的冲突，更加险恶。我应该让我们的客人来进一步地解释……$B$B一度统治整个东凄凉之地的科卡尔部落，如今门庭冷落，力普拉可汗是仅存的族人之一。我们在边境发现了奄奄一息的他。听听他怎么说吧。
text.completion: Be not afraid, $r. I mean you no harm.

english.title: An Introduction Is In Order
english.objectives: Garren Darkwind at Karnum's Glade wants you to speak to Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: I have heard of your exploits here in Desolace, $n. We are in your debt.$b$bI'm afraid I must involve you in yet another crisis, one more pressing than the rest.$b$bThe landscape is not all that has changed here of late. Old conflicts have made way for new, more dire ones. I should allow our guest to explain further....$b$bKhan Leh'prah is among the last of the Kolkar tribe that once possessed all of eastern Desolace. We found him near death on our borders. Listen to his words.
english.completion: Be not afraid, $r. I mean you no harm.

text.title: 恢复人性
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的克雷南·阿朗纳斯谈一谈。
text.description: 克雷南的药剂让你恢复了人性？$B$B看来我不用处决你了。至少现在不用。$B$B快去把这个好消息告诉克雷南·阿朗纳斯吧。他正负责管理……我们关押你的同类的那幢房子。$B$B记住，$N。小心点，我会注意你的一举一动，如果你有什么异常，我会毫不犹豫开枪的。
text.completion: It worked!  By the Light, it worked!

english.title: Among Humans Again
english.objectives: Speak to Krennan Aranas in Duskhaven.
english.description: So Krennan's potion did not kill you?  Well, I suppose that means the human inside of you is in control then.$B$BI guess I won't be shooting you after all.  At least not yet.$B$BGo speak to Krennan Aranas and give him the good news.  He's in charge of the house where we keep... your kind.$B$BJust remember, $N.  I've got my eye on you.  You so much as try anything funny and you'll get a bullet between the eyes.
english.completion: It worked!  By the Light, it worked!

text.title: 突围！
text.objectives: 杀死玛格拉姆村的玛格拉姆看守者。
text.description: 一开始，我反复梦到同样的场景，昭示着即将到来的危险。我看见恶魔军团朝我们袭来，席卷了整个大地。$B$B梦境已然成真。火刃氏族和他们的恶魔主子将玛格拉姆半人马逐出了南部的居住地。因此，玛格拉姆半人马调转矛头，强占了我们的家园。$B$B那场战斗异常激烈。只有一小部分科卡尔半人马得以生还。我要你去东边，进入原本属于我们的家园营救科卡尔半人马囚犯。
text.completion: I thank you, $r. Our tribe may not have survived without your aid.
text.completed: Return to Khan Leh'prah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Breakout!
english.objectives: Kill the Magram Warden at the Magram Village.
english.description: It began with a dream that repeatedly warned me of the danger to come. I saw the demonic legions bearing down upon our kind, overrunning our lands.$b$bThe dream has become real. The Burning Blade and their demon masters have pushed the Magram out of their lands in the south. In turn, the Magram have defeated my people and taken over our homes.$b$bThe fight was ferocious. Only a handful of the Kolkar still live. I would ask that you visit what was once my land in the east, and free them from their prison.
english.completion: I thank you, $r. Our tribe may not have survived without your aid.
english.completed: Return to Khan Leh'prah at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: Liam's Stupor
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: Go away!  You're just inside my head... You're not real.... you're dead!$B$BYou died in Gilneas City... the worgen... they got you...$B$BIt should've been me... it should've been me...$B$BAughhh... first the earth won't stop moving... and now I'm seeing things...  too much rye...$B$B<The prince seems out of it.  Perhaps you can find someone else to speak to.>

english.title: Liam's Stupor
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: Go away!  You're just inside my head... You're not real.... you're dead!$B$BYou died in Gilneas City... the worgen... they got you...$B$BIt should've been me... it should've been me...$B$BAughhh... first the earth won't stop moving... and now I'm seeing things...  too much rye...$B$B<The prince seems out of it.  Perhaps you can find someone else to speak to.>

text.title: 塞纳里奥的财产
text.objectives: 在玛格拉姆领地收集7个塞纳里奥补给箱。
text.description: 自从家园被恶魔侵占后，玛格拉姆半人马就与邻近的势力进入了敌对状态。$B$B他们变得多疑而好战，甚至舍弃了自给自足的传统，开始偷窃他人的财物。$B$B最近我们的补给品总是莫名其妙地不知所踪，很可能是玛格拉姆半人马干的。$B$B$N，去东边的玛格拉姆领地寻找我们的财物吧。
text.progress: Were you able to find our belongings, $n?
text.completion: As we suspected, the Magram have been stealing our supplies. We shall guard them more closely.
text.completed: Return to Garren Darkwind at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Cenarion Property
english.objectives: Collect 7 Cenarion Supply Crates from the Magram Lands.
english.description: Since the demons have invaded their lands, the Magram have broken all ties with any outsiders.$b$bThey are untrusting and hostile and have taken to stealing from others instead of providing for themselves.$b$bMany of our needed supplies have gone missing of late and we suspect that the Magram are to blame.$b$bPlease, $n, go to their lands in the east and search for our belongings.
english.progress: Were you able to find our belongings, $n?
english.completion: As we suspected, the Magram have been stealing our supplies. We shall guard them more closely.
english.completed: Return to Garren Darkwind at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: Tremors
text.objectives: Gwen Armstead wants you to investigate the Queen's Gate.
text.description: $N!  We thought we wouldn't see you again!$B$BListen -- we need your help. A huge earthquake hit us and the aftershocks haven't stopped.  Prince Liam isn't going to be of much use either.$B$BWe need to make sure our defenses are still holding up.  The Queen's Gate is the only thing standing between us and a mess of frothing-at-the-mouth rabid worgen from the Blackwald.$B$BJust follow the road east, out of town.  Let me know if the gate has held up.

english.title: Tremors
english.objectives: Gwen Armstead wants you to investigate the Queen's Gate.
english.description: $N!  We thought we wouldn't see you again!$B$BListen -- we need your help. A huge earthquake hit us and the aftershocks haven't stopped.  Prince Liam isn't going to be of much use either.$B$BWe need to make sure our defenses are still holding up.  The Queen's Gate is the only thing standing between us and a mess of frothing-at-the-mouth rabid worgen from the Blackwald.$B$BJust follow the road east, out of town.  Let me know if the gate has held up.

text.title: 微妙的谈判
text.objectives: 力普拉可汗要你将科卡尔可汗之矛插在先祖之石上，并从玛格拉姆的手中保护它，直到坎玛可汗出现。$B$B你做好前往战场的准备后就跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 只有一种方法才能赢得玛格拉姆的信任和忠诚。$B$B就是把他们打服。$B$B他们在同我的氏族交战时损失惨重。现在他们占有着一块不熟悉的土地，挣扎着力求生存。$B$B如今正是出击的时候。$B$B准备好就跟我说，挥骑杀入，将我的长矛插在先祖之石上。消灭一定数量之后，他们的可汗就只能屈服于我们的意志了。
text.completion: Why is it that you meddle in centaur affairs, $r?

english.title: Delicate Negotiations
english.objectives: Khan Leh'prah wants you to place the Spear of the Kolkar Khan in the Fatherstone and defend it from the Magram until Khan Kammah appears.$b$bSpeak to Khan Leh'prah when you are ready to ride to the battle site.
english.description: There is but one way to win the trust and loyalty of the Magram.$b$bIt must be beaten out of them.$b$bThey have suffered many losses in their war against my clan. They now possess an unfamiliar land, where they struggle just to feed themselves.$b$bNow is the time to strike.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready, then ride in and plant my spear in the Fatherstone. If we can kill enough of them, their Khan will submit to our will.
english.completion: Why is it that you meddle in centaur affairs, $r?

text.title: Further Treatment
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的克雷南·阿朗纳斯谈一谈。
text.description: Listen, $N.  I'm not going to beat around the bush.$B$BThere's a good chance the potion Krennan made for you wasn't a complete success.  Or perhaps you need more of it.$B$BEither way, he's probably better equipped to advise you than I am.  Go see him.

english.title: Further Treatment
english.objectives: Speak to Krennan Aranas in Duskhaven.
english.description: Listen, $N.  I'm not going to beat around the bush.$B$BThere's a good chance the potion Krennan made for you wasn't a complete success.  Or perhaps you need more of it.$B$BEither way, he's probably better equipped to advise you than I am.  Go see him.

text.title: 急需药材
text.objectives: 找到一箱毒参茄精萃。
text.description: 是的。就目前所知，狼人的诅咒是不可能完全治愈的。$B$B但是经过治疗，你可以拥有自我意识……摆脱兽性。$B$B很幸运，药剂在你身上生效了。通常我只能治愈感染诅咒时间不长的病患。$B$B想要摆脱诅咒的影响，你还得继续服药。$B$B我需要毒参茄精萃配制新的血清。你可以在镇子西南的小屋下找到装有毒参茄精萃的箱子。
text.completion: The crate has been smashed and the vials inside of it appear to have been broken.

english.title: In Need of Ingredients
english.objectives: Find the Crate of Mandrake Essence.
english.description: Ah, yes.  The effects of the Curse cannot ever be fully cured as far as we know.$B$BWith treatment, however, your mind will remain yours... and not that of a wild animal.$B$BWe are fortunate that the treatment worked on you.
