Normally, I can only treat recent infections.$B$BWe'll need to continue your medication if we're to have you reverse the Curse.$B$BI will need mandrake essence to brew another batch of my serum for you.  You will find a crate stashed beneath a shed southwest of town.
english.completion: The crate has been smashed and the vials inside of it appear to have been broken.

text.title: 天灾入侵
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: <民兵的肋骨处插着一柄长刀，刀柄上镶嵌有被遗忘者的印记。你四下寻找线索，在海岸边发现了两艘军舰，其装饰风格非常野性。>$B$B<吉尔尼斯遭到了攻击。将这个消息转告暮湾镇的镇长格温·阿姆斯特吧。>
text.completion: Forsaken!  Quick, $n!  We must mount a defense.

english.title: Invasion
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: <A long knife with a skull ornament on its hilt sticks out of the militiaman's ribs.  As you look around for clues, you spot a pair of savage-looking warships at the shore.>$B$B<Gilneas is being invaded.  Bring word back to Duskhaven's Mayor, Gwen Armstead.>
english.completion: Forsaken!  Quick, $n!  We must mount a defense.

text.title: 悲剧的科学！悲剧！
text.objectives: 杀掉8头静电充能角鹰兽。
text.description: 本来我是打算用电击法驯化野生角鹰兽的，可不知道为什么它们狂暴了！现在我的实验对象把这地方闹了个底儿掉！$C，在它们找上我之前，把那些失败产品杀掉。
text.completion: So the world is safe for science again? Excellent! Next time I'll try heated needles or something.
text.completed: Report back to Twistex Happytongs at the Secret Lab in Azshara.

english.title: Bad Science! Bad!
english.objectives: Kill 8 Static-Charged Hippogryphs.
english.description: I was trying to domesticate the indigenous hippogryphs here using a series of debilitating electrical shocks, when for some reason they went berserk! Now my test subjects are tearing up this place for no good reason! $C, go slaughter my failed experiments before they find me.
english.completion: So the world is safe for science again? Excellent! Next time I'll try heated needles or something.
english.completed: Report back to Twistex Happytongs at the Secret Lab in Azshara.

text.title: 吸水
text.objectives: 从亚考兰神殿废墟东边的邪恶水滴身上收集20份临近沸腾的水滴。
text.description: 还有一件事。热水。$B$B这附近可不大好整。又没有温泉，也没有朋友可以蹭。有个好办法。这块海绵拿上……超吸水的！用它到东头的沙洲上去吸些邪恶水滴。$B$B够了之后在塔边上再挤出来，好召唤大元素。他有热水。
text.progress: The Azshari Sea Sponge undulates with living water.
text.completion: You've collected all of the simmering water droplets that Ergll requested. Now it's just a matter of summoning the "jumbo" elemental.
text.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

english.title: Absorbent
english.objectives: Collect 20 Simmering Water Droplets from the Vile Splashes east of the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.description: One other thing I need. Hot water.$B$BNot easy around here. Not hot springs, no friends to share. One good way though. Have this sponge... it's ultra absorbent! Use it to go soak Vile Splashes at the sandbar eastish.$B$BWith enough, go squeeze them out over near the tower to summon jumbo elemental. He has hot water.
english.progress: The Azshari Sea Sponge undulates with living water.
english.completion: You've collected all of the simmering water droplets that Ergll requested. Now it's just a matter of summoning the "jumbo" elemental.
english.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.

text.title: 好多热水
text.objectives: 从埃达拉之塔处滚烫的水元素领主身上获得沸水之球。
text.description: 厄格尔罗告诉你用饱胀的艾萨拉海绵去东北方的埃达拉之塔召唤一个“大”元素。
text.progress: You're back!
text.completion: Convenient, no? Who needs hot springs anyway. This is perfect.
text.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.
text.giverWindow: Alternative recreational uses for scalding water elementals have proven too dangerous to pursue on a commercial level.

english.title: Full of Hot Water
english.objectives: Obtain a Globe of Boiling Water from a Scalding Water Lord at the Tower of Eldara.
english.description: Ergll indicated that you should be able to use the Engorged Azshara Sea Sponge to summon a "jumbo" elemental near the Tower of Eldara to the northeast.
english.progress: You're back!
english.completion: Convenient, no? Who needs hot springs anyway. This is perfect.
english.completed: Return to Ergll on the coast of the Ruins of Arkkoran.
english.giverWindow: Alternative recreational uses for scalding water elementals have proven too dangerous to pursue on a commercial level.

text.title: 有吃的就干
text.objectives: 收集5块蜥蜴的肋肉。
text.description: <坎玛可汗听你说明了恶魔的威胁，以及力普拉可汗预见的景象。>$B$B不需要用恶魔来给我们上课，$R。正是他们把我们氏族从祖先的土地上赶了出来。$B$B正是他们强迫我们占据科卡尔的废土，在那里苟延残喘。$B$B对科卡尔的战争让我的人民饱受其苦，余下来的这点人不知温饱。$B$B给我的人带点吃的来，然后咱们再来谈谈恶魔的事情。
text.progress: Have you brought food for my clan, $r?
text.completion: Very good, $r. This will sustain us for now.
text.completed: Return to Khan Kammah at the New Magram Village in Desolace.

english.title: Will Work For Food
english.objectives: Collect 5 Basilisk Flanks.
english.description: <Khan Kammah listens as you explain the demonic threat, and Khan Leh'prah's visions.>$b$bNo one need lecture us about the demons, $r. It is they who drove our clan from our ancestral lands.$b$bIt is they who forced us to take over the Kolkar wastelands, where we struggle just to exist.$b$bThe war against the Kolkar took a heavy toll on my people. What few of us remain are weary and hungry.$b$bBring food for my people and then we shall discuss the demons.
english.progress: Have you brought food for my clan, $r?
english.completion: Very good, $r. This will sustain us for now.
english.completed: Return to Khan Kammah at the New Magram Village in Desolace.

text.title: Meet Me Up Top
text.objectives: Make your way up top on the upper deck of the Vengeance Wake off the shore of the Lost Isles and speak with Thrall.
text.description: I never thought that I would be a prisoner of the Alliance again. I cannot begin to express my gratitude to you... $N, is it?$B$BI will meet you up top and from there we will deal with them.
text.completion: My mission is too critical to let these meddlers continue to dog us. It's up to you and I to put an end to this once and for all!

english.title: Meet Me Up Top
english.objectives: Make your way up top on the upper deck of the Vengeance Wake off the shore of the Lost Isles and speak with Thrall.
english.description: I never thought that I would be a prisoner of the Alliance again. I cannot begin to express my gratitude to you... $N, is it?$B$BI will meet you up top and from there we will deal with them.
english.completion: My mission is too critical to let these meddlers continue to dog us. It's up to you and I to put an end to this once and for all!

text.title: 言行一致
text.objectives: 坎玛可汗要你跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 看来我们已别无选择了。$B$B虽然我很不情愿跟科卡尔半人马联手，但是科卡尔可汗的话还是很有道理的。$B$B请转告他，我愿意举起长矛，与他们并肩作战。
text.completion: You have done well, $c. Now we must convince the Gelkis...

english.title: My Word is My Bond
english.objectives: Khan Kammah wants you to speak to Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: It would seem that we have no choice.$b$bAs reluctant as I am to cooperate with the Kolkar, there is wisdom in the words of their Khan.$b$bYou may give him my word that we shall lend our spears to the battle.
english.completion: You have done well, $c. Now we must convince the Gelkis...

text.title: 三个王子
text.objectives: 杀死洛忽、舍利克和觉伦斯，然后跟苏度可汗谈一谈。
text.description: 吉尔吉斯半人马居住在凄凉之地的西南部。他们跟玛格拉姆半人马一样固执，由于没有受过战争和迁移的影响，他们的体格显得更加强壮。$B$B必须展示强大的力量，才可能挫败吉尔吉斯半人马的锐气。$B$B苏度可汗和他的三个儿子统领整个氏族。苏度可汗年老体弱，且受到旧时战伤的折磨。他整天待在洞穴深处，完全不露面了。实权都落在他那三个儿子手里。$B$B杀死他们，迫使苏度答应我们的条件。
text.completion: My sons all slain... my clan in ruins.... Were I in my youth, I would tear you limb from limb! Go now... kill me or leave me to mourn alone, $r.
text.completed: Speak to Khan Shodo at Bolgan's Hole in Desolace.

english.title: Three Princes
english.objectives: Slay Rhoho, Sherik, and Jorreth.
english.description: The Gelkis reside in southwest Desolace. They are just as stubborn as the Magram, and since they have not suffered war and relocation, they are considerably stronger.$b$bHumbling the Gelkis will require an extreme show of force.$b$bKhan Shodo and his three sons rule the clan. Shodo is aging, and suffers from old war wounds. He never leaves the depths of his cave. The strength of his rule lies in his sons.$b$bSlay them, and persuade the Khan to commit to our cause.
english.completion: My sons all slain... my clan in ruins.... Were I in my youth, I would tear you limb from limb! Go now... kill me or leave me to mourn alone, $r.
english.completed: Speak to Khan Shodo at Bolgan's Hole in Desolace.

text.title: 没这么快！
text.objectives: Khan Shodo wants you to kill 10 Maraudine Maulers in the Valley of Spears.$b$bYou are to search their corpses for clues to Kherrah's whereabouts.
text.description: <The Khan of the Gelkis clan stares at you with an empty gaze as you detail the demon threat and Leh'prah's visions.>$b$bIt matters not to me what becomes of this land now. I have failed my clan and my forefathers....$b$bThere is but one thing left in this world that might bring my old soul hope, and she's likely dead as well.$b$bMy precious daughter, Kherrah, was taken from me by the Maraudine clan. If you can bring her back to me alive, I shall consider your proposal.
text.completion: As you slaughter their enemy, the Gelkis clan cannot help but to acknowledge your prowess.

english.title: Not So Fast!
english.objectives: Khan Shodo wants you to kill 10 Maraudine Maulers in the Valley of Spears.$b$bYou are to search their corpses for clues to Kherrah's whereabouts.
english.description: <The Khan of the Gelkis clan stares at you with an empty gaze as you detail the demon threat and Leh'prah's visions.>$b$bIt matters not to me what becomes of this land now. I have failed my clan and my forefathers....$b$bThere is but one thing left in this world that might bring my old soul hope, and she's likely dead as well.$b$bMy precious daughter, Kherrah, was taken from me by the Maraudine clan. If you can bring her back to me alive, I shall consider your proposal.
english.completion: As you slaughter their enemy, the Gelkis clan cannot help but to acknowledge your prowess.

text.title: 被囚的公主
text.objectives: You are to find Kherrah somewhere behind the doors to Maraudon.
text.description: 你查到了苏度可汗的女儿柯尔拉的下落。她被关押在玛拉顿！$B$B营救行动是有风险的，但是如果想与吉尔吉斯氏族达成同盟，就必须救出可汗的女儿。
text.completion: Is it safe for me to leave, $r?

english.title: Behind Closed Doors
english.objectives: You are to find Kherrah somewhere behind the doors to Maraudon.
english.description: You've discovered the location of Khan Shodo's daughter, Kherrah. She is being held behind the doors to Maraudon!$b$bThe rescue attempt is certain to be risky, but if you seek the Gelkis clan's cooperation, you must free the Khan's daughter.
english.completion: Is it safe for me to leave, $r?

text.title: 化敌为友
text.objectives: 柯尔拉要你跟力普拉可汗谈一谈。
text.description: <柯尔拉听你讲述最近发生的事件。>$B$B我同意科卡尔可汗的话。氏族世代的仇恨应该划上句号了。恶魔的威胁才促使半人马齐心一致，这真是莫大的耻辱。$B$B我会回去说服父王，让他答应与你们结盟。相信我，他会听我的。$B$B请转告力普拉可汗，吉尔吉斯氏族随时听候调遣。
text.completion: You have done well, $r. And not a moment too soon....

english.title: Time For Change
english.objectives: Kherrah wants you to speak with Khan Leh'prah.
english.description: <Kherrah listens to you as you explain recent events.>$b$bI agree with the words of the Kolkar Khan. The time for ancient grudges is over. It is a shame that it has taken a demonic crisis to unite the tribes.$b$bI shall return to my father and convince him to join your cause. You have my word that he will comply.$b$bReturn to Khan Leh'prah and inform him that the Gelkis will be ready when called upon.
english.completion: You have done well, $r. And not a moment too soon....

text.title: 你既然来了
text.objectives: 搜寻长矛谷，找到6件被亵渎的圣物。
text.description: 玛洛迪氏族骚扰吉尔吉斯营地已经好些年了，这些强盗什么都偷。$B$B他们最喜欢做的一件事就是亵渎偷来的吉尔吉斯圣物。$B$B如果你能找到并摧毁这些被亵渎的古器，吉尔吉斯氏族肯定会非常感激。
text.completion: The destruction of those defiled relics will ease the minds of the Gelkis, and will strengthen their resolve. You have done well.

english.title: While You're Here
english.objectives: You are to scour the Valley of Spears to find 6 Defiled Relics.
english.description: The Maraudine have raided the Gelkis camps for many years, stealing anything they could get their hands on.$b$bOne of their favorite torments is to take these relics of power which the Gelkis hold sacred, and bring them here to be defiled.$b$bThe Gelkis clan would certainly be grateful if you were to find and destroy these defiled artifacts.
english.completion: The destruction of those defiled relics will ease the minds of the Gelkis, and will strengthen their resolve. You have done well.

text.title: 肥肠
text.objectives: 麦拉斯要你去杀掉肥肠。
text.description: 啊嘿，伙计！$B$B你觉得你能给村子出点力吗？$B$B我们能对付大多数的鲸鱼，可有一条特别大的，矛叉不进。$B$B肥肠把我们赖以生存的鱼都吃光了，变得越来越大！$B$B去找到那畜生，看它还敢贪嘴！
text.completion: Oy, mon! Ya did it! We soon be havin' fish to eat, thanks be to you.

english.title: Blubbergut
english.objectives: Mai'Lahii wants you to kill Blubbergut.
english.description: Ahoy, mon!$b$bYou think you be able ta do something for da village here?$b$bMost whales we can handle fine, but there be a special whale out there that be too big for our spears.$b$bBlubbergut been gettin' bigger an' bigger - eatin' up the fish we use to live on!$b$bGet out there and find the thing, then make him pay for his gluttony!
english.completion: Oy, mon! Ya did it! We soon be havin' fish to eat, thanks be to you.

text.title: Chipping In
text.objectives: Kill 5 Drysnap Crawlers and 5 Drysnap Pincers.
text.description: As you have no doubt noticed by now, the recent changes to the land have had many side-effects. Some of these are beneficial, while others pose serious problems.$b$bJust south of the village the local lobstrok are emerging from the sea and choking off the road to the village.$b$bPlease, $c, go and thin the numbers of this pest.
text.completion: On behalf of us all at Shadowprey Village, I thank you, $r.
text.completed: Speak to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

english.title: Chipping In
english.objectives: Kill 5 Drysnap Crawlers and 5 Drysnap Pincers.
english.description: As you have no doubt noticed by now, the recent changes to the land have had many side-effects. Some of these are beneficial, while others pose serious problems.$b$bJust south of the village the local lobstrok are emerging from the sea and choking off the road to the village.$b$bPlease, $c, go and thin the numbers of this pest.
english.completion: On behalf of us all at Shadowprey Village, I thank you, $r.
english.completed: Speak to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.

text.title: 猎物还是猎人
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇外的利亚姆·格雷迈恩王子谈一谈。
text.description: 一直以来，礁石群都让我们远离来自海岸的骚扰。但是地震为被遗忘者的舰队开辟出一条通道。$B$B快，$N。在我和其他士兵备战的同时，希望你可以减缓敌人前进的步伐。$B$B前方已经传来了王子与被遗忘者激战的声音。跟利亚姆谈一谈，看看你能不能帮得上忙。$B$B对了……请保护王子。我总觉得他最近有点莽撞。
text.completion: $n!!!  You ARE alive! I thought I was having dreams about the old days when I heard your voice...

english.title: Kill or Be Killed
english.objectives: Speak to Prince Liam Greymane outside of Duskhaven.
english.description: The reefs have always protected us from a coastal attack.  The earthquakes must've opened a passage for the Forsaken ships.$B$BQuick, $N.  Slow down the attackers while I get the rest of the militia ready.$B$BI think I can hear the Prince and some of our men engaging the Forsaken even as we speak.  Speak to Liam and see how you can be of use.$B$BOh... and make sure he doesn't get himself killed.  I'm afraid he might be a little reckless in his current state.
english.completion: $n!!!  You ARE alive! I thought I was having dreams about the old days when I heard your voice...

text.title: 葬影村
text.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Mai'Lahii.
text.description: Hello again, $c.$b$bI have received news that Shadowprey Village is in need of some assistance. Our hands are more than full here, so I must call upon you to travel there and be of assistance to them.$b$bThe village lies on the coast to the southwest of here. When you arrive, seek out the one named Mai'Lahii.
text.completion: Welcome to Shadowprey Village, $r. I was not sure the Cenarion Circle would send anyone.

english.title: Shadowprey Village
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Mai'Lahii.
english.description: Hello again, $c.$b$bI have received news that Shadowprey Village is in need of some assistance. Our hands are more than full here, so I must call upon you to travel there and be of assistance to them.$b$bThe village lies on the coast to the southwest of here. When you arrive, seek out the one named Mai'Lahii.
english.completion: Welcome to Shadowprey Village, $r. I was not sure the Cenarion Circle would send anyone.

text.title: 幽灵岗哨
text.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Maurin Bonesplitter.
text.description: Greetings, $c.$b$bIt is good to see that you still draw breath. The time has come for me to call upon your services.$b$bJust southwest of this glade stands Ghost Walker Post. There you will find a forsaken by the name of Maurin Bonesplitter.$b$bHe may have a solution for one of the problems we face here.$b$bSpeak with him and do what you can to assist him.
text.completion: Greetings, $c. It is good that you have finally arrived....

english.title: Ghost Walker Post
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak with Maurin Bonesplitter.
english.description: Greetings, $c.$b$bIt is good to see that you still draw breath. The time has come for me to call upon your services.$b$bJust southwest of this glade stands Ghost Walker Post. There you will find a forsaken by the name of Maurin Bonesplitter.$b$bHe may have a solution for one of the problems we face here.$b$bSpeak with him and do what you can to assist him.
english.completion: Greetings, $c. It is good that you have finally arrived....

text.title: 发射装置
text.objectives: 玛乌林·碎骨要你从濒死的科多兽身上收集3个中空的科多兽角。
text.description: 命运使然，这里有件特殊的使命要完成——一件能让塞纳里奥议会和我都有所得益的事情。$B$B你瞧，$C，我要制作一种特别的，这么说吧……药剂，压力不小。我相信我的工作就要完成了，但是我得经过试验才能确定。$B$B试验的目标就是西边威胁着这一地区的纳迦。他们的消失对议会来说显然是求之不得的好事。$B$B不过首先，我需要一个发射装置。濒死的科多兽身上那种中空的角就很不错。
text.progress: Back so soon, $c?
text.completion: Yes, yes. These will do nicely....

english.title: Delivery Device
english.objectives: Maurin Bonesplitter wants you to collect 3 Hollow Kodo Horns from Dying Kodo.
english.description: As fate would have it, there's a special deed that needs doing - one that will benefit the Cenarion Circle as well as myself.$b$bYou see, $c, I am under pressure to create a special... concoction, shall we say. I believe my work to be complete, but I need to have it tested to be certain.$b$bThe target of this test is to be the naga, who threaten this region from the west. Their demise would surely aid the Circle.$b$bFirst though, I need a delivery device. Hollow horns from the dying kodo should do nicely.
english.progress: Back so soon, $c?
english.completion: Yes, yes. These will do nicely....

text.title: 打扮整齐
text.objectives: 戴上你的新法师帽，同北方火箭车换乘站东北面大法师克希雷姆的影像交谈。
text.description: 吃一堑长一智吧。$B$B给，拿上我的法师帽。我敢说只要你看起来像那么回事，他没准真会收你为徒……当然你要先跳跳那些火圈，小火圈，底下还有尖刺，另一头是滚刀片儿。$B$B东北方向的那座山上你应该就能找到克希雷姆的影像了。
text.completion: Well look at you, aren't you just a marvel of modern Magery! Quite a fancy hat, I must say. Apprentices. Apprentici? I do think that I might have quite a few already, but I suppose one can never have too many appren..tici.
text.end: Approach Archmage Xylem while wearing your Wizard Hat

english.title: Dressed to Impress
english.objectives: Put on your new wizard hat and then speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem just northeast of the Northern Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Every man's got to learn his own lessons I suppose.$B$BHere, take my wizard hat. I have no doubt that he'll take you on as an apprentice if you look the role... you just might have to jump through some hoops first. Tiny flaming hoops, suspended over spikes, with spinning blades on the other side.$B$BYou should be able to find an image of Xylem on top of that hill to the northeast.
english.completion: Well look at you, aren't you just a marvel of modern Magery! Quite a fancy hat, I must say. Apprentices. Apprentici? I do think that I might have quite a few already, but I suppose one can never have too many appren..tici.
english.end: Approach Archmage Xylem while wearing your Wizard Hat

text.title: 斯米德的挽具
text.objectives: Nataka at Ghost Walker Post wants you to deliver Smeed's Harnesses to Smeed.
text.description: 请原谅，年轻的$R。$B$B我需要一点帮助。我刚完成了一份挽具的订单，需要马上送出去。$B$B我也老了，走不了这么远，尤其考虑到最近事态又变得这么危险。$B$B你能帮帮忙吗？$B$B请把它们送给斯米德，那个地精就住在东南边。
text.completion: Ahh, my harnesses! Thanks, friend!

english.title: Smeed's Harnesses
english.objectives: Nataka at Ghost Walker Post wants you to deliver Smeed's Harnesses to Smeed.
english.description: Pardon me, young $r.$b$bI'm in need of a little help. I've just finished filling an order for harnesses that must be delivered right away.$b$bI'm a bit old for the trip, especially considering how dangerous things have become lately.$b$bWould you mind?$b$bThey need to go to Smeed, a goblin who lives just southeast of here.
english.completion: Ahh, my harnesses! Thanks, friend!

text.title: 地狱火入侵
text.objectives: 费古尔·双刃要你消灭10名次级地狱火。
text.description: 恶魔开始行动了，$R！不做些什么的话，我们不出一星期就会被包围。我刚从玛诺洛克集会所过来，地狱火在那里从天而降！$B$B我们至少要给自己争取一点时间。去那儿把我没完成的事情做完！
text.completion: Well done, $r! The danger persists, but you have bought us some time.

english.title: Infernal Encroachment
english.objectives: Felgur Twocuts wants you to destroy 10 Lesser Infernals.
english.description: The demons are on the move, $r!$b$bIf nothing is done, we'll be overrun in a matter of weeks. I've just returned from Mannoroc Coven, where the infernals there are falling from the sky!$b$bWe need to at least buy ourselves some time. Get down there and pick up where I left off!
english.completion: Well done, $r! The danger persists, but you have bought us some time.

text.title: 玛乌林的调和物
text.objectives: Maurin wants you to deliver Maurin's Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
text.description: <玛乌林小心地将调和物封在中空的科多兽角里。>$B$B给你，$C。$B$B把这些交给卡隆。现在他想怎么用这些对付纳迦就怎么用。$B$B我会进行观察，好对配方的效果做一番评估！
text.completion: I hate to use such unnatural measures, but I fear we simply have no choice....

english.title: Maurin's Concoction
english.objectives: Maurin wants you to deliver Maurin's Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Grove.
english.description: <Maurin carefully seals his concoction into the hollow kodo horns.>$b$bHere you are, $c.$b$bBring these to Karnum. It's up to him how he wants to use them on the naga. $b$bI'll be watching to gauge the effectiveness of my formula!
english.completion: I hate to use such unnatural measures, but I fear we simply have no choice....

text.title: 祖格卡的垮台
text.objectives: 你要在祖格卡的祭坛使用地狱动力核心控制魔王阿兹雷索克，用它的力量消灭祖格卡。
text.description: 你辨认出来，这是一个被召唤的恶魔的精华。$B$B难以理解的危险能量在它的表面吐纳。$B$B你瞧着它，脑子里出现了一幅影像——你自己控制着恶魔的影像。一想象要使用这样的力量，激动之情就掠过你的全身。$B$B你四下看了看，试图找到能够用来对付这名恶魔敌人的宝贝……
text.completion: You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them. You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow....

english.title: Jugkar's Undoing
english.objectives: You are to use the Infernal Power Core to take control of Lord Azrethoc at Jugkar's Altar, and use its powers to slay Jugkar Grim'rod.
english.description: You recognize this as the essence of a summoned demon.$b$bDangerous and rarely understood energies weave in and out of its surface.$b$bAs you gaze upon it, a vision fills your mind - an image of yourself controlling demonic minions. A rush of excitement flows through you as you imagine wielding such power.$b$bLooking at your surroundings, you wonder how this treasure might be used against this demonic enemy....
english.completion: You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them. You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow....

text.title: 被淘汰者
text.objectives: 同北方火箭车换乘站的索纳塔·火舞交谈
text.description: 爽啊！$B$B小艾常说要弄点儿神器来，说他打算和那个大法师什么的交朋友。克希雷姆！$B$B克希雷姆有好多学徒。他什么人都要，然后让他们往死里干，接着就撒手不管了。员工流失率很高。$B$B昨晚就有一个。朝西边，地精大塔一样的东西那儿去了。莫不成他可以帮你引见克希雷姆？莫不成克希雷姆知道小艾在哪儿？$B$B加勒个油啊！
text.completion: Look buddy, I was in your shoes not a week ago. Big powerful Archmage actually takes on apprentices! Who could pass up an opportunity like that?! Sometimes, things really are just too good to be true.

english.title: Wash Out
english.objectives: Speak to Sorata Firespinner at the Northern Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Delicious!$B$BAzy always trying to get his hands on magic artifacts. Said he was trying to make friends with that archmage person. Xylem!$B$BXylem has LOTS of apprentices. Takes in all kinds, burns'm out, leaves them wandering all over. High turnover.$B$BLast one was last night. Headed over towards that big goblin tower construction thing, way west. Maybe he'll help you meet Xylem? Maybe Xylem knows where Azy is?$B$BPlay nice!
english.completion: Look buddy, I was in your shoes not a week ago. Big powerful Archmage actually takes on apprentices! Who could pass up an opportunity like that?! Sometimes, things really are just too good to be true.

text.title: 清理我们的裂口
text.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to use Maurin's Concoction to kill 10 Slitherblade Invaders, 10 Slitherblade Sirens, and 3 Sea Giants.
text.description: As you of course know, $n, the naga remain a serious threat to the region. The time has come for us to drive them back into the sea!$b$bWhen you are ready, Grimfeather will take you to the crevasse where they are preparing a violent assault. Once there, use Maurin's Concoction to teach them a lesson they shall not soon forget.
text.completion: Your deeds continue to impress me, $n. Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

english.title: Cleansing Our Crevasse
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to use Maurin's Concoction to kill 10 Slitherblade Invaders, 10 Slitherblade Sirens, and 3 Sea Giants.
english.description: As you of course know, $n, the naga remain a serious threat to the region. The time has come for us to drive them back into the sea!$b$bWhen you are ready, Grimfeather will take you to the crevasse where they are preparing a violent assault. Once there, use Maurin's Concoction to teach them a lesson they shall not soon forget.
english.completion: Your deeds continue to impress me, $n. Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.

text.title: 坚守阵地
text.objectives: 击败10名入侵的被遗忘者。
text.description: $N！我真的搞不清楚你究竟是活着还是死了……是人类还是狼人……$B$B我甚至不确定自己是不是在做梦。我只能肯定一件事……$B$B那就是，我们要将这些入侵的被遗忘者赶出我们的国土！
text.completion: Yes, $n!  Just like old times... I'm going to have to work hard at not shooting you, but Krennan explained everything to us.
text.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane outside Duskhave in Gilneas.

english.title: Hold the Line
english.objectives: Kill 10 Forsaken Invaders.
english.description: $N!  I'm still not sure if you're alive or dead... human or worgen...$B$BI'm not even sure if I'm really awake.  But THIS I am sure of...$B$BWe're going to kill a great many of these motherless Forsaken.
english.completion: Yes, $n!  Just like old times... I'm going to have to work hard at not shooting you, but Krennan explained everything to us.
english.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane outside Duskhave in Gilneas.

text.title: 合作
text.objectives: 使用黑色火药桶炸死4只恐怖憎恶。
text.description: $N，瞧。那些死胖子——憎恶，他们很难对付，所以你最好别招惹他们。$B$B但我有一个疯狂的点子，说不定会派上用场。但是一旦处理失当，也可能会要了你的性命。$B$B小屋和风车旁散落着不少火药桶。拎起火药桶，朝憎恶的脑袋抛过去。接下来就交给我手中这柄老霰弹枪吧。
text.completion: You and me, $n.  We make a great team... It's good to have you back.
text.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at Duskhaven in Gilneas.

english.title: You Can't Take 'Em Alone
english.objectives: Use the Black Gunpowder Kegs to blow up 4 Horrid Abominations.
english.description: Look here, $N.  The big fat ones -- abominations, they're called -- they don't go down easy, so don't tackle them on your own.$B$BBut I have an idea so crazy it might just work.  Or it might get you killed, if we're not careful, I suppose.$B$BThere's barrels of gunpowder beneath the sheds and by the windmills.  Grab them and toss 'em right on the abominations' heads.  I'll take care of the rest with this trusty old blunderbuss.
english.completion: You and me, $n.  We make a great team... It's good to have you back.
english.completed: Return to Prince Liam Greymane at Duskhaven in Gilneas.

text.title: 上级的命令
text.objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
text.description: The order has come down, $c. Sylvanas herself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.$B$BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.$B$B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>$B$BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to the Dark Lady. Do not embarrass me, $c!
text.completion: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into our lands, desecrate our structures and monuments and murder our people. The time has come to deal with this pest. You will become the instrument of our reckoning.

english.title: The Call to Command
english.objectives: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
english.description: The order has come down, $c. Sylvanas herself has requested that I send my most 'capable' agents back to the Undercity for a highly sensitive tactical operation.$B$BUnfortunately, my most capable agents were killed over three years ago. In their stead I have a collection of brain dead riff-raff.$B$B<Nathanos stares coldly at you.>$B$BTravel to the Undercity at once and report to the Dark Lady. Do not embarrass me, $c!
english.completion: The Grand Crusader sits safely in the Scarlet Bastion while his forces pour into our lands, desecrate our structures and monuments and murder our people. The time has come to deal with this pest. You will become the instrument of our reckoning.

text.title: 红衣信使
text.objectives: 返回东瘟疫之地，找到并杀死红衣信使，拿到大十字军的命令。$B$B把命令交给纳萨诺斯·凋零者，并等待进一步的指示。
text.description: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.
text.progress: 如果你成功了，那你也许可以就此赢得我的尊敬，$C。
text.completion: <纳萨诺斯大笑了起来。>$B$B太好了!我终於等到了一个可以消灭血色十字军神谕者的机会!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller at Morris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

english.title: The Crimson Courier
english.objectives: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader's Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.
english.description: We cannot attack the Scarlet Crusade's command directly; they are too well defended. But there's more than one way to skin a cat. They'll be nothing without their main force.$B$BThe Deathstalkers have been collecting data on the activity of the Crusade outside of Stratholme. Each day, a report is sent from their central command to Tyr's Hand. This report is the key, $r! Find the Crimson Courier and recover that report. Bring it to Nathanos.
english.progress: Succeed now and you will have almost earned my respect, $c.
english.completion: Excellent! Finally! An opportunity to destroy the Scarlet Oracle!
english.completed: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller at Morris Stead in Eastern Plaguelands.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] 希尔斯布莱德之战
text.objectives: 把达萨利亚的奖状交给幽暗城的瓦里玛萨斯。
text.description: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.$b$bTake this sealed commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.  Go with pride, $c.
text.progress: Why aren't you out on the battlefield, $C?
text.completion: So you're the $C who tore through the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills? I've heard your name already. Word travels fast.$B$BThe Horde can use someone like you if you keep this up, $N.$B$BWe need to keep our eyes on all threats around us, but with that king leading them, the humans will continue to be a problem. You've confirmed that there's strength enough in the Horde to end that threat in time.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Battle of Hillsbrad
english.objectives: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.$b$bTake this sealed commendation to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.  Go with pride, $c.
english.progress: Why aren't you out on the battlefield, $C?
english.completion: So you're the $C who tore through the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills? I've heard your name already. Word travels fast.$B$BThe Horde can use someone like you if you keep this up, $N.$B$BWe need to keep our eyes on all threats around us, but with that king leading them, the humans will continue to be a problem. You've confirmed that there's strength enough in the Horde to end that threat in time.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 邪恶的盟友
text.objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
text.description: 大人：$B$B您很清楚我们可以提供什么。您占领贫瘠之地及其它土地的机会非常大，我们也只想要您的帮助作为回报。所谓的帮助不过是让您授予我们在这一带行动的自由。$B$B请允许我们说得更远些。我们拥有强大的力量，并愿意与那些希望加入我们的聪明人分享。我目前仍待在剃刀高地外面。$B$B向您致以最高的敬意，$B玛克林大使
text.progress: What do you want, $n? This had better be important.
text.completion: I've seen the insignia on this scroll before during my time in Northrend. You say this was on that crone who leads the pigs in Razorfen Kraul? I'll be damned if I'm going to let the Scourge get a foothold here. The one who wrote this - this Malcin - is one of the Lich King's servants, obviously, and that makes him a target. Your target. They're not going to take Kalimdor.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

english.title: An Unholy Alliance
english.objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: My Lady,$B$BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.$B$BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.$B$BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin
english.progress: What do you want, $n? This had better be important.
english.completion: I've seen the insignia on this scroll before during my time in Northrend. You say this was on that crone who leads the pigs in Razorfen Kraul? I'll be damned if I'm going to let the Scourge get a foothold here. The one who wrote this - this Malcin - is one of the Lich King's servants, obviously, and that makes him a target. Your target. They're not going to take Kalimdor.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at Lordamere Lake in Silverpine Forest.

text.title: 邪恶的盟友
text.objectives: 把玛克林大使的头颅交给幽暗城的瓦里玛萨斯。
text.description: Supposedly this Malcin is outside Razorfen Downs. There's no question - he has to die.$b$bMy contacts in Orgrimmar tell me their scouts have found signs of the Plague down there. The quilboar are showing signs of being plagued, too; they're much more powerful. Whatever the Scourge are doing down there needs to end. Now.$b$bFind this Malcin and kill him. Report back here when he's dead.
text.progress: Did you find the Ambassador, $n? Did you kill him? I will not have the Scourge gain a foothold in Kalimdor. We've fought too hard to allow them easy access to our cities. At least their crone still numbers among the living. She might be stupid enough to allow the Scourge in her home, but she must have sense enough to know she'd lose everything if she took the 'power' they offer.
text.completion: Good work, $c! You've done the Horde proud by stopping the Scourge from setting down roots on our soil. An act like that deserves a reward, and the Forsaken have enough lying around that I'm sure they can spare a few things. We may not know everything they've done in the Downs, but we'll find out. They can't slink around in the dark forever.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

english.title: An Unholy Alliance
english.objectives: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: Supposedly this Malcin is outside Razorfen Downs. There's no question - he has to die.$b$bMy contacts in Orgrimmar tell me their scouts have found signs of the Plague down there. The quilboar are showing signs of being plagued, too; they're much more powerful. Whatever the Scourge are doing down there needs to end. Now.$b$bFind this Malcin and kill him. Report back here when he's dead.
english.progress: Did you find the Ambassador, $n? Did you kill him? I will not have the Scourge gain a foothold in Kalimdor. We've fought too hard to allow them easy access to our cities. At least their crone still numbers among the living. She might be stupid enough to allow the Scourge in her home, but she must have sense enough to know she'd lose everything if she took the 'power' they offer.
english.completion: Good work, $c! You've done the Horde proud by stopping the Scourge from setting down roots on our soil. An act like that deserves a reward, and the Forsaken have enough lying around that I'm sure they can spare a few things. We may not know everything they've done in the Downs, but we'll find out. They can't slink around in the dark forever.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

text.title: 艾露恩的礼物
text.objectives: 造访萨格隆的艾露恩的遗迹。
text.description: 简直难以忍受！$B$B萨特亵渎了神圣的土地……$B$B我向你保证，他们没几天可活了。一旦凑够人手，我就会率军发动攻击，杀光这些邪恶的生物。$B$B但是现在，或许你能帮我舒缓一下紧张愤怒的情绪？$B$B前往东边的萨格隆，搜查那片废墟，确保艾露恩的遗迹完好无损。$B$B我会付给你应得的酬劳的。
text.completion: The relics are intact! Well, indeed, that is something. You have put my mind at ease, $r. Please accept this as my gift to you.
text.completed: Return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

english.title: Elune's Gifts
english.objectives: Visit Elune's Relics in Sargeron.
english.description: Simply intolerable!$b$bSatyrs of all things, desecrating our sacred lands...$b$bTheir days are numbered, $r. I can assure you of that. As soon as we have the numbers, I shall lead a charge that will rid this land of the wicked creatures.$b$bFor now, though, perhaps you could put my mind at ease?$b$bTravel just east of here to Sargeron and scour the ruins. Find the relics of Elune and ensure that they are in good condition.$b$bI'll pay you well for this favor.
english.completion: The relics are intact! Well, indeed, that is something. You have put my mind at ease, $r. Please accept this as my gift to you.
english.completed: Return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

text.title: 深入血色修道院
text.objectives: 消灭大检察官怀特迈恩、血色十字军指挥官莫格莱尼、血色十字军勇士赫洛德和驯犬者洛克希，然后向幽暗城的布拉贡·血拳。
text.description: 我驻扎在这的任务之一便是帮助被遗忘者守好边境，而这，$C，也正是你要为我做的事情。$B$B我本可以继续在这过活，但血色十字军会马不停蹄的袭击我的人，把他们的头一个个砍下来。他们在这是个麻烦，大麻烦，而你要对此做点什么。$B$B到修道院去，杀死大检察官怀特迈恩和她的军官们。
text.completion: I'm sure Sylvanas will be glad to have that problem taken care of, $n. The task I gave you wasn't easy, but here you stand, victorious. That commands respect, and what you've done won't be forgotten.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

english.title: Into The Scarlet Monastery
english.objectives: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Bragor Bloodfist in the Undercity.
english.description: One of my duties while I'm stationed here is to help the Forsaken take care of their borders, and that, $c, is exactly what you're going to do for me.$b$bI might live and breathe, but the Scarlet Crusade will cut down my people as quickly as they will one of the undead. They're a problem here, a big one, and you're going to do something about it.$b$bGo to the Monastery and slay High Inquisitor Whitemane and her lieutenants.
english.completion: I'm sure Sylvanas will be glad to have that problem taken care of, $n. The task I gave you wasn't easy, but here you stand, victorious. That commands respect, and what you've done won't be forgotten.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in the Undercity.

text.title: 毁灭之力
text.objectives: 将《暗影法术研究》和《扭曲虚空的魔法》这两本书交给幽暗城的布拉贡·血拳。
text.description: 仔细听着， $C。$B$B也许你还不知道，奥格瑞玛现在有了麻烦。在怒焰裂谷深处，一个名为燃刃的阴影议会氏族正在做着各种邪恶的事情。他们主要由兽人组成，我不相信那些连话都说不清楚的粗笨家伙能够妥善利用宝贵的知识。所以你要到那里去，把他们解决掉。$B$B他们应该有两本书。不能让那两本书继续留在燃刃氏族的手里，也不能让它们落尽被遗忘者的手中。你要把它们直接交给我。
text.progress: Did you secure the books? They need to be kept out of the wrong hands.
text.completion: Good, $c. You've done well. I'll keep these safe from prying eyes; the last thing we need is a strong Shadow Council rising up again. Check back with me in the future; there's always something that needs doing around here, apparently, and I might need another able body.
text.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in Undercity.

english.title: The Power to Destroy...
english.objectives: Bring the books Spells of Shadow and Incantations from the Nether to Bragor Bloodfist in Undercity.
english.description: Listen up, $c.$b$bYou may not know this, but Orgrimmar's got a problem. Deep in Ragefire Chasm, a sect of the Shadow Council called the Searing Blade performs their sinister work. They're mainly orcs, and I can't trust sensitive information in the hands of the grunts there. That's where you come in.$b$bThey should have two books in their possession. I want them kept out of the hands of the Searing Blade and the Forsaken alike. Bring them to me directly.
english.progress: Did you secure the books? They need to be kept out of the wrong hands.
english.completion: Good, $c. You've done well. I'll keep these safe from prying eyes; the last thing we need is a strong Shadow Council rising up again. Check back with me in the future; there's always something that needs doing around here, apparently, and I might need another able body.
english.completed: Return to Bragor Bloodfist at the Royal Quarter in Undercity.

text.title: 追根问柄！
text.objectives: 从武器架以及各种萨特身上收集20把萨特军刀。
text.description: 艾露恩的侍女像！它比传闻中描述的更加光彩夺目。$B$B当你靠近它时，脑海中浮现出关于这件古器的传说：$B$B在上古时期，战争结束后，敌人的武器会被抛入火盆以完成净化。$B$B你想象着仪式的场景，突然间，附近武器架上的金属闪光吸引了你的注意……
text.completion: With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift. You can't help but to feel a great sense of honor as you receive one of Elune's boons.
text.completed: Place the Satyr Sabers upon the statue of Elune's Handmaiden at Sargeron in Desolace.

english.title: To the Hilt!
english.objectives: Collect 20 Satyr Sabers from the weapon racks and various satyrs in the region.
english.description: The handmaiden of Elune! It's even more glorious than the stories tell.$b$bThe legends surrounding this relic come to your mind as you draw near it:$b$bIn ancient time, after battle, the enemies' weapons were to be cast upon the basin in exchange for a divine gift of some sort.$b$bAs you ponder this ritual, the glint of steel catches your eye from a nearby weapon rack....
english.completion: With the ritual completed, you are awarded a divine gift. You can't help but to feel a great sense of honor as you receive one of Elune's boons.
english.completed: Place the Satyr Sabers upon the statue of Elune's Handmaiden at Sargeron in Desolace.

text.title: 十枚魔印
text.objectives: 从萨格隆的各种萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印。
text.description: 远古的传说指出，这只古老的火盆是用来执行献祭仪式的。$B$B你只记得传闻的只言片语，据说如果有人剐下月神的敌人的血肉，并将其放入火盆燃烧的余烬，那么这个人将得到祝福。$B$B环视四周，你觉得盘踞在此地的萨特就是完美的祭品。
text.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.
text.completed: Place the Satyr Flesh on Elune's Brazier at Sargeron in Desolace.

english.title: Ten Pounds of Flesh
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various satyrs in Sargeron.
english.description: According to ancient legend, this ancient brazier was placed here for the performing of sacrifices.$b$bFrom what little you remember of the stories, a blessing is bestowed upon the being who places the flesh of Elune's enemies on the brazier's burning embers.$b$bLooking around, you determine that the satyrs who now possess this region would likely qualify.
english.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.
english.completed: Place the Satyr Flesh on Elune's Brazier at Sargeron in Desolace.

text.title: 来自上天的恩赐
text.objectives: 你要从萨格隆邪恶的萨特身上收集10枚萨特魔印，将它们放进艾露恩的火盆。
text.description: 你接受了来自古器的赐福，感觉自己与上古时代的世界产生了强烈的羁绊。$B$B你决定尽可能地利用这神圣的礼物。
text.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

english.title: Blessings From Above
english.objectives: You are to collect 10 pieces of Satyr Flesh from the various Satyrs in Sargeron, and place them on Elune's Brazier.
english.description: You feel a deep connection to the distant past having partaken of the ancient blessing granted by this relic.$b$bYou determine to make as much as you can of this divine gift.
english.completion: The divine brazier graciously endows you with a blessing.

text.title: 没什么是几颗瓜解决不了的
text.objectives: 收集8枚瓜果，将它们的汁水挤到萨格隆的艾露恩之杯中去。
text.description: 萨格隆废墟上的标记，以及从弗瑞恩的文字里收集的点滴资料，让你明白了一件事：$B$B艾露恩庇护所的旧喷泉有什么蹊跷。$B$B看样子，如果用泉水洗脸的话，人们就能获得特殊的力量。当然，首先，远古喷泉里得有某样用来洗的东西才行。$B$B你正在思忖着，突然在附近的大树脚下发现了一颗瓜果……
text.completion: After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font. Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess. You ponder the significance of this revelation and determine to study Furien's research for more clues....

english.title: Nothing a Couple of Melons Won't Fix
english.objectives: You must gather 8 Melonfruit and squeeze their juices into the Cup of Elune at Sargeron.
english.description: The markings on the Sargeron ruins, combined with what you've gleaned from Furien's text make one thing clear:$b$bThere is something special about the old fountain in the Sanctuary of Elune.$b$bIt would seem that one could expect special power from washing their face in the fountain. First, of course, there would need to be something in the ancient fountain with which to wash.$b$bPondering this problem, you spot a melonfruit at the base of a nearby tree....
english.completion: After filling it with liquid from the melons, you proceed to wash your eyes from the ancient font. Upon opening your eyes, you are able to see the spirits of ancient elves, still faithfully carrying out rituals to their goddess. You ponder the significance of this revelation and determine to study Furien's research for more clues....

text.title: 心平气和
text.objectives: 杀死科霍。
text.description: 前哨站肩负着监视潜在的敌对势力的重任。一旦联盟对凄凉之地发动攻击，我们的工作可以确保这项行动不受干扰。$B$B最近，一名侦察兵在西边的火刃氏族要塞不幸被捕，敌人残忍地杀害了他。从那之后，我们就不断遭到火刃兽人科霍的戏弄和攻击。$B$B他们的日子活不长了，但是我愿意花大价钱让科霍这个混蛋现在就去死！
text.completion: It is done. Captain Pentigast should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.
text.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

english.title: Peace of Mind
english.objectives: Kill Kohor.
english.description: We are a forward post, charged with monitoring potential adversaries. Once the Alliance launches its Desolace campaign, our work here will ensure that there are no surprises.$b$bRecently, one of our scouts was caught and sacrificed by the Burning Blade at their stronghold to the west. Since then, we've been assaulted with threats and taunts from a Burning Blade wretch named Kohor.$b$bTheir days here are numbered, but I will pay handsomely for that one to be silenced now!
english.completion: It is done. Captain Pentigast should be able to sleep in peace now that Kohor's threats have been silenced.
english.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

text.title: 耳饰在燃烧
text.objectives: 收集25个火刃耳饰。
text.description: 本迪加斯上尉对雷斧堡垒的火刃兽人恨之入骨。$B$B如果带回诛杀火刃兽人的证据，他应该会很满意吧。
text.progress: What have you there, $c?
text.completion: Ears of the Burning Blade? Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!
text.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

english.title: Ears Are Burning
english.objectives: Collect 25 Burning Blade Ears.
english.description: Captain Pentigast has made no secret of his disdain for the Burning Blade at Thunder Axe Fortress.$b$bSurely, proof of their demise would be of value to him.
english.progress: What have you there, $c?
english.completion: Ears of the Burning Blade? Well done, $c. This is just a shadow of what will soon become of that vile cult!
english.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

text.title: 眼见为实
text.objectives: 前往雷斧堡垒，寻找远古召唤仪式羊皮卷。
text.description: 科霍临死的时候提到，火刃氏族正在召唤一只足以威胁整个凄凉之地的恶魔。$B$B他的话或许有恫吓的成分，但是我们不能掉以轻心。$B$B这件事不能拖到联盟攻击凄凉之地时再解决。你必须调查雷斧堡垒，收集线索并终结这个可能的威胁。
text.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
text.completion: It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this. No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!
text.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

english.title: You'll Know It When You See It
english.objectives: Find the Ancient Summoning Ritual in Thunder Axe Fortress.
english.description: With his dying breath, Kohor mentioned the summoning of a demon that could threaten the entire region.$b$bHe may have been bluffing, but that's not a chance worth taking.$b$bThis cannot wait for the Alliance's invasion of Desolace to take shape. You must scour Thunder Axe Fortress for clues and bring an end to this potential threat.
english.progress: The Burning Blade must not be allowed to succeed with their plan!
english.completion: It is most fortunate that you took the time to search for this. No one would have expected the Burning Blade to be in possession of something so powerful!
english.completed: Return to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

text.title: 收集徽记
text.objectives: 在雷斧堡垒收集100个褪色的徽记，将它们放入火刃召唤法阵，然后杀死纳扎尔贡。
text.description: 看来是真的……$B$B你在雷斧堡垒找到的羊皮纸上详细地记载着恶魔召唤仪式的步骤。它比火刃氏族掌握的所有召唤法阵还要强大。$B$B很明显，我们必须不惜代价破坏这个仪式！$B$B如果能提前将恶魔召唤出来，那么这场危机或许有化解的机会。
text.completion: You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c. If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with. Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.
text.completed: Speak to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

english.title: Putting Their Heads Together
english.objectives: Collect 100 Bleached Skulls from Thunder Axe Fortress, then place them at the Burning Blade Summoning Circle, then kill Nazargen.
english.description: So it's true....$b$bThe parchment you discovered in Thunder Axe Fortress details a powerful summoning ritual. One stronger than the Burning Blade have ever been known to possess.$b$bClearly, this rite must be stopped at all costs!$b$bPerhaps if this demon were summoned forth prematurely the crisis could be averted.
english.completion: You diverted what would have been a serious crisis, $c. If that summoning was delayed just a bit longer, the demon would have become far too powerful for our small forces here to contend with. Please accept this gift as our thanks for your service.
english.completed: Speak to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.

text.title: 艾瑟雷索
text.objectives: 麦尔金斯下士要你去艾瑟雷索跟库拉谈一谈。
text.description: 最近我们收到一份来自塞纳里奥议会研究员的求救。$B$B我们手上没有多余的人，所以我要你代表我们去拜访一下她。$B$B库拉的位置就在西边海岸上的艾瑟雷索高塔废墟附近。
text.completion: It is good that you have come. There is grave danger looming here.

english.title: Ethel Rethor
english.objectives: Corporal Melkins wants you to speak to Korrah at Ethel Rethor.
english.description: We have recently received a plea for help from a researcher of the Cenarion Circle.$b$bWe have no one we can spare to send, so I ask that you pay her a visit on our behalf.$b$bKorrah is posted near the ruined tower of Ethel Rethor, on the coast to the west.
english.completion: It is good that you have come. There is grave danger looming here.

text.title: 沉着迎敌
text.objectives: 跟暮湾镇的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: $N，接下来的事情交给我们负责吧。向阿姆斯特镇长报到。$B$B我们所遭遇的不过是被遗忘者的一支小分队。如果不赶紧转移，麻烦就大了。$B$B前往敌人的登陆点，看看你能不能帮上什么忙。
text.completion: Great news, $n.  I've sent the remaining militia to the shore to meet the Forsaken force head on.

english.title: Holding Steady
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Duskhaven.
english.description: We can take it from here, $N.  Check in with Mayor Armstead.$B$BThese are only a small part of the Forsaken's forces.  If we don't move quickly we're going to have bigger problems on our hands.$B$BSee what you can do to engage the Forsaken army at their landing location.
english.completion: Great news, $n.  I've sent the remaining militia to the shore to meet the Forsaken force head on.

text.title: 艾伦农场的防风地窖
text.objectives: 进入吉尔尼斯艾伦农场的防风地窖，跟高弗雷勋爵谈一谈。
text.description: 高弗雷勋爵率军在被遗忘者的登陆点附近布防。看看你能不能帮助我们击退敌人。$B$B此地往西就是艾伦农场，听说高弗雷勋爵征用了那里的防风地窖。去找他吧。
text.completion: The Forsaken are here in full strength, $n.  We barely have enough men to hold them back.

english.title: The Allens' Storm Cellar
english.objectives: Speak to Lord Godfrey inside the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.
english.description: Lord Godfrey is leading the attack near the Forsaken's landing area.  See what you can do to help us keep the Forsaken back.$B$BI've been told Godfrey has commandeered the storm cellar in the Allen Farmstead, far to the west.  Seek him there.
english.completion: The Forsaken are here in full strength, $n.  We barely have enough men to hold them back.

text.title: 救救我的孩子！
text.objectives: 营救哈蒙德农场的辛西娅、阿什莉和詹姆斯。
text.description: 士兵们不允许我离开这里，但是我的孩子们还待在农场！求求你找到他们。$B$B被遗忘者根本没有怜悯之心……我的孩子们随时都有性命之忧！$B$B他们叫辛西娅、阿什莉和詹姆斯。请你将他们带回来。我会感激不尽的。
text.progress: I... I don't know if I can go on without them.
text.completion: My children are safe!  You've done a wonderful thing, $n.  I don't know how to thank you!
text.completed: Return to Melinda Hammond in the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.

english.title: Save the Children!
english.objectives: Rescue Cynthia, Ashley and James in the Hammond Farmstead.
english.description: The military will not allow me outside the cellar, but my children are still in my farm!  Please, you must go find them.$B$BThe Forsaken have no regard for innocent life -- my kids are in great danger!$B$BTheir names are Cynthia, Ashley and James.  If you find them, bring them back here.  I'll be forever in your debt.
english.progress: I... I don't know if I can go on without them.
english.completion: My children are safe!  You've done a wonderful thing, $n.  I don't know how to thank you!
english.completed: Return to Melinda Hammond in the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.

text.title: 释放兽性
text.objectives: 杀死8名被遗忘者步兵或是被遗忘者水手。
text.description: $N，我不想说谎。我不喜欢与狼人为伍。$B$B谁知道克雷南的药剂究竟能持续多久，到时候说不定你会咬下我们的脑袋。$B$B不过在那之前，我们可以好好利用你的野性。$B$B我要你前往战场奋力杀敌，消灭那些被遗忘者，尽可能地宣泄你的怒火。$B$B$N，让他们尝尝狼人的厉害吧。
text.progress: Did you take care of the Forsaken scum, $N?
text.completion: Not bad, $n.  It's a good thing you're on our side.
text.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey in the Allen Farmstead's storm cellar in Gilneas.

english.title: Unleash the Beast
english.objectives: Kill 8 Forsaken Footsoldiers or Sailors.
english.description: I'm not going to lie, $N.  I don't like the idea of having worgen among our ranks.$B$BWho knows how long 'til Krennan's concoction wears off and you're trying to chomp one of our heads off.$B$BUntil that time, however, we can make ample use of your ferocity.$B$BI want you to go out in the battlefield and kill as many of those Forsaken as you can, in as brutal a way as you can.$B$BWe're going to put the fear of the worgen in them, $N.
english.progress: Did you take care of the Forsaken scum, $N?
english.completion: Not bad, $n.  It's a good thing you're on our side.
english.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey in the Allen Farmstead's storm cellar in Gilneas.

text.title: 神秘的艾萨莱特水晶
text.objectives: 在附近的悬崖收集五份艾萨莱特水晶样本。
text.description: 艾萨莱特水晶！这一神秘的结晶物质一度用来铸炼邪能武器。可我们也发现它拥有高度聚能性。这是地精自发现卡亚矿石之后最伟大的新发现，足以载入史册。$B$B可它究竟从哪儿来？是什么？为什么偏偏在这儿才有？科研问题必须得有一个解！我需要更多的研究样本。去悬崖附近的艾萨莱特水晶矿脉多找找看。
text.progress: Have you got more samples? Careless adventurers have been looting this stuff for years - they don't know how precious it is!
text.completion: Ah, excellent. Some of these samples look fresh. I'm going to be up to my neck in this stuff trying to solve this mystery!
text.completed: Bring the samples to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Mysterious Azsharite
english.objectives: Collect 5 Azsharite Samples from the nearby cliffs.
english.description: Azsharite! This mysterious crystalline substance has been used to forge weapons of fel power, but in our hands, we've discovered that it's capable of focusing enormous amounts of energy. It may be the biggest goblin discovery since kaja'mite.$B$BBut what is it? Where does it come from? Why is it located only here? Science demands an answer! I need more samples to study. Search out Azsharite deposits all along the nearby cliffs.
english.progress: Have you got more samples? Careless adventurers have been looting this stuff for years - they don't know how precious it is!
english.completion: Ah, excellent. Some of these samples look fresh. I'm going to be up to my neck in this stuff trying to solve this mystery!
english.completed: Bring the samples to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 巨型茶点
text.objectives: 杀死雾翼崖居者，收集8具残缺的雾翼遗骸。
text.description: 你在悬崖边晃悠的时候或许能帮我找另一个调查切入点。巨人们从天地之初就徜徉在这些山崖上了。也许他们有艾萨莱特水晶的头绪？若能同巨人们打好交道那是最好。$B$B去为他们备份大餐以示诚意！杀掉那些滋扰我们研究的雾翼崖居者，把它们的尸首带来给我。
text.progress: I probably should've warned you that mistwing chimaeras can shoot lightning.
text.completion: Phew! The stench! Well, hopefully that massive heap of carcasses smells more appetizing to a giant.
text.completed: Bring the carcasses to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: A Gigantic Snack
english.objectives: Collect 8 Mutilated Mistwing Carcasses from Mistwing Cliffdwellers.
english.description: While you're here running around the cliffs, perhaps you can help me with another line of investigation. The giants who walk these cliffs have been here since these mountains formed. Maybe they know where the Azsharite comes from? It's in our best interest to befriend these giants and find out.$B$BGather up a gigantic meal for me as a peace offering! Kill the mistwing cliffdwellers that have been such a nuisance to our studies and collect their carcasses for me.
english.progress: I probably should've warned you that mistwing chimaeras can shoot lightning.
english.completion: Phew! The stench! Well, hopefully that massive heap of carcasses smells more appetizing to a giant.
english.completed: Bring the carcasses to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 萨加德营地
text.objectives: 卡隆·沼织要你跟萨加德谈一谈。
text.description: $C，你还活着，这令我很高兴。我接到报告称南面的恶魔愈发躁动了。$B$B如果恶魔继续往北扩张的话，位于边界处的那座营地就会陷入与外界隔绝的险境。$B$B或许你可以帮帮他们？$B$B营地的首领叫萨加德。他会给你详细的指示。$B$B谢谢你，朋友。一路保重。
text.completion: Demons? Oh, there be lots I can tell yeh 'bout demons!

english.title: Thargad's Camp
english.objectives: Karnum Marshweaver wants you to speak to Thargad.
english.description: It pleases me to see that you still draw breath, $c. I have been sent word that the demon activity in the south has been intensifying.$b$bThere is a camp on the borderlands there that is in danger of being cut off if the demons move northward.$b$bPerhaps you could lend them a hand?$b$bI know the leader of the camp there is Thargad. He will be able to direct you wisely.$b$bThank you, friend. Be well.
english.completion: Demons? Oh, there be lots I can tell yeh 'bout demons!

text.title: 地狱火入侵
text.objectives: 杀死10个次级地狱火。
text.description: 听着。你瞧。$B$B<萨加德指向东方。>$B$B看见那些从天而降的绿色大火球了吗？$B$B大批的恶魔源源不断地降落到陆地上，几乎没有遇到任何阻碍。嗯，也不完全是这样啦……至少我一直在努力，让这些家伙不至于太过嚣张。$B$B你能不能去那里帮我完成未竟的任务？
text.completion: Well, lad! Don't hesitate to knock a few more down for good measure!
text.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

english.title: Infernal Encroachment
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Lesser Infernals.
english.description: Listen up, now. An' lookie here.$b$b<Thargad points off to the east.>$b$bYeh see them big green glowin' balls that be fallin' from the sky?$b$bThose be a nasty buncha demons roamin' the lands unchecked. Well, almost unchecked... I've been keepin' 'em on their toes, givin' 'em sumthin' ta think about.$b$bHow 'bout you get over there an' pick up where I left off?
english.completion: Well, lad! Don't hesitate to knock a few more down for good measure!
english.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

text.title: 燃烧军团的传送门
text.objectives: 放逐玛诺洛克集会所的6扇传送门。
text.description: Here it is - the Hand of Iruxos.$b$bGot it from one o' them Burning Blade leaders myself.$B$BPowerful thing! See, yeh use it on demon portals and they just disappear! Spooky magic, but these be desperate times....$b$bThe demons keep comin' at this rate, and my camp will get overrun before ya know it.$b$bHere ya go, now. Get on with it.$B$B
text.completion: Aye, that'll buy us some time, $c. Thank yeh.
text.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

english.title: Portals of the Legion
english.objectives: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven.
english.description: Here it is - the Hand of Iruxos.$b$bGot it from one o' them Burning Blade leaders myself.$B$BPowerful thing! See, yeh use it on demon portals and they just disappear! Spooky magic, but these be desperate times....$b$bThe demons keep comin' at this rate, and my camp will get overrun before ya know it.$b$bHere ya go, now. Get on with it.$B$B
english.completion: Aye, that'll buy us some time, $c. Thank yeh.
english.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

text.title: 祖格卡的垮台
text.objectives: 你要在祖格卡的祭坛使用地狱动力核心控制魔王阿兹雷索克，用它的力量消灭祖格卡。
text.description: 你辨认出来，这是一个被召唤的恶魔的精华。$B$B难以理解的危险能量在它的表面吐纳。$B$B你瞧着它，脑子里出现了一幅影像——你自己控制着恶魔的影像。一想象要使用这样的力量，激动之情就掠过你的全身。$B$B你四下看了看，试图找到能够用来对付这名恶魔敌人的宝贝……
text.completion: You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them. You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow....

english.title: Jugkar's Undoing
english.objectives: You are to use the Infernal Power Core to take control of Lord Azrethoc at Jugkar's Altar, and use its powers to slay Jugkar Grim'rod.
english.description: You recognize this as the essence of a summoned demon.$b$bDangerous and rarely understood energies weave in and out of its surface.$b$bAs you gaze upon it, a vision fills your mind - an image of yourself controlling demonic minions. A rush of excitement flows through you as you imagine wielding such power.$b$bLooking at your surroundings, you wonder how this treasure might be used against this demonic enemy....
english.completion: You should be proud of how you manipulated the enemy's power and used it against them. You've dealt the demons of Mannoroc a severe blow....

text.title: 亲近巨人
text.objectives: 同南部火箭车终点站外的格蒙刚交谈，找出艾萨莱特水晶的秘密
text.description: 初步研究表明，你带来的艾萨莱特水晶既非生物体，也不是自然形成。艾萨拉还有一种造物与其类似：那些悬崖上蹒跚的巨人。$B$B其中一个貌似愿意帮助我们进行研究。把你给格蒙刚的肉带上，他就在西边等着。好生款待——看看他是否知道艾萨莱特水晶的秘密！
text.completion: Speak slower - what are you saying? Am I hearing you right? Those formations of azsharite are actually where the giants have - oh my. Groady!! Let's not tell Dr. Grapplehammer, he's made this stuff his life's work.$B$BWell, at least now we know where azsharite comes from, and why it's so rare. We've got to figure out a way to speed up, uh, "production!"
text.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Befriending Giants
english.objectives: Talk to Gormungan outside of the Southern Rocketway Terminus and discover the secret of azsharite.
english.description: A cursory study of the azsharite you brought me reveals that it's not biological in nature, nor is it naturally formed. There's another creature in Azshara with similar properties: the cliff giants that lumber around these cliffs.$B$BOne of the giants seems willing to help our research along. Take the meat you collected to Gormungan, the giant standing just west of here. Befriend him, then grill him - find out if he knows the secret of azsharite!
english.completion: Speak slower - what are you saying? Am I hearing you right? Those formations of azsharite are actually where the giants have - oh my. Groady!! Let's not tell Dr. Grapplehammer, he's made this stuff his life's work.$B$BWell, at least now we know where azsharite comes from, and why it's so rare. We've got to figure out a way to speed up, uh, "production!"
english.completed: Return to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 诛杀布伦多
text.objectives: 找到布伦多的背包。
text.description: 我终日忙于收集古器，根本无暇料理其他事务，不过有件小事令我耿耿于怀。$B$B这阵子有个被遗忘者炼金师跑来这里偷东西。我通常都假装视而不见，但是他先后溜进来三次，偷走了不少补给品……我受够了！$B$B找到这名小偷，夺回我失窃的财物！
text.progress: Well, $c? Did yeh find the cretin?
text.completion: Justice is done! Now let's have a peek at what's left of my goods....
text.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

english.title: Hunting Brendol
english.objectives: Recover Brendol's Satchel.
english.description: I'm too busy collectin' artifacts to busy myself with much else, but there is a bit of an issue here I wouldn't mind sortin' out.$b$bThere's a forsaken apothecary who's been pokin' around these parts for a while now. Normally, I'd ignore him, but three times now he's snuck into my camp and pilfered my supplies.... enough's enough!$b$bFind the thief and bring me whatever's left o' my things!
english.progress: Well, $c? Did yeh find the cretin?
english.completion: Justice is done! Now let's have a peek at what's left of my goods....
english.completed: Return to Thargad at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

text.title: 嫩虾尾！
text.objectives: 收集7条嫩虾尾。
text.description: 萨加德一心扑在泰坦古器的搜寻工作上。要不是我，他会忙得连饭都忘记吃了！$B$B说到饮食，我正想为他准备一顿特别的美餐——你愿意帮我吗？$B$B西边的海岸生活着一群龙虾。我可打不过它们，如果你能取回一些嫩虾尾的话，我就可以烹制一顿大餐！
text.progress: Were you able to collect some lobstrock tails, $r?
text.completion: Ohhh, these will do nicely! Thargad will be so surprised!
text.completed: Return to Dumti at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

english.title: Rock Lobstrock!
english.objectives: Get 7 Tender Lobstrock Tails.
english.description: Thargad works practically nonstop chasing after ancient Titan relics. He stays so busy that if it weren't for me, he'd probably forget to eat!$b$bSpeaking of eating, I'd like to prepare him something special - perhaps you could help me out?$b$bLobstrock roam all over the coast to the west. I'd never last in a fight with them myself, but I could make a great meal if you were to bring me some of their tails!
english.progress: Were you able to collect some lobstrock tails, $r?
english.completion: Ohhh, these will do nicely! Thargad will be so surprised!
english.completed: Return to Dumti at Thargad's Camp in Desolace.

text.title: 令人瞩目的发现
text.objectives: Take the Mysterious Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Glade.
text.description: <萨加德翻看着背包，拽出一件奇怪的东西。>$B$B咦，太奇怪了……这只中空的科多兽角里装有某种药水。$B$B<萨加德闻了闻药水。>$B$B哇！这肯定不是治病疗伤的药剂。它更像是一种……毒剂。$B$B赶紧把它交给卡隆吧，看看他有什么说法……
text.completion: Yes, $c. Not only do I know what this is, I know just how you should use it....

english.title: An Impactful Discovery
english.objectives: Take the Mysterious Concoction to Karnum at Karnum's Glade.
english.description: <Thargad rummages through the satchel and pulls out a curious object.>$b$bWell now, this is odd... it's a hollow kodo horn with some sort of potion inside.$b$b<Thargad sniffs the potion.>$b$bWHEW! Definitely not any kind of healthy elixir. This mess is meant for one thing... killin'.$b$bHow 'bout yeh run it back up to Karnum and see if there's anything he can do with it...
english.completion: Yes, $c. Not only do I know what this is, I know just how you should use it....

text.title: 清理我们的裂口
text.objectives: 使用玛乌林的调和物杀死10名滑刃入侵者和10名滑刃海妖，以及3名海洋巨人。
text.description: 我认得这邪恶的造物。它是一种可怕的疾病，杀人于瞬间，残忍无情。尽管我厌恶使用这些装置，但恐怕这里没有别的选择。$B$B你当然也知道，这一地区的纳迦依然是个严重的威胁。是该把他们赶回大海的时候了！$B$B你准备好了之后，恐羽就会将你带往裂口，他们在正那里准备一次强烈的进攻。$B$B在纳迦和他们的盟军身上使用这调和物，确保凄凉之地的安全！
text.completion: Your deeds continue to impress me, $n. Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.
text.completed: Return to Karnum Marshweaver at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

english.title: Cleansing Our Crevasse
english.objectives: Use Maurin's Concoction to kill 10 Slitherblade Invaders, 10 Slitherblade Sirens, and 3 Sea Giants.
english.description: I recognize this foul creation. It's a terrible disease that kills almost instantly, and in a most violent manner. Loathe as I am to employ such devices, I fear we have no choice here.$b$bAs you of course know, the naga remain a serious threat to the region. The time has come for us to drive them back into the sea!$b$bWhen you are ready, Grimfeather will take you to the crevasse where they are preparing a violent assault.$b$bUse the concoction on the naga and their allies to make Desolace safe!
english.completion: Your deeds continue to impress me, $n. Please accept this gift on behalf of the Cenarion Circle.
english.completed: Return to Karnum Marshweaver at Karnum's Glade in Desolace.

text.title: 海边的船长
text.objectives: 使用被遗忘者投石车登上被遗忘者战船，击败莫里斯船长和安森船长。
text.description: 被遗忘者投石车快把我们搞死了，$N。即使毁掉它们，还有两艘装配重炮的战舰泊在海湾呢。$B$B我有个一石二鸟的作战计划。你，就是计划中的石头。$B$B消灭操纵投石车的机械师，然后使用投石车将自己发射到被遗忘者的战舰上。$B$B只要你的瞄准技术不是太差，应该可以安全地着陆。登上战舰后，进入甲板下的船舱，消灭两艘战舰的船长。$C，祝你好运。
text.progress: You're back, $N. How's the situation outside?
text.completion: Well done, $n.  You might be a bloody beast, but you're our beast.
text.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey inside the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.

english.title: Two By Sea
english.objectives: Use the Forsaken Catapults to board the Forsaken ships and slay Captain Morris and Captain Anson.
english.description: The Forsaken catapults are kicking the snot out of us, $N.  And even if we do take care of them, they've two ships with rows of cannons at the ready.$B$BI've a plan to kill two birds with one stone.  You're the stone in this plan.$B$BTake out the machinists manning the catapults.  After this, use the catapults to launch yourself aboard the Forsaken ships.$B$BIf your aim isn't terrible, you should be able to land safely.  Once onboard, go below decks and take care of each ship's captain.  Good luck, $c.
english.progress: You're back, $N. How's the situation outside?
english.completion: Well done, $n.  You might be a bloody beast, but you're our beast.
english.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey inside the storm cellar of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.

text.title: 废墟海岸的邪恶侏儒
text.objectives: 击败废墟海岸里的宾汉姆，顺带干掉4名网枪侏儒和6名光枪侏儒。
text.description: 无赖！异端！自从我开始在艾萨拉的研究后，加基斯宾家就没少扯后腿、搞破坏。而现在一帮子二流工匠居然也被撺掇着来助拳。我有要事缠身：务必要让那些侏儒完蛋大吉。$B$B从我的秘密实验室往南，到海边的废墟海岸去，把他们那些不成比例的大头给我剁下来。
text.completion: Oh - marvelous. Tell me more. And that precocious young Gadgetspring? Dead as well? Ah, wonderful. My work here is important but at times I do miss the carnage of demolishing my enemies on a more personal level. Here, perhaps you can make use of some of my discarded equipment.
text.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.
text.giverWindow: The mustachioed menace.

english.title: The Terrible Tinkers of the Ruined Reaches
english.objectives: Slay Bingham Gadgetspring in the Ruined Reaches, along with 4 Netgun Gnomes and 6 Zapper Gnomes.
english.description: Scoundrels! Infidels! Ever since I started my operation here in Azshara the Gadgetspring family has hampered my studies and sabotaged my research. And now a mob of middling, second-rate tinkers have rallied to their aid! I have pressing business to attend to: see to it that those gnomes are finished for good.$B$BHead to the Ruined Reaches on the coast, south of my Secret Lab, and start rolling some of their disproportionately enormous heads for me.
english.completion: Oh - marvelous. Tell me more. And that precocious young Gadgetspring? Dead as well? Ah, wonderful. My work here is important but at times I do miss the carnage of demolishing my enemies on a more personal level. Here, perhaps you can make use of some of my discarded equipment.
english.completed: Return to Hobart Grapplehammer at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.
english.giverWindow: The mustachioed menace.

text.title: 被抓了！
text.objectives: 军官金妮要你乘她的坐骑前往尼耶尔前哨站去跟麦尔金斯下士谈一谈。
text.description: 站住！$B$B以尼耶尔前哨站守卫的名义，我受命让所有壮丁前往麦尔金斯下士处报到。$B$B我无权透露其他信息。$B$B我所能提供的只是交通工具。你可以用我的坐骑，它将直接把你送到。$B$B解散。
text.completion: Welcome to Nijel's Point, $r. Now, let's see about getting you briefed on our situation here.

english.title: Rerouted!
english.objectives: Officer Jankie wants you to ride her mount to Nijel's Point and speak to Corporal Melkins.
english.description: Halt!$b$bOn behalf of the Nijel's Point Guard, I am under orders to send all able-bodied allies to report directly to Corporal Melkins.$b$bI am not authorized to offer any other information.$b$bWhat I can offer is transportation. You are free to use my mount. It will deliver you directly.$b$bDismissed.
english.completion: Welcome to Nijel's Point, $r. Now, let's see about getting you briefed on our situation here.

text.title: 艾萨莱特水晶实验一号
text.objectives: 从废墟海岸的侏儒塔里拿一剂巨人用量的泻药。想办法喂给格蒙刚吃。
text.description: 说起来，我想到了一个万全之策，不过你不会喜欢的。要让巨人上厕所，我们需要一种……大号的……泻药。哦嘿！你还别不信，侏儒们正好有这种玩意儿。这可不是巧合。我倒想知道他们打算替谁通肠胃。$B$B我们的探子报告说泻药已经被运往加基斯宾的塔里，就沿着秘密实验室南部的海岸线。把泻药弄到手，去给格蒙刚尝尝！
text.progress: Once you have the laxative, try to feed it to Gormungan. And maybe give him a magazine or something. Do it for science!
text.completion: So it was a no-go? Literally? Well, Grapplehammer won't take no for an answer. We'll have to try something else.$B$BMaybe I'll have my interns smuggle this laxative into the night elf encampment. That'll be good for a laugh, at least.
text.completed: Report your findings to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

english.title: Azsharite Experiment Number One
english.objectives: Grab a giant-sized laxative from the gnomish tower in the Ruined Reaches. Try to feed the laxative to Gormungan the giant.
english.description: Well, I can think of one surefire way to send a giant running to the bathroom, but you're not going to like it. What we need is a ... massive ... laxative. Oh hey! Would you believe the gnomes have something of the sort? That can't be a coincidence. I wonder what they're trying to push through over there?$B$BOur intelligence reports that the laxative was delivered to Gadgetspring's tower, down on the shoreline south of the Secret Lab. Retrieve that laxative and feed it to Gormungan!
english.progress: Once you have the laxative, try to feed it to Gormungan. And maybe give him a magazine or something. Do it for science!
english.completion: So it was a no-go? Literally? Well, Grapplehammer won't take no for an answer. We'll have to try something else.$B$BMaybe I'll have my interns smuggle this laxative into the night elf encampment. That'll be good for a laugh, at least.
english.completed: Report your findings to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.

text.title: 敌军的首领
text.objectives: 使用训犬口哨，在猎犬的帮助下击败黑暗游侠西亚拉。
text.description: $N，到目前为止，你都表现得很好。侦察兵已经发现了被遗忘者的陆军首领。$B$B希尔瓦娜斯亲自挑选了一名黑暗游侠作为前线的统帅，她就在海边沃登的房子处。当你靠近她时，吹响这枚口哨。$B$B我会派出凶猛的猎犬将她扑倒。$N，当心。你最好不要跟她单打独斗。
text.progress: Is it done yet, $N?
text.completion: You did it, $n.  That should take the wind out of their sails.
text.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey at the basement of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.
text.giverWindow: Don't forget to use the whistle!

english.title: Leader of the Pack
english.objectives: Use the Mastiff Whistle to help you slay Dark Ranger Thyala.
english.description: Excellent work so far, $N.  Our scouts have identified the leader of the Forsaken ground assault.$B$BOne of Sylvanas' handpicked dark rangers is overseeing the battlefront from the Walden house near the shore.  Take this whistle and use it when you're close to her.$B$BI'll have my men let loose our attack mastiffs to take her down.  Be careful, $N.  You don't want to engage her alone.
english.progress: Is it done yet, $N?
english.completion: You did it, $n.  That should take the wind out of their sails.
english.completed: Return to Lord Godfrey at the basement of the Allen Farmstead in Gilneas.
english.giverWindow: Don't forget to use the whistle!

text.title: 形势
text.objectives: 本迪加斯上尉要你去跟尼耶尔前哨站的瓦拉里尔谈一谈。
text.description: 是的，是的。欢迎来到凄凉之地，$R。$B$B抱歉我们一切从简，这一地区有不少大麻烦——大多数都十万火急。$B$B一句话：能招来的帮手我们都要。$B$B首先，那边的瓦拉里尔一直急着坚持让我们往东边的废墟派遣小分队。$B$B你干嘛不去介绍一下自己呢……
text.completion: A pleasure to meet you, $c.

english.title: Lay of the Land
english.objectives: Captain Pentigast wants you to speak to Vahlarriel in Nijel's Point.
english.description: Yes, yes. Welcome to Desolace, $r.$b$bSorry we had to be so insistent, but we're a small outpost, and there are big problems in this region - most of them quite urgent.$b$bBottom line: We need all the help we can muster.$b$bTo start with, our friend Vahlarriel over there has been getting pretty antsy, insisting that we send a contingent to visit the ruins to the east.$b$bWhy don't you go introduce yourself....
english.completion: A pleasure to meet you, $c.

text.title: 艾萨莱特水晶实验二号
text.objectives: 同助手格瑞里谈谈，让他把你缩成老鼠一般大小。再骑一只火箭老鼠去吓唬巨人格蒙刚。
text.description: 好了，新方案。我们把它吓出来！根据我的经验多数大个子都害怕小家伙——比方说老鼠。唔。这地方老鼠满地爬，可我们怎么才能把它们赶到巨人那儿呢？$B$B嘿！你不介意把你的细胞结构打破重组吧？就疼那么一会儿。我能把你缩成老鼠那般大，然后那些畜生就可以给你当马骑了。这计划够疯狂，所以一定能成！等你做好缩小准备了就跟我说一声……
text.completion: So scaring him didn't work, either? Double-nertz! I'll have to break the news to Grapplehammer: Azsharite's going to remain the rarest substance on the planet. We'll have to use it sparingly.
text.completed: Report your findings to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus.

english.title: Azsharite Experiment Number Two
english.objectives: Speak with Assistant Greely to be shrunken down to rat-size. Mount a Rocketway Rat and use it to terrify Gormungan the giant.
english.description: Okay, new plan. We'll SCARE it out of 'em! In my experience most large creatures are terrified of tiny ones - like rats. Hmm. This place is crawling with rats, but how do we coax them over to the giant?$B$BHey! You don't mind having your cellular matrix broken down and reassembled do you? It's only painful while it's happening. I can shrink you down to rat-sized and you can ride one of these brutes over there like a horse. It's so crazy it's got to work! Speak with me when you're ready for shrinkage...
english.completion: So scaring him didn't work, either? Double-nertz! I'll have to break the news to Grapplehammer: Azsharite's going to remain the rarest substance on the planet. We'll have to use it sparingly.
english.completed: Report your findings to Assistant Greely at the Southern Rocketway Terminus.

text.title: 难道不是很明显吗？
text.objectives: 使用克希雷姆高塔里乔安娜后面的传送门找到灵魂医者安娜拉——可能的话，还有艾索雷葛斯。
