text.title: 战地提拔
text.objectives: 向位于埃达拉斯废墟前线哨所的托克队长报告。
text.description: 指挥官莫洛托夫直接下令把你调到我们的前线哨所去。我们准备派多支小分队进入遗迹，绕过纳迦，夺取神器。他把你指派为其中一名队长。$B$B从海滩西北角出发，沿着路到我们的前线哨所去。
text.completion: $n! You made it in one piece, good. We've got a lot of work for you to handle for us inside the ruins, but we're sending you in with the best to take care of it. You're working with GAMA Force now, Goblin Army: Mergers and Acquisitions. Molotov says you can handle it - that's all I need to hear.

english.title: Field Promotion
english.objectives: Report to Captain Tork at the forward post in the Ruins of Eldarath.
english.description: Commander Molotov sent word directly that you should be dispatched to our forward post. We're preparing to send squads into the ruins to rout the naga and recover the artifact, and he would like you to lead one of them.$B$BGet to the northwest corner of the beach and follow the path up to our forward post.
english.completion: $n! You made it in one piece, good. We've got a lot of work for you to handle for us inside the ruins, but we're sending you in with the best to take care of it. You're working with GAMA Force now, Goblin Army: Mergers and Acquisitions. Molotov says you can handle it - that's all I need to hear.

text.title: 离岸
text.objectives: 将亚考罗克的精华带给锈水港的狂人大叔。
text.description: 我们在这儿干得都不错。与你共事绝对是我的荣幸，士兵。$B$B假如你准备好了，我们可以用旋翼机把你带回锈水港，让你亲自将神器交给狂人大叔。
text.progress: Ah, the man of the hour!
text.completion: And you come with the artifact! The operation was a success then. Mergers and Acquisitions can definitely handle themselves. This thing will fetch quite a pretty penny. And you - I heard you did some impressive work down there. You may well have cut-down expenses by 10% single-handedly. That's the kind of smarty businessman I want in my army! Here are your wages, as promised. And a little something extra too - I hope you like it.

english.title: Shore Leave
english.objectives: Bring the Heart of Arkkoroc to Uncle Bedlam in Bilgewater Harbor.
english.description: We're looking pretty good here at this point. It's definitely been a pleasure working with you, soldier.$B$BIf you're ready to take the artifact back, we've got a Gyrocopter ready to take you back to Bilgewater Harbor so that you can deliver it to Uncle Bedlam personally.
english.progress: Ah, the man of the hour!
english.completion: And you come with the artifact! The operation was a success then. Mergers and Acquisitions can definitely handle themselves. This thing will fetch quite a pretty penny. And you - I heard you did some impressive work down there. You may well have cut-down expenses by 10% single-handedly. That's the kind of smarty businessman I want in my army! Here are your wages, as promised. And a little something extra too - I hope you like it.

text.title: An Audience With The Arcanist
text.objectives: Retrieve the Ancient Dragonforged Blades tome from Arcanist Tybalin.
text.description: I've placed an enchantment on the tabard that should allow you to slip past the Silver Enclave's defenses for a short period of time. You should have enough time to find your way up to the top level of the Silver Enclave and meet up with the Silver Covenant's man there, known as Arcanist Tybalin.$B$BWhile disguised, obtain the copy of Ancient Dragonforged Blades that his men borrowed from Wyrmrest, and return the book to me.
text.progress: Did you recover the book from Wyrmrest?
text.completion: Excellent work. Now that this is in our hands, we must get it to Myralion Sunblaze as soon as possible. We can't risk the Silver Covenant taking the book from us again.$B$BI'll get that tabard back to Shandy and see that he's well compensated for his assistance. Once the book is in Myralion's hands, the Silver Covenant won't be a threat anymore.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at The Filthy Animal in Dalaran.

text.title: 收益性考察
text.objectives: 用隐形力场生成器摸进埃达拉斯废墟，检验亚考罗克的精华。
text.description: 最近稍微安生了一些。加里维克斯也许还会继续花大把钞票让我们驻守，但我总觉得咱们还有油水可捞。$B$B纳迦和海巨人通常可不是什么好朋友，所以纳迦一定是在控制他们。带上这台隐形力场生成器，到遗迹里去，看看有什么有价值的发现没有。
text.completion: Hahah! Sweet deal. I'll get the ball rolling on this. All I need now is to find a buyer and get the go-ahead from Uncle Bedlam. Here are your wages for your work here. Excellent work, soldier.
text.completed: Return to Commander Molotov at the Gallywix Defense Post on Forlorn Ridge in Azshara.

english.title: Profitability Scouting
english.objectives: Use the stealth field generator to infiltrate the Ruins of Eldarath and identify the Heart of Arkkoroc.
english.description: Things seem to be quieting down a bit. Gallywix will probably keep forking out cash to keep us posted here, but I have a feeling we might be able to milk a bit more out of the deal.$B$BNaga and Sea Giants aren't normally friends, so the naga must be controlling them somehow. Take this stealth field generator, get in those ruins, and let me know if you find something that looks really pricey.
english.completion: Hahah! Sweet deal. I'll get the ball rolling on this. All I need now is to find a buyer and get the go-ahead from Uncle Bedlam. Here are your wages for your work here. Excellent work, soldier.
english.completed: Return to Commander Molotov at the Gallywix Defense Post on Forlorn Ridge in Azshara.

text.title: 私聊
text.objectives: 同奥格瑞玛火箭车换乘站的列兵沃塞斯特交谈。
text.description: 瞧，在你走之前还有一件事。$B$B列兵沃塞斯特还在那座塔里“征兵”。去告诉他我们准备打包走人了。回老家。$B$B很高兴与你共事，新兵。
text.completion: What?! I got left out of the action completely? Are you serious? Alright, alright... no shooting the messenger. Thanks for the news, bud. Maybe I'll see you back at town.

english.title: Private Chat
english.objectives: Speak to Private Worcester at the Orgrimmar Rocketway Exchange.
english.description: Look... one last favor before you run off.$B$BPrivate Worcester is still back at that tower "recruiting." Go and let him know that we're good to pack it up now. Back to town.$B$BPleasure working with you, recruit.
english.completion: What?! I got left out of the action completely? Are you serious? Alright, alright... no shooting the messenger. Thanks for the news, bud. Maybe I'll see you back at town.

text.title: 去见卡莱迪斯·亮矛
text.objectives: 将上古龙铸之刃交给奎尔德拉之冢的卡莱迪斯·亮矛。
text.description: 我们必须立刻将这本书交给卡莱迪斯·亮矛。你能帮我这个忙吗？你已经证明自己有足够的实力击败夺日者，除了你以外，我无法信任其他人能够完成这个任务。$B$B带着这本书前往奎尔德拉之冢。它就在冰冠冰川银色比武场的南边。卡莱迪斯和那把剑都会等着你。我们越早鉴别出这件武器，我们就能越早拥有它。
text.progress: We've been expecting your return. What has kept you?
text.completion: I knew the symbols on the blade were familiar. The weapon was most certainly forged by the dragons and gifted to one of the mortal races, but which blade is this, and how did it come to rest in Icecrown?
text.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

english.title: Return To Caladis Brightspear
english.objectives: Bring Ancient Dragonforged Blades to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.
english.description: We must get this book to Caladis Brightspear immediately. Would you bring it to him? I cannot rely on anyone else to transport the book and you have proven adept at keeping the Sunreavers at bay.$B$BTake it with you to Quel'Delar's rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Caladis and the sword will be waiting. The sooner we can identify the blade, the sooner we can claim it.
english.progress: We've been expecting your return. What has kept you?
english.completion: I knew the symbols on the blade were familiar. The weapon was most certainly forged by the dragons and gifted to one of the mortal races, but which blade is this, and how did it come to rest in Icecrown?
english.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.

text.title: 快速部署
text.objectives: 向锈水港的德索图小队长报告
text.description: 你马上开始述职报到。负责部署的德索图小队长就在火箭发射台的坡道下。$B$B愿我们富有，士兵。解散！
text.completion: Nice to meet you soldier. Commander Molotov speaks highly of you.

english.title: Rapid Deployment
english.objectives: Report to Captain Desoto in Bilgewater Harbor for deployment.
english.description: You will be reporting for active duty immediately. Captain Desoto is overseeing deployment just down the ramp at the rocket launch station.$B$BMake us rich, soldier. Dismissed!
english.completion: Nice to meet you soldier. Commander Molotov speaks highly of you.

text.title: 净化雷角之井
text.objectives: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well.
text.description: The Grimtotem are a tribe that believe all of Kalimdor should belong to the tauren alone. Their hate and anger led to a corrupting thirst for power. Magatha, their leader, poisoned our High Chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof, and attempted to take Thunder Bluff for herself; she was defeated, and the Grimtotem exiled.$B$BNow they seek to ruin Mulgore itself as they are driven out. Quickly, $N, you must go to the Thunderhorn Water Well in the north and perform the ritual!
text.completion: You've done great honor for both me and my ancestors today.  Please, take this with my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Mull Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village.

english.title: Thunderhorn Cleansing
english.objectives: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well.
english.description: The Grimtotem are a tribe that believe all of Kalimdor should belong to the tauren alone. Their hate and anger led to a corrupting thirst for power. Magatha, their leader, poisoned our High Chieftain, Cairne Bloodhoof, and attempted to take Thunder Bluff for herself; she was defeated, and the Grimtotem exiled.$B$BNow they seek to ruin Mulgore itself as they are driven out. Quickly, $N, you must go to the Thunderhorn Water Well in the north and perform the ritual!
english.completion: You've done great honor for both me and my ancestors today.  Please, take this with my gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Mull Thunderhorn at Bloodhoof Village.

text.title: 幻象仪祭
text.objectives: 和血蹄村的扎尔曼·双月谈一谈。
text.description: I cannot thank you enough for cleansing my tribe's well, $n, and for fighting the savage Grimtotem to do it. But there is more to be done, and it is time for your journey to lead you beyond Bloodhoof Village.$B$BZarlman Two-Moons stands by the fire in the north end of the village.  Go speak with him and learn of the next ritual you must undertake.
text.completion: 我感觉到你会来找我，$C。我能够辨认出那些想要通过大地之母仪祭的人。

english.title: Rite of Vision
english.objectives: Speak with Zarlman Two-Moons in Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: I cannot thank you enough for cleansing my tribe's well, $n, and for fighting the savage Grimtotem to do it. But there is more to be done, and it is time for your journey to lead you beyond Bloodhoof Village.$B$BZarlman Two-Moons stands by the fire in the north end of the village.  Go speak with him and learn of the next ritual you must undertake.
english.completion: I sensed you would be coming to me, $c. I can always recognize one who is trying to pass the Rites of the Earthmother.

text.title: 整装待发
text.objectives: 将战用艾萨莱特水晶核心送往锈水港的布利尼克·菲兹福斯处。同“天旋地转”费利兹交谈免费搭机。
text.description: $N，我已经把你从实验室抢救出来的艾萨莱特水晶净化样本武装好了。假如我的计算正确，那么它的爆破力足以夷平一座城市。$B$B要是我错了，那么我们说不定会把星球一劈两半。$B$B只有一个办法知道，那就是试射！把艾萨莱特水晶核心送到锈水的巨炮那儿，向布利尼克·菲兹福斯报到。我的雇佣驾驶员“天旋地转”费利兹会载你一程。$B$B我会尾随其后……就在安全距离外。
text.progress: What's that you've got there - did Grapplehammer send you?
text.completion: Oh! This is it! It's the big one! We're in business boys!
text.completed: Deliver the Armed Azsharite Core to Bleenik Fizzlefuse at Bilgewater Harbor. Speak with Friz Groundspin for a free airlift.

english.title: A Hello to Arms
english.objectives: Deliver the Armed Azsharite Core to Bleenik Fizzlefuse at Bilgewater Harbor. Speak with Friz Groundspin for a free airlift.
english.description: $N, I've taken the purified sample of Azsharite you rescued from the lab and I've weaponized it. If my calculations are correct, it will detonate with enough force to level a city.$B$BIf I'm wrong, we may cleave the planet in two.$B$BThe only way to find out is a test-firing! Deliver the Azsharite core to the giant cannon in Bilgewater and report to Bleenik Fizzlefuse. My pilot-for-hire Friz Groundspin here can give you a ride.$B$BI'll follow... from a safe distance.
english.progress: What's that you've got there - did Grapplehammer send you?
english.completion: Oh! This is it! It's the big one! We're in business boys!
english.completed: Deliver the Armed Azsharite Core to Bleenik Fizzlefuse at Bilgewater Harbor. Speak with Friz Groundspin for a free airlift.

text.title: 摩林·云行者
text.objectives: 去找血蹄村东边的摩林·云行者。
text.description: 你也许听说过风险投资公司。他们是一个地精“财阀”，类似于一个部族。$B$B这些财阀其中的一个加入了部落，但风险投资公司只会忠于贪婪。这些贪婪的地精和他们的工人以前曾经试图染指过莫高雷的资源，不过鲜有成功。$B$B我们的一个前锋摩林·云行者，已经前去查看一个地精车队的残骸了。如果你愿意帮他的话，出村沿着路往东走就是。
text.completion: Well met. If Ahmo has already explained the minor quibbles of what kind of goblin we'll be driving from our lands, let's get to work.

english.title: Morin Cloudstalker
english.objectives: Find Morin Cloudstalker to the east of Bloodhoof Village.
english.description: You may have heard of the Venture Company. They are a goblin "cartel", something like a tribe.$B$BWhile one of these cartels has joined us in the Horde, the Venture Company is loyal only to greed. These greedy goblins and their workers have tried to exploit the resources of Mulgore before, to little success.$B$BOne of our outrunners, Morin Cloudstalker, has gone to check the remains of one of the goblin caravans. If you wish to help him, follow the road out of the village to the east.
english.completion: Well met. If Ahmo has already explained the minor quibbles of what kind of goblin we'll be driving from our lands, let's get to work.

text.title: Out of Order
text.objectives: Paul's Test Questgiver wants you to kill zombies.
text.description: Hey there $c, I need you to solve the Cataclysm. Go hunt me some zombies.

english.title: Out of Order
english.objectives: Paul's Test Questgiver wants you to kill zombies.
english.description: Hey there $c, I need you to solve the Cataclysm. Go hunt me some zombies.

text.title: 利剑的重铸
text.objectives: 取得5块注能的萨隆邪铁锭和熔炉之主的巨锤，用它们重铸奎尔德拉。
text.description: 我们不能让奎尔德拉就这样只是一堆耻辱的碎片。带上这把剑的残片和你发现的剑柄，到冰冠堡垒的萨隆矿坑去。$B$B巫妖王强迫许多奴隶在那里采掘熔炼萨隆邪铁矿石。我们要用萨隆邪铁重铸奎尔德拉。$B$B你必须取得注能的萨隆邪铁锭和熔炉之主的大锤，然后用它们在熔炉之主的铁砧上重铸这把剑。
text.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
text.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar, although Blood-Queen Lana'thel proclaimed we could not! The blade must still be tempered, but she and her master will not stand in our way!
text.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.

english.title: Reforging The Sword
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer and use them to make the Reforged Quel'Delar.
english.description: We cannot allow Quel'Delar to remain broken and disgraced. Take the remnants of the sword, along with the battered hilt you discovered, and venture into the Pit of Saron within Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the pit, the Lich King uses slaves to mine, process, and transform saronite ore. This infused saronite is what we will use to rebuild Quel'Delar.$B$BYou must gather bars of infused saronite and capture the forgemaster's hammer, then bring them to the forgemaster's anvil and reforge the sword.
english.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
english.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar, although Blood-Queen Lana'thel proclaimed we could not! The blade must still be tempered, but she and her master will not stand in our way!
english.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.

text.title: Operation Item Get
text.objectives: Paul's Test Questgiver wants you to obtain 5 Trogg Items.
text.description: Now that ye've killed those wolves, let's try out somethin' different.  Go nab some items from the troggs over yonder.$b$bOnly the burliest of the burly have items.$b$bci 49707 5
text.completed: Return to Paul's Test Questgiver.

english.objectives: Paul's Test Questgiver wants you to obtain 5 Trogg Items.
english.description: Now that ye've killed those wolves, let's try out somethin' different.  Go nab some items from the troggs over yonder.$b$bOnly the burliest of the burly have items.$b$bci 49707 5
english.completed: Return to Paul's Test Questgiver.

text.title: 探查灰谷
text.objectives: 与灰谷的库格·血滴交谈。
text.description: 就算达纳希恩的渣滓从艾萨拉撤退的当口，驻扎在灰谷的骑兵还是不停地给我发来综合报告。暗夜精灵也许会在贫瘠之地对我们发动一次进攻。$B$B$C，我要你摸过边境去找我的一个探子，他叫库格·血滴，塔伦迪斯营地西南边过了桥便是。查清楚森林里都发生了些什么！
text.completion: You say Talrendis Point has fallen? That's good news! It also explains the exodus of elves I've seen along this road.
text.completed: 与灰谷的库格·血滴交谈。

english.title: Probing into Ashenvale
english.objectives: Speak with Kulg Gorespatter in Ashenvale.
english.description: Even as the Darnassian scum pull back from Azshara, I've been getting mixed reports from my riders stationed in Ashenvale, to the west. The night elves may be making an assault on our territory in the Barrens.$B$B$C, I need you to slip across the border and speak to one of my scouts. Look for Kulg Gorespatter just across the bridge at the southwest edge of Talrendis Point. Find out what's happening in those woods!
english.completion: You say Talrendis Point has fallen? That's good news! It also explains the exodus of elves I've seen along this road.
english.completed: Speak with Kulg Gorespatter in Ashenvale.

text.title: Track Beasts
text.objectives: Speak to Honu Staghunter and learn Track Beasts.
text.description: The art of tracking is the soul of the hunt, and you did well in finding me here. I am no seasoned expert, but I've been taught well; I can share with you more ways of following beasts and finding your prey.$B$BIt is the least I can do in repayment for saving me.

english.title: Track Beasts
english.objectives: Speak to Honu Staghunter and learn Track Beasts.
english.description: The art of tracking is the soul of the hunt, and you did well in finding me here. I am no seasoned expert, but I've been taught well; I can share with you more ways of following beasts and finding your prey.$B$BIt is the least I can do in repayment for saving me.

text.title: Mark of the Wild
text.objectives: Speak to Keshu Treehoof and learn Mark of the Wild.
text.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to call out to the Earth Mother, and draw upon the power of the wild.

english.title: Mark of the Wild
english.objectives: Speak to Keshu Treehoof and learn Mark of the Wild.
english.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to call out to the Earth Mother, and draw upon the power of the wild.

text.title: 战斗怒吼
text.objectives: Speak to Brave Sharphorn and learn Battle Shout.
text.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to harness your inner fury into a mighty battle shout.

english.title: Battle Shout
english.objectives: Speak to Brave Sharphorn and learn Battle Shout.
english.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to harness your inner fury into a mighty battle shout.

text.title: 黑色的末日
text.objectives: 杀死漆黑山脊的暮光领主卡特娜拉和玛里希恩。
text.description: 现在该把这堆破事做个了结了。我们要在黑龙军团回去报告主子之前，把它们从艾萨拉彻底抹除。$B$B我还是不明白它们抓我们是为了哪一出，所以我要你帮我最后一个忙——杀进漆黑山脊，干掉它们的头脑暮光领主卡特娜拉和玛里希恩。$B$B要是事情棘手，我会来帮忙的。我只是不想冒险中了他们给艾索雷葛斯下的套。
text.completion: You truly amaze me, mortal. It's rare to meet someone so dedicated and resourceful. Azuregos and I are likely to depart Azshara and remain discrete for a while. I do hope that we meet again someday though. Perhaps to put an end to Deathwing himself. Farewell, $n. Stay safe.
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.
text.giverWindow: Hunting dragons can be a very unforgiving line of work.

english.title: Fade to Black
english.objectives: Kill Twilight Lord Katrana and Malicion in Sable Ridge.
english.description: Now we put an end to all this madness. We need to rout the black dragonflight from Azshara entirely before they can return with any communication for their master.$B$BI still don't know what they have up their sleeve for capturing us, so I'd like to ask this one last thing of you - go into sable ridge and kill their leaders, Twilight Lord Katrana and Malicion.$B$BIf things get hairy, I will come help. I just don't want to risk falling into whatever trap they set for Azuregos.
english.completion: You truly amaze me, mortal. It's rare to meet someone so dedicated and resourceful. Azuregos and I are likely to depart Azshara and remain discrete for a while. I do hope that we meet again someday though. Perhaps to put an end to Deathwing himself. Farewell, $n. Stay safe.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at the Northern Rocketway Terminus.
english.giverWindow: Hunting dragons can be a very unforgiving line of work.

text.title: 沼泽困境
text.objectives: 前往乱木沼泽营救5名撞击幸存者。
text.description: 食人魔袭击了两辆马车。喏，你看到的这是一辆，还有一辆陷在北边的沼泽地了。$B$B去那儿搭救幸存者吧，我要来想想如何对付这些食人魔。
text.progress: Were any of the passengers still alive?
text.completion: You've done it again, $n.  You have my thanks.
text.completed: Return to Liam Greymane at the Stagecoach Crash Site.

english.title: Stranded at the Marsh
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Crash Survivors at the Hailwood Marsh.
english.description: The ogres got two of our stagecoaches: this one and one that fell into the marsh just north of here.$B$BI want you to head there and rescue any survivors while we hatch up a plan to deal with these ogres.
english.progress: Were any of the passengers still alive?
english.completion: You've done it again, $n.  You have my thanks.
english.completed: Return to Liam Greymane at the Stagecoach Crash Site.

text.title: 守住阵线！
text.objectives: 杀死6名石腭入侵者。
text.description: 嗨，叫你呢！你看上去挺结实的。帮个忙呗？$B$B这场大地震催生出一帮野蛮的石腭怪，他们正找地儿撒气呢。我们正在全力抵御石腭怪的进攻，想请你帮帮忙啊。$B$B很简单——你只需去南边，帮巡山人对付他们就行啦。我们必须坚守防线！
text.progress: How many of 'em did ya get?
text.completion: Impressive work, laddie.  We can hold the perimeter from here on out. Here, take this for yer troubles.  It might come in handy, as I've got something more important to ask of ye...
text.completed: Return to Joren Ironstock in Coldridge Valley.

english.title: Hold the Line!
english.objectives: Slay 6 Rockjaw Invaders.
english.description: Hey, you there!  Ye're a stout-looking $c.  Lend us a hand?$b$bIt looks like today's big earthquake shook a bunch o' those barbarous troggs out of the ground, and they're sure steamed about something.  My men are doing what they can to hold them off, but we could use a hand.$b$bDo yer part - head just south of here and help dig me mountaineers outta trouble.  We've got to hold the line!
english.progress: How many of 'em did ya get?
english.completion: Impressive work, laddie.  We can hold the perimeter from here on out. Here, take this for yer troubles.  It might come in handy, as I've got something more important to ask of ye...
english.completed: Return to Joren Ironstock in Coldridge Valley.

text.title: 罪有应得！
text.objectives: 杀死3名石腭暴徒。
text.description: $N，听着。我对石腭怪非常了解，体型最大最强壮的石腭怪将受到最高的尊崇。这帮野蛮的家伙只崇尚力量。$B$B你瞧见那些坐镇后方的大家伙了吗？他们其实就是所谓的领袖人物。去杀掉一些，让他们知道铁炉堡之子可不是好惹的！
text.progress: Well, what're ye waitin' for, $C?
text.completion: Hmm... they blame us for destroying their home, ye say?  Well, that wasn't us, that was the horrible earthquake we had earlier today.  Are they that dense that they can't see we nearly lost our camp too? Can't blame a trogg for fightin' for his home, though.
text.completed: Return to Joren Ironstock in Coldridge Valley.

english.title: Give 'em What-For
english.objectives: Kill 3 Rockjaw Goons.
english.description: Alright, $n, listen up.  I know a thing or two about troggs, and one of those things is that the biggest, strongest troggs get the most respect.  The brutes value strength over anything else.$b$bYe see those great big troggs sitting back behind the front lines?  They're the closest they have to what ye'd call a leader.  Go take out a few, and show 'em what it means to mess with the Sons of Ironforge!
english.progress: Well, what're ye waitin' for, $C?
english.completion: Hmm... they blame us for destroying their home, ye say?  Well, that wasn't us, that was the horrible earthquake we had earlier today.  Are they that dense that they can't see we nearly lost our camp too? Can't blame a trogg for fightin' for his home, though.
english.completed: Return to Joren Ironstock in Coldridge Valley.

text.title: 疗伤
text.objectives: 对4名受伤的寒脊巡山人使用斯登的急救包。
text.description: $N，听着！我可不像乔娜，要你舞刀弄枪地拼命，我只需要一个行事稳重且稍微有点勇气的帮手。$B$B巡山人的受训课程只是对付狼而已……石腭怪入侵这阵势哪儿见过啊！许多优秀的巡山人在战斗中负了伤，体能也达到了极限。我要你帮我治疗伤者。$B$B来，带上我的急救包，尽你所能地帮助我们吧。
text.progress: Thanks for yer help, $N.
text.completion: Many of those that y'saved have already made it back to camp.  The wounds're well-dressed!  Ye might have a future in first aid, if ye're into that sorta thing.
text.completed: Return to Sten Stoutarm in Coldridge Valley.

english.title: Aid for the Wounded
english.objectives: Use Sten's First Aid Kit on 4 Wounded Coldridge Mountaineers.
english.description: $N, listen!  Unlike Joren, I've no need for yer blade, but I do need someone with a steady hand and a bit o' courage.$b$bOur mountaineers are trained to protect the village from the odd wolf attack... not an all-out trogg invasion!  Many of our best have succumbed to wounds and exhaustion, and I need yer help bandaging them up.$b$bHere, take my first aid kit and assist as many as ye can.
english.progress: Thanks for yer help, $N.
english.completion: Many of those that y'saved have already made it back to camp.  The wounds're well-dressed!  Ye might have a future in first aid, if ye're into that sorta thing.
english.completed: Return to Sten Stoutarm in Coldridge Valley.

text.title: 恰当的欢迎
text.objectives: 杀死4名食人魔爪牙，并进入克洛斯的巢穴夺得克洛斯的旗帜。
text.description: $N，被遗忘者在我们身后穷追不舍，食人魔又想从侧面发动袭击。$B$B他们是双头怪克洛斯的走狗，是吉尔尼斯地区最卑鄙最残忍的势力。$B$B如果能诱使克洛斯转而攻击被遗忘者，我们就可以赢得时间，顺利撤退。$B$B要达成这个目标，只有惹恼克洛斯。杀死他的爪牙还不够，我们得偷走他视若珍宝的那面虎皮旗。
text.progress: How did it go, $n?
text.completion: You definitely got the ettin angry, $n.   I heard him myself. Let's hope this works.
text.completed: Return to Liam Greymane at the Stagecoach Crash Site.

english.title: Introductions Are in Order
english.objectives: Kill 4 Ogre Minions and obtain Koroth's Banner in Koroth's Den.
english.description: The Forsaken are right on our heels and now these ogres are trying to flank us, $N.$B$BThey're servants of the ettin Koroth -- the meanest, most destructive force in all of Gilneas.$B$BIf we can bait Koroth into charging the Forsaken's forward force, we should be able to cover our retreat and buy some time.$B$BThe only way this can work is if we make Koroth furious.  It won't be enough to just kill his minions.  We need to swipe his most prized possession, a tiger-skinned banner.
english.progress: How did it go, $n?
english.completion: You definitely got the ettin angry, $n.   I heard him myself. Let's hope this works.
english.completed: Return to Liam Greymane at the Stagecoach Crash Site.

text.title: 安威玛尔紧急戒严
text.objectives: 跟安威玛尔的乔娜·铁枷谈一谈。
text.description: 感谢你为我们所做的一切，但是别的地方更需要帮助。$B$B穴居人的攻击，再加上不久之前的这场大地震，安威玛尔的所有平民都进入了紧急戒严状态。安威玛尔位于西北方的山岭处。$B$B去那里跟我的妻子乔娜谈一谈。她的身体十分健硕，就跟你一样。
text.completion: Achh.. and what do YOU want?  Can't ye see I'm busy in here!  Go an' bother someone else, I haven't the time. Wait, what's that ye say?  Joren sent you to help?  Well why didn't ye say so?

english.title: Lockdown in Anvilmar
english.objectives: Speak with Jona Ironstock in Anvilmar.
english.description: We appreciate yer help out here, but there may be a place where they need ye even more.$b$bDue to the trogg attacks - not to mention that massive earthquake we just had - we're putting all civilians on lockdown inside Anvilmar, just up the hill to the northwest.$b$bGo an' talk to me wife, Jona, inside Anvilmar.  I'm certain she's in need of an able-bodied $g man:lass; such as yerself.
english.completion: Achh.. and what do YOU want?  Can't ye see I'm busy in here!  Go an' bother someone else, I haven't the time. Wait, what's that ye say?  Joren sent you to help?  Well why didn't ye say so?

text.title: 重要的事先做：我们需要啤酒
text.objectives: 取回一桶风暴战锤烈酒、一桶塞拉摩麦酒和一桶侏儒轻啤。
text.description: 我没见过有人能在没有麦酒喝的情况下去干活儿的！安威玛尔的啤酒储备已经所剩无几，情况非常危险！$B$B幸运的是，我们提前酿好了一些酒以备不时之需。在安威玛尔以西，沿着山谷的北部边界走，你可以找到装有风暴战锤烈酒和塞拉摩麦酒的酒桶。你还可以在此地以东找到侏儒轻啤。那是我最喜欢的美酒。
text.progress: The ale, darling, the ale!
text.completion: Ahh... that hits the spot.  Now we can get some work done around here.
text.completed: Return to Jona Ironstock in Anvilmar.

english.title: First Things First: We're Gonna Need Some Beer
english.objectives: Obtain a Cask of Stormhammer Stout, a Cask of Theramore Pale Ale, and a Cask of Gnomenbrau.
english.description: I don't know how ANYONE expects to get any work done around here if we don't have any ale!  Our beer level here in Anvilmar is dangerously low.$b$bLucky for us, we've stowed some backup kegs for just such an occasion.  West of Anvilmar, along the valley's northern border, ye'll find kegs of Stormhammer Stout and Theramore Pale Ale.  Just to the east of here, ye'll find a stash of Gnomenbrau.  That's me personal favorite.
english.progress: The ale, darling, the ale!
english.completion: Ahh... that hits the spot.  Now we can get some work done around here.
english.completed: Return to Jona Ironstock in Anvilmar.

text.title: 其他的物资
text.objectives: 收集3块野猪腰肉和4张粗糙的狼皮。
text.description: 如果封锁状态持续下去的话，我们需要食物和毛毯来果腹并维持体温。你能外出帮我们收集一些物资吗？$B$B这里的野猪长得膘肥体壮……肉质十分美味。我们还需要一些幼狼的毛皮。$B$B这些野兽在寒脊山谷随处可见。
text.progress: The people are gettin' restless.  D'ye have the supplies yet?
text.completion: This'll have to do for now.  We've a lot of people to feed here, but we've got to make do with what we've got.  With any luck, King Bronzebeard in Ironforge will send us some help shortly.
text.completed: Return to Jona Ironstock in Anvilmar.

english.title: All the Other Stuff
english.objectives: Obtain 3 Boar Haunches and 4 Ragged Wolf Hides.
english.description: If we're going to be on lockdown for any extended period o' time, we're gonna need some food, and some blankets to keep the wee ones warm.  Would ye mind headin' outside and gatherin' up some supplies?$b$bYe'll find that a few o' the small boars actually have some healthy-sized haunches... good for eatin'.  We'll also need some pelts from the young wolves.$b$bYe'll find animals almost anywhere ye go in Coldridge.
english.progress: The people are gettin' restless.  D'ye have the supplies yet?
english.completion: This'll have to do for now.  We've a lot of people to feed here, but we've got to make do with what we've got.  With any luck, King Bronzebeard in Ironforge will send us some help shortly.
english.completed: Return to Jona Ironstock in Anvilmar.

text.title: 锻造利剑
text.objectives: 在灵魂坩锅锻造已经重铸的奎尔德拉。
text.description: 破碎的奎尔德拉终于完整如初了，但如果不经过适当的锻打，你还无法使用它作战。它参差不齐的萨隆邪铁边缘仍然脆弱易碎。$B$B你可以在冰冠堡垒深处的灵魂洪炉对它进行深度锻造。把奎尔德拉带到噬魂者的住所去，找到那里的坩埚。将这把剑放进坩埚里，对它进行锻造，然后再回来见我。我会在冰封大殿等你。
text.progress: Until the sword is tempered, it will be useless.
text.completion: I... I don't understand. Tempering the sword should've restored the blade to its original condition. What has happened here?
text.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.

english.title: Tempering The Blade
english.objectives: Temper the Reforged Quel'Delar in the Crucible of Souls.
english.description: At last, the pieces of Quel'Delar are rejoined and the blade is whole, but it cannot see battle until you have tempered it. That jagged saronite edge is brittle and will shatter the moment it strikes anything.$B$BDeep in Icecrown Citadel's Forge of Souls is a place where the blade can safely be tempered. Take Quel'Delar with you to the abode of the Devourer of Souls and look for the crucible. Plunge the blade into the crucible to temper it and bring it back to me in The Frozen Halls.
english.progress: Until the sword is tempered, it will be useless.
english.completion: I... I don't understand. Tempering the sword should've restored the blade to its original condition. What has happened here?
english.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.

text.title: 矮人圣物
text.objectives: 收集5件被遗忘的矮人圣物。
text.description: 我亲爱的$N！你对考古学感兴趣吗？$B$B眼前就有一个激动人心的大好机会。剧烈的地震活动使得大量的古器露出地面，它们就躺在我们的营地周围。沿着山谷的北部边界走，你可以找到各种各样的宝物。将它们带回来给我，或许我们可以一起进行研究。$B$B好啦！出发吧！
text.progress: 有事吗?
text.completion: Wonderful!  Look at this one... it must be over 200 years old! Now, onto other matters...
text.completed: Return to Grundel Harkin in Anvilmar.

english.title: Dwarven Artifacts
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Forgotten Dwarven Artifacts.
english.description: $N, my $g boy: beautiful flower;!  Are you into archaeology?$b$bWe've an exciting opportunity right outside our front door.  All the shaking from today's seismic event has knocked a number of artifacts loose from the soil around our encampment.  Survey along the valley's northern border, and you should find all sorts of treasures.  Bring some back to me, and perhaps we can study them together.$b$bRight, then!  Off you go!
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Wonderful!  Look at this one... it must be over 200 years old! Now, onto other matters...
english.completed: Return to Grundel Harkin in Anvilmar.

text.title: 冰霜试炼
text.objectives: 在不被霜燃击中的前提下收集20份冰之精华以完成冰霜试炼。
text.description: 你知道，有的学徒管我叫冷血动物。但我总是说，不要让生理部位的温度影响你对学习的热情。$B$B要挑战冰霜试炼，触摸冰霜水晶打开传送门。进去以后目的很简单，收集那些飘着的小冰球一样的东西。$B$B为了增加难度，那些旋转的霜燃将会拖你的后腿。要是你想玩得华丽些的，可以用符文跳过它们。不俗吧？
text.completion: Brilliant. You certainly don't let cold feet stop you. Or cold any part for that matter! No? ...too soon?
text.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Frost.

english.title: The Trial of Frost
english.objectives: Complete the Trial of Frost by gathering 20 Essence of Ice without getting hit by Frostburn.
english.description: You know, some of my apprentices have called me cold hearted. I always say though, I shall not let the temperature of my body parts stand in the way of true learning.$B$BTo reach the Trial of Frost, touch the Frost crystal to open a portal. Once there, the goal is quite simple - gather the little floaty ice orb thingies.$B$BTo counter the simple, the rotating Frostburns may put back your progress, as it were. If you want to be fancy, you can use the rune traps to jump over them as they rotate by. Neat, eh?
english.completion: Brilliant. You certainly don't let cold feet stop you. Or cold any part for that matter! No? ...too soon?
english.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Frost.

text.title: 暗影试炼
text.objectives: 在不被碰到的前提下将20个泣灵引入陷阱，完成暗影试炼。
text.description: 咱们不要落了法师的陈腔滥调。比如说我吧，就喜欢不拘一格。通灵术也是可以很有意思的！$B$B触摸暗影水晶打开传送门，就能抵达我的暗影试炼场。在那里，准备好了就踏上祭坛。$B$B泣灵会追逐你……你的目标很简单，就是把它们引到陷阱里去，当然不要让它们碰到你。
text.completion: I like the way you move, apprentice. Don't you worry about where I got all the souls from. They were obtained in a perfectly humane manner, I assure you.
text.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Shadow.

english.title: The Trial of Shadow
english.objectives: Complete the Trial of Shadow by luring 20 Weeping Souls into the shadow runes without getting touched.
english.description: Let us not be confined by the bounds of the mage repertoire of magic. I, for one, choose not to be classist. Necromancy can just be so much fun!$B$BTouch the Shadow Crystal to open a portal to my Trial of Shadow. Once there, move to the Altar when you are ready to begin.$B$BWeeping Souls shall begin to pursue you... your goal is simply to drag them into the traps. And be sure not to let them touch you.
english.completion: I like the way you move, apprentice. Don't you worry about where I got all the souls from. They were obtained in a perfectly humane manner, I assure you.
english.completed: Speak to the Image of Archmage Xylem at the Trial of Shadow.

text.title: 映像大厅
text.objectives: 将淬火的奎尔德拉带到映像大厅里面的剑冢去。
text.description: 你已经重铸了这把剑，并对它进行了锻造，但它仍然只是静静地躺在剑鞘里，丝毫没有显示出它应有的力量。你说这把剑在吸引你，就好象它拥有自己的意志？$B$B你敢把它带到它想去的地方吗？这把剑不应该如此沉默，但如果你不把它带去那个地方，也许我们将永远不知道这是为什么。把它带进冰冠堡垒的映像大厅。在那里一定要万分小心！我会在冰封大殿等你。
text.progress: What happened inside the Halls of Reflection?
text.completion: I had not thought it possible for evil to take hold in such a sword, but I suppose it was naive of me. If the greatest of dragonkind's creations could be corrupted and turned against them, why not a mere sword? Uther's advice is wise, $n, and I would urge you to heed it quickly.
text.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.
text.objective1: Bring Quel'Delar to Halls of Reflection

english.title: The Halls Of Reflection
english.objectives: Bring your Tempered Quel'Delar to Sword's Rest inside the Halls of Reflection.
english.description: You have reforged and tempered the sword, yet it sits quietly in its sheath, showing no signs of the power it should possess. You say the sword pulls you, as though it possesses a will?$B$BDare you bring it where it wishes to go? It's not right that the sword should be this silent and this insistent, yet I fear that if you do not take the sword to its destination, we will never learn why. Take it into Icecrown Citadel's Halls of Reflection, but be on your guard! I'll be waiting for you in The Frozen Halls.
english.progress: What happened inside the Halls of Reflection?
english.completion: I had not thought it possible for evil to take hold in such a sword, but I suppose it was naive of me. If the greatest of dragonkind's creations could be corrupted and turned against them, why not a mere sword? Uther's advice is wise, $n, and I would urge you to heed it quickly.
english.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear in the Frozen Halls.
english.objective1: Bring Quel'Delar to Halls of Reflection

text.title: Rockbiter Weapon
text.objectives: Speak to Miira Thunderhoof and learn Rockbiter Weapon.
text.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to draw upon the spirits of earth, and imbue your weapon with elemental power.

english.title: Rockbiter Weapon
english.objectives: Speak to Miira Thunderhoof and learn Rockbiter Weapon.
english.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to draw upon the spirits of earth, and imbue your weapon with elemental power.

text.title: 真言术：韧
text.objectives: Speak to Seer Skyhoof and learn Power Word: Fortitude.
text.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to channel the fortitude of An'she, and imbue yourself with great stamina.

english.title: Power Word: Fortitude
english.objectives: Speak to Seer Skyhoof and learn Power Word: Fortitude.
english.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to channel the fortitude of An'she, and imbue yourself with great stamina.

text.title: 风谷村
text.objectives: 跟风谷村的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈。
text.description: 我们的车夫奉命在风谷村这座以渔业为生的小镇集合。哨兵说那里可能有庇护所和粮草供给。$B$B与风谷村的格温·阿姆斯特谈一谈，她负责接应我们的车队。
text.completion: It's good to see you made it, $n.  It looks like most everybody did. We're not doing too bad so far for an emergency evacuation.

english.title: Stormglen
english.objectives: Speak to Gwen Armstead in Stormglen.
english.description: Our carriage drivers were told to regroup in the fishing town of Stormglen.  Our scouts report there might be shelter and supplies to be found there.$B$BMeet Gwen Armstead there, she'll be in charge of taking care of our people.
english.completion: It's good to see you made it, $n.  It looks like most everybody did. We're not doing too bad so far for an emergency evacuation.

text.title: 害虫控制
text.objectives: 在风谷村杀死6只邪巢诱捕蛛。
text.description: $N，你知道吗？在这动荡的年代，风谷村竟得以在战火中保持完好。$B$B被遗忘者还在向内陆挺进，我们能在这里歇歇脚真是不错。$B$B不过镇子的另一半被蜘蛛占据了，我已经禁止村民们踏足那里。$B$B你愿意帮助我们清理这些蜘蛛吗？有你对付那些八条腿的野兽，我相信受伤的士兵们也会睡得安稳一些。
text.progress: You're back, $N. Have the spiders been taken care of?
text.completion: You've done well, $n.  The spiders are everywhere, however, and I'm afraid we've barely put a dent in their numbers.
text.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at Stormglen in Gilneas.

english.title: Pest Control
english.objectives: Kill 6 Vilebrood Skitterers in Stormglen.
english.description: Well, what do you know, $N?  All this time and Stormglen's been left mostly intact.$B$BIt's too bad the Forsaken are still working their way inland, but it'll make a fine place to rest our feet for a night or two.$B$BThe other half of town is overrun with spiders, so I've asked the villagers to stay away from there.$B$BPerhaps you'd like to lend a hand in clearing the spiders out?  I'm certain our injured men and women will sleep more soundly if they know someone's keeping those eight-legged beasts at bay.
english.progress: You're back, $N. Have the spiders been taken care of?
english.completion: You've done well, $n.  The spiders are everywhere, however, and I'm afraid we've barely put a dent in their numbers.
english.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at Stormglen in Gilneas.

text.title: Seal of Righteousness
text.objectives: Speak to Bowe Dawnhorn and learn Seal of Righteousness.
text.description: 我自己只是一个学徒，$N，但是我还是可以给你一个感激的教训。$B$B让我教你如何用自己的光来填充自己，用

english.title: Seal of Righteousness
english.objectives: Speak to Bowe Dawnhorn and learn Seal of Righteousness.
english.description: I am but an apprentice myself, $n, but I can still impart a lesson to you in thanks.$B$BAllow me to teach you how to fill yourself with the light of An'she, and strike down your enemies with

text.title: 抓紧时机
text.objectives: 从石腭挖掘者那里取回5件无价的石腭器物。
text.description: 西南方的穴居人村落遭遇了同样的创伤。理论上，穴居人古器也会在地震活动中露出地面！$B$B可惜石腭挖掘者已经抢先夺走了大部分的器物。看看你能不能找回一些来。穴居人的考古成果很可能有助于我们探寻伟大的矮人种族的历史！
text.progress: Did you manage to pry any artifacts from the troggs?
text.completion: Well would you look at this!  An axe blade, a couple of arrowheads, and what appears to be some sort of rudimentary spoon.  This is indeed fascinating. Thanks again for your help, $n.  I've much studying to keep myself occupied while Joren's got us under lockdown.
text.completed: Return to Grundel Harkin in Anvilmar.

english.title: Make Hay While the Sun Shines
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Priceless Rockjaw Artifacts from Rockjaw Scavengers.
english.description: The trogg village to the southwest suffered similar damage to ours.  One would assume, logically, that there would be some trogg artifacts sticking out of the ground, too!$b$bUnfortunately, it looks like most of the artifacts have already been scooped up by trogg scavengers.  Please, go see if you can find some way to get them back.  Believe it or not, knowledge about troggs may eventually lead to further knowledge about the mighty dwarves!
english.progress: Did you manage to pry any artifacts from the troggs?
english.completion: Well would you look at this!  An axe blade, a couple of arrowheads, and what appears to be some sort of rudimentary spoon.  This is indeed fascinating. Thanks again for your help, $n.  I've much studying to keep myself occupied while Joren's got us under lockdown.
english.completed: Return to Grundel Harkin in Anvilmar.

text.title: 白须需要你
text.objectives: 前往寒脊山谷格瑞林·白须的营地。
text.description: 你帮了我们很多，可惜我得派你去别处了。$B$B我的好朋友格瑞林·白须捎信来说他需要帮助。沿着西边的道路走，你应该可以在西南方的巨魔营地附近找到他。$B$B$N，去吧。石腭怪虽然令人头痛，但是巨魔更麻烦。
text.completion: Welcome, $c.  Are you ready to get to work?

english.title: Whitebeard Needs Ye
english.objectives: Report to Grelin Whitebeard's camp in Coldridge Valley.
english.description: Ye've done us a great service here, but I'm afraid I've gotta send ye off elsewhere.$b$bGrelin Whitebeard, a good friend of mine, has put in word that he may need some reinforcements near the troll camps to the southwest.  Follow the road westward, ye should find him soon enough.$b$bBe well, $n.  Troggs may be a pain, but trolls are a whole other type of trouble.
english.completion: Welcome, $c.  Are you ready to get to work?

text.title: 替代品
text.objectives: 收集6箱替换部件。
text.description: 我手下的人全都受伤了！伐木机也全都出了故障！而裁判很快就要宣布比赛结束了！$B$B我急得火烧眉毛，$N，我需要你！！！$B$B我们必须修好一台伐木机。锈水码头到处都是替换部件。如果锈水海盗队有机会获胜的话，任何拥有正宗血统的科赞岛地精都会让你随意拾取的。$B$B我们要让热砂港大鲨鱼队见识一下，足球炸弹该怎样玩！
text.progress: We're counting on you, $n!
text.completion: That's my boy! Now to get one of these useless hunks of metal in working order and you into the game!
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

english.title: The Replacements
english.objectives: Collect 6 Replacement Parts.
english.description: My guys are all on the injured roster! Our shredders are all kaput! The ref is about to call the game!$B$BIt's down to the wire and I need you, $N!!!$B$BLet's get one of these shredders in working condition. There are replacement parts all over Bilgewater Port. Any green-blooded Kezanian will gladly let you have them if there's a chance that the Buccaneers will win.$B$BWe'll show those no-good Steamwheedle Sharks how to play footbomb!
english.progress: We're counting on you, $n!
english.completion: That's my boy! Now to get one of these useless hunks of metal in working order and you into the game!
english.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

text.title: 打探消息
text.objectives: 靠近每座霜鬃营地的霜鬃占卜者，偷听他们的谈话。
text.description: 我完全猜不透巨魔的面部表情。话虽如此，在我看来那些巨魔也不是愤怒吧。他们的神情更像是迷茫……甚至有点害怕。$B$B一定发生了什么我们所不知的事情，$N。与其杀光这里的巨魔，不如先做做调查。$B$B东南、西南以及正西方有三座巨魔营地。每座营地都有一名占卜者……你不如悄悄靠近，偷听一下他们的谈话。
text.progress: I can't even begin to imagine what would make the trolls act like this.
text.completion: Hmm... interesting.  From what you're saying, it sounds like a fire elemental might have snuck in from Searing Gorge.  Or, the earthquake opened up a crack to the elemental plane... Either way, this is bad news.  You should probably report this information to Grelin.
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Soren at Whitebeard's Camp.

english.title: Trolling for Information
english.objectives: Stand near a Frostmane Soothsayer in each of the Frostmane camps and listen to what they have to say.
english.description: I'm notoriously bad at reading troll facial expressions.  That being said, these trolls don't look angry to me.  They seem to be confused... maybe a little frightened.$b$bSomething happened that we're not seeing here, $N.  I say we do some investigation before we just kill every troll in sight.$b$bThere are three troll camps in the area: one to the southeast, one to the southwest, and one due west.  Each camp has a soothsayer... see if you can get close enough to listen to what they're saying.
english.progress: I can't even begin to imagine what would make the trolls act like this.
english.completion: Hmm... interesting.  From what you're saying, it sounds like a fire elemental might have snuck in from Searing Gorge.  Or, the earthquake opened up a crack to the elemental plane... Either way, this is bad news.  You should probably report this information to Grelin.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Soren at Whitebeard's Camp.

text.title: 铁炉堡之旅
text.objectives: 向寒脊山谷的汉兹·跳链报到。
text.description: 寒脊山谷出现了一只火元素，这事儿非同小可呀。这场地震不仅搞出了一堆石腭怪……甚至改变了整个世界，拉开了通往元素位面的裂隙。我们应该向铁炉堡汇报此事。$B$B你愿意跑这一趟吗？别担心，我觉得你没问题啦。跟山谷东部通道处的汉兹·跳链谈谈。他会为你指明方向的。
text.completion: To Ironforge?  Well first, you'll need to go through Kharanos, and before that, you'll have to go through this tunnel.

english.title: A Trip to Ironforge
english.objectives: Report to Hands Springsprocket in Coldridge Valley.
english.description: The presence of a fire elemental here in Coldridge is no small matter.  That earthquake did more than just upset a bunch of troggs... it changed the world enough to tear a gash into the elemental plane.  We should submit a report to Ironforge.$b$bYou wouldn't be willing to take a trip, would ya?  Don't worry, I've a feeling that you'll do just fine.  Talk to Hands Springsprocket by the tunnel on the eastern edge of the valley.  He'll point you in the right direction.
english.completion: To Ironforge?  Well first, you'll need to go through Kharanos, and before that, you'll have to go through this tunnel.

text.title: 跟上那架直升机！
text.objectives: 向安威玛尔附近的米罗·齿针报到。
text.description: 你你你看见了吗？刚才洞穴一阵震颤是怎么回事呢？我得说你来得真是时候，要是早一分钟说不定就没命了呢。$B$B这场地震让洞口的监测工作变得容易多了，但是你要去卡拉诺斯可就艰难了。$B$B等等，我有个法子！诺莫瑞根飞行员在附近设立了一处飞行点。只要我发出信号，他们应该会赶来帮忙的。我猜他们会降落在安威玛尔后方吧。
text.completion: Milo Geartwinge, reporting for duty.  You sent up a distress signal?

english.title: Follow that Gyro-Copter!
english.objectives: Report to Milo Geartwinge near Anvilmar.
english.description: D-d-did you see that?  How the whole cave just crumbled like that?  I guess it's good that you got here when you did, and not a minute earlier.$b$bWhile this development makes my job of monitoring the cave entrance much easier, I imagine it makes it a lot harder for you to get to Kharanos.$b$bHey wait, I've got an idea!  The Gnomeregan Airmen have a flight path not far from here.  I'll send up a signal, and they should be here to help.  I imagine they'll land back over at Anvilmar.
english.completion: Milo Geartwinge, reporting for duty.  You sent up a distress signal?

text.title: 收拾行囊
text.objectives: 收集1把寒脊酒壶、1件粗糙的狼皮斗篷以及一些隔夜的野猪肉。
text.description: 直升机的承重力有限，最多还能容下一名$C。你真走运啊，$N！$B$B乔娜说你的大部分私人物品已经被送往安威玛尔了。你收拾一下必需品吧，把剩下的事情都做个了结。等你准备好，我们就可以出发了。
text.progress: Are you absolutely certain you've taken care of everything?  You won't have time to turn back.
text.completion: Took you long enough.  Hold on tight, and take a good hard look!  Chances are you won't be coming back here for quite some time.
text.completed: Return to Milo Geartwinge in Coldridge Valley.

english.title: Pack Your Bags
english.objectives: Obtain a Coldridge Beer Flagon, a Ragged Wolf-Hide Cloak, and some Leftover Boar Meat.
english.description: The weight limit on my gyro is such that I only have enough room for one $r.  Looks like you're in luck, $n!$b$bThat dwarf woman Jona told me that most of your personal belongings have been moved inside Anvilmar.  Please gather what you'll need, finish up any affairs that remain, and return to me when you're prepared for takeoff.
english.progress: Are you absolutely certain you've taken care of everything?  You won't have time to turn back.
english.completion: Took you long enough.  Hold on tight, and take a good hard look!  Chances are you won't be coming back here for quite some time.
english.completed: Return to Milo Geartwinge in Coldridge Valley.

text.title: 别忘记我们
text.objectives: 向卡拉诺斯的萨雷克·黑石报到。
text.description: 你要走了？出发前记得带足口粮。$B$B抵达卡拉诺斯后一定要找萨雷克·黑石谈谈。告诉他寒脊山谷发生的一切，以及我们需要帮助。希望他可以为我们安排一下。
text.completion: Coldridge Valley?  I've got my own problems here!  What, they can't deal with a couple of troggs?  And trolls?  And incursions from the elemental plane? Actually, on second thought, that's kind of a lot.  I'm surprised they're doing as well as they are.  I'll see what I can do.

english.title: Don't Forget About Us
english.objectives: Report to Tharek Blackstone in Kharanos.
english.description: You're leaving?  Make sure you stock up before you head out.$b$bMore importantly, please speak to Tharek Blackstone once you arrive in Kharanos.  Tell him what has happened here in Coldridge, and that we could use some assistance.  Hopefully he'll be able to arrange something for us.
english.completion: Coldridge Valley?  I've got my own problems here!  What, they can't deal with a couple of troggs?  And trolls?  And incursions from the elemental plane? Actually, on second thought, that's kind of a lot.  I'm surprised they're doing as well as they are.  I'll see what I can do.

text.title: 賦能符文
text.objectives: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
text.description: $N, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the shaman trainer Teo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.
text.progress: The sprits have forewarned me of your arrival, $n.  Have you heard them too?
text.completion: These are dark days, friend.  Look around you... even here in remote Coldridge, the sprits are rebelling.  The land is crying out for help.  Yet still, even in times such as these, the spirits will always turn an ear to those who ask for their assistance.
text.completed: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

english.objectives: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.
english.description: $N, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the shaman trainer Teo. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar.

english.completed: Read the Empowered Rune and speak to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

text.title: 破碎的往昔
text.objectives: 找到6张破旧的日记书页。
text.description: 我发现了一本日记，是一个名叫布莱德肖的人写的。可惜好些书页缺失了，尤其是后面的内容。$B$B如果你能找到足够多的书页，我或许可以了解在狼人的诅咒爆发后这里究竟发生了什么。$B$B谁知道呢……城镇的居民或许逃走了，说不定还有幸存者。$B$B说不定我的父亲尚在人世。
text.progress: Any luck finding those pages?
text.completion: Thank you, $n.  It will take some time, but I'll try to make sense of what we have.
text.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Stormglen in Gilneas.

english.title: Pieces of the Past
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Old Journal Pages.
english.description: I found a journal by a man named Bradshaw.  Unfortunately it's missing many pages.  Especially towards the end.$B$BIf you find enough of the pages I might be able to piece together what happened here after the Curse broke out.$B$BWho knows... maybe the people in this town found a way out.   Maybe there are still survivors out there.$B$B Maybe my father is still alive.
english.progress: Any luck finding those pages?
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  It will take some time, but I'll try to make sense of what we have.
english.completed: Return to Lorna Crowley at Stormglen in Gilneas.

text.title: 奥术符文
text.objectives: Read the Arcane Rune and speak to Teegli Merrowith in Coldridge Valley.
text.description: $N, this rune was given to me to pass on to ye. Take some time to read it when ye have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Teegli. Take a gander at it and go find her inside Anvilmar.
text.progress: I see that Jona's given you my runic message.  Do you still have it with you?
text.completion: The power of the arcane is everywhere, $n.  Only some of us have the ability to see it, and fewer still possess the ability to master it. You are one of those few.
text.completed: Read the Arcane Rune and speak to Teegli Merrowith in Coldridge Valley.

text.title: Airborne Again
text.objectives: Secure a ride to Valormok with the Airborne Priests in the eastern portion of Bilgewater Harbor.
text.description: We just got word from Valormok that we can't send anymore windriders that way unless we want them shot down by Talrendis snipers. We can't give up Valormok if we want a secure route to Ashenvale, so we're going in another way.$B$BThe airborne priests have graciously offered to drop some people in for us from above sniper range. Head up to the military area and secure a ride on one of their planes. They'll get you there in one piece, and hopefully once you're there, you can resecure our windrider lines.
text.completion: It's past time that these night elf scum be purged from Azshara. Glad to have an able body like you to sink the point home. Ready to get to work?

text.title: 通向堡垒之路
text.objectives: 解救15名联盟奴隶，消灭熔炉领主加弗斯特。
text.description: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry! Kill their captors and set them free, hero, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.
text.completion: You've done well this day. With many of the slaves freed and now with access to the forges, it will not be long before I have a strong force to aid in delivering us from Scourgelord Tyrannus and this foul pit.
text.completed: Speak to Martin Victus near Garfrost's rise.

english.title: The Path to the Citadel
english.objectives: Free 15 Alliance Slaves and kill Forgemaster Garfrost.
english.description: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry! Kill their captors and set them free, hero, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.

english.completed: Speak to Martin Victus near Garfrost's rise.

text.title: 痛苦灵魂的回声
text.objectives: 消灭布隆亚姆和噬魂者，夺取萨隆矿坑的入口。
text.description: I cannot thank you enough for coming. We're severely undermanned to be risking a venture into the citadel, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$B$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the citadel.$B$BPlease hurry, $n. We're counting on you.
text.completion: Just in time! Thank you, $n. The Pit of Saron lies ahead, and if our scouts are correct, past that will be the Halls of Reflection. It is there that Arthas lets his guard down, and it is there that we hope to find a clue to his weakness... or maybe, just maybe, his redemption.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the rear of the Forge of Souls.

english.title: Echoes of Tortured Souls
english.objectives: Kill Bronjahm and the Devourer of Souls to secure access to the Pit of Saron.
english.description: I cannot thank you enough for coming. We're severely undermanned to be risking a venture into the citadel, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$B$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the citadel.$B$BPlease hurry, $n. We're counting on you.
english.completion: Just in time! Thank you, $n. The Pit of Saron lies ahead, and if our scouts are correct, past that will be the Halls of Reflection. It is there that Arthas lets his guard down, and it is there that we hope to find a clue to his weakness... or maybe, just maybe, his redemption.
english.completed: Speak to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the rear of the Forge of Souls.

text.title: 巫妖王之怒
text.objectives: Find Lady Jaina Proudmoore and escape the Halls of Reflection
text.description: Uther knew a great deal about how Arthas might be defeated. It's hard to believe that there is much hope of defeating Arthas upon the steps of his own throne. And who will take up the crown of Lich King if it comes to that?$B$BMany questions remain, but the answers that you've uncovered may be critical to ensuring Arthas' defeat. You need to find Jaina and escape the Lich King while there's still time.
text.completion: I can barely believe we're still alive. It was foolish of me to follow him. I've made that mistake too many times.  And you... it was reckless of you to come after me instead of escaping with the information! But... well... thank you. You truly are a hero. With Uther's guidance, we may stand a chance at defeating Arthas. All the lives lost today were not in vain.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Jaina Proudmoore at the rear of the Halls of Reflection.

english.objectives: Find Lady Jaina Proudmoore and escape the Halls of Reflection

With Uther's guidance, we may stand a chance at defeating Arthas. All the lives lost today were not in vain.

text.title: 蛛后的麻烦
text.objectives: 进入雷格纳的巢穴，杀死雷格纳。
text.description: $N，蜘蛛的数量越来越多了。你必须进入它们的巢穴，杀死蛛后。$B$B我们在蛛网密布的黑瘴林边缘发现了一只名叫雷格纳的巨蛛。这次行动很危险，我们全指望你了。
text.progress: Did you take care of Rygna, $N?
text.completion: Great job, $n.  We've heard rumors of survivors further in the mountains.  Now we'll be able to send scouts there.
text.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at Stormglen in Gilneas.
text.giverWindow: Find her in that cave, and come back alive. We're counting on you.

english.title: Queen-Sized Troubles
english.objectives: Slay Rygna at Rygna's Lair.
english.description: The spiders keep coming in alarming numbers, $N.  You're going to have to go into their lair and kill the broodmother.$B$BWe've spotted the giant spider known as Rygna at the edge of the Blackwald in an area covered in thick webs.  It'll be dangerous, but we're all counting on you.
english.progress: Did you take care of Rygna, $N?
english.completion: Great job, $n.  We've heard rumors of survivors further in the mountains.  Now we'll be able to send scouts there.
english.completed: Return to Gwen Armstead at Stormglen in Gilneas.
english.giverWindow: Find her in that cave, and come back alive. We're counting on you.

text.title: 必要的粗暴
text.objectives: 进入锈水海盗队伐木机，朝8名热砂港大鲨鱼队队员投掷足球炸弹。
text.description: 我们就剩这台伐木机了。我趁没人的时候装载了，嗯，改进过的足球炸弹。$B$B我要你进入伐木机，给对方点颜色瞧瞧！

english.title: Necessary Roughness
english.objectives: Get into the Bilgewater Buccaneer and then throw the Footbomb at 8 Steamwheedle Sharks.
english.description: We're down to our last shredder. While no one was looking, I loaded it up with, shall we say, modified footbombs.$B$BKid, I need you to get in that shredder and give 'em heck!

text.title: 四攻得分
text.objectives: 将足球炸弹踢进位于对方球门后方的两根烟囱之间，取得决定性的一分。
text.description: 看你的了。你已经彻底摧毁了热砂港大鲨鱼队，接下来只要进球得分就赢了。$B$B这话你知我知就行，我们得露一手。只是进球也太容易了……你能不能来个远球，直接穿过矗立在对方球门后方的两根烟囱！$B$B我改进了足球炸弹，它具备了足够的推进力。$B$B去吧，让我以你为荣！
text.completion: Uh... you did it, kid. You REALLY did it! We won the game and.... DID YOU SEE THAT DRAGON?!!!
text.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

english.title: Fourth and Goal
english.objectives: Score the winning goal by kicking the Footbomb through the smokestacks behind the opposing goal.
english.description: It's all up to you, kid. You demolished the Steamwheedle Sharks, so now all that's left to do is to kick the winning goal.$B$BNow, just between you and me, I think we should do this one right. I don't want you to just kick a goal... I want you to kick it so far it sails between the two smokestacks behind the goal!$B$BI've modified the footbomb to give you the extra power that you'll need.$B$BMake me proud!
english.completion: Uh... you did it, kid. You REALLY did it! We won the game and.... DID YOU SEE THAT DRAGON?!!!
english.completed: Return to Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.

text.title: 清理高地之路
text.objectives: 杀死3名高地之路斥候。
text.description: 这里，$C！你发现了高地之路嘛。$B$B联盟企图切断我们与石爪山脉的联系，但是他们忽视了牛头人世代在此狩猎为生的事实。我们熟悉从这里到千针石林的每一条山路和小径。$B$B但是为了确保这些道路的畅通，我们必须阻止人类发现它们。$B$B沿着东面的小径巡逻，杀死沿途的高地之路斥候，然后跟图纳瓦·静风谈一谈。
text.completion: Patrolling the high road is grave business, but it must be done. These narrow mountain trails are, for the time being, one of our only lifelines into Stonetalon. They must be preserved.$B$BThank you.
text.completed: Talk to Tunawa Stillwind at the High Road in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Clear the High Road
english.objectives: Slay 3 High Road Scouts.
english.description: This way, $c! I see you've discovered the high road.$B$BThe Alliance hopes to sever our ties with Stonetalon, but they forget that we tauren have hunted across these lands for generations. We know every hillside switchback and game trail from here to Thousand Needles.$B$BBut for these paths to stay open, we must stop the humans from mapping them out.$B$BPatrol the trail east and kill any high road scouts you find along the way, then speak to Tunawa Stillwind just up the path.
english.completion: Patrolling the high road is grave business, but it must be done. These narrow mountain trails are, for the time being, one of our only lifelines into Stonetalon. They must be preserved.$B$BThank you.
english.completed: Talk to Tunawa Stillwind at the High Road in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 坚守猎手岭
text.objectives: 跟南贫瘠之地猎手岭的欧娜塔伊谈一谈。
text.description: 荣耀岗哨虽然已经沦陷，但是它的精神不会消逝。幸存者转移到了新的据点——猎手岭。$B$B沿着高地之路继续前进，就是我们的营地。去那里跟欧娜塔伊谈一谈，告诉她目前为止这条道路还算安全。
text.completion: So the Alliance is probing the twists and turns of the high road?$B$BEven if they were to map it out, they couldn't attack these hills in numbers. This is our land, $N. And they will pay dearly for presuming otherwise.
text.completed: 跟南贫瘠之地猎手岭的欧娜塔伊谈一谈。

english.title: Holdout at Hunter's Hill
english.objectives: Speak with Onatay at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Honor's Stand may have been lost, but its spirit was never crushed. Even now survivors are holding out at a point called "Hunter's Hill."$B$BContinue following the high road and you will find our camp just up ahead. Speak with Onatay when you get there and let her know the trail is, for the moment, still clear.
english.completion: So the Alliance is probing the twists and turns of the high road?$B$BEven if they were to map it out, they couldn't attack these hills in numbers. This is our land, $N. And they will pay dearly for presuming otherwise.
english.completed: Speak with Onatay at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 进入寒冰堡垒
text.objectives: 从冰冠堡垒一侧进入到灵魂洪炉，在那里找到希尔瓦娜斯·风行者女王。
text.description: $C！快过来，我有些话要告诉你！$B$B我的女王——希尔瓦娜斯·风行者在冰冠堡垒的防御工事中发现了一个通道，这个通道直通一个被她称为“灵魂洪炉”的地方。她离开前嘱咐我找一些奋勇的战士前去她那。我想那就是你了。$B$B去洪炉的入口找到女王，$C。
text.completion: Good. $n, I know of you. You'll be perfect for these tasks. We've been afforded a rare chance to delve into Icecrown Citadel, but we must move quickly if we're to avoid Arthas' notice.

english.title: Inside the Frozen Citadel
english.objectives: Enter The Forge of Souls from the side of Icecrown Citadel and locate Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
english.description: $C! Come close quickly, I must have a word!$B$BMy queen, the Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, has uncovered a hole in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel into a place she referred to as "The Forge of Souls." She sent word before she left for me to find fierce fighters to send her way. I think you'll do.$B$BGo to her within the entrance to the forge, $c.
english.completion: Good. $n, I know of you. You'll be perfect for these tasks. We've been afforded a rare chance to delve into Icecrown Citadel, but we must move quickly if we're to avoid Arthas' notice.

text.title: 通向堡垒之路
text.objectives: 解救15名部落奴隶，消灭熔炉领主加弗斯特。
text.description: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry. Kill their captors and set them free, $c, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.
text.completion: You've done well this day. With many of the slaves freed and now with access to the forges, it will not be long before I have a strong force to aid in delivering us from Scourgelord Tyrannus and this foul pit.
text.completed: Speak to Gorkun Ironskull near Garfrost's rise.

english.title: The Path to the Citadel
english.objectives: Free 15 Horde Slaves and kill Forgemaster Garfrost.
english.description: They've put our captured soldiers to work in the quarry. Kill their captors and set them free, $c, and do it quickly. We will need their aid when we confront Scourgelord Tyrannus.
english.completion: You've done well this day. With many of the slaves freed and now with access to the forges, it will not be long before I have a strong force to aid in delivering us from Scourgelord Tyrannus and this foul pit.
english.completed: Speak to Gorkun Ironskull near Garfrost's rise.

text.title: 进入寒冰堡垒
text.objectives: 从冰冠堡垒一侧进入到灵魂洪炉，在那里找到吉安娜·普罗德摩尔女士。
text.description: $C！快过来，我有些话要告诉你！$B$B吉安娜·普罗德摩尔女士在冰冠堡垒的防御工事中发现了一个通道，这个通道直通一个被她称为“灵魂洪炉”的地方。她离开前嘱咐我寻找任何我能…可以帮忙的人，嗯，我想那就是你了。$B$B请尽快到那里同她会面。
text.completion: $n! I'm so glad you've come. We've been afforded a rare chance to delve into Icecrown Citadel, but we must move quickly if we're to avoid Arthas' notice.

english.title: Inside the Frozen Citadel
english.objectives: Enter The Forge of Souls from the side of Icecrown Citadel and find Lady Jaina Proudmoore.
english.description: $C! Come close quickly, I must have a word!$B$BMy patron, the Lady Jaina Proudmoore, has uncovered a hole in the defenses of Icecrown Citadel into a place she referred to as "The Forge of Souls." She sent word before she left for me to find any help that I could... and, well, I was hoping that might be you.$B$BPlease, find her there as soon as you can.
english.completion: $n! I'm so glad you've come. We've been afforded a rare chance to delve into Icecrown Citadel, but we must move quickly if we're to avoid Arthas' notice.

text.title: 痛苦灵魂的回声
text.objectives: 消灭布隆亚姆和噬魂者，夺取萨隆矿坑的入口。
text.description: I'm glad we have someone capable to aid us in this. Delving into the citadel with so few is risky at best, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$B$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the Citadel.$B$BBe quick about it, $n. Time is short.
text.completion: Well timed, $c! The Pit of Saron lies ahead, and if our scouts are correct, past that will be the Halls of Reflection. It is there that Arthas lets his guard down, and it is there that we hope to find a clue to his weakness... and a route to vengeance long overdue.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the rear of the Forge of Souls.
