english.objectives: Kill Bronjahm and the Devourer of Souls to secure access to the Pit of Saron.
english.description: I'm glad we have someone capable to aid us in this. Delving into the citadel with so few is risky at best, but opportunities like this are too rare to pass up.$B$BI'm awaiting the arrival of champions from the coliseum, but if your reputation holds true, you should be more than equipped to fight through the forge yourself. Clear the way to the far side and secure the passage to the Pit of Saron. We will need to hold it to move our men further into the Citadel.$B$BBe quick about it, $n. Time is short.
english.completion: Well timed, $c! The Pit of Saron lies ahead, and if our scouts are correct, past that will be the Halls of Reflection. It is there that Arthas lets his guard down, and it is there that we hope to find a clue to his weakness... and a route to vengeance long overdue.
english.completed: Speak to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner at the rear of the Forge of Souls.

text.title: 战士的救赎
text.objectives: 从荣耀岗哨取回5箱被收缴的武器，交给5名石爪囚犯。使用附近的绳索可以快速进出联盟的营地。
text.description: $C，在荣耀岗哨沦陷时缴械投降的那些懦夫，对部落来说已经毫无价值了。但是我还不想那么快就放弃他们。山下关押囚犯的塔楼的防御力量略显薄弱。希望那些囚犯能把握最后这次机会，选择光荣地战死。$B$B这些绳索可以让你快速在山岭上爬上爬下。滑下山去，取回被收缴的武器，然后将其交给塔楼里的囚犯。$B$B$N，你要坚守塔楼！我们的装备还不足以发动全面进攻。
text.completion: From up here I got the perfect view of the havoc you just caused, $N. Our lost brothers reclaimed some of their dignity, and the Alliance dogs were sent scrambling. Sharp work, my friend!$B$BIf the Alliance sleeps comfortably at night, we are not doing our job.$B$BWe will never let up.$B$BWe will never give in.
text.completed: Return to Holgom on the high road in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Warriors' Redemption
english.objectives: Acquire 5 crates of Confiscated Arms from Honor's Stand and re-equip 5 Stonetalon Prisoners. Use the nearby ropes to quickly sneak in and out of the Alliance camp.
english.description: Those that surrendered when Honor's Stand fell are no longer worthy of our Horde, $c. But I'm not giving up on them yet. The prison tower below us is lightly guarded. Let's give those prisoners one final chance to die with honor.$B$BI've set up ropes that will allow you to quickly clamber up and down the mountain. Slip down, acquire the confiscated weapons, and re-arm the prisoners inside the tower.$B$BAnd $N, stay by the tower! We're not yet equipped for an assault on the base proper.
english.completion: From up here I got the perfect view of the havoc you just caused, $N. Our lost brothers reclaimed some of their dignity, and the Alliance dogs were sent scrambling. Sharp work, my friend!$B$BIf the Alliance sleeps comfortably at night, we are not doing our job.$B$BWe will never let up.$B$BWe will never give in.
english.completed: Return to Holgom on the high road in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 以眼还眼
text.objectives: 杀死匹克上尉，并将他的纹章交给奥尔塔格。
text.description: 谁？你的脚步声坚定有力，不像那些整天懒洋洋地踱来踱去的守卫。$B$B你是一位$C？依然在浴血奋战？朋友，我是没有什么希望了。我看不见东西，上不了战场了。$B$B匹克上尉毒打囚犯时，我大声地斥责他。于是他狠狠地踢了我的头。$R，他一直踢，直到踢瞎我的眼睛。$B$B匹克上尉就在塔楼顶层。想为我寻求正义的话，就把他的纹章拿来给我。$B$B如果他不乐意的话……你就看着办吧。
text.progress: Peake is a monster. If his superiors knew, they would thank the Horde for ending him.
text.completion: You have them? I'll take your word for it. Hearing Peake scream like one of his victims is reward enough for me.$B$BNow leave me be, $N. I do not wish to be a burden to my clan.
text.completed: Deliver Peake's eyes to Oltarg at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Eye for an Eye
english.objectives: Slay Captain Peake and deliver his eyes to Oltarg.
english.description: Who goes there? Your footsteps are not the lazy stride of a guard.$B$BA $c, you say? Still brave and free? There's no hope for me, friend. I have lost my eyesight and am no longer fit for battle.$B$BI dared speak up while Captain Peake savagely beat one of the prisoners. In return he kicked me in the head. And kept kicking. He kicked me blind, $r.$B$BYou'll find Captain Peake at the top of this tower. If you seek justice, bring me his eyes.$B$BIf he does not part with them willingly... so be it.
english.progress: Peake is a monster. If his superiors knew, they would thank the Horde for ending him.
english.completion: You have them? I'll take your word for it. Hearing Peake scream like one of his victims is reward enough for me.$B$BNow leave me be, $N. I do not wish to be a burden to my clan.
english.completed: Deliver Peake's eyes to Oltarg at Honor's Stand in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 迅猛龙之皮
text.objectives: 杀死恐齿疾步龙和恐齿镰爪龙，从它们身上收集8张恐齿迅猛龙的皮。
text.description: 我们被包围了，$C。难以逾越的大裂隙加上联盟频繁的骚扰，物资储备已经不多了。但是牛头人总是可以做到物尽其用的。$B$B在没有熔炉的情况下，熟练的制皮师可以利用优质的毛皮修补并强化受损的护甲。$B$B山下就是恐齿迅猛龙的狩猎场。它们的皮粗糙而坚韧，不容易捕杀。去吧，$N，把迅猛龙的皮带回来给我！
text.progress: Terrortooth raptors hunt in packs and surround their prey. We hunt them, yes; but we also respect them.
text.completion: <Onatay looks over the fresh hides, nodding her head slowly.>$B$BYes $N, I can work with these. You work fast!$B$BThese hides will help us hold out for reinforcements longer. Thank you.
text.completed: Deliver the hides to Onatay at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Raptor Scraps
english.objectives: Gather 8 Terrortooth Hides from Terrortooth Runners and Terrortooth Scytheclaws.
english.description: We are besieged here, $c, and between that chasm and the harassment of the Alliance we are short on supplies. But we make do with what's at hand, as we tauren always have.$B$BIn the absence of a forge, a skilled leatherworker can strengthen and patch up our damaged armor with good quality hides.$B$BDown below is the hunting ground of the Terrortooth Raptors. They are not so easy to kill, in part due to the ruggedness of their thick skin. Hunt them, $N, and bring their hides to me!
english.progress: Terrortooth raptors hunt in packs and surround their prey. We hunt them, yes; but we also respect them.
english.completion: <Onatay looks over the fresh hides, nodding her head slowly.>$B$BYes $N, I can work with these. You work fast!$B$BThese hides will help us hold out for reinforcements longer. Thank you.
english.completed: Deliver the hides to Onatay at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 天空中的讯号
text.objectives: 前往南贫瘠之地蔓生绿洲的乌纳菲营地，跟玛卡巴·扁蹄谈一谈。
text.description: 看东南方。你注意到乌纳菲营地腾起的烟火了吗？$B$B大约十分钟前，我看见营地位置窜起了浓烈的白烟。村民们在狩猎时会使用这种古老的讯号进行远距离定位。但是刚才的讯号，是遇难求救的讯号。$B$B$N，我的兄弟玛卡巴就在蔓生绿洲。去那里看看他遇到了什么麻烦。$B$B绿洲中的道路不多，留意查看扎营处。
text.completion: So my sister recognized the old signals? Her hunter's eyes are as sharp as ever.$B$B$N, when we first set up this camp we were at the edge of this jungle. Now look at it!$B$BSomething is amiss.
text.completed: Talk to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Signals in the Sky
english.objectives: Travel to Camp Una'fe in the Overgrowth of Southern Barrens and speak with Makaba Flathoof.
english.description: Turn your eyes to the southeast. Do you see the campfire smoke from Camp Una'fe?$B$BNot ten minutes ago I saw great puffs of white smoke roll up into the sky from the center of camp. It was an old signal used by my village to coordinate the hunt over great distances, but this time, it was a distress signal.$B$B$N, my brother Makaba had gone into that unnatural jungle. Please go there and make sure he's not in any trouble.$B$BThere are few paths: look for tents within the wilderness.
english.completion: So my sister recognized the old signals? Her hunter's eyes are as sharp as ever.$B$B$N, when we first set up this camp we were at the edge of this jungle. Now look at it!$B$BSomething is amiss.
english.completed: Talk to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 让恐惧浸透他们的心灵
text.objectives: 杀死8名荣耀岗哨步兵和1名荣耀岗哨军官。
text.description: $N，看见下面的小径了吗？它归我管。如果联盟狗敢踏上这条路，他们就要当心自己的脑袋。$B$B该缴过路费了！杀死荣耀岗哨的卫兵，或许可以迫使他们撤回原地。$B$B记住，至少干掉一名在路上巡逻的军官。让联盟知道，谁也别想过得安稳。
text.completion: Excellent, $N. It will be some time before we can assault the hold proper, but until then, we must teach them to fear the Barrens.
text.completed: Return to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Put the Fear in Them
english.objectives: Kill 8 Honor's Stand Footmen and 1 Honor's Stand Officer.
english.description: Do you see the trail below us, $N? That is MY trail. And if the Alliance dogs choose to use my trail, they'd best be looking over their shoulder.$B$BIt's time to collect my toll! Slay the footsoldiers from Honor's Stand and see if we can't send them scurrying back to their walls.$B$BBe sure to take out at least one of their officers patrolling the road. They need to realize that nobody is safe.
english.completion: Excellent, $N. It will be some time before we can assault the hold proper, but until then, we must teach them to fear the Barrens.
english.completed: Return to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 低地之路
text.objectives: 将道路图纸交给南贫瘠之地猎手岭的基洛克·血槌。
text.description: 这捆纸藏在军官衣服下的皮质小包里。$B$B好几张作战地图上都画着一条源于塞拉摩，穿越贫瘠之地，直达荣耀岗哨的大道，这条大道仍在建设中。看来联盟企图从海岸处修筑道路，插入卡利姆多的心脏地带！$B$B应该把这件事告诉基洛克·血槌。
text.progress: Ah, you say you found something on one of the bodies?
text.completion: <Kilrok pages through the plans you discovered.>$B$BThis explains much, $N. No wonder our foes are so hellbent on taking the southern Barrens. It's at the center of their plans for the continent!$B$BBut they didn't account for us, did they $c?
text.completed: Deliver the Roadway Plans to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

english.title: The Low Road
english.objectives: Deliver the Roadway Plans to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.
english.description: This bundle of papers was found in a leather satchel hidden under the officer's clothes.$B$BBattle maps of the region depict Honor's Stand, connected to what appears to be a large unfinished roadway crossing the Barrens all the way from Theramore. It looks like the Alliance plans to build a road from the coast straight into the heart of Kalimdor!$B$BKilrok Gorehammer will want to see this.
english.progress: Ah, you say you found something on one of the bodies?
english.completion: <Kilrok pages through the plans you discovered.>$B$BThis explains much, $N. No wonder our foes are so hellbent on taking the southern Barrens. It's at the center of their plans for the continent!$B$BBut they didn't account for us, did they $c?
english.completed: Deliver the Roadway Plans to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 阻止勘测
text.objectives: 找到并杀死勘测员亨利·吉克斯。
text.description: 这些图纸出自同一人之手。我曾经撞见过一名人类勘测员，在猎手岭和东面的丛林间来回走动。$B$B$N，干掉这名勘测员，阻止联盟的阴谋。$B$B<基洛克指着地图下方的签名。>$B$B这是什么？“吉克斯？”人类连名字都显得软弱无力。杀死他。
text.completion: Good, good. We've got to keep Honor's Stand isolated.$B$BAlone ... afraid ... $N, if we keep up the pressure, maybe someday they'll simply surrender the pass.
text.completed: Return to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Search up and down the road south of Honor's Stand.

english.title: Stalling the Survey
english.objectives: Find and kill the surveyor Henry Zykes.
english.description: These maps have all been drawn by the same steady hand. I've seen a human surveyor heading up and down the road between the hold and the jungle to the east.$B$BWe can set their plans back by making an example out of this surveyor, $N.$B$B<Kilrok points to the signature at the bottom of the maps.>$B$BWhat do you think that says? "Zykes?" Even human names sound thin and weak. Kill him.
english.completion: Good, good. We've got to keep Honor's Stand isolated.$B$BAlone ... afraid ... $N, if we keep up the pressure, maybe someday they'll simply surrender the pass.
english.completed: Return to Kilrok Gorehammer at Hunter's Hill in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Search up and down the road south of Honor's Stand.

text.title: 告诉莎希好消息
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛上卡亚罗贸易公司总部的莎希·硬钳谈一谈。
text.description: 我是想跟你一起庆祝的，$N，但是卡亚罗山似乎被那条龙搞得一团糟。我……嗯……我还是收拾行李，搭乘第一班船离开科赞岛的好！$B$B你应该返回总部，告诉莎希你为我们赢得了球赛的冠军。我觉得你还应该把龙和卡亚罗山的事情也告诉她。$B$B祝你好运！
text.completion: You're kidding, right?! DEATHWING?!!! Okay, this'll work out just fine. We'll throw your party and by the time it's over, I'm sure that the dragon will be long gone and the ground will stop shaking. If not, we can always charter a ship off of the island.

english.title: Give Sassy the News
english.objectives: Speak with Sassy Hardwrench at KTC Headquarters on Kezan.
english.description: I'd celebrate with you, $N, but it feels like that dragon did a number on ol' Mount Kajaro. I... uh... I think I'm gonna grab my stuff and get on the first ship leaving the island!$B$BAnyways, you should probably head back to headquarters and let Sassy know that you won the footbomb title for us. I'm sure she'll also want to know about the dragon and Mount Kajaro.$B$BGood luck!
english.completion: You're kidding, right?! DEATHWING?!!! Okay, this'll work out just fine. We'll throw your party and by the time it's over, I'm sure that the dragon will be long gone and the ground will stop shaking. If not, we can always charter a ship off of the island.

text.title: 参加预选赛
text.objectives: 跟科赞岛卡亚罗运动场的克罗斯彻克教练谈一谈。
text.description: $N, Coach Crosscheck, the leader of our fearless Bilgewater Buccaneers, is looking for you.$B$BHe says that the division title against the Steamwheedle Sharks is on the line and that you're the only one that can bring it home for us!$B$BHead west into town. You can't miss Kajaro Field!

english.title: Report for Tryouts
english.objectives: Speak with Coach Crosscheck at Kajaro Field on Kezan.
english.description: $N, Coach Crosscheck, the leader of our fearless Bilgewater Buccaneers, is looking for you.$B$BHe says that the division title against the Steamwheedle Sharks is on the line and that you're the only one that can bring it home for us!$B$BHead west into town. You can't miss Kajaro Field!

text.title: 太阳之井之旅
text.objectives: 在奎尔丹纳斯岛，太阳之井高地入口处同哈杜伦·明翼交谈。
text.description: 尽快将奎尔德拉带到太阳之井，$N。要相信乌瑟尔的话，他说过，当这把剑受到巫妖王邪恶力量的影响时，你无法彻底控制它。你必须前往奎尔丹纳斯岛，在那里，设法进入太阳之井，只有在那你才能净化这把剑。$B$B太阳之井的守卫不会轻易放行的，所以你必须找到哈杜伦·明翼，他会在那里巡视那些守卫。
text.progress: What brings you here?
text.completion: Admit you to the Sunwell? That's impossible! The Sunwell is the most sacred and important site of our people. We have only recently reclaimed it with the help of the Shattered Sun Offensive. It is not a place for tourists or travelers.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at Dawnstar Village in Isle of Quel'Danas.

english.title: Journey To The Sunwell
english.objectives: Speak with Halduron Brightwing at the entrance to the Sunwell Plateau on the Isle of Quel'Danas.
english.description: Take Quel'Delar to the Sunwell as quickly as possible, $N. Trust in Uther's words when he says that you will not always be able to control the blade while it is subject to the evil of the Lich King's influence. You must travel to the Isle of Quel'Danas, and there, seek entry to the Sunwell itself, where you can cleanse the sword.$B$BThe guardians of the Sunwell will not simply allow you to walk in, so you must find Halduron Brightwing, who will be inspecting the guards there.
english.progress: What brings you here?
english.completion: Admit you to the Sunwell? That's impossible! The Sunwell is the most sacred and important site of our people. We have only recently reclaimed it with the help of the Shattered Sun Offensive. It is not a place for tourists or travelers.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at Dawnstar Village in Isle of Quel'Danas.

text.title: 蛮鬃图腾
text.objectives: 从草原狼前锋身上获得4颗草原狼前锋的牙齿。
text.description: 还剩下一口井需要净化，它是以蛮鬃部族的名字命名的。要想净化这口井，你必须从大地上寻找一种凶猛的肉食动物的牙齿，那就是草原狼前锋的牙齿。去北边寻找草原狼前锋，拿到我要的东西之后再回来。$B$B这些草原狼前锋经常在雷霆崖的山脚下游荡。
text.progress: 你找到我要的牙齿了吗，$N?
text.completion: 很好，$N。我可以感受到大地做出的牺牲，这让我既骄傲又悲伤。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Una Wildmane at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

english.title: Wildmane Totem
english.objectives: Collect 4 Prairie Alpha Teeth from Prairie Wolf Alphas.
english.description: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan.  For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha.  Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished.$B$BAlphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
english.progress: $N.  Do you have the teeth I asked for?
english.completion: Very good, $n.  I can feel the sacrifice of the land in this offering, and my spirit swells with sadness, and pride.
english.completed: Return to Una Wildmane at Camp Sungraze in Mulgore.

text.title: 净化蛮鬃之井
text.objectives: 在蛮鬃之井使用蛮鬃之井净化图腾，然后回来见穆尔·雷角。
text.description: 你净化冰蹄之井和雷角之井的事迹已经被广为传诵了，年轻的$N。我也已经做好了蛮鬃之井净化图腾，接下来这就是你的最后一个任务了。$B$B蛮鬃之井在雷霆崖的北面，到那里完成净化仪式吧，拯救这片被地精污染的土地，让这片土地上的生灵再次畅饮甘甜纯净的井水！
text.completion: 你成功了!你净化了水井，也净化了我们的土地。血蹄村非常感激你，$N。$B$B愿你的功绩在风中传诵百年，愿莫高雷的水永远纯净。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Una Wildmane at Camp Sungraze.

english.title: Wildmane Cleansing
english.objectives: Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well.
english.description: Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young $N.  The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.$B$BThe Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff.  Perform the ritual!  Heal the land of the Grimtotem's poisons!  Let clean water flow once again!
english.completion: You've done it.  You have cleaned the wells, and healed our land.  Bloodhoof village is grateful, $n. May the wind whisper your deeds for a hundred seasons, and may the waters of Mulgore remain clean forever.
english.completed: Return to Una Wildmane at Camp Sungraze.

text.title: 把狗管好
text.objectives: 杀死6只乱齿清道夫。
text.description: 并不是所有从陶拉祖逃出来的人都能成功抵达乌纳菲，$N。有些在路上重伤不治。有些被趁乱打劫的野猪人截住。$B$B我将负责寻找和收集尸体这件残酷工作。但有些事你可以帮我做。$B$B乱齿清道夫潜行在南边的大地上，靠食腐为生，撕开尸体的肚肠，拖走死者的四肢。拜托你，把它们的数量削减一些，让我好举行体面的葬礼。
text.completion: So it is done.$B$BNormally these scavengers are part of the Earthmother's cycle of life. But on the heels of the devastation wracked by both the Alliance and the cataclysm, their numbers grow overwhelming. It is good to thin them out.
text.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Keeping the Dogs at Bay
english.objectives: Kill 6 Hecklefang Scavengers.
english.description: Not everyone who fled Taurajo was able to make it to Una'fe, $N. Some died of wounds along the way. Others were jumped by opportunistic quilboar.$B$BI'll take care of the grim task of finding and gathering the bodies. But there is something you can do for me.$B$BHecklefang scavengers prowl the lands south of here and are savaging the corpses, tearing at their bowels and dragging away the limbs of the dead. Please, thin their numbers so that I can perform the proper funerary rites.
english.completion: So it is done.$B$BNormally these scavengers are part of the Earthmother's cycle of life. But on the heels of the devastation wracked by both the Alliance and the cataclysm, their numbers grow overwhelming. It is good to thin them out.
english.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

text.title: Filling Up the Spellbook
text.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Teegli Merrowith. Successfully cast Arcane Missiles 2 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: Excellent!  Let's get started.$b$bFirst, you're going to have to learn the spell Arcane Missiles.  This spell is a little bit different from others you've learned in the past. Each time you cast another spell, you have a chance to create an opening to use Arcane Missiles.  Why not get a feel for the spell using those training dummies the militia trainees put up outside the entrance to Anvilmar?
text.completion: There we go!  One spell down, many many more to go.  Come back to me after you've had some experience casting this spell, and I'll show you some more tricks.
text.completed: Return to Teegli Merrowith at Anvilmar.

english.objectives: Learn Arcane Missiles from Teegli Merrowith. Successfully cast Arcane Missiles 2 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

english.completed: Return to Teegli Merrowith at Anvilmar.

text.title: Your Path Begins Here
text.objectives: Learn Primal Strike from Teo Hammerstorm, then use Primal Strike 2 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance of Anvilmar.
text.description: Excellent!  Let us begin.$b$bThe first skill you will learn is that of the Primal Strike.  The primal spirits, when called upon, will strengthen your arm to deliver a mighty blow.$b$bHelpful, isn't it?
text.completion: This has been but one of many footfalls on the long path of the $c.  Come back to me after you've had some experience in the field, and I will help guide you on your next step.
text.completed: Return to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

english.objectives: Learn Primal Strike from Teo Hammerstorm, then use Primal Strike 2 times on a Training Dummy near the entrance of Anvilmar.

text.title: 圣光之力
text.objectives: Learn Seal of Righteousness and Judgment from Bromos Grummner. After casting Seal of Righteousness on yourself, use Judgment on one of the Training Dummies at the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: Are ya ready to start?  Wonderful!  We're glad to have ya.$b$bBefore ya go back outside, I'm gonna need ya to learn the Seal of Righteousness.  It will grant Holy damage to your swings, helping ya dispatch yer enemies quicker.$B$BThe other thing yer gonna want to know is that any time ya have a seal active, ya can use the light to judge yer enemies. Yer judgement will deal damage each time ye invoke it.
text.completion: There, ya did it.  The Light favors quick learners like you.  Come back to me after you've spent some time using what I've taught ya, and I'll show ya something new.
text.completed: Return to Bromos Grummner at Anvilmar.

english.title: The Power of the Light
english.objectives: Learn Seal of Righteousness and Judgment from Bromos Grummner. After casting Seal of Righteousness on yourself, use Judgment on one of the Training Dummies at the entrance to Anvilmar.
english.description: Are ya ready to start?  Wonderful!  We're glad to have ya.$b$bBefore ya go back outside, I'm gonna need ya to learn the Seal of Righteousness.  It will grant Holy damage to your swings, helping ya dispatch yer enemies quicker.$B$BThe other thing yer gonna want to know is that any time ya have a seal active, ya can use the light to judge yer enemies. Yer judgement will deal damage each time ye invoke it.
english.completion: There, ya did it.  The Light favors quick learners like you.  Come back to me after you've spent some time using what I've taught ya, and I'll show ya something new.
english.completed: Return to Bromos Grummner at Anvilmar.

text.title: 火上浇油
text.objectives: 营救被关住的5名陶拉祖难民，杀掉任意组合的共计8名刺背织棘者和刀刃卫士。
text.description: 当难民们从陶拉祖往北奔逃的时候，有些人在夜幕中走散了。许多人都被刺背野猪人抓到了西边和西南边他们的营地里。$B$B我不清楚野猪人俘虏难民是打算从我们这儿得到些什么，但他们能得到的只有我的愤怒。我们所回报的也只会是复仇。$B$B把我被困住的弟兄们解救出来，杀掉那些劫持者，让野猪人知道教训。
text.completion: It's bad enough to have one's village sacked... but to spend the following night in a quilboar cage? I'm glad you were there to help, $N.
text.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Bad to Worse
english.objectives: Rescue 5 caged Taurajo Refugees, and kill any combination of 8 Bristleback Thornweavers or Bladewardens.
english.description: When the refugees fled north from Taurajo, some were separated as darkness closed in. Many were taken prisoner by the Bristleback quilboar who set up camp west and southwest of here.$B$BI am not certain what the quilboar hoped to get from us by capturing our refugees; all they have earned is my ire. And all they'll get in return is vengeance.$B$BRescue my trapped brothers and sisters, and kill their captors to send a message to the quilboar.
english.completion: It's bad enough to have one's village sacked... but to spend the following night in a quilboar cage? I'm glad you were there to help, $N.
english.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 哦，猎人的生活
text.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Thorgas Grimson, then use Steady Shot 5 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: The life of a hunter is steeped in tradition, ye know.  Trackin' mighty beasts through rugged terrain.  Drinkin'.  Travelin' the land, yer gun at yer side.  Drinkin'.  Survivin' on wits and courage and cunning, followed by a good stiff drink.$b$bBut before we get to the good stuff, though, ye'll need to learn how to do the beginner stuff.
text.completion: Now that ye've got a new $c trick under yer belt, and now that I've got some of yer money, go out there an' track some beasts!  Come back sometime in the future, an' we'll talk again.
text.completed: Return to Thorgas Grimson at Anvilmar.

english.title: Oh, A Hunter's Life For Me
english.objectives: Learn Steady Shot from Thorgas Grimson, then use Steady Shot 5 times on the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.

Survivin' on wits and courage and cunning, followed by a good stiff drink.$b$bBut before we get to the good stuff, though, ye'll need to learn how to do the beginner stuff.
english.completion: Now that ye've got a new $c trick under yer belt, and now that I've got some of yer money, go out there an' track some beasts!  Come back sometime in the future, an' we'll talk again.
english.completed: Return to Thorgas Grimson at Anvilmar.

text.title: Getting Battle-Ready
text.objectives: Learn Charge from Thran Khorman, then use Charge on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: Lesson one.  Aside from your sword and shield, what's the most important tool you have in your arsenal?$b$b<Thran awaits your response.>$b$bOh never mind, I'll answer it for you.  It's your mobility.  One of the strengths of the warrior is the ability to get around the battlefield quickly.  Here, $N, I'll train you to use your legs to your advantage.
text.completion: Now we're getting somewhere.  You've got quite a manly bellow, sir! Come back to me in a bit, and I'll teach you something else.
text.completed: Return to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.

english.objectives: Learn Charge from Thran Khorman, then use Charge on one of the Training Dummies outside the entrance to Anvilmar.
english.description: Lesson one.  Aside from your sword and shield, what's the most important tool you have in your arsenal?$b$b<Thran awaits your response.>$b$bOh never mind, I'll answer it for you.  It's your mobility.  One of the strengths of the warrior is the ability to get around the battlefield quickly.  Here, $N, I'll train you to use your legs to your advantage.
english.completion: Now we're getting somewhere.  You've got quite a manly bellow, sir! Come back to me in a bit, and I'll teach you something else.
english.completed: Return to Thran Khorman in Anvilmar.

text.title: Evisceratin' the Enemy
text.objectives: Learn Evisecerate from Solm Hargrin, then use Eviscerate 3 times on the Training Dummies near the entrance to Anvilmar.
text.description: One of the things that makes a rogue dangerous is our ability to use combinations of combat maneuvers and wait for the chance to use a devastating technique.$B$BNow that you've had a chance to master Sinister Strike, it's time to show you a new skill you can use as a follow up.$B$BPlease, allow me to train you.
text.completion: You've got the hang of it.  Go get some practice out there... maybe take out a few of those troggs or trolls.  Or rabbits, I don't care. Return after you've gotten some practice, and I'll show you another trick of the trade.
text.completed: Return to Solm Hargrin in Anvilmar.

text.title: 力量之语
text.objectives: Learn Flash Heal from Branstock Khalder, then cast Flash Heal 5 times on Wounded Militia members in Anvilmar.
text.description: Now, if ya DO want to become somethin' special, ye'll need to talk to me.  A priest is nothin' without his spells.  And I know a couple of spells that I might be able to teach ya.$b$bThe first is a quick heal that can fix ya up when you've taken damage. Tell me, $g boy; lass:, do ya ever take damage?
text.completion: Well done, $n.  You'll make a fine $c in due time. Return to me after you've proven yourself a bit more, and I'll reward you by teaching you another spell or two.
text.completed: Return to Branstock Khalder at Anvilmar.
text.objective1: Practice Flash Heal on Wounded Militia

english.objectives: Learn Flash Heal from Branstock Khalder, then cast Flash Heal 5 times on Wounded Militia members in Anvilmar.

text.title: 说他们的语言
text.objectives: 在刺背竞技场中吹响挑战之角，一对一击败刃鼻。
text.description: 野猪人之所以展开攻击，是因为他们感觉到了对手的软弱。力量是他们唯一明白的语言，因此我们将向他们展示我们的力量。$B$B<玛卡巴从背包里拿出一只巨大的号角来。>$B$B这东西有点粗糙，不过能派上用场。刺背的头领们用类似的号角互相挑战，争夺支配权。$B$B$N，我要你去挑战刺背的勇士刃鼻，一对一，在他的追随者面前打败他。到正南方的刺背竞技场中吹响这个号角。
text.progress: Have you taken the Bristlebacks down a peg or two?
text.completion: What? He attacked you with a dozen boars? I guess quilboar have their own ideas of what "single combat" means.$B$BStill, the Bristleback will be left reeling after the blow you delivered. It will not be long before a new champion rises amongst them to stir up trouble... but at least this buys us some time to get these refugees relocated safely.$B$BThank you, $N. The survivors owe you a great debt.
text.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.
text.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabersnout.

english.title: Speaking Their Language
english.objectives: Blow the Horn of Challenge in the Bristleback Challenge Ring, and defeat Sabersnout in single combat.
english.description: The quilboar are attacking because they perceive weakness. Strength is the only language they understand. So we will show them strength.$B$B<Makaba withdraws a large horn from his satchel.>$B$BThis is admittedly crude work but it'll do. Bristleback leaders use horns like these to challenge one another for dominance.$B$B$N, I want you to challenge the Bristleback champion, Sabersnout, to single combat. Defeat him in front of his followers. Blow the horn at the Bristleback challenge ring due south of here.
english.progress: Have you taken the Bristlebacks down a peg or two?
english.completion: What? He attacked you with a dozen boars? I guess quilboar have their own ideas of what "single combat" means.$B$BStill, the Bristleback will be left reeling after the blow you delivered. It will not be long before a new champion rises amongst them to stir up trouble... but at least this buys us some time to get these refugees relocated safely.$B$BThank you, $N. The survivors owe you a great debt.
english.completed: Return to Makaba Flathoof at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.
english.giverWindow: Blow the Horn of Challenge to engage Sabersnout.

text.title: 萨洛瑞安·寻晨者
text.objectives: 访问萨洛瑞安·寻晨者的遗体，获得他的祝福，以使用奎尔德拉。
text.description: $N，如果你真的拥有奎尔德拉，我也许可以让你进入太阳之井。也许你知道这把剑的历史，知道萨洛瑞安·寻晨者曾经挥舞它对抗天灾军团，守卫太阳之井。他牺牲的地方就是今天的死亡之痕。正是因为他舍身血战，才为他的族人赢得了进行战争准备的时间。你可以在这座岛的死亡之痕南端找到他的遗迹。去那里看看，如果他的灵魂赐予你祝福，我就会让你进入太阳之井。
text.completion: I confess that I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to recognize you as the heir to Quel'Delar, but I defer to his judgment. You may enter the Sunwell, but I remind you that you are a guest in our most sacred of precincts, and you should act accordingly.
text.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at Dawnstar Village in Isle of Quel'Danas.

english.title: Thalorien Dawnseeker
english.objectives: Visit Thalorien Dawnseeker's Remains and obtain his blessing to wield Quel'Delar.
english.description: If you truly bear Quel'Delar, $N, I might be able to admit you to the Sunwell. If you know the blade's history, you recall that it was borne by Thalorien Dawnseeker in defense of the Sunwell against the Scourge. He fell in what is now the Dead Scar, buying time for his men to make their own preparations. You will find his remains near the southern end of the Dead Scar on this isle. Visit them, and if his spirit gives you its blessing, I will allow you to enter the Sunwell.
english.completion: I confess that I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to recognize you as the heir to Quel'Delar, but I defer to his judgment. You may enter the Sunwell, but I remind you that you are a guest in our most sacred of precincts, and you should act accordingly.
english.completed: Return to Halduron Brightwing at Dawnstar Village in Isle of Quel'Danas.

text.title: 恶臭的东西
text.objectives: 使用滑栓的空气分析器测试6位带有浓郁香气的卫兵周围的空气，然后返回奥格瑞玛，去见侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description: Get a load of these guys, would ya? Steamwheedle's been handling the business of holidays for years, and all of a sudden, these guys bust into the market. They're not Steamwheedle; the cartel hired me to get to the bottom of this. Something stinks here and it ain't just perfume.$B$B$B$BTake this device I brought and go analyze the perfume clouds around the guards. I want to know what they're putting in that stuff. Things ain't natural.
text.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look. Oh, that ain't good.
text.completed: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Something Stinks
english.objectives: Use Snagglebolt's Air Analyzer to test the air around 6 heavily perfumed guards, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Get a load of these guys, would ya? Steamwheedle's been handling the business of holidays for years, and all of a sudden, these guys bust into the market. They're not Steamwheedle; the cartel hired me to get to the bottom of this. Something stinks here and it ain't just perfume.$B$B$B$BTake this device I brought and go analyze the perfume clouds around the guards. I want to know what they're putting in that stuff. Things ain't natural.
english.completion: Hey, thanks, kid. Give it over, let's take a look. Oh, that ain't good.
english.completed: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 植物的攻击
text.objectives: 消灭丛生蔓藤，救下被抓住的5名陶拉祖难民。
text.description: 营地本建在丛林的边缘，现在已经被疯长的植物所包围了。一定是发生了什么非自然的事情！$B$B早前我犯下了一个错误，派稍微健康点的难民去收集坚果和浆果。据那些回来的人说，野生植物居然抓住了他们的脚，甚至把他们吊了起来。我担心那些还没有回来的人。$B$B$C，请把营地附近困在丛生藤蔓里的难民们救回来。
text.completion: Thank you, $N. But now on to the larger question:$B$BWhere is this overgrowth coming from? And why is it raging out of control?
text.completed: Return to Lane Tallgrass at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

english.title: When Plants Attack
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Taurajo Refugees by killing the Grasping Overgrowths that ensnare them.
english.description: This camp was built at the edge of this jungle, and already it is overwhelmed by plant growth. Something unnatural is happening here!$B$BEarlier I made the mistake of sending some of the healthier refugees out to gather nuts and berries. Those that returned talked about the plant life actually grasping at their legs or even picking them up. I worry about those that haven't come back yet.$B$B$C, please rescue the refugees trapped in the grasping overgrowth around the camp.
english.completion: Thank you, $N. But now on to the larger question:$B$BWhere is this overgrowth coming from? And why is it raging out of control?
english.completed: Return to Lane Tallgrass at Camp Una'fe in Southern Barrens.

text.title: War Dance
text.objectives: Defeat Orno Grimtotem at Stonetalon Pass.
text.description: Some see our people as gentle giants, or noble savages. They have never seen us fight against our own kind...against betrayers from within.$B$BThe Grimtotem were offered mercy in exile, and they have scarred their own home to spite us. They will no longer be tolerated in Mulgore.$B$BI've already sent our warriors ahead to drive them out through Stonetalon Pass, to the north. You have fought bravely against the Grimtotem, $n; I ask that you join the battle again. Go, and help deal this final blow.
text.completion: Welcome back, $n. What was done was not for revenge, or pride. It was simply to protect Thunder Bluff, and all our people, from torment and fear. Today, Mulgore is safe once more. The Earth Mother thanks you for all your brave deeds, $n, as do I. You have earned your reward, hero. May you be welcome in Thunder Bluff always.
text.completed: Return to Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
text.giverWindow: Defeat him!

text.title: 香水行动
text.objectives: 被伪装成一个送包裹的人之后，前往奥格瑞玛大门外皇冠药剂公司的物资存放处，然后将他们给你的包裹交给奥格瑞玛的侦探斯奈普·滑栓。
text.description: I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.$B$B$B$BDon't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.$B$B$B$BI'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.
text.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we got here.
text.end: Steal perfume package from Crown Chemical Co. outside Orgrimmar
text.completed: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Pilfering Perfume
english.objectives: While disguised as a package-runner, go to the Crown Chemical Company's stockpile outside the gates of Orgrimmar, then return the package they toss you to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgimmar.
english.description: I knew they were up to no good! There's some sort of mind-affecting chemical in here, but I can't get a handle on it with such a small sample. I need the real stuff.$B$B$B$BDon't just go over there and buy it! I don't want you giving these scumbags one copper. Nah, you gotta get it from the source, discreet-like.$B$B$B$BI'll disguise you as a package runner. I saw a stockpile guarded by their goons outside the gates. Go run by, and DON'T stop, or they'll make you! They'll toss you a crate. Bring it back here.
english.completion: You got it, huh? Good job, kid. Top notch. Let's see what we got here.
english.end: Steal perfume package from Crown Chemical Co. outside Orgrimmar
english.completed: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 一朵奇怪的花
text.objectives: 在蔓生绿洲里初生的花朵上获得不寻常的花芽。
text.description: 大德鲁伊纳拉雷克斯出现在了贫瘠之地这里。他要么是这场混乱的主使，要么就是来修复它的。不管如何，你都应该趁丛林把整个世界都吞没之前，和他谈谈！他就在东南边一座不大的牛头人营地里。$B$B如果可以的话，你可以在路上收集一些植物样本给他去研究。初生的花芽会把最近在丛林里发生的许多变化都告诉他。
text.progress: I am extremely busy, $c.
text.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Seek out Naralex within the Overgrowth in Southern Barrens.

english.title: A Curious Bloom
english.objectives: Gather ten Unusual Flower Buds from Budding Flowers in the Overgrowth.
english.description: The great archdruid Naralex recently appeared here in the Barrens. He's either behind this mess or trying to fix it. Either way, you should talk with him before this jungle engulfs the whole world! He's in a small tauren camp to the southeast.$B$BAlong the way, it would be helpful for you to gather plant samples for him to study. The newest flower buds will tell him a great deal about the most recent changes in the jungle.
english.progress: I am extremely busy, $c.
english.completion: Ah, samples from different parts of the overgrowth? These will be immensely helpful, yes. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Seek out Naralex within the Overgrowth in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 妻离子散
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地世仇哨站的基尔格·锐角。
text.description: 你看到的这些孩子都是在战斗开始时从陶拉祖救出来的。我试着想找到他们的父母。$B$B你从野猪人手上救下的一个难民认出了那个最强壮的孩子，就是基尔格和玛芙蕾·锐角夫妇的儿子。还有，他说基尔格就扎营在鲜血旷野，陶拉祖屠杀现场的北边。$B$B$N，请你到那里去，告诉基尔格·锐角，他的孩子还活得好好的！
text.completion: <Kirge listens intently and then falls to one knee.>$B$BAlive! My boy still lives! Praise to the earthmother, I still have a son.$B$B<Kirge composes himself.>$B$B$C, my boy's mother didn't make it out of Taurajo alive. I will avenge her death, even if it means my son grows up without either of his parents.
text.completed: Find Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: A Family Divided
english.objectives: Find Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.
english.description: The children you see here were all rescued from Taurajo when the fighting started. I'm trying to track down their parents.$B$BOne of the refugees you rescued from the quilboar recognized the strongest child as belonging to Kirge and Mawre Sternhorn. Moreover, he said Kirge was camped at the Fields of Blood, just north of the Taurajo massacre site.$B$B$N, please go there and tell Kirge Sternhorn that his child is alive and well!
english.completion: <Kirge listens intently and then falls to one knee.>$B$BAlive! My boy still lives! Praise to the earthmother, I still have a son.$B$B<Kirge composes himself.>$B$B$C, my boy's mother didn't make it out of Taurajo alive. I will avenge her death, even if it means my son grows up without either of his parents.
english.completed: Find Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 神圣的和堕落的
text.objectives: 将圣光的复仇、25块源生萨隆邪铁、腐面的酸性血液和烂肠的酸性血液放进冰冠堡垒大领主莫格莱尼的符文熔炉中。$B$B腐面的酸性血液和烂肠的酸性血液只能在25人模式的冰冠堡垒中获得。
text.description: $R，我其实不该把这个任务交给你，也许这会导致你的毁灭。$B$B不要理会我的这些话了，听听我要你去完成的任务吧。我会为你提供足够的信息和资源帮助你完成这个任务。$B$B你必须返回霜之哀伤洞穴，取得圣光的复仇——那把被阿尔萨斯丢弃的锤子。用萨隆邪铁重新铸炼它，在它上面用巫妖王奴仆的酸性血液雕刻符文。它会成为我们实行计划的基础。
text.progress: As you draw near, the forge's flame seems to burn even more ravenously...
text.completion: A deep sense of dread washes over you as the flame devours the items.
text.completed: Return to Runeforge in Icecrown Citadel.

english.title: The Sacred and the Corrupt
english.objectives: Place Light's Vengeance, 25 Primordial Saronite, Rotface's Acidic Blood, and Festergut's Acidic Blood in Highlord Mograine's runeforge in Icecrown Citadel.$B$BRotface's Acidic Blood and Festergut's Acidic Blood may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting of Icecrown Citadel.
english.description: It is against my judgment that I present you this errand, $r, as it will likely end in your undoing.$b$bIgnore my counsel and embark on the endeavor, and I shall provide you with the knowledge and resources to see it through.$b$bYou must return to Frostmourne Cavern and recover Light's Vengeance, Arthas' discarded hammer. Reforged with saronite and etched with the acidic blood of the Lich King's abominations, it will provide the foundation for our work.
english.progress: As you draw near, the forge's flame seems to burn even more ravenously...
english.completion: A deep sense of dread washes over you as the flame devours the items.
english.completed: Return to Runeforge in Icecrown Citadel.

starters.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 贫瘠之地的防线
text.objectives: 在鲜血旷野占领一座中立的山丘，并抵御联盟的反攻。
text.description: 联盟的烧杀抢掠在贫瘠之地上留下了一道焦痕。必须阻止他们继续扩张，否则我们将丧失所有领地。$B$B鲜血旷野上有若干座战略型山丘，由木质塔楼和中立的灰色旗帜标示。只有占领这些山丘，才能阻止联盟的攻势！$B$B占领陶拉祖废墟北面、东面以及南面的山丘。夺取一面中立旗帜并抵御联盟的反攻！
text.completion: So you held your ground! With tenacity like yours we may yet drive the Alliance from our lands.
text.completed: Return to Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: A Line in the Dirt
english.objectives: Capture a neutral hill in the Fields of Blood and defend it against an Alliance counterattack.
english.description: The Alliance scorches a trail of murder across the Barrens. We must stop them here or there is nothing left for us.$B$BAcross the Fields of Blood there are a number of strategic hills, marked by wooden towers and neutral gray banners. We must take and hold these hills if we hope to slow the Alliance advance!$B$BLook for the towers to the north, east, and south of what's left of Taurajo. Claim a neutral flag and defend the hill against counterattack!
english.completion: So you held your ground! With tenacity like yours we may yet drive the Alliance from our lands.
english.completed: Return to Kirge Sternhorn at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 灵魂盛宴
text.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to use Shadow's Edge to slay 50 of the Lich King's minions in Icecrown Citadel. Souls can be obtained in 10 or 25 person difficulty.
text.description: Shadow's Edge is among the greatest weapons a $c could hope to obtain.$b$bIs your lust for power sated, $r?$b$b<You feel Mograine's penetrating gaze.>$b$bI thought not. A final warning then...$b$bYou now embark on the most treacherous leg of your quest. Bridle your aspirations, for if your aims are impure then your life, your very soul, is forfeit.$b$bThe weapon you hold is but an empty husk, a mere shadow of what it may become.
text.completion: You seem to have endured this leg of your trial admirably, $r. Pray that fate continues to smile upon you in your endeavor...
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine inside Icecrown Citadel.

text.title: 碎裂的王座
text.objectives: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼要你收集50块影霜碎片。$B$B影霜碎片只能在25人模式下获得。
text.description: 巫妖王的王座再一次成为了他的牢狱。它是基尔加丹亲手从扭曲的下层位面中雕刻出来的冰晶容器。制作它的唯一目的就是封锢耐奥祖的灵魂。$B$B当阿尔萨斯用霜之哀伤击中这块冰晶的时候，他就释放了耐奥祖的灵魂，并让这个充满仇恨的灵魂和他融为一体。而这次打击所迸出的冰封王座碎片也散落在冰冠堡垒各处。$B$B我需要用这些碎片封印你的剑刃中蕴含的力量。而这些碎片都在巫妖王最强大的仆人手中。
text.progress: Have you obtained the shards of the frozen throne, $c?
text.completion: These should suffice, $c. Speak to me when Shadow's Edge has been thoroughly empowered and I will attempt its completion.
text.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

english.title: The Splintered Throne
english.objectives: Highlord Darion Mograine wants you to collect 50 Shadowfrost Shards.$B$BShadowfrost Shards may only be obtained in the 25 person difficulty setting.
english.description: The Lich King's throne once served as his prison. Kil'jaeden himself crafted the vessel of icy crystals from the twisting nether, its sole purpose to hold Ner'zhul's vengeful spirit.$b$bWhen Arthas struck the crystal with Frostmourne, he released Ner'zhul's soul, allowing it to merge with his own. Splinters from that impact are now scattered throughout the citadel.$b$bI shall require those shards, held only by the Lich King's most powerful servants, to seal the power contained in your blade.
english.progress: Have you obtained the shards of the frozen throne, $c?
english.completion: These should suffice, $c. Speak to me when Shadow's Edge has been thoroughly empowered and I will attempt its completion.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Darion Mograine.

text.completion: Congratulations, $c. Against insurmountable odds, you have weathered the storm. I trust that you shall find your reward proportionate to your conviction...

text.title: 雷霆崖之旅
text.objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
text.description: The wells are cleansed, and Mulgore's waters run sweet and clear once more. You've saved us...but you've also uncovered grim happenings. The actions of the Grimtotem must be made known.$B$BIt is time for you to enter Thunder Bluff, our great city atop the mesa.  Go to our leader, Baine Bloodhoof, son of Cairne. He must hear of this.
text.completion: Welcome to Thunder Bluff, $n. You've done great things for our people. Tell me of your journey.

english.objectives: Speak with Baine Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 晋见新头领
text.objectives: 杀死北卫军侦察兵并收集10枚塞拉摩军功奖章。
text.description: $N，加杜尔指挥下的贫瘠之地保卫战进行得并不顺利。加尔鲁什派了血柄督军来接管军务。他就在营地里，如果你想给督军留个好印象的话，最好积极一点。$B$B去东边的鲜血旷野寻找北卫军侦察兵。如果你能呈上一叠他们的军功奖章，督军会对你刮目相看的！
text.progress: You look like the type of $c who gets things done. What news do you have from the field?
text.completion: <Bloodhilt looks at the badges, then allows them to spill from his hands onto the sands below. His lips curl open into a toothy grin.>$B$BNow THIS is what I like to see, $c! What is your name again?$B$BYou will go far here.
text.completed: Deliver the badges to Warlord Bloodhilt at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Meet the New Boss
english.objectives: Kill Northwatch Recon patrols and collect 10 Theramore Merit Badges.
english.description: Our defense of the Barrens hasn't gone well under Gar'dul's command, $N. Garrosh has sent Warlord Bloodhilt here to take control of the situation. He's here in camp, and if you want to make a good impression, you'll demonstrate some initiative.$B$BHead east into the Fields of Blood and seek out Northwatch recon units. Bringing the new Warlord a stack of their merit badges will help you make a name for yourself!
english.progress: You look like the type of $c who gets things done. What news do you have from the field?
english.completion: <Bloodhilt looks at the badges, then allows them to spill from his hands onto the sands below. His lips curl open into a toothy grin.>$B$BNow THIS is what I like to see, $c! What is your name again?$B$BYou will go far here.
english.completed: Deliver the badges to Warlord Bloodhilt at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 狮子的尊严
text.objectives: 任意杀死5只原野徘徊狮或原野傲鬃狮。
text.description: 想找联盟入侵者报仇的话，不妨仔细观察一下贫瘠之地最凶猛的掠食者。$B$B狮子在草丛间悄无声息地前行，它们生性奸诈且具有极强的爆发力。你可以从狮子身上了解战斗的真谛，而那正是我们需要的精神。$B$B捕杀原野徘徊狮和傲鬃狮，然后告诉我你学到了什么。狮群通常栖息在树荫下。
text.completion: Ah yes... I see a cunning in your eyes that was not present before. Well done, $c.
text.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

english.title: Lion's Pride
english.objectives: Kill any combination of 5 Plains Prowlers or Plains Pridemanes.
english.description: If you seek vengeance on our Alliance invaders, you would do well to observe the fiercest of predators in the Barrens.$B$BThe lions that stalk amongst the tall grass do so with cunning, stealth, and power. Learn from their example and you will understand the kind of war we need to fight.$B$BHunt the plains prowlers and pridemanes, then return to me to discuss what you have learned. You will often find them in the shade of large trees.
english.completion: Ah yes... I see a cunning in your eyes that was not present before. Well done, $c.
english.completed: Return to Jorn Skyseer at Vendetta Point in Southern Barrens.

text.title: 奎尔德拉的净化
text.objectives: 将淬火的奎尔德拉浸入到太阳之井中。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
text.description: 将淬火的奎尔德拉浸入到太阳之井中。准备好进入太阳之井高地后，就同太阳之井守卫交谈。
text.progress: What happened during your time in the Sunwell?
text.completion: This is unbelievable, $n. You've really done it! All of the quel'dorei have heard of Thalorien Dawnseeker and Quel'Delar, but no one ever thought the sword would be restored.
text.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest in Icecrown.

english.title: The Purification of Quel'Delar
english.objectives: Immerse your Tempered Quel'Delar in the Sunwell. Speak to a Warden of the Sunwell when you are ready to enter the Sunwell Plateau.
english.description: I admit, I was skeptical that you had actually re-forged Quel'Delar and I did not expect Thalorien's spirit to reveal itself to you. You cannot understand what it means to me and to the rest of my people that Quel'Delar has been recovered.$B$BAs promised, I will admit you to the Sunwell and you will find the leaders of Silvermoon within. Carry the sword to the chamber of the Sunwell and immerse it. The blade will bond to you. When that happens, carry it to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest.
english.progress: What happened during your time in the Sunwell?
english.completion: This is unbelievable, $n. You've really done it! All of the quel'dorei have heard of Thalorien Dawnseeker and Quel'Delar, but no one ever thought the sword would be restored.
english.completed: Return to Caladis Brightspear at Quel'Delar's Rest in Icecrown.

text.title: 残破的剑柄
text.objectives: Bring the Battered Hilt to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.description: This battered old sword hilt has seen better days. Before the hilt was snapped from the blade, it must've been a magnificent example of the blacksmith's art.$B$BThe graceful symbols and exotic gemstones decorating the hilt suggest that the weapon may have belonged to a powerful person. Surely, the Sunreavers would be interested in hearing about the recovery of such an artifact. Seek out their representatives at Quel'Delar's Rest, to the south of the Argent Tournament Grounds.
text.progress: What have you discovered?
text.completion: This came from the citadel? What was it doing there? This blade is certainly not of Scourge manufacture. Weapons of this quality can only be crafted by a few of Azeroth's creatures. We will have to consult them and see if they can help us identify it.
text.completed: Return to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.

text.title: 巨龙所知道的
text.objectives: 同龙眠神殿顶端的克拉苏斯交谈。
text.description: There's no mistaking it - this hilt comes from a powerful, ancient weapon, but which one? I do not recognize these particular markings, but we haven't hit a dead end yet.$B$BKorialstrasz, better known as Krasus, has long been a friend to the quel'dorei and the Kirin Tor. With his vast knowledge and resources, he's certain to know something. Travel to the top of Wyrmrest Temple and seek his counsel, then report to Magister Hathorel inside Sunreaver's Sanctuary in Dalaran.
text.completion: We must recover that book from the Silver Covenant. Without that book from Krasus, we stand little chance of solving the mystery of the sword in Icecrown or unlocking its power.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Filthy Animal in Dalaran.
text.objective1: Ask Krasus about the hilt's origins

text.title: 适当的伪装
text.objectives: 从山迪·格罗斯那里取得“借来的战袍”。
text.description: Getting you inside the Silver Enclave will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Silver Covenant tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. If we can get our hands on one, a simple enchantment will do the rest of the work.$B$BOn the balcony above Threads of Fate, you'll find Shandy Glossgleam. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.
text.progress: Was Shandy able to help you get a Silver Covenant tabard?
text.completion: I knew Shandy would find a way to make it work. Let me get this enchanted and ready for you to use. With any luck, the tabard's owner won't even know it's missing and Shandy will cover the rest of our tracks.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Filthy Animals in Dalaran.

english.objectives: Obtain a Borrowed Tabard from Shandy Glossgleam.
english.description: Getting you inside the Silver Enclave will be tougher than it appears. Only those who possess Silver Covenant tabards are permitted entry to sanctuary. I've helped him a few times in the past, so he owes me a favor. He handles laundry for a wide variety of people in the city. Maybe he can find a way to 'lend' you a tabard for a while.

english.completion: I knew Shandy would find a way to make it work. Let me get this enchanted and ready for you to use. With any luck, the tabard's owner won't even know it's missing and Shandy will cover the rest of our tracks.

text.title: The Silver Covenant's Scheme
text.objectives: Capture the Silver Covenant Orders.
text.description: One of my contacts in the Underbelly caught sight of a Silver Covenant agent gathering information at the Cantrips and Crows Tavern. Silver Covenant members aren't normally found in the sewers, so they must be plotting something.$B$BGo into the Underbelly, find this Silver Covenant agent, and eliminate him. Search the body for any information that might give us a lead on the location of that tome from Wyrmrest. We can't let those simpering Silver Covenant weaklings get it back to Icecrown before we do.
text.progress: Did you find anything of use on that agent?
text.completion: <Magister Hathorel reads the captured orders.>$B$BThe agent you intercepted was supposed to deliver the Wyrmrest tome to Icecrown, after meeting with one Arcanist Tybalin inside the Silver Enclave. We have to reclaim that book, $N, and we only have one chance before it leaves the city. We have to work quickly.
text.completed: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Filthy Animal in Dalaran.

text.title: Return To Myralion Sunblaze
text.objectives: Bring Ancient Dragonforged Blades to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.
text.description: We must get this book to Myralion Sunblade. Would you bring it to him? I cannot rely on anyone else to transport the book and you have proven adept at evading the Silver Covenant's men.$B$BTake it with you to Quel'Delar's Rest, south of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. Myralion will be waiting for you. If he can identify that blade, we may be able to claim it in the name of Aethas Sunreaver and show Dalaran and the Alliance that we will lead the charge against the Lich King.
text.progress: We've been expecting your return. What has kept you?
text.completion: <Myralion accepts the heavy book and begins leafing through it.>$B$BThose symbols on the blade seemed familiar and now there's little wonder why. This is certainly a dragon blade, gifted to one of the mortal races, but which blade is this, and how did it come to rest in Icecrown?
text.completed: Return to Myralion Sunblaze at Quel'Delar's Rest.

text.title: 利剑的重铸
text.objectives: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer, then combine them with the Remnants of Quel'Delar to create the Reforged Quel'Delar.
text.description: 我们不能让奎尔德拉就这样只是一堆耻辱的碎片。带上这把剑的残片和你发现的剑柄，到冰冠堡垒的萨隆矿坑去。$B$B巫妖王强迫许多奴隶在那里采掘熔炼萨隆邪铁矿石。我们要用萨隆邪铁重铸奎尔德拉。$B$B你必须取得注能的萨隆邪铁锭和熔炉之主的大锤，然后用它们在熔炉之主的铁砧上重铸这把剑。
text.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
text.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar in defiance of that Blood-Queen Lana'thel's pronouncement! Now, the blade must be tempered before we can show her the folly of her words.
text.completed: Return to Myralion Sunblaze in the Frozen Halls.

english.title: Reforging The Sword
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Infused Saronite Bars and the Forgemaster's Hammer, then combine them with the Remnants of Quel'Delar to create the Reforged Quel'Delar.
english.description: We cannot allow Quel'Delar to remain broken and disgraced. Take the remnants of the sword, along with the battered hilt you discovered, and venture into the Pit of Saron within Icecrown Citadel.$B$BIn the pit, the Lich King uses slaves to mine, process, and transform saronite ore. This infused saronite is what we will use to rebuild Quel'Delar.$B$BYou must gather bars of infused saronite and capture the forgemaster's hammer, then bring them to the forgemaster's anvil and reforge the sword.
english.progress: Were you able to reconstruct Quel'Delar?
english.completion: You have remade the blade of Quel'Delar in defiance of that Blood-Queen Lana'thel's pronouncement! Now, the blade must be tempered before we can show her the folly of her words.
english.completed: Return to Myralion Sunblaze in the Frozen Halls.

text.title: 锻造利剑
text.objectives: Temper the Re-forged Quel'Delar in the Crucible of Souls.
text.description: At last, the pieces of Quel'Delar are rejoined and the blade is whole, but it cannot see battle until you have tempered it. That jagged saronite edge is brittle and will shatter the moment it strikes anything.$B$BDeep in Icecrown Citadel's Forge of Souls is a place where the blade can safely be tempered. Take Quel'Delar with you to the abode of the Devourer of Souls and look for the crucible. Plunge the blade into the crucible to temper it and bring it back to me. I'll be waiting in The Frozen Halls.
text.progress: Until the sword is tempered, it will be useless.
text.completion: Tempering the sword should've restored the blade. Why hasn't it worked?
text.completed: Return to Myralion Sunblaze in the Frozen Halls.
